local VXLog, VXLogPet, VXField, VXRule, VXMoney, VXOnOff
do
    local T0 = os.clock()
    local BAR = "\226\148\130"
    local enabled = true

    local function pad(s, n)
        s = tostring(s == nil and "" or s)
        local len = #s
        if len >= n then return s:sub(1, n) end
        return s .. string.rep(" ", n - len)
    end

    local function money(v)
        v = tonumber(v) or 0
        local a = math.abs(v)
        for _, u in ipairs({ {1e12, "T"}, {1e9, "B"}, {1e6, "M"}, {1e3, "K"} }) do
            if a >= u[1] then
                local n = string.format("%.2f", v / u[1]):gsub("%.?0+$", "")
                return "$" .. n .. u[2]
            end
        end
        return "$" .. tostring(math.floor(v + 0.5))
    end
    VXMoney = money
    VXOnOff = function(v) return v and "Enabled" or "Disabled" end

    VXLog = function(system, msg)
        if not enabled then return end
        pcall(function()
            warn(string.format("[VX %6.2fs]  %s  %s  %s",
                os.clock() - T0, pad(system, 8), BAR, tostring(msg)))
        end)
    end

    VXField = function(system, label, value)
        label = tostring(label)
        local dots = 30 - #label
        if dots < 2 then dots = 2 end
        VXLog(system, label .. " " .. string.rep(".", dots) .. " " .. tostring(value))
    end

    VXRule = function(system, title)
        VXLog(system, "\226\148\128\226\148\128\226\148\128\226\148\128  " .. tostring(title) .. "  \226\148\128\226\148\128\226\148\128\226\148\128")
    end

    VXLogPet = function(i, pet)
        if not enabled or type(pet) ~= "table" then return end
        pcall(function()
            local traits = tostring(pet.traits or "None")
            if traits == "" then traits = "None" end
            VXLog("Brainrot", string.format("%s  %s  %s  %s  %s  %s",
                pad(string.format("%02d", tonumber(i) or 0), 3),
                pad(pet.petName or pet.name or "?", 30),
                pad(pet.mpsText or pet.genText or "$0/s", 11),
                pad(money(pet.petValue or pet.value or pet.price or 0), 10),
                pad(pet.mutation or "None", 12),
                traits))
        end)
    end
end

function SharedState.OnBrainrotList(fn)
    if type(fn) ~= "function" then return end
    local t = SharedState.BrainrotListListeners
    t[#t + 1] = fn
end
function SharedState.NotifyBrainrotList()
    for _, fn in ipairs(SharedState.BrainrotListListeners) do pcall(fn) end
end

local function mountGui(gui)
    pcall(function()
        if syn and syn.protect_gui then syn.protect_gui(gui) end
    end)
    pcall(function()
        if typeof(protectgui) == "function" then protectgui(gui) end
    end)
    gui.Parent = VXGui
    _G.VXMountedGuis = _G.VXMountedGuis or {}
    table.insert(_G.VXMountedGuis, gui)
    if _G.VXPaletteAdopt then pcall(_G.VXPaletteAdopt, gui) end
    return gui
end

pcall(function() math.randomseed(math.floor((os.clock() * 1e7) % 2147483647) + 7919) end)
local _vxNameCache = {}
local function _vxName(key)
    local v = _vxNameCache[key]
    if not v then
        local t = {}
        for i = 1, math.random(10, 16) do
            t[i] = (math.random(0, 1) == 0) and string.char(math.random(65, 90))
            or string.char(math.random(97, 122))
        end
        v = table.concat(t)
        _vxNameCache[key] = v
    end
    return v
end

-- =====================================================================
-- HOOK REMOVIDO  (deteccao + FireServer engolido)
--
-- O que estava aqui: hookfunction(FireServer) instalado no load, em CADA
-- chamada de FireServer do jogo inteiro, so pra derrubar mensagens
-- "StopTrying" de um remote de nome com 67 caracteres. A captura do
-- reset-remote, que era o outro motivo do hook, ja tinha sido removida
-- (o comentario antigo aqui dizia isso) -- entao sobrava esse unico uso.
--
-- DOIS problemas, os dois graves:
--
--  1. DETECCAO. O update do jogo pos uma canary de anti-cheat que faz
--     integrity-check no caminho de fire de remote. QUALQUER hook de
--     FireServer/__namecall marca a conta -- e o erro "Unable to cast
--     Array to bool" no AssetStreamController e o sintoma. Marca mesmo
--     sem o hook chegar a interceptar nada. Ficar hook-free e a unica
--     saida, e e o que o sabcom faz (ele apagou exatamente este hook
--     pelo mesmo motivo).
--
--  2. FIRESERVER ENGOLIDO EM SILENCIO. O corpo do hook terminava em
--
--         if orig then return orig(self, ...) end
--
--     sem else. Se hookfunction devolvesse nil/false com o hook JA
--     instalado -- acontece em varios executores -- entao
--     orig = getgenv()._vanish_fs_original, que na primeira execucao e
--     nil tambem. Dai TODO FireServer do jogo virava no-op silencioso:
--     o Quantum Cloner incluso. Era por isso que o clone "nao fazia
--     nada" sem erro nenhum no console.
--
-- Perde-se o bloqueio de "StopTrying". O sabcom aceita essa troca e nao
-- repoe nada no lugar: nao vale uma conta marcada.
-- =====================================================================
do
    pcall(function()
        local r = _G.VXResetRemote
        if r ~= nil and (typeof(r) ~= "Instance" or not r:IsDescendantOf(game)) then
            _G.VXResetRemote = nil
            _G.VXCapturedResetRemote = nil
        end
        _G.VXFirstRE = nil
    end)

    -- Se uma execucao ANTERIOR nesta mesma sessao ja instalou o hook, ele
    -- continua vivo -- parar de instalar nao o desfaz. restorefunction
    -- desfaz sem re-hookar (re-hookar pra restaurar tocaria no mesmo
    -- caminho que a canary vigia). Sem restorefunction, so rejoin limpa.
    pcall(function()
        local prev = getgenv and getgenv()._vanish_fs_original
        if prev and restorefunction then
            restorefunction(Instance.new("RemoteEvent").FireServer)
            getgenv()._vanish_fs_original = nil
        end
    end)
end

do
    local _xchan
    local _lastTry, _attempts = 0, 0
    local _deepScans, _lastDeep = 0, 0
    local _mod

    local MAX_ATTEMPTS, RETRY_GAP = 40, 0.5
    local BOOT_T0, BOOT_BURST, BOOT_GAP = os.clock(), 3.0, 0.10
    local MAX_DEEP, DEEP_GAP = 3, 1.5

    local function _retryGap()
        if (os.clock() - BOOT_T0) < BOOT_BURST then return BOOT_GAP end
        return RETRY_GAP
    end

    local function _channelCount(t)
        if type(t) ~= "table" then return 0 end
        local ok, hits = pcall(function()
            local h, n = 0, 0
            for _, v in next, t do
                n = n + 1
                if type(v) == "table" and type(rawget(v, "CacheTable")) == "table" then
                    h = h + 1
                end
                if n >= 200 then break end
            end
            return h
        end)
        return (ok and hits) or 0
    end

    local function _module()
        if _mod then return _mod end
        if VXPre and type(VXPre.Sync) == "table" then _mod = VXPre.Sync; return _mod end
        local ok, m = pcall(function()
            return require(ReplicatedStorage.Packages.Synchronizer)
        end)
        if ok and type(m) == "table" then _mod = m; return _mod end
        local ok2, m2 = pcall(function()
            local pkgs = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Packages")
            local sync = pkgs and pkgs:FindFirstChild("Synchronizer")
            if not sync then return nil end
            return require(sync)
        end)
        if ok2 and type(m2) == "table" then _mod = m2 end
        return _mod
    end

    local function _probe(mod)
        local gu = (debug and debug.getupvalue) or getupvalue
        if type(gu) ~= "function" then return nil, 0, nil end
        local best, bestN, where = nil, 0, nil
        local function consider(t, tag)
            local n = _channelCount(t)
            if n > bestN then best, bestN, where = t, n, tag end
        end
        local ok, up = pcall(gu, mod.Get, 9)
        if ok and type(up) == "table" then
            consider(rawget(up, 3), "Get/9/3")
            if bestN > 0 then return best, bestN, where end
            consider(up, "Get/9")
            if bestN > 0 then return best, bestN, where end
        end
        return nil, 0, nil
    end

    local function _deepScan(mod)
        local gu = (debug and debug.getupvalue) or getupvalue
        if type(gu) ~= "function" then return nil, 0, nil end
        local best, bestN, where = nil, 0, nil
        local function consider(t, tag)
            local n = _channelCount(t)
            if n > bestN then best, bestN, where = t, n, tag end
        end
        for fname, fn in next, mod do
            if type(fn) == "function" then
                for i = 1, 24 do
                    local o, u = pcall(gu, fn, i)
                    if not o then break end
                    if type(u) == "table" then
                        consider(u, tostring(fname) .. "/" .. i)
                        for j = 1, 4 do
                            consider(rawget(u, j), tostring(fname) .. "/" .. i .. "/" .. j)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return best, bestN, where
    end

    local function _chans()
        if _xchan then return _xchan end
        if _G.VXDisablePlotScan == true then return nil end
        if (os.clock() - _lastTry) <= _retryGap() then return nil end
        _lastTry = os.clock()

        local mod = _module()
        if not mod or _attempts >= MAX_ATTEMPTS then return nil end
        _attempts = _attempts + 1

        local found, n, where = _probe(mod)
        if not found and _deepScans < MAX_DEEP and (os.clock() - _lastDeep) > DEEP_GAP then
            _lastDeep = os.clock()
            _deepScans = _deepScans + 1
            found, n, where = _deepScan(mod)
        end

        if found then
            _xchan = found
            _G.VXSyncDiag = string.format("bypassed via %s - %d channels (attempt %d)",
                tostring(where), n, _attempts)
            _G.VXLog("Scanner", "Synchronizer " .. _G.VXSyncDiag)
        elseif _attempts >= MAX_ATTEMPTS then
            _G.VXSyncDiag = "channels NOT found after " .. MAX_ATTEMPTS
            .. " attempts - plot scanning is disabled"
            _G.VXLog("Scanner", "Synchronizer " .. _G.VXSyncDiag)
        end
        return _xchan
    end

    _G.VXSyncAll = function() return _chans() end

    _G.VXSyncGet = function(idx)
        local t = _chans()
        if not t or idx == nil then return nil end
        local ok, cd = pcall(rawget, t, idx)
        if ok and type(cd) == "table" then return cd end
        local ok2, cd2 = pcall(function() return t[idx] end)
        if ok2 and type(cd2) == "table" then return cd2 end
        return nil
    end

    _G.VXSProp = function(ch, key)
        if type(ch) ~= "table" or key == nil then return nil end
        local ct = rawget(ch, "CacheTable")
        if type(ct) ~= "table" then
            local okC, c2 = pcall(function() return ch.CacheTable end)
            if okC and type(c2) == "table" then ct = c2 end
        end
        if type(ct) ~= "table" then return nil end
        local v = rawget(ct, key)
        if v ~= nil then return v end
        local okV, v2 = pcall(function() return ct[key] end)
        if okV then return v2 end
        return nil
    end

    _G.VXRawCT = function(plotName)
        local c = _G.VXSyncGet(plotName)
        if not c then return nil end
        return rawget(c, "CacheTable")
    end

    _G.VXGetPlotChannel = function(plotName) return _G.VXSyncGet(plotName) end

    -- ========================================================
    --  CANAL A PARTIR DO *Instance* DO PLOT
    --
    --  Recebe o Model, nao o nome: o atributo Order so existe no Model.
    --  Todo o hub resolvia canal por plot.Name (o UUID do Model), mas o
    --  jogo passou a nomear os canais como Plot1, Plot2... -- entao
    --  VXSyncGet(uuid) devolvia nil pra TODAS as bases, o warm-up abaixo
    --  nunca aquecia nada e o scan de plot morria na primeira linha.
    --
    --  UUID PRIMEIRO de proposito: e a chave do proprio Model, entao se
    --  resolve e inequivocamente o canal DAQUELE plot. "Plot"..Order e um
    --  palpite -- se o Order for 0-based ou estiver deslocado da numeracao
    --  dos canais, casa os podiums de um plot com os slots de outro.
    -- ========================================================
    _G.VXPlotChannel = function(plot)
        if typeof(plot) ~= "Instance" then return nil end
        local ch = _G.VXSyncGet(plot.Name)
        if type(ch) == "table" then return ch end
        local ord
        pcall(function() ord = plot:GetAttribute("Order") end)
        if ord ~= nil then
            local ch2 = _G.VXSyncGet("Plot" .. tostring(ord))
            if type(ch2) == "table" then return ch2 end
        end
        return nil
    end
    _G.VXGetPlotAnimalList = function(plotName)
        local ct = _G.VXRawCT(plotName)
        local al = ct and ct.AnimalList
        return type(al) == "table" and al or nil
    end
end

task.spawn(function()
    local plots
    local t0 = os.clock()
    repeat
        plots = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")
        if not plots then task.wait(0.05) end
    until plots or (os.clock() - t0) > 25
    if not plots then return end
    local done, warmT0 = {}, os.clock()
    while (os.clock() - warmT0) < 15 do
        local kids = plots:GetChildren()
        local pending = false
        for _, plot in ipairs(kids) do
            if not done[plot.Name] then
                local ch = _G.VXPlotChannel and _G.VXPlotChannel(plot)
                if ch then
                    pcall(function() if ch.Get then ch:Get("AnimalList"); ch:Get("Owner") end end)
                    local al = _G.VXSProp and _G.VXSProp(ch, "AnimalList")
                    if al ~= nil then done[plot.Name] = true else pending = true end
                else
                    pending = true
                end
            end
        end
        if not pending and #kids > 0 then break end
        task.wait(0.05)
    end
    local n = 0
    for _ in pairs(done) do n = n + 1 end
    _G.VXLog("Scanner", "Plot data force-loaded - " .. n .. " channels warm")
end)

task.spawn(function()
    if not Workspace.StreamingEnabled then
        _G.VXLog("Scanner", "Stream-in skipped - StreamingEnabled is off")
        return
    end
    local plots
    local t0 = os.clock()
    repeat
        plots = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")
        if not plots then task.wait(0.1) end
    until plots or (os.clock() - t0) > 25
    if not plots then return end
    local function plotPos(plot)
        local okp, pv = pcall(function() return plot:GetPivot().Position end)
        if okp and pv and pv.Magnitude > 1 then return pv end
        if plot.PrimaryPart then return plot.PrimaryPart.Position end
        local bp = plot:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
        return bp and bp.Position or nil
    end
    local pending = 0
    for _, plot in ipairs(plots:GetChildren()) do
        local pos = plotPos(plot)
        if pos then
            pending = pending + 1
            task.spawn(function()
                pcall(function() LocalPlayer:RequestStreamAroundAsync(pos) end)
                pending = pending - 1
            end)
        end
    end
    local sw = os.clock()
    while pending > 0 and os.clock() - sw < 10 do task.wait(0.05) end
    _G.VXLog("Scanner", "Plot stream-in requested")
end)

_G.PATHFINDING_ACTIVE = _G.PATHFINDING_ACTIVE or false

do
    local HIDDEN_KEYS = {
        "identifyexecutor",
        "islclosure",
        "iscclosure",
        "hookfunction",
        "getgenv",
        "getrenv",
    }

    _G.VXSafeNetCall = function(fn, ...)
        if type(fn) ~= "function" then return false end
        local env = getgenv and getgenv() or _G
        local saved = {}
        for _, key in ipairs(HIDDEN_KEYS) do
            saved[key] = rawget(env, key)
            rawset(env, key, nil)
        end
        local ok, a, b, c, d, e = pcall(fn, ...)
        for k, v in next, saved do
            if v ~= nil then
                rawset(env, k, v)
            end
        end
        if ok then return true, a, b, c, d, e end
        return false, a
    end

    local _hubNetModule
    local function getVXNetModule()
        if _hubNetModule then return _hubNetModule end
        local ok, mod = _G.VXSafeNetCall(function()
            return require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
                :WaitForChild("Packages"):WaitForChild("Net")
                :WaitForChild("Net"))
        end)
        if ok and type(mod) == "table" then _hubNetModule = mod end
        return _hubNetModule
    end

    -- ============================================================
    --  A reserva daqui era FIRAR O ALIAS MORTO.
    --
    --  Terminava com
    --      local remote = netFolder:FindFirstChild(fullPath)   -- "RE/Nome"
    --      if remote then remote:FireServer(...); return true end
    --
    --  O "RE/Nome" em texto claro no folder Net e um ALIAS MORTO: existe,
    --  aceita FireServer e nao faz absolutamente nada no servidor. Como a
    --  funcao devolvia true, o chamador dava a acao por concluida. Falha
    --  silenciosa perfeita.
    --
    --  Agora vai primeiro pelo resolvedor portado do sabcom (_G.VXNet:
    --  direto sem hash -> hash do proprio jogo -> RE/RF/URE), depois pelo
    --  modulo Net do jogo, e nao ha mais reserva por alias.
    -- ============================================================
    _G.VXNetFire = function(path, ...)
        local args = { ... }
        local ok, delivered = _G.VXSafeNetCall(function()
            local fullPath = path
            if fullPath:sub(1, 3) ~= "RE/" and fullPath:sub(1, 3) ~= "RF/" then
                fullPath = "RE/" .. fullPath
            end
            local bare = fullPath:sub(4)

            local vx = _G.VXNet
            if vx and type(vx.GetRemote) == "function" then
                local r = vx:GetRemote(bare)
                if r then
                    if r:IsA("RemoteFunction") then
                        r:InvokeServer(table.unpack(args))
                    else
                        r:FireServer(table.unpack(args))
                    end
                    return true
                end
            end

            local net = getVXNetModule()
            if net then
                if type(net.RemoteEvent) == "function" then
                    local re = net:RemoteEvent(bare)
                    if re and re.FireServer then re:FireServer(table.unpack(args)); return true end
                end
                if type(net.FireServer) == "function" then
                    net:FireServer(fullPath, table.unpack(args)); return true
                end
            end
            return false
        end)
        return (ok and delivered) and true or false
    end

    _G.VXFireRemote = function(remote, ...)
        if not remote or not remote.FireServer then return false end
        local args = { ... }
        return _G.VXSafeNetCall(function() return remote:FireServer(table.unpack(args)) end)
    end

    _G.VXInvokeRemote = function(remote, ...)
        if not remote or not remote.InvokeServer then return false end
        local args = { ... }
        return _G.VXSafeNetCall(function() return remote:InvokeServer(table.unpack(args)) end)
    end

    _G.VXFirePrompt = function(prompt, holdTime)
        if not prompt or not prompt.Parent then return end
        _G.VXSafeNetCall(function()
            holdTime = holdTime or 0
            if typeof(fireproximityprompt) == "function" then
                pcall(function() fireproximityprompt(prompt, holdTime) end)
            elseif typeof(firesignal) == "function" then
                pcall(firesignal, prompt.PromptButtonHoldBegan)
                if holdTime > 0 then task.wait(holdTime) end
                pcall(firesignal, prompt.Triggered)
                pcall(firesignal, prompt.PromptButtonHoldEnded)
            end
        end)
    end
end

_G.VXFpsCap = _G.VXFpsCap or 999
do
    local function applyCap()
        if not setfpscap then return end
        pcall(setfpscap, tonumber(_G.VXFpsCap) or 999)
    end
    applyCap()
    task.spawn(function()
        while true do
            applyCap()
            task.wait(2)
        end
    end)
end

_G.VXStripCapable = (type(getconnections) == "function") and (type(debug) == "table" and type(debug.getinfo) == "function")
_G.VXStripNow = _G.VXStripNow or function() end
task.spawn(function()
    if not _G.VXStripCapable then return end
    local getinfo = debug.getinfo
    local _cr = cloneref or function(x) return x end
    local lp = _cr(game:GetService("Players")).LocalPlayer
    while not lp do task.wait(0.2); lp = _cr(game:GetService("Players")).LocalPlayer end
    local STRIP_SIGS = { "CFrame", "Position" }

    local function isWatcherSource(src)
        return src == "=ReplicatedFirst.test"
    end

    local function stripPart(part)
        if not part then return end
        for _, sig in ipairs(STRIP_SIGS) do
            local okC, conns = pcall(getconnections, part:GetPropertyChangedSignal(sig))
            if okC and type(conns) == "table" then
                for _, c in ipairs(conns) do
                    local f = c.Function
                    if f and c.Enabled then
                        local okInfo, info = pcall(getinfo, f)
                        if okInfo and info and isWatcherSource(info.source) then
                            pcall(function() c:Disable() end)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    local function Strip()
        local char = lp.Character
        stripPart(char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
    end
    _G.VXStripNow = function() pcall(Strip) end
    while true do
        pcall(Strip)
        task.wait(2)
    end
end)

local function isFMLYPlayer(player)
    if not player then return false end
    local dn = (type(player.DisplayName) == "string" and player.DisplayName or ""):lower()
    local un = (type(player.Name) == "string" and player.Name or ""):lower()
    return (dn:find("fmly", 1, true) ~= nil) or (un:find("fmly", 1, true) ~= nil)
end
_G.VXIsFMLY = isFMLYPlayer

local function isMobile()
    return UserInputService.TouchEnabled and not UserInputService.KeyboardEnabled and not UserInputService.MouseEnabled
end

--  =======================================================================
--  PALETTE SWITCH
--
--  Every colour literal in this file is written in the Purple scheme. Gold is
--  expressed as a remap table -- Purple on the left, the gold/silver value it
--  replaced on the right.
--
--  The switch works by shadowing Color3 for the rest of this chunk. Repainting
--  the GUI tree after the fact was not enough: colours captured into locals at
--  build time (toggle ON/OFF colours, hover tween targets, gradient stops held
--  in closures) are not reachable from any instance property, so they stayed
--  purple and reasserted themselves on the next hover or tween. Remapping at
--  the constructor means every literal -- captured or not -- is already the
--  right colour before anything is built.
--
--  This is a local shadow, so it applies to this script only and never touches
--  the game's own Color3.
--  =======================================================================

local VX_PALETTE_HEX = {
    A855F7 = "C49A3E", E6DAFF = "C9CCD3", C696FF = "ECD292",
    B36BF5 = "CDA54A", C79BFF = "E0A878", A99BC4 = "9EA1A8",
    ["6E5C92"] = "74787F", ["9B8AB8"] = "8F929A", E8DEFF = "E0E4EC",
}

local _vxToGold, _vxToPurple = {}, {}
local _vxHexToGold, _vxHexToPurple = {}, {}
do
    local function key(r, g, b) return r * 65536 + g * 256 + b end
    for _, e in ipairs(VX_PALETTE_PAIRS) do
        local pr, pg, pb, gr, gg, gb = e[1], e[2], e[3], e[4], e[5], e[6]
        _vxToGold[key(pr, pg, pb)]   = { gr, gg, gb }
        _vxToPurple[key(gr, gg, gb)] = { pr, pg, pb }
    end
    for pur, gold in pairs(VX_PALETTE_HEX) do
        _vxHexToGold[pur:upper()]    = gold:upper()
        _vxHexToPurple[gold:upper()] = pur:upper()
    end
end

--  Read the saved scheme straight off disk: Config is not built yet, and the
--  shadow has to be in place before the first literal is evaluated.
local _vxTheme = "Purple"
pcall(function()
    if isfile and readfile and isfile(FileName) then
        local raw = readfile(FileName)
        if type(raw) == "string" and raw:find('"ColorTheme"%s*:%s*"Gold"') then
            _vxTheme = "Gold"
        end
    end
end)
_G.VXPaletteName = _vxTheme

--  Declared at chunk scope so the rebind below shadows Color3 for the rest of
--  THIS file only. Assigning the bare global here would repaint the whole
--  client, which is emphatically not the intent.
local Color3 = Color3
do
    local realColor3 = Color3
    local realFromRGB = realColor3.fromRGB
    if _vxTheme == "Gold" then
        local shadowed = setmetatable({}, { __index = realColor3 })
        shadowed.fromRGB = function(r, g, b)
            r = tonumber(r) or 0; g = tonumber(g) or 0; b = tonumber(b) or 0
            local hit = _vxToGold[math.floor(r) * 65536 + math.floor(g) * 256 + math.floor(b)]
            if hit then return realFromRGB(hit[1], hit[2], hit[3]) end
            return realFromRGB(r, g, b)
        end
        Color3 = shadowed
    end
end

--  RichText markup carries its colours inside the string, so those are
--  rewritten at the point of assignment instead.
function _G.VXPaletteText(txt)
    if _G.VXPaletteName ~= "Gold" or type(txt) ~= "string" then return txt end
    return (txt:gsub("#(%x%x%x%x%x%x)", function(h)
        return "#" .. (_vxHexToGold[h:upper()] or h)
    end))
end


do
    local legacy = {
        [FileName]      = "VergentX Full Configuration.json",
        ["VX_config.json"] = "VergentX_config.json",
    }
    if type(isfile) == "function" and type(readfile) == "function"
    and type(writefile) == "function" then
        for newName, oldName in pairs(legacy) do
            pcall(function()
                if not isfile(newName) and isfile(oldName) then
                    writefile(newName, readfile(oldName))
                end
            end)
        end
    end
end

local _VXDefaultSnapshot
do
    local function deep(t)
        if type(t) ~= "table" then return t end
        local o = {}
        for k, v in pairs(t) do o[k] = deep(v) end
        return o
    end
    _VXDefaultSnapshot = deep(DefaultConfig)
end
local Config = DefaultConfig

if isfile and isfile(FileName) then
    pcall(function()

        local src = FileName
        local ok, decoded = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(src)) end)
        if not ok then return end
        for k, v in pairs(DefaultConfig) do
            if decoded[k] == nil then decoded[k] = v end
        end
        if decoded.TpSettings then
            for k, v in pairs(DefaultConfig.TpSettings) do
                if decoded.TpSettings[k] == nil then decoded.TpSettings[k] = v end
            end
        end
        if decoded.Positions then
            for k, v in pairs(DefaultConfig.Positions) do
                if decoded.Positions[k] == nil then decoded.Positions[k] = v end
            end
        end
        if decoded.HideAdminControl == nil then decoded.HideAdminControl = true end
        -- ====================================================
        --  LISTA VAZIA SALVA NAO E ESCOLHA, E FALTA DE ESCOLHA.
        --
        --  O merge acima so cobre chave AUSENTE (decoded[k] == nil).
        --  Uma PriorityList = {} gravada por quem nunca abriu a aba
        --  Priority passa por esse teste sendo uma tabela valida, e
        --  entao ganha da lista padrao -- todo save antigo continuaria
        --  sem lista nenhuma.
        --
        --  Mesma regra do resto do hub: so sobrescreve o padrao quando
        --  o save tem entradas de verdade.
        -- ====================================================
        if type(decoded.PriorityList) ~= "table" or #decoded.PriorityList == 0 then
            decoded.PriorityList = VXDefaultPriorityCopy()
            decoded.PriorityListInitialized = true
        end
        Config = decoded
    end)
end

_G.VXApplyFactoryDefaults = function(cfg)
    if type(cfg) ~= "table" then return cfg end
    local function deep(t)
        if type(t) ~= "table" then return t end
        local o = {}
        for k, v in pairs(t) do o[k] = deep(v) end
        return o
    end
    local src = _VXDefaultSnapshot or {}
    for k in pairs(cfg) do
        if src[k] == nil then cfg[k] = nil end
    end
    for k, v in pairs(src) do
        cfg[k] = deep(v)
    end
    cfg.HideAdminPanel = true
    cfg.HideAdminControl = true
    cfg.HideBrainrotSelection = true
    cfg.Positions = cfg.Positions or {}
    cfg.Positions.StatusHUD = { X = 0.5, Y = 0.08 }
    return cfg
end

if isfile and not isfile(FileName) then
    _G.VXApplyFactoryDefaults(Config)
end

_G.VXBootT0 = _G.VXBootT0 or os.clock()

function _G.VXDelayFrom(delayKey, fn)
    if _G.VX_INSTANT_BOOT then
        task.spawn(fn)
        return
    end
    task.spawn(function()
        local d = tonumber(Config[delayKey]) or 0
        local left = d - (os.clock() - _G.VXBootT0)
        if left > 0 then task.wait(left) end
        fn()
    end)
end

_G.VXApplyFOV = function()
    pcall(function()
        local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera
        if cam and Config.FOV and cam.FieldOfView ~= Config.FOV then
            cam.FieldOfView = Config.FOV
        end
    end)
end
_G.VXFovReady = false

    _G.VXApplyFOV()
    _G.VXFovReady = true
end)
do
    local _fovFrame = 0
    RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not _G.VXFovReady then return end
        _fovFrame = _fovFrame + 1
        if _fovFrame < 6 then return end
        _fovFrame = 0
        local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera
        if cam and Config.FOV and cam.FieldOfView ~= Config.FOV then
            _G.VXApplyFOV()
        end
    end)
end

do
    local _myPlot, _myPlotAt = nil, 0

    local function isYourBase(plot)
        local sign = plot:FindFirstChild("PlotSign")
        local yb = sign and sign:FindFirstChild("YourBase")
        return yb ~= nil and yb:IsA("BillboardGui") and yb.Enabled == true
    end

    local function ownerFromSign(plot)
        local sign = plot:FindFirstChild("PlotSign")
        local sg = sign and sign:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SurfaceGui", true)
        local label = sg and sg:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextLabel", true)
        if not label then return nil end
        local txt = label.Text
        if not txt or txt == "" or txt:lower():find("empty") then return nil end
        local nick = txt:match("^(.-)'") or txt
        nick = nick:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
        if nick == "" then return nil end
        return nick
    end

    local function ownerFromChannel(plot)
        local name, uid = nil, nil
        pcall(function()
            local get = _G.VXSyncGet
            if not get then return end
            local ch = get(plot.Name)
            if not ch then return end
            local own = _G.VXSProp(ch, "Owner")
            if own == nil then return end
            if typeof(own) == "Instance" and own:IsA("Player") then
                name, uid = own.DisplayName, own.UserId
            elseif type(own) == "table" then
                if own.UserId then
                    uid = own.UserId
                    local p = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(own.UserId)
                    name = (p and p.DisplayName) or own.Name
                elseif own.Name then
                    local p = Players:FindFirstChild(own.Name)
                    if p then name, uid = p.DisplayName, p.UserId else name = own.Name end
                end
            elseif type(own) == "number" then
                uid = own
                local p = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(own)
                name = p and p.DisplayName or nil
            elseif type(own) == "string" and own ~= "" then
                local p = Players:FindFirstChild(own)
                if p then name, uid = p.DisplayName, p.UserId else name = own end
            end
        end)
        return name, uid
    end

    _G.VXPlotOwner = function(plot)
        if not plot then return nil, nil end
        local cName, cUid = ownerFromChannel(plot)
        if cName or cUid then return cName, cUid end
        if isYourBase(plot) then return LocalPlayer.DisplayName, LocalPlayer.UserId end
        local nick = ownerFromSign(plot)
        if nick then
            for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if p.DisplayName == nick or p.Name == nick then return p.DisplayName, p.UserId end
            end
            return nick, nil
        end
        return nil, nil
    end

    _G.VXPlotOwnerPlayer = function(plot)
        local name, uid = _G.VXPlotOwner(plot)
        if uid then
            local p = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(uid)
            if p then return p end
        end
        if name then
            for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if p.DisplayName == name or p.Name == name then return p end
            end
        end
        return nil
    end

    _G.VXFindMyPlot = function()
        if _myPlot and _myPlot.Parent and (os.clock() - _myPlotAt) < 5 then return _myPlot end
        local plots = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")
        if not plots then return nil end
        local kids = plots:GetChildren()

        for _, plot in ipairs(kids) do
            local _, uid = ownerFromChannel(plot)
            if uid and uid == LocalPlayer.UserId then
                _myPlot, _myPlotAt = plot, os.clock()
                return plot
            end
        end

        for _, plot in ipairs(kids) do
            if isYourBase(plot) then
                _myPlot, _myPlotAt = plot, os.clock()
                return plot
            end
        end

        local hit, matches = nil, 0
        local me1, me2 = LocalPlayer.DisplayName:lower(), LocalPlayer.Name:lower()
        for _, plot in ipairs(kids) do
            local nick = ownerFromSign(plot)
            if nick then
                nick = nick:lower()
                if nick == me1 or nick == me2 then matches = matches + 1; hit = plot end
            end
        end
        if matches == 1 then
            _myPlot, _myPlotAt = hit, os.clock()
            return hit
        end
        return nil
    end
end

_G.VXRevealFns = {}
_G.VXGuiRevealed = false
function VXOnGuiReveal(fn)
    if _G.VXGuiRevealed then task.spawn(fn) else table.insert(_G.VXRevealFns, fn) end
end
function VXFireGuiReveal()
    if _G.VXGuiRevealed then return end
    _G.VXGuiRevealed = true
    for _, fn in ipairs(_G.VXRevealFns) do task.spawn(fn) end
    table.clear(_G.VXRevealFns)
end

local VX_FADE_PROPS = {
    Frame = { "BackgroundTransparency" },
    CanvasGroup = { "GroupTransparency", "BackgroundTransparency" },
    ScrollingFrame = { "BackgroundTransparency", "ScrollBarImageTransparency" },
    TextLabel = { "BackgroundTransparency", "TextTransparency", "TextStrokeTransparency" },
    TextButton = { "BackgroundTransparency", "TextTransparency", "TextStrokeTransparency" },
    TextBox = { "BackgroundTransparency", "TextTransparency", "TextStrokeTransparency" },
    ImageLabel = { "BackgroundTransparency", "ImageTransparency" },
    ImageButton = { "BackgroundTransparency", "ImageTransparency" },
    ViewportFrame = { "BackgroundTransparency", "ImageTransparency" },
    UIStroke = { "Transparency" },
}
function VXFadeReveal(root, dur)
    if not root or not root.Parent then return end
    if _G.VX_INSTANT_BOOT then return end

    local now = os.clock()
    local o = root
    while o and not o:IsA("PlayerGui") do
        local t = o:GetAttribute("VXFadeAt")
        if t and now - t < 0.6 then return end
        if o:IsA("ScreenGui") then break end
        o = o.Parent
    end
    root:SetAttribute("VXFadeAt", now)
    local items = {}
    local function grab(inst)
        local props = VX_FADE_PROPS[inst.ClassName]
        if not props then return end
        for _, p in ipairs(props) do
            local v = inst[p]
            if v < 1 then
                items[#items + 1] = { o = inst, p = p, v = v }
                inst[p] = 1
            end
        end
    end
    pcall(grab, root)
    for _, d in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do pcall(grab, d) end
    local ti = TweenInfo.new(dur or 0.45, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear)
    for _, it in ipairs(items) do
        TweenService:Create(it.o, ti, { [it.p] = it.v }):Play()
    end
end

_G.VXBootT0 = _G.VXBootT0 or os.clock()
_G.VXRevealedGuis = {}
function VXScheduleGuiReveal(name, delayKey, shouldShow)

    VXOnGuiReveal(function()
        --  d is read again by the log line at the end of this function, so it
        --  has to live out here. It used to be scoped inside the if, which
        --  made it a nil global at the format call -- and since VX_INSTANT_BOOT
        --  is true the branch never ran, so it was nil every single time.
        local d = tonumber(Config[delayKey]) or 0
        if not _G.VX_INSTANT_BOOT then
            local left = d - (os.clock() - _G.VXBootT0)
            if left > 0 then task.wait(left) end
        end

        local gui = VXGui:FindFirstChild(name)
        if not gui then
            local done = false
            local conn
            conn = VXGui.ChildAdded:Connect(function(c)
                if c.Name == name then
                    gui = c
                    done = true
                    if conn then conn:Disconnect() conn = nil end
                end
            end)
            gui = gui or VXGui:FindFirstChild(name)
            if not gui then
                local t0 = os.clock()
                while not done and (os.clock() - t0) < 5 do
                    gui = VXGui:FindFirstChild(name)
                    if gui then break end
                    RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
                end
            end
            if conn then conn:Disconnect() conn = nil end
            gui = gui or VXGui:FindFirstChild(name)
        end

        _G.VXRevealedGuis[name] = true
        local shown = false
        if gui and shouldShow() and not gui.Enabled then
            VXFadeReveal(gui)
            gui.Enabled = true
            shown = true
        end
        if _G.VXLog then
            _G.VXLog("GUI", string.format("%s after %.1fs delay%s",
                (tostring(delayKey):gsub("Delay$", "")), d, shown and "" or " (hidden by config)"))
        end

        if _G.VXReflowNotifs then
            task.defer(function() pcall(_G.VXReflowNotifs) end)
            task.delay(0.2, function() pcall(_G.VXReflowNotifs) end)
        end
    end)
end

local _DM = { conns = {}, sky = nil, origSky = nil, busy = false, on = false }

local function _dmClearConns()
    for _, c in ipairs(_DM.conns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
    _DM.conns = {}
end

local function _dmEnsureSky(lighting)
    if _DM.sky and _DM.sky.Parent == lighting then
        for _, o in ipairs(lighting:GetChildren()) do
            if o:IsA("Sky") and o ~= _DM.sky then
                if not _DM.origSky then _DM.origSky = o end
                o.Parent = nil
            end
        end
        return
    end
    for _, o in ipairs(lighting:GetChildren()) do
        if o:IsA("Sky") then
            if not _DM.origSky then _DM.origSky = o end
            o.Parent = nil
        end
    end
    local sky = Instance.new("Sky")
    sky.Name = _vxName("VXDarkSky")
    sky.SkyboxBk = ""; sky.SkyboxDn = ""; sky.SkyboxFt = ""
    sky.SkyboxLf = ""; sky.SkyboxRt = ""; sky.SkyboxUp = ""
    sky.StarCount = 0
    sky.CelestialBodiesShown = false
    sky.MoonTextureId = ""
    sky.SunTextureId = ""
    sky.Parent = lighting
    _DM.sky = sky
end

local function _dmApply()
    if _DM.busy then return end
    _DM.busy = true
    pcall(function()
        local lighting = Services.Lighting
        local strength = Config.NightVisionStrength or 100

        lighting.ClockTime = 0
        lighting.GlobalShadows = true
        lighting.FogStart = 0

        if strength == 0 then
            lighting.Brightness = 1
            lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(127, 127, 127)
            lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(127, 127, 127)
            lighting.FogEnd = 100000
        else
            lighting.Brightness = 0
            local ambientValue = math.floor(120 * (1 - (strength / 100)))
            local ambientColor = Color3.fromRGB(ambientValue, ambientValue, ambientValue)
            lighting.Ambient = ambientColor
            lighting.OutdoorAmbient = ambientColor
            lighting.FogEnd = 9e9
        end

        lighting.ColorShift_Top = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
        lighting.ColorShift_Bottom = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
        lighting.FogColor = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
        pcall(function() lighting.ExposureCompensation = 0 end)

        for _, o in ipairs(lighting:GetChildren()) do
            if o:IsA("Atmosphere") or o:IsA("Clouds") then o:Destroy() end
        end
        pcall(function()
            local terrain = Workspace:FindFirstChildOfClass("Terrain")
            if terrain then
                for _, o in ipairs(terrain:GetChildren()) do
                    if o:IsA("Clouds") then o:Destroy() end
                end
            end
        end)

        _dmEnsureSky(lighting)
    end)
    _DM.busy = false
end

local _dmGen = 0
local function enableDarkMode()
    if not Config.DarkMode then return end
    _DM.on = true
    _dmClearConns()
    pcall(_dmApply)
    _dmGen = _dmGen + 1
    local myGen = _dmGen
    local lighting = Services.Lighting

    local function alive()
        return Config.DarkMode and _DM.on and _dmGen == myGen
    end
    local function reassert()
        if not alive() or _DM.busy then return end
        _dmApply()
    end

    table.insert(_DM.conns, lighting:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ClockTime"):Connect(reassert))
    table.insert(_DM.conns, lighting:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Brightness"):Connect(reassert))
    table.insert(_DM.conns, lighting:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Ambient"):Connect(reassert))
    table.insert(_DM.conns, lighting:GetPropertyChangedSignal("OutdoorAmbient"):Connect(reassert))
    table.insert(_DM.conns, lighting:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ColorShift_Top"):Connect(reassert))
    table.insert(_DM.conns, lighting.ChildAdded:Connect(function(o)
        if not alive() then return end
        if o:IsA("Atmosphere") or o:IsA("Clouds") or (o:IsA("Sky") and o ~= _DM.sky) then
            task.defer(reassert)
        end
    end))

    table.insert(_DM.conns, RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not alive() or _DM.busy then return end
        local strength = Config.NightVisionStrength or 100
        local wantBrightness = (strength == 0) and 1 or 0
        if lighting.ClockTime ~= 0 or lighting.Brightness ~= wantBrightness then
            _dmApply()
        end
    end))

    task.spawn(function()
        while alive() do
            if not _DM.busy then
                pcall(function()
                    if lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Atmosphere")
                    or not (_DM.sky and _DM.sky.Parent == lighting) then
                        _dmApply()
                    end
                end)
            end
            task.wait(0.25)
        end
    end)
end

local function disableDarkMode()
    _dmGen = _dmGen + 1
    _DM.on = false
    _dmClearConns()
    pcall(function()
        local lighting = Services.Lighting
        if _DM.sky then pcall(function() _DM.sky:Destroy() end); _DM.sky = nil end
        if _DM.origSky then
            pcall(function()
                if _DM.origSky.Parent == nil then _DM.origSky.Parent = lighting end
            end)
            _DM.origSky = nil
        end
        lighting.ClockTime = 14
        lighting.Brightness = 1
        lighting.GlobalShadows = true
        lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
        lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
        lighting.ColorShift_Top = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
        lighting.ColorShift_Bottom = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
        lighting.FogColor = Color3.fromRGB(192, 192, 192)
        lighting.FogEnd = 100000
        lighting.FogStart = 0
    end)
end

local function SaveConfig()
    if writefile then
        pcall(function()
            local toSave = {}
            for k, v in pairs(Config) do
                if k ~= "NoAnimation" then
                    toSave[k] = v
                end
            end
            toSave.ProximityAP = false
            writefile(FileName, HttpService:JSONEncode(toSave))
        end)
    end
end

local function _vxNormalizePos(targetFrame)

    local parent = targetFrame.Parent
    if not parent then return nil, nil end
    local ps = parent.AbsoluteSize
    if ps.X <= 0 or ps.Y <= 0 then return nil, nil end

    local p = targetFrame.Position
    local sx = p.X.Scale + (p.X.Offset / ps.X)
    local sy = p.Y.Scale + (p.Y.Offset / ps.Y)
    return math.clamp(sx, 0.02, 0.98), math.clamp(sy, 0.02, 0.98)
end
_G.VXNormalizePos = _vxNormalizePos

local function _vxCommitPos(targetFrame, positionKey)
    local sx, sy = _vxNormalizePos(targetFrame)
    if not sx then return end

    targetFrame.Position = UDim2.new(sx, 0, sy, 0)
    if not positionKey then return end
    if not Config then return end
    if not Config.Positions then Config.Positions = {} end
    Config.Positions[positionKey] = { X = sx, Y = sy }
    if SaveConfig then SaveConfig() end
end
_G.VXCommitPos = _vxCommitPos

local function _vxApplySavedPos(targetFrame, positionKey, defX, defY)
    local pos = (Config and Config.Positions and Config.Positions[positionKey])
    or { X = defX or 0.5, Y = defY or 0.5 }
    local sx = math.clamp(tonumber(pos.X) or defX or 0.5, 0.02, 0.98)
    local sy = math.clamp(tonumber(pos.Y) or defY or 0.5, 0.02, 0.98)

    targetFrame.Position = UDim2.new(sx, 0, sy, 0)
    return sx, sy
end
_G.VXApplySavedPos = _vxApplySavedPos

local function MakeDraggable(dragBar, targetFrame, positionKey)
    local dragging = false
    local dragStart, startPos
    local dragConnection = nil
    local endConnection = nil
    local activeType = nil

    local function isDragStart(t)
        return t == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or t == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
    end
    local function isDragMove(t)
        return t == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or t == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
    end

    local function stopDrag()
        if not dragging then return end
        dragging = false
        activeType = nil
        if dragConnection then dragConnection:Disconnect(); dragConnection = nil end
        if endConnection then endConnection:Disconnect(); endConnection = nil end

        _vxCommitPos(targetFrame, positionKey)
    end

    dragBar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if not isDragStart(input.UserInputType) then return end
        if Config and Config.UILocked then return end
        if dragging then return end

        dragging = true
        activeType = input.UserInputType
        dragStart = input.Position

        local sx, sy = _vxNormalizePos(targetFrame)
        if sx then targetFrame.Position = UDim2.new(sx, 0, sy, 0) end
        startPos = targetFrame.Position

        dragConnection = UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(moved)
            if not dragging then return end
            if not isDragMove(moved.UserInputType) then return end
            local delta = moved.Position - dragStart
            targetFrame.Position = UDim2.new(
                startPos.X.Scale,
                startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
                startPos.Y.Scale,
                startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
                )
        end)

        endConnection = UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(ended)
            if ended.UserInputType == activeType then stopDrag() end
        end)
    end)

    pcall(function()
        dragBar.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
            if activeType and input.UserInputType == activeType then stopDrag() end
        end)
    end)
end

do
    local GuiService = cloneref and cloneref(game:GetService("GuiService")) or game:GetService("GuiService")
    local currentError = ""
    local clearing = false
    local function startClearing()
        if clearing then return end
        clearing = true
        task.spawn(function()
            while Config.CleanErrorGUIs and currentError ~= "" do
                pcall(function() GuiService:ClearError() end)
                RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
            end
            clearing = false
        end)
    end
    pcall(function()
        GuiService.ErrorMessageChanged:Connect(function(msg)
            currentError = (type(msg) == "string" and msg) or ""
            if currentError ~= "" and Config.CleanErrorGUIs then startClearing() end
        end)
    end)
    _G.VXClearErrorNow = function()
        pcall(function() GuiService:ClearError() end)
        if currentError ~= "" then startClearing() end
    end
end

do
    local function removeAccessories(character)
        for _, item in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
            if item:IsA("Accessory") then
                item:Destroy()
            end
        end
    end

    local function sweepAll()
        pcall(function()
            for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if player.Character then
                    removeAccessories(player.Character)
                end
            end
            for _, model in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
                if model:IsA("Model") and model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
                    removeAccessories(model)
                end
            end
        end)
    end
    _G.VXAntiFlasherSweep = function()
        if Config.AntiFlasher then task.spawn(sweepAll) end
    end

    local function hookPlayer(player)
        player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
            if Config.AntiFlasher then removeAccessories(character) end
        end)
    end
    Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
        hookPlayer(player)
        if player.Character and Config.AntiFlasher then
            removeAccessories(player.Character)
        end
    end)
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        hookPlayer(player)
    end

    Workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(descendant)
        if not Config.AntiFlasher then return end
        if descendant:IsA("Accessory") then
            local parent = descendant.Parent
            if parent and parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
                descendant:Destroy()
            end
        elseif descendant:IsA("Model") and descendant:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
            removeAccessories(descendant)
        end
    end)

    if Config.AntiFlasher then task.spawn(sweepAll) end
end

function applyMarble(frame, spread)
    frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    local g = Instance.new("UIGradient", frame)
    g.Rotation = -40
    if spread then

        g.Color = ColorSequence.new{
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.00, Color3.fromRGB(56, 28, 92)),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.18, Color3.fromRGB(42, 24, 70)),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.36, Color3.fromRGB(24, 16, 38)),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.52, Color3.fromRGB(12, 8, 20)),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.68, Color3.fromRGB(22, 15, 34)),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.85, Color3.fromRGB(32, 21, 50)),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1.00, Color3.fromRGB(44, 26, 72)),
        }
    else
        g.Color = ColorSequence.new{
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.00, Color3.fromRGB(48, 24, 80)),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.24, Color3.fromRGB(12, 8, 20)),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.76, Color3.fromRGB(12, 8, 20)),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1.00, Color3.fromRGB(46, 23, 76)),
        }
    end
    return g
end

--  =======================================================================
--  PALETTE SWITCH
--
--  Every colour in this file is written as its Purple literal. Rather than
--  parameterise several hundred scattered Color3 calls, the gold scheme is
--  expressed as a remap table -- Purple value on the left, the original gold
--  or silver value it replaced on the right -- and applied by walking the
--  live GUI tree. That way both schemes stay switchable at runtime without
--  the source having to carry two copies of every literal.
--  =======================================================================

local function _vxMapColor(c, tbl)
    if typeof(c) ~= "Color3" then return nil end
    local r = math.floor(c.R * 255 + 0.5)
    local g = math.floor(c.G * 255 + 0.5)
    local b = math.floor(c.B * 255 + 0.5)
    local hit = tbl[r * 65536 + g * 256 + b]
    if not hit then return nil end
    return Color3.fromRGB(hit[1], hit[2], hit[3])
end

local function _vxMapSequence(seq, tbl)
    local kps = seq.Keypoints
    local out, hit = {}, false
    for i, kp in ipairs(kps) do
        local m = _vxMapColor(kp.Value, tbl)
        if m then hit = true end
        out[i] = ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(kp.Time, m or kp.Value)
    end
    if not hit then return nil end
    return ColorSequence.new(out)
end

local _VX_COLOR_PROPS = {
    "BackgroundColor3", "TextColor3", "ImageColor3", "BorderColor3",
    "PlaceholderColor3", "ScrollBarImageColor3", "TextStrokeColor3",
}

local function _vxRepaint(inst, tbl, hexTbl)
    for _, prop in ipairs(_VX_COLOR_PROPS) do
        local ok, cur = pcall(function() return inst[prop] end)
        if ok and typeof(cur) == "Color3" then
            local m = _vxMapColor(cur, tbl)
            if m then pcall(function() inst[prop] = m end) end
        end
    end
    if inst:IsA("UIStroke") then
        local m = _vxMapColor(inst.Color, tbl)
        if m then pcall(function() inst.Color = m end) end
    elseif inst:IsA("UIGradient") then
        local m = _vxMapSequence(inst.Color, tbl)
        if m then pcall(function() inst.Color = m end) end
    end
    --  RichText labels keep their colours in the markup.
    local okR, rich = pcall(function() return inst.RichText end)
    if okR and rich then
        local okT, txt = pcall(function() return inst.Text end)
        if okT and type(txt) == "string" and txt:find("#", 1, true) then
            local new = txt:gsub("#(%x%x%x%x%x%x)", function(h)
                return "#" .. (hexTbl[h:upper()] or h)
            end)
            if new ~= txt then pcall(function() inst.Text = new end) end
        end
    end
end

_G.VXMountedGuis = _G.VXMountedGuis or {}

local _vxPaletteConns = {}
local function _vxWatch(gui)
    local c = gui.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d)
        task.defer(function() pcall(_vxRepaint, d, _vxToGold, _vxHexToGold) end)
    end)
    _vxPaletteConns[#_vxPaletteConns + 1] = c
end

function _G.VXSetPalette(name)
    name = (tostring(name) == "Gold") and "Gold" or "Purple"
    if name == _G.VXPaletteName then return end

    local tbl    = (name == "Gold") and _vxToGold or _vxToPurple
    local hexTbl = (name == "Gold") and _vxHexToGold or _vxHexToPurple
    _G.VXPaletteName = name

    --  Theme drives everything built from here on.
    for k, v in pairs(Theme) do
        local m = _vxMapColor(v, tbl)
        if m then Theme[k] = m end
    end
    for k, v in pairs(VXPalette) do
        local m = _vxMapColor(v, tbl)
        if m then VXPalette[k] = m end
    end

    --  ...and everything already on screen gets repainted in place.
    for _, gui in ipairs(_G.VXMountedGuis or {}) do
        if gui and gui.Parent then
            pcall(function()
                _vxRepaint(gui, tbl, hexTbl)
                for _, d in ipairs(gui:GetDescendants()) do
                    pcall(_vxRepaint, d, tbl, hexTbl)
                end
            end)
        end
    end

    --  Anything built later still comes out of Purple literals, so while Gold
    --  is selected each mounted GUI keeps a listener that repaints new
    --  descendants as they appear.
    for _, c in ipairs(_vxPaletteConns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
    table.clear(_vxPaletteConns)
    if name == "Gold" then
        for _, gui in ipairs(_G.VXMountedGuis or {}) do
            if gui and gui.Parent then pcall(_vxWatch, gui) end
        end
    end
end

--  Called by mountGui for GUIs created after a switch.
function _G.VXPaletteAdopt(gui)
    if _G.VXPaletteName ~= "Gold" then return end
    task.defer(function()
        pcall(function()
            _vxRepaint(gui, _vxToGold, _vxHexToGold)
            for _, d in ipairs(gui:GetDescendants()) do
                pcall(_vxRepaint, d, _vxToGold, _vxHexToGold)
            end
        end)
        pcall(_vxWatch, gui)
    end)
end

VXPalette = {
    Orb1    = Color3.fromRGB(150, 88, 232),
    Orb2    = Color3.fromRGB(168, 120, 245),
    Orb3    = Color3.fromRGB(96, 58, 158),
    Orb4    = Color3.fromRGB(206, 176, 255),
    Star    = Color3.fromRGB(226, 208, 255),
    BorderA = Color3.fromRGB(150, 96, 226),
    BorderB = Color3.fromRGB(72, 46, 118),
}

function VXNew(class, props, parent)
    local obj = Instance.new(class)
    if props then
        for k, v in pairs(props) do obj[k] = v end
    end
    if parent then obj.Parent = parent end
    return obj
end

function VXRound(inst, r)
    return VXNew("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, r or 8) }, inst)
end

function VXStroke(inst, color, thickness, transparency)
    return VXNew("UIStroke", {
        Color = color or VXPalette.BorderA,
        Thickness = thickness or 1.2,
        Transparency = transparency or 0.35,
        ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border,
    }, inst)
end

function VXGrad(inst, colorSeq, rotation, transparencySeq)
    local g = Instance.new("UIGradient")
    if colorSeq then g.Color = colorSeq end
    if rotation then g.Rotation = rotation end
    if transparencySeq then g.Transparency = transparencySeq end
    g.Parent = inst
    return g
end

function VXComplexBG(frame, opts)
    opts = opts or {}
    local corner = opts.corner or 12
    if opts.orbs ~= false then
        local orbLayer = VXNew("Frame", {
            Name = "VX_OrbLayer", Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 0, ClipsDescendants = true,
        }, frame)
        VXRound(orbLayer, corner)
        local orbDef = {
            {0.14, 0.60, 62, VXPalette.Orb1},
            {0.74, 0.28, 30, VXPalette.Orb2},
            {0.82, 0.80, 72, VXPalette.Orb3},
            {0.30, 0.20, 26, VXPalette.Orb4},
        }
        for _, d in ipairs(orbDef) do
            local orb = VXNew("Frame", {
                AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
                Position = UDim2.new(d[1], 0, d[2], 0),
                Size = UDim2.new(0, d[3], 0, d[3]),
                BackgroundColor3 = d[4], BackgroundTransparency = 0.9,
                BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 0,
            }, orbLayer)
            VXRound(orb, d[3])
        end
    end
    local nStars = opts.stars or 16
    if nStars > 0 then
        local starClip = VXNew("Frame", {
            Name = "VX_StarClip", Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 0, ClipsDescendants = true,
        }, frame)
        VXRound(starClip, corner)
        local starLayer = VXNew("Frame", {
            Name = "VX_StarLayer", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
            Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1.4, 0, 1.4, 0),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 0,
        }, starClip)
        local rng = Random.new()
        for i = 1, nStars do
            local sz = rng:NextInteger(2, 4)
            local star = VXNew("Frame", {
                AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
                Position = UDim2.new(rng:NextNumber(0.04, 0.96), 0, rng:NextNumber(0.04, 0.96), 0),
                Size = UDim2.new(0, sz, 0, sz),
                BackgroundColor3 = VXPalette.Star,
                BackgroundTransparency = rng:NextNumber(0.25, 0.8),
                BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 0,
            }, starLayer)
            VXRound(star, sz)
        end
    end
    if opts.sheen ~= false then
        local sheenClip = VXNew("Frame", {
            Name = "VX_SheenClip", Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 0, ClipsDescendants = true,
        }, frame)
        VXRound(sheenClip, corner)

        local sheen = VXNew("Frame", {
            Name = "VX_Sheen", Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.42, 0),
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(222, 224, 228),
            BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 0,
        }, sheenClip)
        VXRound(sheen, corner)
        VXGrad(sheen, nil, 90, NumberSequence.new({
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.94),
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
        }))
        local vignette = VXNew("Frame", {
            Name = "VX_Vignette", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1),
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.5, 0),
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0),
            BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 0,
        }, sheenClip)
        VXRound(vignette, corner)
        VXGrad(vignette, nil, 90, NumberSequence.new({
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.82),
        }))
        local edge = VXNew("Frame", {
            Name = "VX_EdgeLight", Position = UDim2.new(0, corner, 0, 0),
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -corner * 2, 0, 1),
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(158, 162, 170),
            BackgroundTransparency = 0.72, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 0,
        }, sheenClip)
        VXGrad(edge, nil, 0, NumberSequence.new({
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0.1),
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
        }))
    end
    if opts.border ~= false then
        local stroke = VXNew("UIStroke", {
            Name = "VX_Border", Thickness = 0.8, Transparency = 0.4,
            Color = VXPalette.BorderA, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border,
        }, frame)
        VXGrad(stroke, ColorSequence.new({
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, VXPalette.BorderA),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, VXPalette.BorderB),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, VXPalette.BorderA),
        }), 45)
        return stroke
    end
end

function VXApplyTextShine(lbl)
    if lbl:FindFirstChild("VX_TextShine") then return end
    local g = Instance.new("UIGradient")
    g.Name = "VX_TextShine"
    g.Rotation = 0

    g.Color = ColorSequence.new{
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.00, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.50, Color3.fromRGB(241, 243, 247)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1.00, Color3.fromRGB(225, 228, 234)),
    }
    g.Parent = lbl
end

function VXTextShine(root)
    for _, d in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
        if (d:IsA("TextLabel") or d:IsA("TextButton")) and not d.RichText then
            local c = d.TextColor3
            if math.min(c.R, c.G, c.B) >= 0.4 then
                VXApplyTextShine(d)
            end
        end
    end
end

function VXToggleRing(toggleFrame, gapPx)
    gapPx = gapPx or 5
    local seq = ColorSequence.new{
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Theme.SilverLo),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Theme.GoldHi),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Theme.SilverLo),
    }
    local inner = Instance.new("UIStroke", toggleFrame)
    inner.Thickness = 1
    inner.Transparency = 0.35
    inner.Color = Color3.fromRGB(6, 6, 8)
    inner.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
    local ig = Instance.new("UIGradient", inner)
    ig.Rotation = 25
    ig.Color = seq
    local ring = Instance.new("Frame", toggleFrame)
    ring.Name = "VX_ToggleRing"
    ring.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
    ring.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
    ring.Size = UDim2.new(1, gapPx, 1, gapPx)
    ring.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    Instance.new("UICorner", ring).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    local outer = Instance.new("UIStroke", ring)
    outer.Thickness = 1
    outer.Transparency = 0.7
    outer.Color = Color3.fromRGB(6, 6, 8)
    outer.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
    local og = Instance.new("UIGradient", outer)
    og.Rotation = 205
    og.Color = seq
end

_G.VXFeatureRegistry = _G.VXFeatureRegistry or {}
_G.VXFeatureIdCounts = _G.VXFeatureIdCounts or {}
function VXRegisterFeature(entry)
    local n = (_G.VXFeatureIdCounts[entry.name] or 0) + 1
    _G.VXFeatureIdCounts[entry.name] = n
    entry.id = entry.name .. (n > 1 and ("#" .. n) or "")
    entry.listeners = {}
    table.insert(_G.VXFeatureRegistry, entry)
    return entry
end
function VXFindFeature(id)
    for _, e in ipairs(_G.VXFeatureRegistry) do
        if e.id == id then return e end
    end
    return nil
end

local AnimalModels do
    local m = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Models")
    AnimalModels = m and m:FindFirstChild("Animals") or nil
    if not AnimalModels then
        task.spawn(function()
            local mm = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Models", 30)
            AnimalModels = mm and mm:WaitForChild("Animals", 30) or nil
        end)
    end
end

local function VXCloneForViewport(template)
    if not template then return nil end
    local unarch = {}
    if not template.Archivable then unarch[#unarch + 1] = template; template.Archivable = true end
    for _, d in ipairs(template:GetDescendants()) do
        if not d.Archivable then unarch[#unarch + 1] = d; d.Archivable = true end
    end
    local ok, clone = pcall(function() return template:Clone() end)
    for _, d in ipairs(unarch) do pcall(function() d.Archivable = false end) end
    if not ok or not clone then return nil end
    for _, d in ipairs(clone:GetDescendants()) do
        if d:IsA("BaseScript") or d:IsA("ModuleScript") or d:IsA("Sound")
        or d:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or d:IsA("BillboardGui") then
            pcall(function() d:Destroy() end)
        end
    end
    return clone
end
_G.VXCloneForViewport = VXCloneForViewport

local function VXFindAnimalTemplate(folder, animalName)
    if not folder then return nil end
    local template = folder:FindFirstChild(animalName)
    if template then return template end
    local want = tostring(animalName):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", ""):lower()
    for _, m in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
        if m.Name:lower() == want then return m end
    end

    if #want >= 4 then
        for _, m in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
            local n = m.Name:lower()
            if n:find(want, 1, true) or want:find(n, 1, true) then return m end
        end
    end
    return nil
end
_G.VXFindAnimalTemplate = VXFindAnimalTemplate

local function VXFindLiveAnimalModel(petLike)
    if type(petLike) ~= "table" then return nil end
    local m = petLike._model or petLike.model
    if typeof(m) == "Instance" and m.Parent then return m end
    if petLike.plot then
        local found = nil
        pcall(function()
            local plotsFolder = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")
            local plotInst = plotsFolder and plotsFolder:FindFirstChild(tostring(petLike.plot))
            if not plotInst then return end
            local podiums = plotInst:FindFirstChild("AnimalPodiums")
            local podium = podiums and petLike.slot and podiums:FindFirstChild(tostring(petLike.slot))
            local podiumPos = nil
            if podium then
                local okP, ppos = pcall(function() return podium:GetPivot().Position end)
                if okP and typeof(ppos) == "Vector3" then podiumPos = ppos end
            end
            local wantNames = {}
            if petLike.petName then wantNames[tostring(petLike.petName):lower()] = true end
            if petLike.name then wantNames[tostring(petLike.name):lower()] = true end
            if petLike.index then wantNames[tostring(petLike.index):lower()] = true end
            local bestDist = math.huge
            for _, desc in ipairs(plotInst:GetDescendants()) do
                if desc:IsA("Model") and wantNames[desc.Name:lower()]
                and desc:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true) then
                    if podiumPos then
                        local okD, d = pcall(function() return (desc:GetPivot().Position - podiumPos).Magnitude end)
                        if okD and d < bestDist then bestDist = d; found = desc end
                    else
                        found = desc
                        break
                    end
                end
            end

            if not found and podium then
                for _, desc in ipairs(podium:GetDescendants()) do
                    if desc:IsA("Model") and desc.Name ~= "Claim" and desc.Name ~= "Base" and desc.Name ~= "Decorations" then
                        if desc:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true) then found = desc; break end
                    end
                end
            end
            if not found and podiumPos then
                pcall(function() LocalPlayer:RequestStreamAroundAsync(podiumPos, 0.5) end)
            end
        end)
        if found then return found end
    end
    return nil
end
_G.VXFindLiveAnimalModel = VXFindLiveAnimalModel

local VXIcons = {}
do
    local _MutData, _TraitData = nil, nil
    local _mutCache, _traitCache, _colorCache

    local function _iconsResolved()
        return _MutData ~= nil and _TraitData ~= nil
    end

    local function _flushIconCaches()
        if _mutCache then table.clear(_mutCache) end
        if _traitCache then table.clear(_traitCache) end
        if _colorCache then table.clear(_colorCache) end
    end

    local function _ensure()
        if _iconsResolved() then return true end

        local pre = SharedState and SharedState.Pre
        if pre then
            if _MutData == nil and pre.Mutations ~= nil then _MutData = pre.Mutations end
            if _TraitData == nil and pre.Traits ~= nil then _TraitData = pre.Traits end
            if _iconsResolved() then _flushIconCaches() return true end
        end

        pcall(function()
            local datas = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Datas")
            if not datas then return end
            if _MutData == nil then
                local m = datas:FindFirstChild("Mutations")
                if m then _MutData = require(m) end
            end
            if _TraitData == nil then
                local shared = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Shared")
                local t = datas:FindFirstChild("Traits") or (shared and shared:FindFirstChild("Traits"))
                if t then _TraitData = require(t) end
            end
        end)

        if _iconsResolved() then _flushIconCaches() end
        return _iconsResolved()
    end

    task.spawn(function()
        if _ensure() then return end
        local ok = pcall(function()
            local datas = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Datas", 30)
            if not datas then return end
            if _MutData == nil then
                local m = datas:WaitForChild("Mutations", 30)
                if m then _MutData = require(m) end
            end
            if _TraitData == nil then
                local t = datas:FindFirstChild("Traits")
                if not t then
                    local shared = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Shared")
                    t = shared and shared:FindFirstChild("Traits")
                end
                t = t or datas:WaitForChild("Traits", 30)
                if t then _TraitData = require(t) end
            end
        end)
        if ok and _iconsResolved() then
            _flushIconCaches()
            if SharedState then
                SharedState.IconDataReady = true
                SharedState.ListNeedsRedraw = true
                SharedState.SelectionDirty = true
            end
            if _G.VXFireIconsReady then pcall(_G.VXFireIconsReady) end
        end
    end)
    local function _pick(data)
        if type(data) ~= "table" then return nil end
        local v = data.Icon or data.Image or data.AssetId or data.ImageId
        if type(v) == "number" then return "rbxassetid://" .. v end
        return v
    end

        if c ~= nil then return c or nil end
        _ensure()
        local col
        if _MutData and type(_MutData[name]) == "table" then
            local mc = _MutData[name].MainColor or _MutData[name].Color or _MutData[name].PrimaryColor
            if typeof(mc) == "Color3" then col = mc end
        end
        col = col or MUT_COLOR[name]
        if col or _iconsResolved() then _colorCache[name] = col or false end
        return col
    end
    function VXIcons.Mutation(name)
        if not name or name == "" or name == "None" or name == "Normal" then return "" end
        local c = _mutCache[name]; if c ~= nil then return c end
        _ensure()
        local icon = (_MutData and _pick(_MutData[name]))
        or (name == "YinYang" and _MutData and _pick(_MutData["Yin Yang"]))
        or MUT_FALLBACK[name] or ""
        if icon ~= "" or _iconsResolved() then _mutCache[name] = icon end
        return icon
    end
    function VXIcons.Trait(name)
        if not name or name == "" or name == "None" then return "" end
        local c = _traitCache[name]; if c ~= nil then return c end
        _ensure()
        local icon = (_TraitData and _pick(_TraitData[name])) or TRAIT_FALLBACK[name] or ""
        if icon ~= "" or _iconsResolved() then _traitCache[name] = icon end
        return icon
    end

    function VXIcons.SplitTraits(v)
        local out = {}
        if type(v) == "table" then
            for _, t in ipairs(v) do
                if type(t) == "string" and t ~= "" and t ~= "None" then out[#out + 1] = t end
            end
            return out
        end
        if type(v) ~= "string" or v == "" or v == "None" then return out end
        for t in v:gmatch("[^,]+") do
            t = t:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
            if t ~= "" and t ~= "None" then out[#out + 1] = t end
        end
        return out
    end
