local VXRarity = {}
do
    local STATIC = {
        Common    = Color3.fromRGB(64, 214, 74),
        Uncommon  = Color3.fromRGB(108, 206, 128),
        Rare      = Color3.fromRGB(72, 148, 255),
        Epic      = Color3.fromRGB(190, 96, 246),
        Legendary = Color3.fromRGB(255, 214, 72),
        Mythic    = Color3.fromRGB(231, 56, 61),

        ["Brainrot God"] = Color3.fromRGB(255, 104, 138),
        Secret    = Color3.fromRGB(236, 237, 242),
        OG        = Color3.fromRGB(255, 214, 92),
    }

    local function rainbowSeq(phase)
        local kp, N = {}, 10
        for i = 0, N do
            local pos = i / N
            kp[i + 1] = ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(pos, Color3.fromHSV((pos - phase) % 1, 0.82, 1))
        end
        return ColorSequence.new(kp)
    end
    local function waveSeq(phase, lo, hi)
        local kp, N = {}, 10
        for i = 0, N do
            local pos = i / N
            local w = math.sin((pos - phase) * math.pi * 2) * 0.5 + 0.5
            kp[i + 1] = ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(pos, lo:Lerp(hi, w))
        end
        return ColorSequence.new(kp)
    end

    local function ogSeq(phase, lo, hi)

        local kp, N, HW, FREQ = {}, 19, 0.12, 2
        for i = 0, N do
            local pos = i / N
            local d = ((pos - phase) * FREQ) % 1
            local dist = math.min(d, 1 - d)
            local w = math.clamp(dist / HW, 0, 1)
            w = w * w * (3 - 2 * w)
            kp[i + 1] = ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(pos, lo:Lerp(hi, w))
        end
        return ColorSequence.new(kp)
    end
    local SECRET_LO, SECRET_HI = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 48), Color3.fromRGB(248, 249, 252)
    local OG_LO, OG_HI = Color3.fromRGB(16, 11, 3), Color3.fromRGB(255, 190, 70)
    local ANIM = {
        ["Brainrot God"] = { kind = "rainbow", rot = 0,  speed = 0.28, build = function(p) return rainbowSeq(p) end },
        ["Secret"]       = { kind = "secret",  rot = 90, speed = 0.60, build = function(p) return waveSeq(p, SECRET_LO, SECRET_HI) end },
        ["OG"]           = { kind = "og",      rot = 90, speed = 0.45, build = function(p) return ogSeq(p, OG_LO, OG_HI) end },
    }
    local reg = {}
    local started = false

    local function _gradVisible(lbl)
        local node, hops = lbl, 0
        while node and hops < 10 do
            if node:IsA("GuiObject") then
                if not node.Visible then return false end
            elseif node:IsA("LayerCollector") then
                return node.Enabled
            else
                return true
            end
            node = node.Parent
            hops = hops + 1
        end
        return true
    end

    local RATE = 1 / 30

    local _lcOf = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
    local function layerOf(lbl)
        local lc = _lcOf[lbl]
        if lc and lc.Parent then return lc end
        local node, hops = lbl, 0
        while node and hops < 12 do
            if node:IsA("LayerCollector") then _lcOf[lbl] = node; return node end
            node = node.Parent
            hops = hops + 1
        end
        return nil
    end

    local function ensureLoop()
        if started then return end
        started = true
        local acc = 0
        RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
            acc = acc + dt
            if acc < RATE then return end
            acc = 0
            if next(reg) == nil then return end
            local t = os.clock()
            local cache
            for grad, info in pairs(reg) do
                local lbl = grad.Parent
                if not lbl then
                    reg[grad] = nil
                else

                    local lc = layerOf(lbl)
                    if (lc == nil or lc.Enabled) and _gradVisible(lbl) then
                        cache = cache or {}
                        local seq = cache[info.kind]
                        if not seq then
                            seq = info.build((t * info.speed) % 1)
                            cache[info.kind] = seq
                        end
                        grad.Color = seq
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
    end
    function VXRarity.Color(word)
        return STATIC[word] or Color3.fromRGB(190, 193, 200)
    end

    function VXRarity.Apply(label, word)
        if not label then return end
        label.RichText = true
        local shine = label:FindFirstChild("VX_TextShine")
        if shine then shine:Destroy() end
        local anim = ANIM[word]
        local grad = label:FindFirstChild("VXRarityGrad")
        if anim then
            label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 235, 255)
            if not grad then
                grad = Instance.new("UIGradient")
                grad.Name = "VXRarityGrad"
                grad.Parent = label
            end
            grad.Rotation = anim.rot
            grad.Offset = Vector2.new(0, 0)
            grad.Color = anim.build(0)
            reg[grad] = anim
            ensureLoop()
        else
            if grad then reg[grad] = nil; grad:Destroy() end
            label.TextColor3 = STATIC[word] or Color3.fromRGB(190, 193, 200)
        end
    end
end
_G.VXRarity = VXRarity

local function VXAttachHoverGlow(btn)
    if typeof(btn) ~= "Instance" or not btn:IsA("GuiButton") then return end
    if btn:GetAttribute("_vxGlow") then return end
    btn:SetAttribute("_vxGlow", true)
    local glow = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    glow.Name = "VXHoverGlow"
    glow.Thickness = 1.5
    glow.Transparency = 1
    glow.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
    glow.Parent = btn
    local grad = Instance.new("UIGradient", glow)
    grad.Rotation = 25
    grad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.0, Color3.fromRGB(120, 124, 132)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.fromRGB(198, 150, 255)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1.0, Color3.fromRGB(120, 124, 132)),
    })
    local function refresh()
        local st = btn.GuiState
        local on = (st == Enum.GuiState.Hover or st == Enum.GuiState.Press)
        TweenService:Create(glow, TweenInfo.new(0.15), { Transparency = on and 0.05 or 1 }):Play()
    end
    btn:GetPropertyChangedSignal("GuiState"):Connect(refresh)
end
_G.VXAttachHoverGlow = VXAttachHoverGlow
local function VXGlowRoot(root)
    if not root then return end
    for _, d in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do VXAttachHoverGlow(d) end
    root.DescendantAdded:Connect(VXAttachHoverGlow)
end
_G.VXGlowRoot = VXGlowRoot

local function createAnimalPreview(parent, animalName, size, altName, petLike)

    local template = VXFindLiveAnimalModel(petLike)

    if not template and AnimalModels then
        template = VXFindAnimalTemplate(AnimalModels, animalName)
        if not template and altName then template = VXFindAnimalTemplate(AnimalModels, altName) end
        if not template and _G.VXAnimalIndexByDisplay then
            local idx = _G.VXAnimalIndexByDisplay[tostring(animalName or ""):lower()]
            or (altName and _G.VXAnimalIndexByDisplay[tostring(altName):lower()])
            if idx then template = VXFindAnimalTemplate(AnimalModels, idx) end
        end

        if not template then
            local want = tostring(animalName or ""):lower()
            local want2 = altName and tostring(altName):lower() or nil
            if #want >= 3 or (want2 and #want2 >= 3) then
                pcall(function()
                    for _, desc in ipairs(AnimalModels:GetDescendants()) do
                        if desc:IsA("Model") then
                            local dn = desc.Name:lower()
                            if dn == want or dn == want2
                            or (#want >= 4 and (dn:find(want, 1, true) or want:find(dn, 1, true)))
                            or (want2 and #want2 >= 4 and (dn:find(want2, 1, true) or want2:find(dn, 1, true))) then
                                template = desc
                                break
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end)
            end
        end
    end

    if template and not (template:IsA("Model") or template:IsA("BasePart")) then
        template = template:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Model") or template:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
        or template:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Model", true) or template:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
    end
    if not template then return nil end
    if Config.DisableViewports then return nil end

    local viewport = Instance.new("ViewportFrame")
    viewport.Size = size or UDim2.new(0, 40, 0, 40)
    viewport.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    viewport.BorderSizePixel = 0
    viewport.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
    viewport.LightColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    viewport.LightDirection = Vector3.new(-1, -1, -1)
    viewport.Parent = parent

    local worldModel = Instance.new("WorldModel")
    worldModel.Parent = viewport

    local camera = Instance.new("Camera")
    viewport.CurrentCamera = camera
    camera.Parent = viewport

    local clone = VXCloneForViewport(template)
    if not clone then viewport:Destroy(); return nil end

    if clone:IsA("Model") and clone.PrimaryPart then
        clone:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(CFrame.new(0, 0, 0))
    elseif clone:IsA("BasePart") then
        clone.CFrame = CFrame.new(0, 0, 0)
    else
        pcall(function() clone:PivotTo(CFrame.new()) end)
    end

    clone.Parent = worldModel

    local cPrimary = clone:IsA("Model") and (clone.PrimaryPart or clone:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true))
    or (clone:IsA("BasePart") and clone or nil)

    if not cPrimary then viewport:Destroy(); return nil end

    if cPrimary then
        local esize
        local ok = pcall(function() esize = clone:GetExtentsSize() end)
        if not ok or not esize then esize = cPrimary.Size or Vector3.new(3, 3, 3) end
        local maxDim = math.max(esize.X, esize.Y, esize.Z)
        if maxDim < 1 then maxDim = 3 end

        local frontDir = cPrimary.CFrame.LookVector
        local rightDir = cPrimary.CFrame.RightVector

        local viewDir = (frontDir - rightDir).Unit
        local distance = maxDim * 1.24
        local height = esize.Y * 0.15

        local camPos = cPrimary.Position + (viewDir * distance) + Vector3.new(0, height, 0)
        camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(camPos, cPrimary.Position)
        camera.FieldOfView = 60
    end

    pcall(function()
        if clone:IsA("BasePart") then clone.Anchored = true end
        for _, d in ipairs(clone:GetDescendants()) do
            if d:IsA("BasePart") then d.Anchored = true end
        end
    end)

    _G.VXLiveViewports = _G.VXLiveViewports or setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
    _G.VXLiveViewports[viewport] = true

    return viewport
end
_G.VXCreateAnimalPreview = createAnimalPreview

_G.isBindingKey = false

    local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", frame)
    stroke.Thickness = 1
    stroke.Transparency = 0.4
    stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(6, 6, 8)
    stroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
    return stroke
end

local function MakeText(label, isTitle)

    label.Font = isTitle and Enum.Font.Gotham or Enum.Font.Gotham
    label.TextSize = (isTitle and 14 or 11) * MOBILE_SCALE
    label.TextColor3 = Theme.TextPrimary
end

local function findAdorneeGlobal(animalData)
    if not animalData then return nil end
    local plots = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")
    local plot = plots and animalData.plot and plots:FindFirstChild(tostring(animalData.plot))
    if not plot then return nil end
    local podiums = plot:FindFirstChild("AnimalPodiums")
    local podium = podiums and animalData.slot and podiums:FindFirstChild(tostring(animalData.slot))
    if not podium then return nil end
    local base = podium:FindFirstChild("Base")
    if not base then return nil end
    local spawn = base:FindFirstChild("Spawn")
    if spawn then return spawn end
    return base:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart") or base
end

local VXNotifStack = {}
local NOTIF_STACK_GAP = 7
local NOTIF_SCALE = 0.85

local function reflowNotifs()
    for i = #VXNotifStack, 1, -1 do
        local e = VXNotifStack[i]
        if not (e.frame and e.frame.Parent) then
            table.remove(VXNotifStack, i)
        end
    end
    if #VXNotifStack == 0 then return end

    local inset = 36
    pcall(function() inset = game:GetService("GuiService"):GetGuiInset().Y end)

    local hudTop = nil
    local hud = VXGui:FindFirstChild(_vxName("VXStatusHUD"))
    if hud then
        local mc = hud:FindFirstChild("VX_MainContainer")
        if mc and mc.AbsoluteSize.Y > 0 then
            hudTop = mc.AbsolutePosition.Y

            local respects = true
            pcall(function() respects = not hud.IgnoreGuiInset end)
            if respects then hudTop = hudTop + inset end
        end
    end
    if not hudTop then

        local vpY = 0
        pcall(function()
            local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera
            if cam then vpY = cam.ViewportSize.Y end
        end)
        local cfgY = (Config.Positions and Config.Positions.StatusHUD
            and Config.Positions.StatusHUD.Y) or 0.08
        if vpY > inset then hudTop = cfgY * (vpY - inset) + inset end
    end

    local TOP_MARGIN = 2
    local HUD_GAP = 10

    local function place(e, yy)
        if yy < 0 then yy = 0 end
        TweenService:Create(e.frame, TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
            Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, yy)
        }):Play()
    end

    local order = {}
    for _, e in ipairs(VXNotifStack) do
        if e.isAutoTP then order[#order + 1] = e end
    end
    for _, e in ipairs(VXNotifStack) do
        if not e.isAutoTP then order[#order + 1] = e end
    end
    if #order == 0 then return end

    local totalH = 0
    for i, e in ipairs(order) do
        totalH = totalH + e.height
        if i < #order then totalH = totalH + NOTIF_STACK_GAP end
    end

    local y = TOP_MARGIN
    if hudTop then
        local above = hudTop - HUD_GAP - totalH
        if above > y then y = above end
    end
    for _, e in ipairs(order) do
        place(e, y)
        y = y + e.height + NOTIF_STACK_GAP
    end
end
_G.VXReflowNotifs = reflowNotifs

local function _removeNotifByType(ntype)
    if ntype == nil then return end
    for i = #VXNotifStack, 1, -1 do
        local e = VXNotifStack[i]
        if e.ntype == ntype then
            table.remove(VXNotifStack, i)
            pcall(function() if e.sg and e.sg.Parent then e.sg:Destroy() end end)
        end
    end
end

        }

        Instance.new("UICorner", previewContainer).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)

                    if not previewContainer.Parent then return end

                _tagText = (yPos > 26.8 and "F3") or (yPos > 9.8 and "F2") or "F1"
            end

        local tagPill = Instance.new("Frame", f)
        tagPill.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)

        Instance.new("UICorner", tagPill).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 9)
        local _tpg = Instance.new("UIGradient", tagPill)
        _tpg.Rotation = 0
        _tpg.Color = ColorSequence.new({
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Theme.GoldHi), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Theme.GoldLo),
        })
        local tagLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel", tagPill)
        tagLbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
        tagLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        tagLbl.Text = _tagText
        tagLbl.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
        tagLbl.TextSize = 10
        tagLbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(24, 18, 6)
        tagLbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center

        local textContainer = Instance.new("Frame", f)
        textContainer.Size = UDim2.new(1, -172, 0, NOTIF_HEIGHT - 14)
        textContainer.Position = UDim2.new(0, 86, 0, 7)
        textContainer.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        local nameLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel", textContainer)
        nameLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24)

        nameLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 11)
        nameLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        nameLabel.Text = brainrotName or "Unknown"
        nameLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
        nameLabel.TextSize = 18
        nameLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(247, 227, 255)
        nameLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        nameLabel.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
        VXGrad(nameLabel, ColorSequence.new({
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Theme.SilverHi),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Theme.GoldHi),
        }), 20)
        VXApplyTextShine(nameLabel)

        local rmRow = Instance.new("Frame", textContainer)
        rmRow.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 42)
        rmRow.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 22)
        rmRow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        local rmLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout", rmRow)
        rmLayout.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
        rmLayout.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center
        rmLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
        rmLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 7)
        local rarLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel", rmRow)
        rarLbl.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X
        rarLbl.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
        rarLbl.LayoutOrder = 1
        rarLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        rarLbl.Text = _rarWord
        rarLbl.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
        rarLbl.TextSize = 14
        rarLbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        if _G.VXRarity then _G.VXRarity.Apply(rarLbl, _rarWord) else rarLbl.TextColor3 = _rarCol end

        local mutIcon = Instance.new("ImageLabel", rmRow)
        mutIcon.LayoutOrder = 2
        mutIcon.Size = UDim2.new(0, 18, 0, 18)
        mutIcon.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        mutIcon.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
        do
            local _mi = (_mutWord ~= "Normal") and VXIcons.Mutation(_mutWord) or ""
            mutIcon.Image = _mi
            mutIcon.Visible = (_mi ~= "")
        end
        local mutLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel", rmRow)
        mutLbl.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X
        mutLbl.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
        mutLbl.LayoutOrder = 3
        mutLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        mutLbl.Text = _mutWord
        mutLbl.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
        mutLbl.TextSize = 14
        mutLbl.TextColor3 = (_mutWord == "Normal") and Theme.TextMuted
        or (VXIcons.MutationColor(_mutWord) or Color3.fromRGB(208, 212, 220))
        mutLbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left

        for _ti, _tName in ipairs(VXIcons.SplitTraits(_pd.traits)) do
            if _ti > 4 then break end
            local _tImg = VXIcons.Trait(_tName)
            if _tImg ~= "" then
                local tIcon = Instance.new("ImageLabel", rmRow)
                tIcon.LayoutOrder = 3 + _ti
                tIcon.Size = UDim2.new(0, 18, 0, 18)
                tIcon.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                tIcon.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
                tIcon.Image = _tImg
            end
        end

        local genLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel", f)
        genLabel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 1)
        genLabel.Position = UDim2.new(1, -14, 1, -10)
        genLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 170, 0, 18)
        genLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        genLabel.Text = tostring(genText or _pd.mpsText or "")
        genLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
        genLabel.TextSize = 15
        genLabel.TextColor3 = Theme.GoldHi
        genLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right

        local progressContainer = Instance.new("Frame", f)
        progressContainer.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 2)
        progressContainer.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 1, -5)
        progressContainer.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(38, 39, 44)
        progressContainer.BackgroundTransparency = 0.35
        progressContainer.BorderSizePixel = 0
        Instance.new("UICorner", progressContainer).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
        local progressBar = Instance.new("Frame", progressContainer)
        progressBar.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
        progressBar.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.GoldHi
        progressBar.BorderSizePixel = 0
        Instance.new("UICorner", progressBar).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
        local pGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient", progressBar)
        pGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new{
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(92, 52, 158)),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(160, 84, 240))
        }
        local autoEntry = { frame = f, width = NOTIF_WIDTH, height = NOTIF_HEIGHT * NOTIF_SCALE, sg = sg, isAutoTP = true, ntype = "AutoTP" }
        table.insert(VXNotifStack, 1, autoEntry)
        reflowNotifs()
        TweenService:Create(progressBar, TweenInfo.new(DURATION, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), { Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0) }):Play()
        task.delay(DURATION, function()
            if sg and sg.Parent then
                for i = #VXNotifStack, 1, -1 do
                    if VXNotifStack[i] == autoEntry then table.remove(VXNotifStack, i) end
                end
                TweenService:Create(f, TweenInfo.new(0.2), { Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, -200) }):Play()
                task.wait(0.25)
                if sg.Parent then sg:Destroy() end
                reflowNotifs()
            end
        end)
    end)
end

local function AddMobileMinimize(frame, labelText)
    if not IS_MOBILE then return end
    if not frame or not frame.Parent then return end
    local guiParent = frame.Parent
    local header = frame:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Frame")
    if not header then return end

    local minimizeBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    minimizeBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 26 * MOBILE_SCALE, 0, 26 * MOBILE_SCALE)
    minimizeBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -30 * MOBILE_SCALE, 0, 6 * MOBILE_SCALE)
    minimizeBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.SurfaceHighlight
    minimizeBtn.Text = "-"
    minimizeBtn.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
    minimizeBtn.TextSize = 18 * MOBILE_SCALE
    minimizeBtn.TextColor3 = Theme.TextPrimary
    minimizeBtn.AutoButtonColor = false
    minimizeBtn.Parent = header
    Instance.new("UICorner", minimizeBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8 * MOBILE_SCALE)

    local restoreBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", guiParent)
    restoreBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 110 * MOBILE_SCALE, 0, 34 * MOBILE_SCALE)
    restoreBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10 * MOBILE_SCALE, 1, -44 * MOBILE_SCALE)
    restoreBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.SurfaceHighlight
    -- sem emoji: Gotham nao tem glifo pra ele e sai como "?"
    restoreBtn.Text = (labelText or "OPEN")
    restoreBtn.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
    restoreBtn.TextSize = 12 * MOBILE_SCALE
    restoreBtn.TextColor3 = Theme.TextPrimary
    restoreBtn.Visible = false
    restoreBtn.AutoButtonColor = false
    Instance.new("UICorner", restoreBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10 * MOBILE_SCALE)

    MakeDraggable(restoreBtn, restoreBtn)

    minimizeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        frame.Visible = false
        restoreBtn.Visible = true
    end)

    restoreBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        frame.Visible = true
        restoreBtn.Visible = false
    end)
end

local State = {
    carpetSpeedEnabled = false,
    isTpMoving = false,
}

task.spawn(function()
    if not game:IsLoaded() then game.Loaded:Wait() end
    if not LocalPlayer.Character then LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Wait() end
    task.wait(0.5)

    local splash = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    splash.Name = _vxName("VXSplash")
    splash.ResetOnSpawn = false
    splash.DisplayOrder = 9999
    mountGui(splash)

    local holder = Instance.new("Frame", splash)
    holder.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
    holder.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
    holder.Size = UDim2.new(0, 240, 0, 56)
    holder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    local hScale = Instance.new("UIScale", holder)
    hScale.Scale = 1

    local verTag = Instance.new("TextLabel", holder)
    verTag.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
    verTag.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -4)
    verTag.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 16)
    verTag.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    verTag.Text = ""
    verTag.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
    verTag.TextSize = 12
    verTag.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(160, 84, 240)
    verTag.TextTransparency = 0.35

    local SPLASH_SIZE = 34
    local function letterW(ch)
        local w = SPLASH_SIZE * 0.62 * #ch
        pcall(function()
            w = game:GetService("TextService"):GetTextSize(ch, SPLASH_SIZE, Enum.Font.Gotham, Vector2.new(300, 80)).X
        end)
        return w
    end
    local defs = {
        { ch = "Vergent", col = Color3.fromRGB(202, 205, 212) },
        { ch = "X",       col = Color3.fromRGB(160, 84, 240) },
    }
    local totalW = 0
    for _, d in ipairs(defs) do d.w = letterW(d.ch); totalW = totalW + d.w end
    local runX = -totalW / 2
    local letters = {}
    for i, d in ipairs(defs) do
        local L = Instance.new("TextLabel", holder)
        L.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
        L.Size = UDim2.new(0, math.ceil(d.w) + 2, 0, 48)
        L.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, runX, 0.5, -26)
        L.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        L.Text = d.ch
        L.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
        L.TextSize = SPLASH_SIZE
        L.TextColor3 = d.col
        L.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        L.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
        L.TextTransparency = 1
        L.TextStrokeTransparency = 1
        pcall(VXApplyTextShine, L)
        letters[i] = { lbl = L, landX = runX }
        runX = runX + d.w
    end

    for i, l in ipairs(letters) do
        TweenService:Create(l.lbl, TweenInfo.new(0.38, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
            { Position = UDim2.new(0.5, l.landX, 0.5, 0) }):Play()
        TweenService:Create(l.lbl, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
            { TextTransparency = 0 }):Play()
        if i < #letters then task.wait(0.14) end
    end
    task.wait(0.34)

    TweenService:Create(hScale, TweenInfo.new(0.16, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Scale = 1.05 }):Play()
    task.wait(0.16)
    TweenService:Create(hScale, TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut), { Scale = 1 }):Play()
    task.wait(0.55)

    local out = TweenInfo.new(0.28, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In)
    for _, l in ipairs(letters) do
        TweenService:Create(l.lbl, out, { TextTransparency = 1 }):Play()
    end
    TweenService:Create(hScale, out, { Scale = 1.06 }):Play()
    task.wait(0.3)
    splash:Destroy()
end)

local _rotSliderRefs = nil
local _rotationDragging = false
local _lastAutoR = 210

local function makeRotationSlider(parent)

    local rotationRow = Instance.new("Frame", parent)
    rotationRow.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 48 * MOBILE_SCALE)
    rotationRow.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(12, 12, 14)
    rotationRow.BackgroundTransparency = 0.32
    rotationRow.BorderSizePixel = 0
    Instance.new("UICorner", rotationRow).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6 * MOBILE_SCALE)
    local rotStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", rotationRow)
    rotStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(6, 6, 8); rotStroke.Thickness = 1; rotStroke.Transparency = 0.85
    rotStroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border

    local rotationLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel", rotationRow)
    rotationLbl.Size = UDim2.new(0.6, 0, 0, 20 * MOBILE_SCALE)
    rotationLbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8 * MOBILE_SCALE, 0, 3 * MOBILE_SCALE)
    rotationLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    rotationLbl.Text = "Invis Rotation: " .. Config.InvisStealAngle
    rotationLbl.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
    rotationLbl.TextSize = 12 * MOBILE_SCALE
    rotationLbl.TextColor3 = Theme.TextPrimary
    rotationLbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left

    local rotationVal = Instance.new("TextLabel", rotationRow)
    rotationVal.Size = UDim2.new(0, 50 * MOBILE_SCALE, 0, 20 * MOBILE_SCALE)
    rotationVal.Position = UDim2.new(1, -60 * MOBILE_SCALE, 0, 3 * MOBILE_SCALE)
    rotationVal.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    rotationVal.Text = tostring(Config.InvisStealAngle)
    rotationVal.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
    rotationVal.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(160, 84, 240)
    rotationVal.TextSize = 12 * MOBILE_SCALE
    rotationVal.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right

    local rotationSliderBg = Instance.new("Frame", rotationRow)
    rotationSliderBg.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16 * MOBILE_SCALE, 0, 4 * MOBILE_SCALE)
    rotationSliderBg.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8 * MOBILE_SCALE, 0, 33 * MOBILE_SCALE)
    rotationSliderBg.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(29, 30, 33)
    rotationSliderBg.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
    Instance.new("UICorner", rotationSliderBg).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

    local rotationFill = Instance.new("Frame", rotationSliderBg)
    rotationFill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    rotationFill.Size = UDim2.new(math.clamp((Config.InvisStealAngle - VX_ROT_MIN) / VX_ROT_SPAN, 0, 1), 0, 1, 0)
    Instance.new("UICorner", rotationFill).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    local rotFillGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient", rotationFill)
    rotFillGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new{
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(92, 52, 158)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(160, 84, 240)),
    }

    local rotationKnob = Instance.new("Frame", rotationSliderBg)
    rotationKnob.Size = UDim2.new(0, 20 * MOBILE_SCALE, 0, 9 * MOBILE_SCALE)
    rotationKnob.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)

    rotationKnob.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(math.clamp((Config.InvisStealAngle - VX_ROT_MIN) / VX_ROT_SPAN, 0, 1), 0.5)
    rotationKnob.Position = UDim2.new(math.clamp((Config.InvisStealAngle - VX_ROT_MIN) / VX_ROT_SPAN, 0, 1), 0, 0.5, 0)
    Instance.new("UICorner", rotationKnob).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    local rotKnobStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", rotationKnob)
    rotKnobStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(160, 84, 240)
    rotKnobStroke.Thickness = 1
    rotKnobStroke.Transparency = 0.15
    rotKnobStroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border

    local rotationDragging = false

    _rotSliderRefs = {
        fill = rotationFill,
        knob = rotationKnob,
        lbl = rotationLbl,
        val = rotationVal,
        mn = 180,
        mx = 360,
    }

    local function updateRotationSlider(inputX)
        if Config.AutoRotateInvis then return end
        local pos = rotationSliderBg.AbsolutePosition.X
        local size = rotationSliderBg.AbsoluteSize.X
        local pct = math.clamp((inputX - pos) / size, 0, 1)
        local val = VX_ROT_MIN + (pct * VX_ROT_SPAN)
        val = math.clamp(math.floor(val + 0.5), VX_ROT_MIN, VX_ROT_MAX)
        Config.InvisStealAngle = val
        _G.InvisStealAngle = val
        if _G.InvisOnStealV1 then _G.InvisOnStealV1.ROTATION = val end
        SaveConfig()
        rotationFill.Size = UDim2.new(pct, 0, 1, 0)
        rotationKnob.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(pct, 0.5)
        rotationKnob.Position = UDim2.new(pct, 0, 0.5, 0)
        rotationLbl.Text = "Rotation: " .. val
        rotationVal.Text = tostring(val)
    end

    _G._updateRotationSliderDisplay = function(angle)
        local pct = math.clamp((angle - VX_ROT_MIN) / VX_ROT_SPAN, 0, 1)
        local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
        TweenService:Create(rotationFill, tweenInfo, {Size = UDim2.new(pct, 0, 1, 0)}):Play()

        TweenService:Create(rotationKnob, tweenInfo, {Position = UDim2.new(pct, 0, 0.5, 0), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(pct, 0.5)}):Play()
        rotationLbl.Text = "Rotation: " .. math.floor(angle)
        rotationVal.Text = tostring(math.floor(angle))
    end

    rotationSliderBg.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
            if Config.AutoRotateInvis then return end
            rotationDragging = true
            _rotationDragging = true
            updateRotationSlider(input.Position.X)
        end
    end)
    rotationKnob.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
            rotationDragging = true
            _rotationDragging = true
        end
    end)
    UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
            rotationDragging = false
            _rotationDragging = false
        end
    end)
    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if rotationDragging and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
            updateRotationSlider(input.Position.X)
        end
    end)
end

    depthKnob.Position = UDim2.new(math.clamp((Config.SinkSliderValue - VX_DEPTH_MIN) / VX_DEPTH_SPAN, 0, 1), 0, 0.5, 0)
    Instance.new("UICorner", depthKnob).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    local dpKnobStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", depthKnob)
    dpKnobStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(160, 84, 240)
    dpKnobStroke.Thickness = 1
    dpKnobStroke.Transparency = 0.15
    dpKnobStroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border

    local depthDragging = false
    local function updateDepthSlider(inputX)
        local pos = depthSliderBg.AbsolutePosition.X
        local size = depthSliderBg.AbsoluteSize.X
        local pct = math.clamp((inputX - pos) / size, 0, 1)
        local val = VX_DEPTH_MIN + (pct * VX_DEPTH_SPAN)
        val = math.clamp(math.floor(val * 10 + 0.5) / 10, VX_DEPTH_MIN, VX_DEPTH_MAX)
        Config.SinkSliderValue = val
        _G.SinkSliderValue = val
        SaveConfig()
        depthFill.Size = UDim2.new(pct, 0, 1, 0)
        depthKnob.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(pct, 0.5)
        depthKnob.Position = UDim2.new(pct, 0, 0.5, 0)
        depthLbl.Text = "Depth: " .. string.format("%.1f", val)
        depthVal.Text = string.format("%.1f", val)
    end

    depthSliderBg.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
            depthDragging = true
            updateDepthSlider(input.Position.X)
        end
    end)
    depthKnob.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
            depthDragging = true
        end
    end)
    UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
            depthDragging = false
        end
    end)
    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if depthDragging and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
            updateDepthSlider(input.Position.X)
        end
    end)
end

local function makeToggleRow(parent, text, defaultValue, callback, guard)

    local row = Instance.new("Frame", parent)
    row.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 34 * MOBILE_SCALE)
    row.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(12, 12, 14)
    row.BackgroundTransparency = 0.32
    row.BorderSizePixel = 0
    Instance.new("UICorner", row).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6 * MOBILE_SCALE)
    local rowStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", row)
    rowStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(6, 6, 8)
    rowStroke.Thickness = 1
    rowStroke.Transparency = 0.85
    rowStroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border

    local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel", row)
    lbl.Size = UDim2.new(0.6, -8 * MOBILE_SCALE, 1, 0)
    lbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10 * MOBILE_SCALE, 0, 0)
    lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    lbl.Text = text
    MakeText(lbl, true)
    lbl.TextSize = 12 * MOBILE_SCALE
    lbl.TextColor3 = Theme.TextPrimary
    lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left

    local ON_COL = Color3.fromRGB(140, 80, 222)
    local OFF_COL = Color3.fromRGB(44, 45, 51)
    local isOn = defaultValue or false
    local toggleFrame = Instance.new("Frame", row)
    toggleFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 44 * MOBILE_SCALE, 0, 22 * MOBILE_SCALE)
    toggleFrame.Position = UDim2.new(1, -52 * MOBILE_SCALE, 0.5, -11 * MOBILE_SCALE)
    toggleFrame.BackgroundColor3 = isOn and ON_COL or OFF_COL
    toggleFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
    Instance.new("UICorner", toggleFrame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

    local toggleDot = Instance.new("Frame", toggleFrame)
    toggleDot.Size = UDim2.new(0, 18 * MOBILE_SCALE, 0, 18 * MOBILE_SCALE)
    toggleDot.Position = isOn and UDim2.new(1, -20 * MOBILE_SCALE, 0.5, -9 * MOBILE_SCALE) or UDim2.new(0, 2 * MOBILE_SCALE, 0.5, -9 * MOBILE_SCALE)
    toggleDot.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    Instance.new("UICorner", toggleDot).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    VXToggleRing(toggleFrame, math.floor(5 * MOBILE_SCALE + 0.5))

    local toggleBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", toggleFrame)
    toggleBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    toggleBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    toggleBtn.Text = ""
    toggleBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

        if guard and not guard(not isOn) then return end
        isOn = not isOn
        local newPos = isOn and UDim2.new(1, -20 * MOBILE_SCALE, 0.5, -9 * MOBILE_SCALE) or UDim2.new(0, 2 * MOBILE_SCALE, 0.5, -9 * MOBILE_SCALE)
        local newColor = isOn and ON_COL or OFF_COL
        TweenService:Create(toggleDot, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {Position = newPos}):Play()
        TweenService:Create(toggleFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {BackgroundColor3 = newColor}):Play()
        if callback then callback(isOn) end

        if text ~= "Carpet Speed" then pcall(ShowNotification, text, isOn and "Enabled" or "Disabled") end
    end)

    local function setState(newOn)
        isOn = newOn and true or false
        toggleDot.Position = isOn and UDim2.new(1, -20 * MOBILE_SCALE, 0.5, -9 * MOBILE_SCALE) or UDim2.new(0, 2 * MOBILE_SCALE, 0.5, -9 * MOBILE_SCALE)
        toggleFrame.BackgroundColor3 = isOn and ON_COL or OFF_COL
    end

    return row, toggleFrame, toggleDot, setState
end

                    _rotSliderRefs.val.Text = tostring(cur)
                    _rotSliderRefs.lbl.Text = "Rotation: " .. cur

                    TweenService:Create(_rotSliderRefs.knob, tweenInfo, {Position = UDim2.new(rl, 0, 0.5, 0)}):Play()
                end
            else

            end

        end
    end)

            if updateVisualState then updateVisualState(_G.invisibleStealEnabled or false) end
        end
    end)
end

task.spawn(function()

        local num = tonumber(n)
        if not num then return tostring(n) end
        if num >= 1e12 then return string.format("%.1fT", num / 1e12):gsub("%.0T", "T")
        elseif num >= 1e9 then return string.format("%.1fB", num / 1e9):gsub("%.0B", "B")
        elseif num >= 1e6 then return string.format("%.1fM", num / 1e6):gsub("%.0M", "M")
        elseif num >= 1e3 then return string.format("%.1fK", num / 1e3):gsub("%.0K", "K")
        else return tostring(num) end
    end

    _G.VXFormatAbbreviated = formatAbbreviated

    VXRound(stealTrack, 6 * MOBILE_SCALE)

    local stealFill = VXNew("Frame", {
        Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), BorderSizePixel = 0,
    }, stealTrack)
    VXRound(stealFill, 7 * MOBILE_SCALE)

    VXGrad(stealFill, ColorSequence.new({

        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Theme.GoldLo),

    local stealSecs = {}
    local stealPct = {}

    local idleDistText = ""

    SharedState.StealBarMirror = { active = false, progress = 0, dur = 0 }
    local _lastPhase, _lastActive, _lastName, _lastIdle, _lastEnabled
    task.spawn(function()
        while frame.Parent do
            RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
            local mir = SharedState.StealBarMirror
            local active = (mir and mir.active) and true or false
            local dur = (mir and mir.dur) or 0

            local progress
            if active and mir and mir._start and dur > 0 then
                progress = math.clamp((os.clock() - mir._start) / dur, 0, 1)
            else
                progress = (mir and mir.progress) or 0
            end
            local ct = SharedState.SelectedPetData
            local nm = ct and (ct.petName or "") or ""
            local phase = _G.VXStealPhase or "IDLE"
            local _cycling = brainrotSelectionEnabled and (phase == "STEALING" or active)

            if not _cycling
            and phase == _lastPhase and active == _lastActive
            and nm == _lastName and idleDistText == _lastIdle
            and brainrotSelectionEnabled == _lastEnabled then
                continue
            end
            _lastPhase, _lastActive = phase, active
            _lastName, _lastIdle, _lastEnabled = nm, idleDistText, brainrotSelectionEnabled

            local cycling = brainrotSelectionEnabled and (phase == "STEALING" or active)
            if brainrotSelectionEnabled and phase == "RAGDOLLED" then

                stealStatus.Text = "RAGDOLLED"
                stealStatus.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80)
                stealNameLbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(198, 182, 221)

                stealBorder.Transparency = 0.2
            elseif brainrotSelectionEnabled and phase == "CARRYING" then

                stealStatus.Text = "CARRYING"
                stealStatus.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 235, 140)
                stealNameLbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(250, 230, 255)
                stealFill.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
                stealFill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 220, 120)
                stealPct.Text = "100%"
                stealPct.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 255, 230)
                stealSecs.Text = "delivering"
                stealBorder.Color = Color3.fromRGB(80, 220, 120)
                stealBorder.Transparency = 0.12
            elseif brainrotSelectionEnabled and phase == "OUT_OF_RANGE" then

                stealStatus.Text = "OUT OF RANGE"
                stealStatus.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 175, 70)
                stealNameLbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(250, 230, 255)
                stealFill.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
                stealFill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(160, 84, 240)
                stealPct.Text = ""
                stealSecs.Text = idleDistText
                stealBorder.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 175, 70)
                stealBorder.Transparency = 0.2
            elseif cycling then
                stealStatus.Text = "STEALING"
                stealStatus.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 235, 140)
                stealNameLbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(250, 230, 255)
                stealFill.Size = UDim2.new(active and progress or 0, 0, 1, 0)

                stealFill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
                stealPct.Text = math.floor((active and progress or 0) * 100) .. "%"
                stealPct.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(212, 195, 237)
                if active then
                    stealSecs.Text = string.format("%.1fs left", math.max(0, dur * (1 - progress)))
                end
                stealBorder.Color = Color3.fromRGB(150, 88, 232)
                stealBorder.Transparency = 0.12
            else

                stealStatus.Text = "IDLE"
                stealStatus.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 150, 60)
                stealNameLbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(218, 201, 245)
                stealFill.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
                stealPct.Text = ""
                stealSecs.Text = idleDistText
                stealBorder.Color = Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 132)
                stealBorder.Transparency = 0.5
            end
        end
    end)

    _G.VXStealPhase = _G.VXStealPhase or "IDLE"
    _G.VX_StealStatus = _G.VX_StealStatus or {}
    _G.VXStealHoldDur = 1.3
    _G.VXStealSyncLead = _G.VXStealSyncLead or 0.15

    local function genTierColor(gv)
        gv = gv or 0
        if gv >= 1e8 then return Color3.fromRGB(255, 104, 138)
        elseif gv >= 1e7 then return Color3.fromRGB(255, 214, 72)
        elseif gv >= 1e6 then return Color3.fromRGB(190, 96, 246)
        elseif gv >= 1e5 then return Color3.fromRGB(72, 148, 255)
        elseif gv >= 1e4 then return Color3.fromRGB(108, 206, 128)
        else return Color3.fromRGB(64, 214, 74) end
    end

    local RARITY_COLORS = {
        ["OG"] = Color3.fromRGB(255, 214, 92), ["Secret"] = Color3.fromRGB(236, 237, 242),
        ["Mythic"] = Color3.fromRGB(231, 56, 61), ["Brainrot God"] = Color3.fromRGB(255, 104, 138),
        ["Legendary"] = Color3.fromRGB(255, 214, 72), ["Epic"] = Color3.fromRGB(190, 96, 246),
        ["Rare"] = Color3.fromRGB(72, 148, 255), ["Uncommon"] = Color3.fromRGB(108, 206, 128),
        ["Common"] = Color3.fromRGB(64, 214, 74),
    }
    local function genTierWord(gv)
        gv = gv or 0
        if gv >= 1e8 then return "Brainrot God"
        elseif gv >= 1e7 then return "Legendary"
        elseif gv >= 1e6 then return "Epic"
        elseif gv >= 1e5 then return "Rare"
        elseif gv >= 1e4 then return "Uncommon"
        else return "Common" end
    end
    local function rarityInfo(petData)
        local word = petData.rarity or genTierWord(petData.mpsValue or petData.genValue)
        local col = RARITY_COLORS[word] or genTierColor(petData.mpsValue or petData.genValue)
        return word, col
    end

    _G.VXRarityInfo = rarityInfo

        VXRound(btn, 7 * MOBILE_SCALE)

        local cardShade = VXNew("Frame", {
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1), Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0),

            BorderSizePixel = 0,

        card.setThumb = function(pd)
            _thumbGen = _thumbGen + 1
            local myGen = _thumbGen
            for _, c in ipairs(thumb:GetChildren()) do
                if c:IsA("ViewportFrame") then c:Destroy() end
            end
            task.spawn(function()
                local tries = 0
                while _thumbGen == myGen and thumb.Parent do
                    local ok, vp = pcall(createAnimalPreview, thumb, pd.petName, UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0), pd.index, pd)
                    if ok and vp then
                        if _thumbGen ~= myGen then vp:Destroy() end
                        return
                    end
                    tries = tries + 1
                    task.wait(tries < 10 and 0.5 or 2)
                end
            end)
        end
        card.thumbFor = tostring(petData.index or petData.petName or "?") .. "|" .. tostring(petData.mutation or "")
        card.thumbModel = petData.model or petData._model
        card.setThumb(petData)

        card.tagPill = VXNew("Frame", {
            Position = UDim2.new(1, -68 * MOBILE_SCALE, 0, 6 * MOBILE_SCALE),
            Size = UDim2.new(0, 62 * MOBILE_SCALE, 0, 19 * MOBILE_SCALE),
            BackgroundColor3 = Theme.GoldHi, BackgroundTransparency = 0.05, BorderSizePixel = 0,
        }, btn)
        VXRound(card.tagPill, 9 * MOBILE_SCALE)
        VXGrad(card.tagPill, ColorSequence.new({
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Theme.GoldHi),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Theme.GoldLo),

        card.tagStroke = { Color = Theme.Accent1 }
        card.tag = VXNew("TextLabel", {
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Text = "", Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextSize = 11 * MOBILE_SCALE,
            TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(24, 18, 6), TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
        }, card.tagPill)

        card.name = VXNew("TextLabel", {
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 60 * MOBILE_SCALE, 0, 5 * MOBILE_SCALE),
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -120 * MOBILE_SCALE, 0, 21 * MOBILE_SCALE),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1, RichText = true, Text = petData.petName or "?",
            Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextSize = 17 * MOBILE_SCALE,
            TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(247, 227, 255), TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
        }, btn)
        VXGrad(card.name, ColorSequence.new({
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Theme.SilverHi),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Theme.GoldHi),
        }), 20)

        local rmRow = VXNew("Frame", {
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 60 * MOBILE_SCALE, 0, 30 * MOBILE_SCALE),
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -164 * MOBILE_SCALE, 0, 20 * MOBILE_SCALE),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        }, btn)
        VXNew("UIListLayout", {
            FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal,
            VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center,
            SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
            Padding = UDim.new(0, 6 * MOBILE_SCALE),
        }, rmRow)
        card.rarity = VXNew("TextLabel", {
            AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0), LayoutOrder = 1,
            BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "", Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, RichText = true,
            TextSize = 14 * MOBILE_SCALE, TextColor3 = Theme.TextSecondary, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
        }, rmRow)

        card.mutIcon = VXNew("ImageLabel", {
            LayoutOrder = 2, Size = UDim2.new(0, 18 * MOBILE_SCALE, 0, 18 * MOBILE_SCALE),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1, ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit, Image = "", Visible = false,

        card.mut = VXNew("TextLabel", {
            AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0), LayoutOrder = 3,

            TextSize = 14 * MOBILE_SCALE, TextColor3 = Theme.TextMuted, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,

                BackgroundTransparency = 1, ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit, Image = "", Visible = false,
            }, rmRow)

            local p = card.pet

            if SharedState._brManualUID ~= nil and tostring(SharedState._brManualUID) == tostring(p.uid) then
                SharedState._brManualUID = nil
            else
                SharedState._brManualUID = p.uid
            end
            selectedTargetUID = p.uid
            SharedState.SelectedPetData = p

            for i, q in ipairs(pets) do
                if tostring(q.uid) == tostring(p.uid) then selectedTargetIndex = i; break end

    local VISIBLE_SLOTS = 7
    local placeholderCards = {}
    local function buildPlaceholder(i)
        local row = VXNew("Frame", {

            Size = UDim2.new(1, -8 * MOBILE_SCALE, 0, BRL.ROW_H),
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(12, 12, 14), BackgroundTransparency = 0.5,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
        }, listFrame)
        VXRound(row, 7 * MOBILE_SCALE)
        local phShade = VXNew("Frame", {
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1), Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0),
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.5, 0), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0),
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
        }, row)
        VXRound(phShade, 7 * MOBILE_SCALE)
        VXGrad(phShade, nil, 90, NumberSequence.new({
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.9),
        }))

        local greyBar = VXNew("Frame", {
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.12, 0), Size = UDim2.new(0, 3 * MOBILE_SCALE, 0.76, 0),
            BackgroundColor3 = Theme.GoldLo, BackgroundTransparency = 0.35, BorderSizePixel = 0,
        }, row)
        VXRound(greyBar, 2)
        local blankThumb = VXNew("Frame", {
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 8 * MOBILE_SCALE, 0.5, -22 * MOBILE_SCALE),
            Size = UDim2.new(0, 44 * MOBILE_SCALE, 0, 44 * MOBILE_SCALE),
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(12, 12, 14), BackgroundTransparency = 0.25, BorderSizePixel = 0,
        }, row)
        VXRound(blankThumb, 7 * MOBILE_SCALE)
        VXNew("TextLabel", {
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 60 * MOBILE_SCALE, 0, 0),
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -120 * MOBILE_SCALE, 1, 0),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "---", Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
            TextSize = 11 * MOBILE_SCALE, TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(157, 144, 175),
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
        }, row)
        placeholderCards[i] = row
        return row
    end

    for i = 1, VISIBLE_SLOTS do
        local ph = buildPlaceholder(i)
        ph.LayoutOrder = 10000 + i
        ph.Visible = true
    end

    updateUI = function(enabled, allPets)
        brainrotSelectionEnabled = enabled
        allPets = allPets or {}

        local anyStolen = false
        for _, p in ipairs(allPets) do
            if p.isStolen then anyStolen = true break end
        end
        if anyStolen then
            local vis = {}
            for _, p in ipairs(allPets) do
                if not p.isStolen then vis[#vis + 1] = p end
            end
            allPets = vis
        end

        if selectedTargetUID then
            for i, p in ipairs(allPets) do
                if p.uid == selectedTargetUID then selectedTargetIndex = i; break end
            end
        end
        if selectedTargetIndex > #allPets then selectedTargetIndex = math.max(1, #allPets) end

        do
            local cur0 = SharedState.SelectedPetData
            if cur0 and cur0.isStolen then selectedTargetIndex = 0 end
        end

        local present = {}
        for i, petData in ipairs(allPets) do
            present[petData.uid] = true
            local sel = (i == selectedTargetIndex)
            local isCarpet = petData.isCarpet
            local rWord = rarityInfo(petData)
            local card = petCards[petData.uid]
            if not card then
                card = buildPetCard(petData)
                petCards[petData.uid] = card
            end
            card.pet = petData

            local thumbKey = tostring(petData.index or petData.petName or "?") .. "|" .. tostring(petData.mutation or "")
            local thumbModel = petData.model or petData._model
            if card.thumbFor ~= thumbKey or (thumbModel and card.thumbModel ~= thumbModel) then
                card.thumbFor = thumbKey
                card.thumbModel = thumbModel
                if card.setThumb then card.setThumb(petData) end
            end

            if card.root.LayoutOrder ~= i then card.root.LayoutOrder = i end

            if card._rWord ~= rWord then
                card._rWord = rWord
                card.rarity.Text = rWord
                VXRarity.Apply(card.rarity, rWord)
            end

            local nmText = petData.petName or "?"
            if card.name.Text ~= nmText then card.name.Text = nmText end
            if not card._styled then
                card.name.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(247, 227, 255)
                card.tag.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(24, 18, 6)
                card.stats.TextColor3 = Theme.GoldHi
                card.accent.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.GoldHi
                card.thumbStroke.Color = Theme.GoldHi
                card.border.Color = Theme.GoldHi
                card._styled = true
            end

            local mut = petData.mutation
            if card._mut ~= mut then
                card._mut = mut
                if mut and mut ~= "None" and mut ~= "" then
                    card.mut.Text = mut
                    card.mut.TextColor3 = VXIcons.MutationColor(mut) or Color3.fromRGB(208, 212, 220)
                    local mIcon = VXIcons.Mutation(mut)
                    card.mutIcon.Image = mIcon
                    card.mutIcon.Visible = (mIcon ~= "")
                else
                    card.mut.Text = "Normal"
                    card.mut.TextColor3 = Theme.TextMuted
                    card.mutIcon.Visible = false
                end
            end

            if card._traits ~= petData.traits then
                card._traits = petData.traits
                local traits = VXIcons.SplitTraits(petData.traits)
                for _ti = 1, #card.traitIcons do
                    local ic = card.traitIcons[_ti]
                    local tName = traits[_ti]
                    local tImg = tName and VXIcons.Trait(tName) or ""
                    if tImg ~= "" then
                        ic.Image = tImg
                        ic.Visible = true
                    else
                        ic.Visible = false
                    end
                end
            end

            local stText = petData.mpsText or "$?/s"
            if card.stats.Text ~= stText then card.stats.Text = stText end

            if isCarpet then
                if card.tag.Text ~= "CARPET" then card.tag.Text = "CARPET" end
            else
                local part = petData._part or (petData.animalData and findAdorneeGlobal(petData.animalData))
                if part and part.Parent then
                    local y = part.Position.Y
                    local fl = (y > 26.8 and "F3") or (y > 9.8 and "F2") or "F1"
                    if card.tag.Text ~= fl then card.tag.Text = fl end
                elseif card.tag.Text == "" or card.tag.Text == "CARPET" then
                    card.tag.Text = "F?"
                end
            end

            if card._sel ~= sel then
                card._sel = sel
                card.root.BackgroundColor3 = sel and Color3.fromRGB(26, 23, 14) or Color3.fromRGB(12, 12, 14)
                card.root.BackgroundTransparency = sel and 0.1 or 0.32
                card.border.Transparency = sel and 0.05 or 1
                card.border.Thickness = sel and 1.6 or 0
            end
        end
        for uid, card in pairs(petCards) do
            if not present[uid] then
                pcall(function() card.root:Destroy() end)
                petCards[uid] = nil
            end
        end

        for i = 1, VISIBLE_SLOTS do
            local ph = placeholderCards[i] or buildPlaceholder(i)
            ph.LayoutOrder = 10000 + i
            ph.Visible = (#allPets + i) <= VISIBLE_SLOTS
        end

        local ct = allPets[selectedTargetIndex]

        local cur = SharedState.SelectedPetData
        if not (cur and cur.isStolen) then
            SharedState.SelectedPetData = ct
        end
        SharedState.ListNeedsRedraw = false
        local sc = (brPop.Scale > 0) and brPop.Scale or 1

        listFrame.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0,0,0, math.max(0, uiListLayout.AbsoluteContentSize.Y / sc))
    end

    idleDistText = ""

    SharedState.UpdateBrainrotSelectionUI = function()
        SharedState.ListNeedsRedraw = true

        local autoSel = SharedState.SelectedPetData
        if SharedState._brManualUID == nil and autoSel and autoSel.uid then
            selectedTargetUID = autoSel.uid
        end
        updateUI(brainrotSelectionEnabled, get_all_pets())
    end

    _G.VXStealModeListeners = _G.VXStealModeListeners or {}
    _G.VXNotifyStealMode = function(active)
        for _, f in ipairs(_G.VXStealModeListeners) do pcall(f, active) end
    end
    SharedState.GetStealMode = function()
        if not brainrotSelectionEnabled then return nil end
        if stealNearestEnabled then return "Nearest" end
        if stealPriorityEnabled then return "Priority" end
        if stealHighestEnabled then return "Highest" end
        return nil
    end
    SharedState.SetStealMode = function(modeName)
        if modeName ~= "Nearest" and modeName ~= "Highest" and modeName ~= "Priority" then modeName = nil end
        stealNearestEnabled  = (modeName == "Nearest")
        stealHighestEnabled  = (modeName == "Highest")
        stealPriorityEnabled = (modeName == "Priority")
        brainrotSelectionEnabled = (modeName ~= nil)
        Config.AutoStealBrainrots = brainrotSelectionEnabled
        Config.StealNearest, Config.StealHighest, Config.StealPriority =
        stealNearestEnabled, stealHighestEnabled, stealPriorityEnabled
        if modeName then Config.LastBrainrotMode = modeName end

        if _G.VXSetStealMode then pcall(_G.VXSetStealMode, modeName) end
        SaveConfig()
        SharedState._brManualUntil = 0
        SharedState._brManualUID = nil
        local pets = get_all_pets()
        if modeName and #pets > 0 then
            selectedTargetIndex = 1
            selectedTargetUID = pets[1].uid
            SharedState.SelectedPetData = pets[1]
        end
        SharedState.ListNeedsRedraw = true
        if updateUI then updateUI(brainrotSelectionEnabled, pets) end
        if _G.VXNotifyStealMode then _G.VXNotifyStealMode(modeName) end
    end

    SharedState.SetBrainrotEnabled = function(on)
        if on then
            SharedState.SetStealMode(Config.LastBrainrotMode or "Highest")
        else
            SharedState.SetStealMode(nil)
        end
    end
    SharedState.GetBrainrotEnabled = function() return brainrotSelectionEnabled end

    task.spawn(function()
        for _ = 1, 60 do
            if SharedState.InitialScanComplete then break end
            task.wait(0.1)
        end
        local m = SharedState.GetStealMode and SharedState.GetStealMode()
        if m and _G.VXSetStealMode then pcall(_G.VXSetStealMode, m) end
    end)

    do
        local MS = MOBILE_SCALE

        local ssFrame = Instance.new("Frame")

        ssFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Background
