        applyMarble(ssFrame, true)
        ssFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
        ssFrame.ClipsDescendants = true
        ssFrame.Visible = Config.ShowStealSettings == true
        ssFrame.Parent = screenGui
        _G.VXSetStealSettingsVisible = function(on)
            if ssFrame and ssFrame.Parent then ssFrame.Visible = on and true or false end
        end
        Instance.new("UICorner", ssFrame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12 * MS)
        AddAnimatedBorder(ssFrame, 1.5)
        VXComplexBG(ssFrame, { corner = 12 * MS, stars = 8, border = false })
        local ssScale = Instance.new("UIScale", ssFrame)
        VXRegisterScale(ssScale, 1)
        AddMobileMinimize(ssFrame, "STEAL")

        local ssHeader = Instance.new("Frame", ssFrame)
        ssHeader.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40 * MS)
        ssHeader.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        MakeDraggable(ssHeader, ssFrame, "StealSettings")

        local ssStrip = Instance.new("Frame", ssHeader)
        ssStrip.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
        ssStrip.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 33 * MS)
        ssStrip.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(10, 10, 12)
        ssStrip.BackgroundTransparency = 0.45
        ssStrip.BorderSizePixel = 0
        Instance.new("UICorner", ssStrip).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12 * MS)

        local ssTitle = Instance.new("TextLabel", ssStrip)
        ssTitle.Size = UDim2.new(1, -28 * MS, 1, 0)
        ssTitle.Position = UDim2.new(0, 14 * MS, 0, 0)
        ssTitle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        ssTitle.Text = "Steal Settings"
        ssTitle.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        ssTitle.TextSize = 16 * MS
        ssTitle:SetAttribute("_vxTS", true)
        ssTitle.TextColor3 = Theme.TextPrimary
        ssTitle.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        ssTitle.ZIndex = 2
        VXGrad(ssTitle, ColorSequence.new({
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Theme.GoldHi),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Theme.GoldLo),
        }), 25)

        local ssContainer = Instance.new("Frame", ssFrame)
        ssContainer.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20 * MS, 0, 0)
        ssContainer.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
        ssContainer.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10 * MS, 0, 40 * MS)
        ssContainer.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        local ssLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout", ssContainer)
        ssLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 4 * MS)
        ssLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder

        local ssSet = {}
        for _, nm in ipairs({ "Nearest", "Highest", "Priority" }) do
            local _, _, _, setter = makeToggleRow(ssContainer, "Steal " .. nm,
                (SharedState.GetStealMode and SharedState.GetStealMode()) == nm,
                function(on)
                SharedState.SetStealMode(on and nm or nil)
            end)
            ssSet[nm] = setter
        end

        local function ssFit()
            local sc = (ssScale.Scale > 0) and ssScale.Scale or 1
            local h = ssLayout.AbsoluteContentSize.Y / sc
            ssFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 252 * MS, 0, 40 * MS + h + 10 * MS)
        end
        ssLayout:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteContentSize"):Connect(ssFit)
        ssScale:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Scale"):Connect(ssFit)
        task.defer(ssFit)

        task.defer(function()
            for _, d in ipairs(ssFrame:GetDescendants()) do
                if (d:IsA("TextLabel") or d:IsA("TextButton")) and not d:GetAttribute("_vxTS")
                and not d.TextScaled and (d.TextSize or 0) > 0 then
                    d:SetAttribute("_vxTS", true)
                    d.TextSize = math.floor(d.TextSize * 1.18 + 0.5)
                end
            end
        end)

        _G.VXStealModeListeners = _G.VXStealModeListeners or {}
        table.insert(_G.VXStealModeListeners, function(active)
            for nm, set in pairs(ssSet) do set(nm == active) end
        end)

        screenGui:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Enabled"):Connect(function()
            if screenGui.Enabled then VXFadeReveal(ssFrame) end
        end)
    end
end)

local function CreateAdminPanel()
    local adminGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    adminGui.Name = _vxName("VXAdminPanel")
    adminGui.DisplayOrder = 50000
    adminGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
    adminGui.Enabled = false
    mountGui(adminGui)

    adminGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling

    local containerFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
    containerFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 452 * MOBILE_SCALE, 0, 0)

    containerFrame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
    _vxApplySavedPos(containerFrame, "AdminPanel", 0.5, 0.3)
    containerFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    containerFrame.Parent = adminGui
    containerFrame.ZIndex = 1
    local apScale = Instance.new("UIScale", containerFrame)
    VXRegisterScale(apScale, 1)

    local dragBar = Instance.new("Frame", containerFrame)
    dragBar.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 33 * MOBILE_SCALE)
    dragBar.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 25 * MOBILE_SCALE)
    dragBar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(10, 10, 12)
    dragBar.BackgroundTransparency = 0.45
    dragBar.BorderSizePixel = 0
    dragBar.ZIndex = 2
    Instance.new("UICorner", dragBar).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12 * MOBILE_SCALE)

    local dragTitle = Instance.new("TextLabel", dragBar)
    dragTitle.Size = UDim2.new(1, -90 * MOBILE_SCALE, 1, 0)
    dragTitle.Position = UDim2.new(0, 14 * MOBILE_SCALE, 0, 0)
    dragTitle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    dragTitle.ZIndex = 3
    dragTitle.Text = "Admin Panel"
    dragTitle.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
    dragTitle.TextSize = 16 * MOBILE_SCALE
    dragTitle:SetAttribute("_vxTS", true)
    dragTitle.TextColor3 = Theme.TextPrimary
    dragTitle.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    dragTitle.TextStrokeTransparency = 1
    VXGrad(dragTitle, ColorSequence.new({
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Theme.GoldHi),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Theme.GoldLo),
    }), 25)

    local mainFrame = Instance.new("Frame", containerFrame)
    mainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -25 * MOBILE_SCALE)
    mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 25 * MOBILE_SCALE)
    mainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    mainFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.08
    mainFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
    mainFrame.ClipsDescendants = true
    mainFrame.ZIndex = 1

    applyMarble(mainFrame, true)

    local outerBorder = Instance.new("UIStroke", mainFrame)
    outerBorder.Thickness = 0.8
    outerBorder.Transparency = 0.35
    outerBorder.Color = Color3.fromRGB(6, 6, 8)
    outerBorder.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border

    local outerGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient", outerBorder)
    outerGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new{
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Theme.SilverLo),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Theme.GoldHi),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Theme.SilverLo)
    }

    outerGrad.Rotation = 25
    outerBorder.Transparency = 0.25

    Instance.new("UICorner", mainFrame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12 * MOBILE_SCALE)

    MakeDraggable(dragBar, containerFrame, "AdminPanel")
    local contentContainer = Instance.new("Frame", mainFrame)

    contentContainer.Size = UDim2.new(1, -12 * MOBILE_SCALE, 1, -50 * MOBILE_SCALE)
    contentContainer.Position = UDim2.new(0, 6 * MOBILE_SCALE, 0, 40 * MOBILE_SCALE)
    contentContainer.BackgroundTransparency = 1

    local playerList = Instance.new("Frame", contentContainer)
    playerList.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    playerList.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
    playerList.BackgroundTransparency = 1

    local listLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout", playerList)
    listLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 5 * MOBILE_SCALE)
    listLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder

    local function fireClick(button)
        if button then
            if firesignal then
                pcall(firesignal, button.MouseButton1Down)
                pcall(firesignal, button.MouseButton1Up)
                pcall(firesignal, button.Activated)
                pcall(firesignal, button.MouseButton1Click)
            else
                local x = button.AbsolutePosition.X + (button.AbsoluteSize.X / 2)
                local y = button.AbsolutePosition.Y + (button.AbsoluteSize.Y / 2) + 58
                VirtualInputManager:SendMouseButtonEvent(x, y, 0, true, game, 0)
                task.wait()
                VirtualInputManager:SendMouseButtonEvent(x, y, 0, false, game, 0)
            end
        end
    end
    _G.fireClick = fireClick

    local function findProfileButton(profilesScroll, targetPlayer)
        if not profilesScroll or not targetPlayer then return nil end
        local btn = profilesScroll:FindFirstChild(targetPlayer.Name)
        if btn and btn:IsA("GuiButton") then return btn end
        for _, child in ipairs(profilesScroll:GetChildren()) do
            if child:IsA("GuiButton") and (child.Name == targetPlayer.Name or child.Name == targetPlayer.DisplayName) then
                return child
            end
        end
        for _, child in ipairs(profilesScroll:GetDescendants()) do
            if child:IsA("GuiButton") and (child.Name == targetPlayer.Name or child.Name == targetPlayer.DisplayName) then
                return child
            end
        end
        return nil
    end

    local function runAdminCommand(targetPlayer, commandName)
        if not targetPlayer or not commandName then return false end
        if targetPlayer ~= LocalPlayer and shouldSkipAPPanel(targetPlayer) then
            return false
        end
        local realAdminGui = PlayerGui:WaitForChild("AdminPanel", 5)
        if not realAdminGui then return false end

        for attempt = 1, 4 do
            local contentScroll = realAdminGui:FindFirstChild("AdminPanel", true)
            contentScroll = contentScroll and contentScroll:FindFirstChild("Content", true)
            contentScroll = contentScroll and contentScroll:FindFirstChild("ScrollingFrame")
            local cmdBtn = contentScroll and contentScroll:FindFirstChild(commandName)
            if cmdBtn then
                fireClick(cmdBtn)
                task.wait(0.05 + (attempt - 1) * 0.05)
                local profilesScroll = realAdminGui:FindFirstChild("AdminPanel", true)
                profilesScroll = profilesScroll and profilesScroll:FindFirstChild("Profiles", true)
                profilesScroll = profilesScroll and profilesScroll:FindFirstChild("ScrollingFrame")
                local playerBtn = findProfileButton(profilesScroll, targetPlayer)
                if playerBtn then
                    fireClick(playerBtn)
                    return true
                end
            end
            task.wait(0.05)
        end
        return false
    end

    _G.runAdminCommand = runAdminCommand

    _G.VXCmdSequence = function()
        local valid = {}
        for _, id in ipairs(ALL_COMMANDS) do valid[id] = true end
        local en = Config.AdminCmdEnabled or {}
        local out, seen = {}, {}

        for _, id in ipairs(_G.VXAdminCmdOrder or Config.AdminCmdOrder or {}) do
            if valid[id] and not seen[id] then
                seen[id] = true
                if en[id] ~= false then out[#out + 1] = id end
            end
        end

        for _, id in ipairs(ALL_COMMANDS) do
            if not seen[id] and en[id] ~= false then out[#out + 1] = id end
        end
        return out
    end

    _G.VXRunCmdSequence = function(targetPlayer, onFired, skipFn)
        if not targetPlayer then return 0 end
        local fired = 0

        local delay = tonumber(_G.VXAdminCmdDelay) or tonumber(Config.AdminCmdDelay) or 0
        delay = math.floor(math.clamp(delay, 0, 0.5) * 10 + 0.5) / 10
        for _, cmd in ipairs(_G.VXCmdSequence()) do
            if not (skipFn and skipFn(cmd)) then
                if runAdminCommand(targetPlayer, cmd) then
                    fired = fired + 1
                    if onFired then pcall(onFired, cmd) end
                end
                if delay > 0 then task.wait(delay) else task.wait() end
            end
        end
        return fired
    end

    local function teleportToPlayerBase(plr)
        if _G.VXTeleportToPlayerBase then return _G.VXTeleportToPlayerBase(plr) end
        VXStubNote("Admin TP")
        return false
    end

    local isOnCooldown = function(cmd)
        local adminGui = PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("AdminPanel")
        if adminGui then
            local content = adminGui:FindFirstChild("AdminPanel")
            if content then
                local scrollFrame = content:FindFirstChild("Content")
                if scrollFrame then
                    local scrollingFrame = scrollFrame:FindFirstChild("ScrollingFrame")
                    if scrollingFrame then
                        local cmdButton = scrollingFrame:FindFirstChild(cmd)
                        if cmdButton then
                            local timerLabel = cmdButton:FindFirstChild("Timer")
                            if timerLabel then
                                return timerLabel.Visible
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        if not activeCooldowns[cmd] then return false end
        return (tick() - activeCooldowns[cmd]) < (COOLDOWNS[cmd] or 0)
    end

    local function setGlobalVisualCooldown(cmd)
        if SharedState.AdminButtonCache[cmd] then
            for _, b in ipairs(SharedState.AdminButtonCache[cmd]) do
                if b and b.Parent then
                    b.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Error
                    task.delay(COOLDOWNS[cmd] or 5, function()
                        if b and b.Parent then
                            local hasBallooned = (cmd == "balloon" and SharedState.BalloonedPlayers and next(SharedState.BalloonedPlayers) ~= nil)
                            b.BackgroundColor3 = hasBallooned and Theme.Error or Theme.SurfaceHighlight
                        end
                    end)
                end
            end
        end
    end

    local function updateBalloonButtons()
        local hasBallooned = false
        for _, _ in pairs(SharedState.BalloonedPlayers) do
            hasBallooned = true
            break
        end
        if SharedState.AdminButtonCache and SharedState.AdminButtonCache["balloon"] then
            for _, b in ipairs(SharedState.AdminButtonCache["balloon"]) do
                if b and b.Parent then
                    b.BackgroundColor3 = hasBallooned and Theme.Error or Theme.SurfaceHighlight
                end
            end
        end
    end

    local function triggerAll(plr)

        task.spawn(function()
            if not _G.VXRunCmdSequence then return end
            _G.VXRunCmdSequence(plr, function(cmd)
                activeCooldowns[cmd] = tick()
                setGlobalVisualCooldown(cmd)
                if cmd == "balloon" then
                    SharedState.BalloonedPlayers[plr.UserId] = true
                    updateBalloonButtons()
                end
            end, isOnCooldown)
        end)
    end

    local function createPlayerRow(plr)
        local row = Instance.new("Frame")
        row.Name = plr.Name
        row.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 52 * MOBILE_SCALE)

        row.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(12, 12, 14)
        row.BackgroundTransparency = 0.32
        row.BorderSizePixel = 0
        row.Parent = playerList
        row.ClipsDescendants = false

        local rowBorder = Instance.new("UIStroke", row)
        rowBorder.Thickness = 1
        rowBorder.Transparency = 0.85
        rowBorder.Color = Color3.fromRGB(6, 6, 8)
        rowBorder.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border

        Instance.new("UICorner", row).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8 * MOBILE_SCALE)

        row.MouseEnter:Connect(function()

            TweenService:Create(row, TweenInfo.new(0.18), { BackgroundTransparency = 0.6 }):Play()
            TweenService:Create(rowBorder, TweenInfo.new(0.18), { Transparency = 0.6 }):Play()
        end)
        row.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
            TweenService:Create(row, TweenInfo.new(0.18), { BackgroundTransparency = 0.32 }):Play()
            TweenService:Create(rowBorder, TweenInfo.new(0.18), { Transparency = 0.85 }):Play()
        end)

        local spamAllHitbox = Instance.new("TextButton", row)
        spamAllHitbox.Size = UDim2.new(1, -220 * MOBILE_SCALE, 1, 0)
        spamAllHitbox.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
        spamAllHitbox.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        spamAllHitbox.Text = ""
        spamAllHitbox.ZIndex = 5
        spamAllHitbox.AutoButtonColor = false

        spamAllHitbox.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

            if plr ~= LocalPlayer and shouldSkipAPPanel(plr) then
                if row and row.Parent then
                    local orig = row.BackgroundColor3
                    row.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Error
                    task.delay(0.18, function()
                        if row and row.Parent then row.BackgroundColor3 = orig end
                    end)
                end
                if ShowNotification then
                    ShowNotification("Blocked", "This player is HIDDEN / protected")
                end
                return
            end
            local hasAnyAvailable = false
            for _, cmd in ipairs(ALL_COMMANDS) do
                if not isOnCooldown(cmd) then
                    hasAnyAvailable = true
                    break
                end
            end
            if hasAnyAvailable then
                triggerAll(plr)
                local originalColor = row.BackgroundColor3
                row.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Success
                task.delay(0.15, function()
                    if row and row.Parent then
                        row.BackgroundColor3 = originalColor
                    end
                end)
            end
        end)

        local headshot = Instance.new("ImageLabel", row)
        headshot.Size = UDim2.new(0, 36 * MOBILE_SCALE, 0, 36 * MOBILE_SCALE)
        headshot.Position = UDim2.new(0, 6 * MOBILE_SCALE, 0.5, -18 * MOBILE_SCALE)
        headshot.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 17, 22)
        headshot.Image = Players:GetUserThumbnailAsync(plr.UserId, Enum.ThumbnailType.HeadShot, Enum.ThumbnailSize.Size48x48)
        Instance.new("UICorner", headshot).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
        headshot.ZIndex = 6

        local headshotStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", headshot)
        headshotStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(6, 6, 8)
        headshotStroke.Thickness = 1.5 * MOBILE_SCALE
        headshotStroke.Transparency = 0.4
        headshot.ZIndex = 6

        local dName = Instance.new("TextLabel", row)
        dName.Size = UDim2.new(0, 190 * MOBILE_SCALE, 0, 18 * MOBILE_SCALE)

        dName.Position = UDim2.new(0, 48 * MOBILE_SCALE, 0, 8 * MOBILE_SCALE)
        dName.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        dName.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd

        local _tags = {}

        if isFMLYPlayer(plr) and Config.FMLYTagInPanel == true then
            _tags[#_tags+1] = '<font color="rgb(255,215,0)"><b>[FMLY]</b></font>'
        end
        if _G.VXSkipAPPanel and _G.VXSkipAPPanel(plr) then
            _tags[#_tags+1] = '<font color="rgb(0,255,85)"><b>[HIDDEN]</b></font>'
        end
        local _hasTags = (#_tags > 0)
        dName.RichText = _hasTags
        dName.Text = _hasTags and ((plr.DisplayName or "") .. "  " .. table.concat(_tags, " ")) or (plr.DisplayName or "")
        MakeText(dName, true)
        dName.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
        dName.TextSize = 14 * MOBILE_SCALE
        dName.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(247, 227, 255)
        dName.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        dName.ZIndex = 6

        VXGrad(dName, ColorSequence.new({
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Theme.SilverHi),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Theme.GoldHi),
        }), 20)

        local uName = Instance.new("TextLabel", row)
        uName.Size = UDim2.new(0, 150 * MOBILE_SCALE, 0, 12 * MOBILE_SCALE)
        uName.Position = UDim2.new(0, 48 * MOBILE_SCALE, 0, 28 * MOBILE_SCALE)
        uName.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        uName.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
        uName.TextSize = 8 * MOBILE_SCALE
        uName.TextColor3 = Theme.TextMuted
        uName.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        uName.ZIndex = 6

        task.spawn(function()
            while row.Parent do
                task.wait(0.5)
                if not plr or not plr.Parent or not Players:FindFirstChild(plr.Name) then
                    removePlayer(plr)
                    break
                end

                local stealing = plr:GetAttribute("Stealing")
                local nearestBrainrotName = plr:GetAttribute("StealingIndex")

                if stealing then
                    if nearestBrainrotName then
                        uName.Text = nearestBrainrotName
                        uName.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 70, 90)
                        uName.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
                        uName.TextSize = 9 * MOBILE_SCALE
                    else
                        uName.Text = "Stealing"
                        uName.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 70, 90)
                        uName.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
                        uName.TextSize = 9 * MOBILE_SCALE
                    end
                else
                    uName.Text = "@" .. plr.Name
                    uName.TextColor3 = Theme.TextPrimary
                    uName.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
                    uName.TextSize = 9 * MOBILE_SCALE
                end
            end
        end)

        local buttonSpacing = 38 * MOBILE_SCALE
        local buttonSize = 32 * MOBILE_SCALE

        local btnCont = Instance.new("Frame", row)
        btnCont.Name = "VX_btnCont"
        btnCont.Size = UDim2.new(0, (5 * buttonSize) + (4 * (buttonSpacing - buttonSize)), 1, 0)
        btnCont.Position = UDim2.new(1, -btnCont.Size.X.Offset - 10 * MOBILE_SCALE, 0, 0)
        btnCont.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        btnCont.ZIndex = 10
        btnCont.ClipsDescendants = false

        local buttonsDef = {
            {icon = "\240\159\154\128", cmd = "rocket",  color = Theme.SurfaceHighlight, emoji = true},
            {icon = "\240\159\164\184", cmd = "ragdoll", color = Theme.SurfaceHighlight, emoji = true},
            {icon = "\240\159\148\146", cmd = "jail",    color = Theme.SurfaceHighlight, emoji = true},
            {icon = "\240\159\142\136", cmd = "balloon", color = Theme.SurfaceHighlight, emoji = true},
            {icon = "TP",               cmd = "tp",      color = Theme.SurfaceHighlight, emoji = false}
        }

        local startX = 0
        for i, def in ipairs(buttonsDef) do
            local b = Instance.new("TextButton", btnCont)
            b.Size = UDim2.new(0, buttonSize, 0, buttonSize)
            b.Position = UDim2.new(0, startX + ((i-1) * buttonSpacing), 0.5, -buttonSize/2)
            b.AutoButtonColor = false
            b.Text = def.icon
            b.TextSize = (def.emoji and 16 or 12) * MOBILE_SCALE
            b.TextColor3 = Theme.TextPrimary
            if def.emoji then
                b.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
                pcall(function() b.FontFace = Font.fromEnum(Enum.Font.Gotham) end)
                b.RichText = false
                b.TextScaled = false
            else
                b.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
            end
            b.Active = true
            b.ZIndex = 11
            b.BackgroundTransparency = 0.32
            b.BackgroundColor3 = def.color
            b.BorderSizePixel = 0

            local corner = Instance.new("UICorner", b)
            corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8 * MOBILE_SCALE)

            local bHollow = Instance.new("UIStroke", b)
            bHollow.Color = Color3.fromRGB(6, 6, 8)
            bHollow.Thickness = 0.5
            bHollow.Transparency = 0.5
            bHollow.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border

            b.MouseEnter:Connect(function()

                if def.cmd == "tp" then
                    TweenService:Create(b, TweenInfo.new(0.16), { BackgroundColor3 = Theme.SurfaceLight }):Play()
                elseif not isOnCooldown(def.cmd) and not (def.cmd == "balloon" and SharedState.BalloonedPlayers and next(SharedState.BalloonedPlayers) ~= nil) then
                    TweenService:Create(b, TweenInfo.new(0.16), { BackgroundColor3 = Theme.SurfaceLight }):Play()
                end
            end)
            b.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
                if def.cmd == "tp" then
                    TweenService:Create(b, TweenInfo.new(0.16), { BackgroundColor3 = Theme.SurfaceHighlight }):Play()
                elseif not isOnCooldown(def.cmd) and not (def.cmd == "balloon" and SharedState.BalloonedPlayers and next(SharedState.BalloonedPlayers) ~= nil) then
                    TweenService:Create(b, TweenInfo.new(0.16), { BackgroundColor3 = Theme.SurfaceHighlight }):Play()
                end
            end)

            if not SharedState.AdminButtonCache[def.cmd] then
                SharedState.AdminButtonCache[def.cmd] = {}
            end
            table.insert(SharedState.AdminButtonCache[def.cmd], b)

            task.spawn(function()
                while b and b.Parent do
                    task.wait(0.5)
                    if def.cmd == "tp" then
                        if b.BackgroundColor3 ~= Theme.SurfaceHighlight and b.BackgroundColor3 ~= Theme.SurfaceLight then
                            b.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.SurfaceHighlight
                        end
                    else
                        local cd = isOnCooldown(def.cmd)
                        local balloon = (def.cmd == "balloon" and SharedState.BalloonedPlayers and next(SharedState.BalloonedPlayers) ~= nil)
                        if cd or balloon then
                            b.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Error
                        elseif b.BackgroundColor3 ~= Theme.SurfaceHighlight then
                            b.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.SurfaceHighlight
                        end
                    end
                end
            end)

            b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

                if plr ~= LocalPlayer and shouldSkipAPPanel(plr) then
                    if row and row.Parent then
                        local orig = row.BackgroundColor3
                        row.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Error
                        task.delay(0.18, function() if row and row.Parent then row.BackgroundColor3 = orig end end)
                    end
                    if ShowNotification then
                        ShowNotification("Blocked", "This player is HIDDEN / protected")
                    end
                    return
                end
                if def.cmd == "tp" then
                    teleportToPlayerBase(plr)
                else
                    if runAdminCommand(plr, def.cmd) then
                        activeCooldowns[def.cmd] = tick()
                        setGlobalVisualCooldown(def.cmd)
                        if def.cmd == "balloon" then
                            SharedState.BalloonedPlayers[plr.UserId] = true
                            for _, btn in ipairs(SharedState.AdminButtonCache["balloon"] or {}) do
                                if btn and btn.Parent then
                                    btn.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Error
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end)
        end

        VXTextShine(row)
        return row
    end

    local playerRows = {}
    local playerRowsByUserId = {}

    local function updateContainerSize()

        local hasPlayers = next(playerRowsByUserId) ~= nil
        mainFrame.Visible = hasPlayers
        if not hasPlayers then
            containerFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 452 * MOBILE_SCALE, 0, 52 * MOBILE_SCALE)
            return
        end

        local f = (apScale.Scale > 0) and apScale.Scale or 1
        local totalHeight = (listLayout.AbsoluteContentSize.Y or 0) / f

        containerFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 452 * MOBILE_SCALE, 0, totalHeight + 75 * MOBILE_SCALE)
    end
    updateContainerSize()

    listLayout:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteContentSize"):Connect(function()
        updateContainerSize()
    end)

    local function addPlayer(plr)
        if plr == LocalPlayer or playerRowsByUserId[plr.UserId] then return end
        if not Players:FindFirstChild(plr.Name) then return end
        if Config.HideFMLYFromPanel and isFMLYPlayer(plr) then return end

        if playerRows[plr] then return end

        local row = createPlayerRow(plr)
        playerRows[plr] = row
        playerRowsByUserId[plr.UserId] = {player = plr, row = row}
        updateContainerSize()
    end

    local function removePlayer(plr)
        local userId = plr and plr.UserId or nil
        local entry = userId and playerRowsByUserId[userId] or nil
        local row = entry and entry.row or playerRows[plr]

        if row then
            if row.Parent then
                for cmd, buttons in pairs(SharedState.AdminButtonCache) do
                    for i = #buttons, 1, -1 do
                        if buttons[i] and buttons[i].Parent == row then
                            table.remove(buttons, i)
                        end
                    end
                end
                row:Destroy()
            end
            if plr then
                playerRows[plr] = nil
            end
            if userId then
                playerRowsByUserId[userId] = nil
            end
            if SharedState.BalloonedPlayers and userId then
                SharedState.BalloonedPlayers[userId] = nil
            end
            updateContainerSize()
        end
    end

    Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(plr)
        task.wait(0.1)
        if plr and plr.Parent and plr ~= LocalPlayer then
            addPlayer(plr)
        end
    end)

    Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(plr)
        removePlayer(plr)
    end)

    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= LocalPlayer then
            addPlayer(p)
        end
    end

    _G.VXApplyAdminRowFilters = function()
        for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if p ~= LocalPlayer then removePlayer(p) end
        end
        for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if p ~= LocalPlayer then addPlayer(p) end
        end
    end
end

local ProximityAPActive = false
local PROXIMITY_RANGE = Config.ProximityRange or 15

local proxtp = nil
local function updateProxRing()
    if ProximityAPActive then
        if not proxtp or not proxtp.Parent then
            proxtp = Instance.new("Part")
            proxtp.Name = _vxName("VXProxRing")
            proxtp.Anchored = true
            proxtp.CanCollide = false
            proxtp.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
            proxtp.Color = Theme.GoldLo
            proxtp.Transparency = 0.65
            proxtp.CastShadow = false
            proxtp.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
            proxtp:SetAttribute("__TPMarker", true)
            proxtp.Parent = workspace

            local glowRing = Instance.new("Part")
            glowRing.Name = "Glow"
            glowRing.Anchored = true
            glowRing.CanCollide = false
            glowRing.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
            glowRing.Color = Theme.GoldHi
            glowRing.Transparency = 0.8
            glowRing.CastShadow = false
            glowRing.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
            glowRing:SetAttribute("__TPMarker", true)
            glowRing.Parent = proxtp
        end

        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        if char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            local hrp = char.HumanoidRootPart
            local radius = PROXIMITY_RANGE
            local diameter = radius * 2

            proxtp.Size = Vector3.new(0.1, diameter, diameter)
            proxtp.CFrame = (hrp.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, -3.2, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90))
            proxtp.Transparency = 0.55

            local glowRing = proxtp:FindFirstChild("Glow")
            if glowRing then
                glowRing.Size = Vector3.new(0.05, diameter + 0.8, diameter + 0.8)
                glowRing.CFrame = proxtp.CFrame
                glowRing.Transparency = 0.75
            end

            local pulse = (math.sin(tick() * 4) + 1) / 2
            local pColor1 = Theme.GoldLo
            local pColor2 = Theme.GoldHi
            proxtp.Color = pColor1:Lerp(pColor2, pulse)
            if glowRing then
                glowRing.Color = pColor2:Lerp(pColor1, pulse)
            end
        end
    else
        if proxtp and proxtp.Parent then
            proxtp:Destroy()
            proxtp = nil
        end
    end
end

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()

    if not ProximityAPActive and not proxtp then return end
    updateProxRing()
end)

        Instance.new("UICorner", fill).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
        local acsFillGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient", fill)
        acsFillGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new{
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(92, 52, 158)),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(160, 84, 240)),
        }

        knob.Size = UDim2.new(0, 20 * MOBILE_SCALE, 0, 9 * MOBILE_SCALE)
        knob.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)

        knob.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(math.clamp((value - min)/(max - min), 0, 1), 0.5)

        Instance.new("UICorner", knob).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

        knobStroke.Transparency = 0.15
        knobStroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border

        local dragging = false
        local function updateSlider(inputX)
            local pos = sliderBg.AbsolutePosition.X
            local size = sliderBg.AbsoluteSize.X
            local pct = math.clamp((inputX - pos) / size, 0, 1)
            value = min + (pct * (max - min))

        end)

                updateSlider(input.Position.X)
            end
        end)

    local clickToAPHighlight = nil
    local function createClickToAPHighlight()
        if clickToAPHighlight then return end
        clickToAPHighlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
        clickToAPHighlight.Name = _vxName("ClickToAPHighlight")
        clickToAPHighlight.FillColor = Theme.Accent1
        clickToAPHighlight.FillTransparency = 0.5
        clickToAPHighlight.OutlineColor = Theme.Accent2
        clickToAPHighlight.OutlineTransparency = 0.2
        clickToAPHighlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
        clickToAPHighlight.Parent = VXGui
    end

    local function rayToCubeIntersect(rayOrigin, rayDirection, cubeCenter, cubeSize)
        local halfSize = cubeSize / 2
        local minBounds = cubeCenter - Vector3.new(halfSize, halfSize, halfSize)
        local maxBounds = cubeCenter + Vector3.new(halfSize, halfSize, halfSize)
        if rayDirection.X == 0 then rayDirection = Vector3.new(0.0001, rayDirection.Y, rayDirection.Z) end
        if rayDirection.Y == 0 then rayDirection = Vector3.new(rayDirection.X, 0.0001, rayDirection.Z) end
        if rayDirection.Z == 0 then rayDirection = Vector3.new(rayDirection.X, rayDirection.Y, 0.0001) end
        local tmin = (minBounds.X - rayOrigin.X) / rayDirection.X
        local tmax = (maxBounds.X - rayOrigin.X) / rayDirection.X
        if tmin > tmax then tmin, tmax = tmax, tmin end
        local tymin = (minBounds.Y - rayOrigin.Y) / rayDirection.Y
        local tymax = (maxBounds.Y - rayOrigin.Y) / rayDirection.Y
        if tymin > tymax then tymin, tymax = tymax, tymin end
        if tmin > tymax or tymin > tmax then return false end
        if tymin > tmin then tmin = tymin end
        if tymax < tmax then tmax = tymax end
        local tzmin = (minBounds.Z - rayOrigin.Z) / rayDirection.Z
        local tzmax = (maxBounds.Z - rayOrigin.Z) / rayDirection.Z
        if tzmin > tzmax then tzmin, tzmax = tzmax, tzmin end
        if tmin > tzmax or tzmin > tmax then return false end
        if tzmax < tmax then tmax = tzmax end

        if tmax < 0 then return false end
        return true
    end

    local function getPlayerHitboxPart(player)
        local char = player.Character
        if not char then return nil end
        return char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or char:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
    end

    task.spawn(function()
        createClickToAPHighlight()
        local lastHoveredPlayer = nil
        local _capAcc = 0
        RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)

            if Config.ClickToAP then
                _capAcc = _capAcc + dt
                if _capAcc < 0.05 then return end
                _capAcc = 0
                local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
                local mousePos = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
                local ray = camera:ViewportPointToRay(mousePos.X, mousePos.Y)
                local hitboxSize = 6
                local bestPlayer = nil
                local bestDistance = math.huge
                for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                    if p ~= LocalPlayer and not shouldSkipClickToAP(p) then
                        local hitboxPart = getPlayerHitboxPart(p)
                        if hitboxPart then
                            local cubeCenter = hitboxPart.Position
                            if rayToCubeIntersect(ray.Origin, ray.Direction, cubeCenter, hitboxSize) then
                                local distance = (ray.Origin - cubeCenter).Magnitude
                                if distance < bestDistance then
                                    bestDistance = distance
                                    bestPlayer = p
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                if bestPlayer ~= lastHoveredPlayer then
                    if bestPlayer then clickToAPHighlight.Adornee = bestPlayer.Character
                    else clickToAPHighlight.Adornee = nil end
                    lastHoveredPlayer = bestPlayer
                end
            elseif lastHoveredPlayer then

                if clickToAPHighlight then clickToAPHighlight.Adornee = nil end
                lastHoveredPlayer = nil
            end
        end)
    end)

    UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
        if gameProcessed then return end
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and Config.ClickToAP then
            local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
            local mousePos = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
            local ray = camera:ViewportPointToRay(mousePos.X, mousePos.Y)
            local hitboxSize = 6
            local bestPlayer = nil
            local bestDistance = math.huge
            for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if p ~= LocalPlayer and not shouldSkipClickToAP(p) then
                    local hitboxPart = getPlayerHitboxPart(p)
                    if hitboxPart then
                        local cubeCenter = hitboxPart.Position
                        if rayToCubeIntersect(ray.Origin, ray.Direction, cubeCenter, hitboxSize) then
                            local distance = (ray.Origin - cubeCenter).Magnitude
                            if distance < bestDistance then
                                bestDistance = distance
                                bestPlayer = p
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            if bestPlayer then
                task.spawn(function()

                    if not _G.VXRunCmdSequence then return end
                    if Config.ClickToAPSingleCommand then
                        local seq = _G.VXCmdSequence()
                        if #seq == 0 then return end
                        _G.clickToAPCycleIndex = (_G.clickToAPCycleIndex or 0) % #seq + 1
                        if _G.runAdminCommand then
                            _G.runAdminCommand(bestPlayer, seq[_G.clickToAPCycleIndex])
                        end
                    else
                        _G.VXRunCmdSequence(bestPlayer)
                    end
                end)
            end
        end
    end)

    local _, setClickAP, getClickAP = createToggleRow("Click to AP", Config.ClickToAP, function(on)
        Config.ClickToAP = on
        SaveConfig()
    end)
    _G.ToggleClickToAP = function()
        setClickAP(not getClickAP())
    end

    local brainrotClickHighlight = nil
    local brainrotClickExtras = {}
    local function styleBrainrotHighlight(h)
        h.FillColor = Theme.Accent2
        h.FillTransparency = 0.35
        h.OutlineColor = Theme.GoldHi
        h.OutlineTransparency = 0
        h.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
        h.Parent = VXGui
    end
    local function ensureBrainrotClickHighlight()
        if brainrotClickHighlight then return end
        brainrotClickHighlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
        brainrotClickHighlight.Name = _vxName("BrainrotClickAPHighlight")
        styleBrainrotHighlight(brainrotClickHighlight)
    end

    local function setBrainrotHighlight(podium)
        ensureBrainrotClickHighlight()
        for i = 1, #brainrotClickExtras do brainrotClickExtras[i].Adornee = nil end
        if not podium or not podium.Parent then
            brainrotClickHighlight.Adornee = nil
            return
        end

        if podium:IsA("Model") or podium:IsA("BasePart") then
            brainrotClickHighlight.Adornee = podium
            return
        end

        brainrotClickHighlight.Adornee = nil
        local n = 0
        for _, child in ipairs(podium:GetChildren()) do
            if child:IsA("Model") or child:IsA("BasePart") then
                n = n + 1
                local h = brainrotClickExtras[n]
                if not h then
                    h = Instance.new("Highlight")
                    h.Name = _vxName("BrainrotClickAPHighlight")
                    styleBrainrotHighlight(h)
                    brainrotClickExtras[n] = h
                end
                h.Adornee = child
                if n >= 8 then break end
            end
        end
    end

        Config.BrainrotClickAP = on

    end)

    local function podiumAnchorPart(podium)
        if not podium or not podium.Parent then return nil end
        local base = podium:FindFirstChild("Base")
        local spawnP = base and base:FindFirstChild("Spawn")
        local part = spawnP or base
        if part and part:IsA("BasePart") then return part end
        if podium:IsA("BasePart") then return podium end
        if podium:IsA("Model") then
            return podium.PrimaryPart or podium:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
        end
        return nil
    end

    local _brSrcCache = {}
    local function stolenSourcePodium(plr, idxName)
        if idxName == nil or not _G.VXGetStolenSourcePodium then return nil end
        local now = os.clock()
        local c = _brSrcCache[plr.UserId]
        if c and c.idx == idxName and (now - c.t) < 1 then
            if c.podium and c.podium.Parent then return c.podium end
            if c.podium == nil then return nil end
        end
        local ok, podium = pcall(_G.VXGetStolenSourcePodium, idxName)
        if not ok then podium = nil end
        _brSrcCache[plr.UserId] = { idx = idxName, t = now, podium = podium }
        return podium
    end

    local function brainrotClickPick()
        local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not camera then return nil, nil end
        local mousePos = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
        local ray = camera:ViewportPointToRay(mousePos.X, mousePos.Y)

        local steals = nil
        if _G.VXGetSteals then
            local okS, s = pcall(_G.VXGetSteals)
            if okS and type(s) == "table" then steals = s end
        end

        local bestPlayer, bestPodium, bestDist = nil, nil, math.huge
        local function consider(plr, podium)
            local part = podiumAnchorPart(podium)
            if not part then return end
            local center = part.Position
            if not rayToCubeIntersect(ray.Origin, ray.Direction, center, 8) then return end
            local d = (ray.Origin - center).Magnitude
            if d < bestDist then bestDist = d; bestPlayer = plr; bestPodium = podium end
        end

        for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if plr ~= LocalPlayer and plr.Parent and plr:GetAttribute("Stealing")
            and not shouldSkipClickToAP(plr) then

                local sd = steals and steals[plr.UserId]
                if sd and sd.currentPodium then consider(plr, sd.currentPodium) end

                consider(plr, stolenSourcePodium(plr, plr:GetAttribute("StealingIndex")))
            end
        end
        return bestPlayer, bestPodium
    end

    local function runBrainrotSpam(targetPlayer)
        if not targetPlayer or targetPlayer == LocalPlayer then return end
        if not _G.VXRunCmdSequence then return end
        if Config.BrainrotClickAPSingleCommand then
            local seq = _G.VXCmdSequence and _G.VXCmdSequence() or {}
            if #seq == 0 then return end
            _G.brainrotClickCycleIndex = (_G.brainrotClickCycleIndex or 0) % #seq + 1
            if _G.runAdminCommand then _G.runAdminCommand(targetPlayer, seq[_G.brainrotClickCycleIndex]) end
        else
            _G.VXRunCmdSequence(targetPlayer)
        end
    end

    task.spawn(function()
        ensureBrainrotClickHighlight()
        local lastPodium = nil
        local _brAcc = 0
        RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
            if not Config.BrainrotClickAP then
                if lastPodium then
                    setBrainrotHighlight(nil); lastPodium = nil
                end
                return
            end
            _brAcc = _brAcc + dt
            if _brAcc < 0.05 then return end
            _brAcc = 0
            local _, podium = brainrotClickPick()
            if podium ~= lastPodium then
                setBrainrotHighlight(podium)
                lastPodium = podium
            end
        end)
    end)

    UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
        if gameProcessed then return end
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and Config.BrainrotClickAP then
            local plr = brainrotClickPick()
            if plr then task.spawn(function() runBrainrotSpam(plr) end) end
        end
    end)

    createButtonRow("Spam Target Stealing", Theme.Accent2, function()

        local sel = SharedState.SelectedPetData

        local targetNames = {}
        local function addName(n) if n and n ~= "" then targetNames[tostring(n)] = true end end
        addName(sel.name); addName(sel.petName); addName(sel.index)
        if sel.animalData then addName(sel.animalData.name); addName(sel.animalData.index) end
        if not next(targetNames) then return end
        for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if p ~= LocalPlayer and p:GetAttribute("Stealing") then
                local idx = p:GetAttribute("StealingIndex")
                if idx and targetNames[tostring(idx)] then
                    local tp = p
                    task.spawn(function() if _G.VXRunCmdSequence then _G.VXRunCmdSequence(tp) end end)
                end
            end
        end
    end)

    local function doSpamOwner()
        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not hrp then
            return
        end

        local nearestPlot = nil
        local nearestDist = math.huge
        local Plots = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")
        if Plots then
            for _, plot in ipairs(Plots:GetChildren()) do
                local sign = plot:FindFirstChild("PlotSign")
                if sign then
                    local signPos = sign:IsA("BasePart") and sign.Position or (sign.PrimaryPart and sign.PrimaryPart.Position)
                    if signPos then
                        local dist = (hrp.Position - signPos).Magnitude
                        if dist < nearestDist then
                            nearestDist = dist
                            nearestPlot = plot
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        if not nearestPlot then
            return
        end

        local targetPlayer = _G.VXPlotOwnerPlayer and _G.VXPlotOwnerPlayer(nearestPlot) or nil

        if not targetPlayer or targetPlayer == LocalPlayer then
            return
        end

        task.spawn(function()

            if _G.VXRunCmdSequence then _G.VXRunCmdSequence(targetPlayer) end
        end)
    end
    _G.VXSpamOwner = doSpamOwner
    createButtonRow("Spam Owner", Theme.Accent2, doSpamOwner)

    local function doSpamNearest()
        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not hrp then
            return
        end

        local nearestPlayer = nil
        local nearestDist = math.huge
        for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if p ~= LocalPlayer and p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
                local dist = (hrp.Position - p.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude
                if dist < nearestDist then
                    nearestDist = dist
                    nearestPlayer = p
                end
            end
        end

        if not nearestPlayer then
            return
        end

        task.spawn(function()

            if _G.VXRunCmdSequence then _G.VXRunCmdSequence(nearestPlayer) end
        end)
    end
    _G.VXSpamNearest = doSpamNearest
    createButtonRow("Spam Nearest", Theme.Accent2, doSpamNearest)

    local proxAPCooldown = 0
    local PROX_AP_INTERVAL = 0.5

    local proxAPSpamming = {}
    local function proxAPInRange(p)
        if not ProximityAPActive then return false end
        if not p or not p.Parent or p == LocalPlayer then return false end
        if shouldSkipProximityAP(p) then return false end
        local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
        local myHrp = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local tChar = p.Character
        local tHrp = tChar and tChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not (myHrp and tHrp) then return false end
        return (tHrp.Position - myHrp.Position).Magnitude <= PROXIMITY_RANGE
    end
    RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
        if not ProximityAPActive then return end

        proxAPCooldown = proxAPCooldown + dt
        if proxAPCooldown < PROX_AP_INTERVAL then return end
        proxAPCooldown = 0

        for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if proxAPInRange(p) and not proxAPSpamming[p] then
                proxAPSpamming[p] = true
                task.spawn(function()

                    while proxAPInRange(p) do
                        if _G.VXRunCmdSequence then
                            _G.VXRunCmdSequence(p, nil, function() return not proxAPInRange(p) end)
                        else
                            break
                        end
                        task.wait()
                    end
                    proxAPSpamming[p] = nil
                end)
            end
        end
    end)

end

    local function removeFeature(id)
        local rec = featureRows[id]
        if not rec then return end
        featureRows[id] = nil
        if rec.listener and rec.entry then
            for i = #rec.entry.listeners, 1, -1 do
                if rec.entry.listeners[i] == rec.listener then
                    table.remove(rec.entry.listeners, i)
                end
            end
        end
        if rec.row then rec.row:Destroy() end
        for i = #Config.QuickFeatures, 1, -1 do
            if Config.QuickFeatures[i] == id then table.remove(Config.QuickFeatures, i) end
        end
        SaveConfig()
        refreshHint()
        if dropRefresh then dropRefresh() end
    end

    dropScroll.ScrollBarImageColor3 = Theme.Accent1
    dropScroll.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
    dropScroll.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
    dropScroll.ZIndex = 31
    local dropPad = Instance.new("UIPadding", dropScroll)
    dropPad.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 4 * MOBILE_SCALE)
    dropPad.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 4 * MOBILE_SCALE)
    dropPad.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 3 * MOBILE_SCALE)
    dropPad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 3 * MOBILE_SCALE)
    local dropLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout", dropScroll)
    dropLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 8 * MOBILE_SCALE)
    dropLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
    dropLayout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center

    dropRefresh = function()
        if not drop.Visible then return end
        for _, ch in ipairs(dropScroll:GetChildren()) do
            if ch:IsA("Frame") then ch:Destroy() end
        end
        for _, e in ipairs(_G.VXFeatureRegistry) do
            local added = featureRows[e.id] ~= nil
            local r = Instance.new("Frame", dropScroll)
            r.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 34 * MOBILE_SCALE)
            r.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(12, 12, 14)
            r.BackgroundTransparency = 0.32
            r.BorderSizePixel = 0
            r.ZIndex = 31
            Instance.new("UICorner", r).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6 * MOBILE_SCALE)
            local rStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", r)
            rStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(6, 6, 8)
            rStroke.Thickness = 1
            rStroke.Transparency = 0.85
            rStroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border

            local nm = Instance.new("TextLabel", r)
            nm.Size = UDim2.new(1, -48 * MOBILE_SCALE, 1, 0)
            nm.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12 * MOBILE_SCALE, 0, 0)
            nm.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            nm.Text = e.name
            nm.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
            nm.TextSize = 11 * MOBILE_SCALE
            nm.TextColor3 = added and Theme.TextMuted or Theme.TextPrimary
            nm.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
            nm.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
            nm.ZIndex = 31

            local ab = Instance.new("TextButton", r)
            ab.Size = UDim2.new(0, 24 * MOBILE_SCALE, 0, 24 * MOBILE_SCALE)
            ab.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
            ab.Position = UDim2.new(1, -5 * MOBILE_SCALE, 0.5, 0)
            ab.AutoButtonColor = false
            ab.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(38, 39, 44)
            ab.BackgroundTransparency = added and 0.5 or 0.1
            ab.Text = added and "-" or "+"
            ab.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
            ab.TextSize = 14 * MOBILE_SCALE
            ab.TextColor3 = added and Theme.TextMuted or Color3.fromRGB(188, 191, 198)
            ab.ZIndex = 32
            Instance.new("UICorner", ab).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6 * MOBILE_SCALE)
            local abStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", ab)
            abStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(6, 6, 8)
            abStroke.Thickness = 1
            abStroke.Transparency = 0.5
            abStroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
            ab.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                if featureRows[e.id] then removeFeature(e.id) else addFeature(e, false) end
            end)
            VXTextShine(r)
        end
    end

    local function setDropOpen(on)
        dropOpen = on and true or false
        if dropOpen then
            quick.content.Visible = false
            hint.Visible = false
            drop.Visible = true
            dropRefresh()

            drop.Size = dropZeroSize
            drop.GroupTransparency = 1
            TweenService:Create(drop, TweenInfo.new(0.24, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
                { Size = dropFullSize, GroupTransparency = 0 }):Play()
        else
            local t = TweenService:Create(drop, TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In),
                { Size = dropZeroSize, GroupTransparency = 1 })
            t.Completed:Connect(function()
                if not dropOpen then
                    drop.Visible = false
                    drop.Size = dropFullSize
                    quick.content.Visible = true
                    refreshHint()
                end
            end)
            t:Play()
        end
    end

    local plusBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", quick.strip)
    plusBtn.Name = "VX_AddChevron"
    plusBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 24 * MOBILE_SCALE, 0, 24 * MOBILE_SCALE)
    plusBtn.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
    plusBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -8 * MOBILE_SCALE, 0.5, 0)
    plusBtn.AutoButtonColor = false
    plusBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    plusBtn.Text = "▼"
    plusBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    plusBtn.TextSize = 16 * MOBILE_SCALE
    plusBtn.TextColor3 = Theme.Accent2
    plusBtn.ZIndex = 3
    plusBtn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
        TweenService:Create(plusBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.12), { TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 235, 255) }):Play()
    end)
    plusBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
        TweenService:Create(plusBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.12), { TextColor3 = Theme.Accent2 }):Play()
    end)
    plusBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        setDropOpen(not dropOpen)
        plusBtn.Text = dropOpen and "▲" or "▼"
    end)

    refreshHint()
    quickGui.Enabled = false
    VXScheduleGuiReveal(_vxName("VXQuickPanel"), "QuickPanelDelay", function()
        return Config.ShowQuickPanel and true or false
    end)

    task.spawn(function()
        local t0 = os.clock()
        while not _G.VXFeatureRegistryReady and os.clock() - t0 < 15 do
            task.wait(0.25)
        end
        for _, id in ipairs(Config.QuickFeatures) do
            local e = VXFindFeature(id)
            if e then addFeature(e, true) end
        end
        refreshHint()
    end)

end)

_G.VXTierStyles = _G.VXTierStyles or {
    max  = { label = "Max",  star = _G.VXPaletteText("#FFD27A") },
    pro  = { label = "Pro",  star = _G.VXPaletteText("#E6DAFF") },
    base = { label = "Base", star = _G.VXPaletteText("#C79BFF") },
}
local VX_TIER_ORDER = { "base", "pro", "max" }
do

    local t = _G.VXTier
    if t ~= "base" and t ~= "pro" and t ~= "max" then t = "pro" end
    _G.VXTier = t
    Config.Tier = t
end

_G.VXTierBadgeRefreshers = _G.VXTierBadgeRefreshers or {}
function _G.VXSetTier(tier)
    if not _G.VXTierStyles[tier] then return end
    _G.VXTier = tier
    Config.Tier = tier
    pcall(SaveConfig)
    for _, fn in ipairs(_G.VXTierBadgeRefreshers) do pcall(fn) end
end
function _G.VXCycleTier()
    local cur = _G.VXTier or "pro"
    for i, t in ipairs(VX_TIER_ORDER) do
        if t == cur then
            _G.VXSetTier(VX_TIER_ORDER[(i % #VX_TIER_ORDER) + 1])
            return
        end
    end
    _G.VXSetTier("pro")
end

function _G.VXBadgeParams()
    local scale = (44 * MOBILE_SCALE * 1.18 * 0.82) / 32
    return scale, MOBILE_SCALE * 1.2, 1.05
end

function _G.VXTierBadge(parent, scale, txScale, labelScale)

    scale = scale or 1
    txScale = txScale or scale
    labelScale = labelScale or 1
    local badge = Instance.new("Frame")
    badge.Name = "VXTierBadge"

    badge.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X
    badge.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 32 * scale)
    local bPad = Instance.new("UIPadding", badge)
    bPad.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, math.floor(13 * scale + 0.5))
    bPad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, math.floor(13 * scale + 0.5))

    badge.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(34, 24, 52)
    badge.BackgroundTransparency = 0
    badge.BorderSizePixel = 0
    Instance.new("UICorner", badge).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    local bStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", badge)
    bStroke.Thickness = 1
    bStroke.Transparency = 0.4
    bStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(6, 6, 8)
    bStroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
    local bStrokeGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient", bStroke)
    bStrokeGrad.Rotation = 25
    bStrokeGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new{
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Theme.SilverLo),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Theme.GoldHi),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Theme.SilverLo),
    }

    local holder = Instance.new("Frame", badge)
    holder.Name = "VX_Label"
    holder.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X
    holder.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
    holder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    holder.ZIndex = 51
    local lay = Instance.new("UIListLayout", holder)
    lay.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
    lay.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
    lay.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center
    lay.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
    lay.Padding = UDim.new(0, math.floor(5 * txScale + 0.5))
    local function badgePart(txt, sizePx, order, rich, color, isStarPart)
        local l = Instance.new("TextLabel", holder)
        l.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        l.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
        l.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X
        l.RichText = rich or false
        l.Text = txt
        l.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
        l.TextSize = sizePx
        l.TextColor3 = color or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        l.TextStrokeTransparency = 1
        l.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
        l.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
        l.LayoutOrder = order
        l.ZIndex = 51
        if isStarPart then

            local sp = Instance.new("UIPadding", l)
            sp.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, math.max(1, math.floor(2 * txScale + 0.5)))
        end
        return l
    end

    local labelColor = Color3.fromRGB(214, 198, 246)
    local starSize = math.floor(8 * txScale + 0.5)
    local star1 = badgePart("", starSize, 1, true, nil, true)
    local lab = badgePart("", math.floor(13.75 * labelScale * txScale + 0.5), 2, false, labelColor)
    local star2 = badgePart("", starSize, 3, true, nil, true)

    local function refresh()
        local style = _G.VXTierStyles[_G.VXTier or "pro"] or _G.VXTierStyles.pro

        local starTxt = _G.VXPaletteText('<font color="#E6DAFF">★</font>')
        star1.Text = starTxt
        star2.Text = starTxt
        lab.Text = style.label
    end
    refresh()
    table.insert(_G.VXTierBadgeRefreshers, refresh)

    badge.Parent = parent
    badge.ZIndex = 50
    return badge
end

local function CreateStatusHUD()
    local existing = VXGui:FindFirstChild(_vxName("VXStatusHUD"))
    if existing then existing:Destroy() end

    local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    gui.Name = _vxName("VXStatusHUD")
    gui.DisplayOrder = 50000
    gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
    gui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
    gui.Enabled = false
    mountGui(gui)

    local HUD_HEIGHT = 40 * MOBILE_SCALE
    --  Minimum width only. VX_Main auto-sizes on X (see the list layout
    --  below), so the pill is always exactly as wide as its contents plus
    --  padding instead of a hardcoded box the segments float inside.
    local HUD_WIDTH = 340 * MOBILE_SCALE
    local UNLOCK_HEIGHT = 44 * MOBILE_SCALE
    local PILL_SCALE = 1.0

    local mainContainer = Instance.new("Frame", gui)
    mainContainer.Name = "VX_MainContainer"
    mainContainer.Size = UDim2.new(0, HUD_WIDTH, 0, HUD_HEIGHT + UNLOCK_HEIGHT)
    mainContainer.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
    mainContainer.Position = UDim2.new(Config.Positions.StatusHUD.X, 0, Config.Positions.StatusHUD.Y, 0)
    mainContainer.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    mainContainer.ClipsDescendants = false
    VXRegisterScale(Instance.new("UIScale", mainContainer), 1)

    local main = Instance.new("Frame")
    main.Name = "VX_Main"

    main.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X
    main.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, HUD_HEIGHT * PILL_SCALE)
    main.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
    main.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 0)

    local _mainGrad = applyMarble(main)
    _mainGrad.Rotation = 0
    main.BackgroundTransparency = 0
    main.BorderSizePixel = 0
    main.Parent = mainContainer

    local cornerRadius = 18 * MOBILE_SCALE * PILL_SCALE
    local mainCorner = Instance.new("UICorner", main)
    mainCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, cornerRadius)

    local mainBorder = Instance.new("UIStroke", main)
    mainBorder.Thickness = 0.8
    mainBorder.Transparency = 0.35
    mainBorder.Color = Color3.fromRGB(6, 6, 8)
    mainBorder.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border

    local mainBorderGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient", mainBorder)
    mainBorderGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new{
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Theme.SilverLo),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Theme.GoldHi),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Theme.SilverLo)
    }
    mainBorderGrad.Rotation = 25

    local unlockContainer = Instance.new("Frame", mainContainer)
    unlockContainer.Name = "VX_UnlockButtonsContainer"
    unlockContainer.Size = UDim2.new(0, 124 * MOBILE_SCALE, 0, 36 * MOBILE_SCALE)

    unlockContainer.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -62 * MOBILE_SCALE, 0, HUD_HEIGHT * PILL_SCALE + 7 * MOBILE_SCALE)
    unlockContainer.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    unlockContainer.Visible = Config.ShowUnlockButtonsHUD

    local unlockCorner = Instance.new("UICorner", unlockContainer)
    unlockCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8 * MOBILE_SCALE)

    local unlockBg = Instance.new("Frame", unlockContainer)
    unlockBg.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    local _unlockGrad = applyMarble(unlockBg)
    _unlockGrad.Rotation = 0
    unlockBg.BackgroundTransparency = 0
    unlockBg.BorderSizePixel = 0
    local unlockBgCorner = Instance.new("UICorner", unlockBg)
    unlockBgCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8 * MOBILE_SCALE)

    local unlockBorder = Instance.new("UIStroke", unlockContainer)
    unlockBorder.Thickness = 1 * MOBILE_SCALE
    unlockBorder.Transparency = 0.4
    unlockBorder.Color = Color3.fromRGB(6, 6, 8)
    unlockBorder.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border

    local unlockBorderGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient", unlockBorder)
    unlockBorderGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new{
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Theme.SilverLo),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Theme.GoldHi),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Theme.SilverLo)
    }

    local btnSize = 28 * MOBILE_SCALE
    local btnSpacing = 10 * MOBILE_SCALE
    local startX = 9 * MOBILE_SCALE

    local function getPlotOwnerName(plot)
        if not plot then return "Unknown" end
        local name = _G.VXPlotOwner and _G.VXPlotOwner(plot) or nil
        return name or "Unknown"
    end

    local function findClosestUnlockAtLevel(targetLevel)
        local character = LocalPlayer.Character
        local hrp = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not hrp then return nil, nil, nil end

        local plots = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")
        if not plots then return nil, nil, nil end

        local targetY = nil
        if targetLevel == 1 then
            targetY = -2
        elseif targetLevel == 2 then
            targetY = 15
        elseif targetLevel == 3 then
            targetY = 27
        end

        if not targetY then return nil, nil, nil end

        local closestPrompt = nil
        local closestDist = math.huge
        local closestPlot = nil

        for _, plot in ipairs(plots:GetChildren()) do
            local unlockFolder = plot:FindFirstChild("Unlock")
            if unlockFolder then
                for _, item in ipairs(unlockFolder:GetChildren()) do
                    local part = nil
                    local pos = nil

                    if item:IsA("Model") then
                        pcall(function() pos = item:GetPivot().Position end)
                        part = item:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
                    elseif item:IsA("BasePart") then
                        pos = item.Position
                        part = item
                    end

                    if pos and part then
                        if math.abs(pos.Y - targetY) < 5 then
                            for _, desc in ipairs(part:GetDescendants()) do
                                if desc:IsA("ProximityPrompt") and desc.Enabled then
                                    local dist = (hrp.Position - pos).Magnitude
                                    if dist < closestDist then
                                        closestDist = dist
                                        closestPrompt = desc
                                        closestPlot = plot
                                    end
                                    break
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        return closestPrompt, closestDist, closestPlot
    end

    for i = 1, 3 do
        local btn = Instance.new("TextButton", unlockContainer)
        btn.Name = "VX_UnlockBtn_" .. i
        btn.Size = UDim2.new(0, btnSize, 0, btnSize)
        btn.Position = UDim2.new(0, startX + ((i-1) * (btnSize + btnSpacing)), 0.5, -btnSize/2)
        btn.AutoButtonColor = false
        btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(16, 11, 24)
        btn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.32
        btn.Text = tostring(i)
        btn.TextSize = math.floor(13 * MOBILE_SCALE + 0.5)
        btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(228, 216, 250)
        btn.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
        btn.TextStrokeTransparency = 1
        btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
        btn.ZIndex = 2
        local btnCorner = Instance.new("UICorner", btn)
        btnCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6 * MOBILE_SCALE)
        VXApplyTextShine(btn)

        local btnStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", btn)
        btnStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(6, 6, 8)
        btnStroke.Thickness = 0.5
        btnStroke.Transparency = 0.5
        btnStroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border

        btn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
            TweenService:Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(0.18), {BackgroundTransparency = 0.55}):Play()
            TweenService:Create(btnStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.18), {Transparency = 0.2}):Play()
        end)

        btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
            TweenService:Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(0.18), {BackgroundTransparency = 0.32}):Play()
            TweenService:Create(btnStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.18), {Transparency = 0.5}):Play()
        end)

        btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            TweenService:Create(btnStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.1), {Color = Theme.Success}):Play()
            task.wait(0.1)
            TweenService:Create(btnStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.1), {Color = Color3.fromRGB(150, 60, 240)}):Play()

            local foundPrompt, distance, foundPlot = findClosestUnlockAtLevel(i)

            if foundPrompt then
                local plotOwner = getPlotOwnerName(foundPlot)
                local levelName = i == 1 and "Basement" or (i == 2 and "Main" or "Roof")

                if fireproximityprompt then
                    _G.VXSafeNetCall(fireproximityprompt, foundPrompt)
                else
                    foundPrompt:InputBegan(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1)
                    task.wait(0.05)
                    foundPrompt:InputEnded(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1)
                end

                ShowNotification("Unlock", levelName .. " - " .. plotOwner .. " (" .. math.floor(distance) .. "s)")
            end
        end)
    end

    --  Segmented flow layout. The old build positioned four absolutely-placed
    --  children inside a fixed-width box and ran layoutHud() on every text
    --  bounds change to divide the leftover pixels into three equal gaps --
    --  which meant the pill had dead space when the tier label was short and
    --  crowded the edges when it was long. Now a horizontal UIListLayout does
    --  the spacing, hairline dividers separate the segments, and the pill
    --  itself auto-sizes on X to whatever that comes out to.
    local container = Instance.new("Frame", main)
    container.Name = "VX_Row"
    container.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X
    container.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
    container.BackgroundTransparency = 1

    local rowPad = Instance.new("UIPadding", container)
    rowPad.PaddingLeft  = UDim.new(0, 16 * MOBILE_SCALE)
    rowPad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 16 * MOBILE_SCALE)

    local row = Instance.new("UIListLayout", container)
    row.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
    row.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
    row.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center
    row.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
    row.Padding = UDim.new(0, 11 * MOBILE_SCALE)

    --  Keep the pill from collapsing below the configured minimum width.
    local rowMin = Instance.new("UISizeConstraint", container)
    rowMin.MinSize = Vector2.new(HUD_WIDTH * PILL_SCALE - 32 * MOBILE_SCALE, 0)

    local function divider(order)
        local d = Instance.new("Frame", container)
        d.Name = "VX_Div"
        d.LayoutOrder = order
        d.Size = UDim2.new(0, 1, 0, math.floor(HUD_HEIGHT * PILL_SCALE * 0.45 + 0.5))
        d.BorderSizePixel = 0
        d.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent1
        d.BackgroundTransparency = 0.6
        return d
    end

    local title = Instance.new("TextLabel", container)
    title.Name = "VX_Title"
    title.LayoutOrder = 1
    title.RichText = true
    title.Text = _G.VXPaletteText('<font color="#E6DAFF">Vergent</font><font color="#A855F7">X</font>')
    title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    title.TextSize = math.floor(20 * MOBILE_SCALE * PILL_SCALE + 0.5)
    title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 235, 255)
    title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    title.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X
    title.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
    title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
    title.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
    title.TextStrokeTransparency = 1
    VXApplyTextShine(title)

    local _badgeScale, _badgeTxScale, _badgeLabelScale = _G.VXBadgeParams()
    --  VXBadgeParams is sized for the settings panel; fit it to this pill so
    --  the badge tracks HUD_HEIGHT instead of the old hardcoded 44 * 1.18.
    local _badgeFit = (HUD_HEIGHT * PILL_SCALE * 0.66) / (44 * MOBILE_SCALE * 1.18 * 0.82)
    _badgeScale   = _badgeScale * _badgeFit
    _badgeTxScale = _badgeTxScale * _badgeFit

    local hudBadge = _G.VXTierBadge(container, _badgeScale, _badgeTxScale, _badgeLabelScale)
    hudBadge.LayoutOrder = 2

    divider(3)

    local discordLink = Instance.new("TextLabel", container)
    discordLink.Name = "VX_Discord"
    discordLink.LayoutOrder = 4
    discordLink.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X
    discordLink.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
    discordLink.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    discordLink.Text = "discord.gg/vergent"
    discordLink.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
    discordLink.TextSize = math.floor(13 * MOBILE_SCALE * PILL_SCALE + 0.5)
    discordLink.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(170, 110, 245)
    discordLink.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
    discordLink.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
    discordLink.TextStrokeTransparency = 1

    divider(5)

    --  Fixed width, right aligned: the fps/ping digits change every second and
    --  an auto-sized label here would shove the whole row around each tick.
    local stats = Instance.new("TextLabel", container)
    stats.Name = "VX_Stats"
    stats.LayoutOrder = 6
    stats.Size = UDim2.new(0, 96 * MOBILE_SCALE, 1, 0)
    stats.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    stats.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
    stats.TextSize = math.floor(12 * MOBILE_SCALE * PILL_SCALE + 0.5)
    stats.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
    stats.TextColor3 = Theme.TextPrimary
    stats.RichText = true
    stats.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
    stats.TextStrokeTransparency = 1
    stats.Text = _G.VXPaletteText("<font color='#9B8AB8'>— fps | — ms</font>")

    local acc, rate = 0, 1
    RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
        if not gui.Enabled then return end
        acc = acc + dt
        if acc < rate then return end
        acc = 0
        local lastFps = math.floor(1/dt)
        local ping = math.floor(LocalPlayer:GetNetworkPing() * 1000)
        local fc = (lastFps >= 50) and "#7CE8A2" or (lastFps >= 30) and "#FFD37A" or "#FF7A8A"
        local pc = (ping < 100) and "#7CE8A2" or (ping < 200) and "#FFD37A" or "#FF7A8A"
        stats.Text = string.format(
            _G.VXPaletteText("<font color='%s'>%d fps</font> <font color='#9B8AB8'>|</font> <font color='%s'>%dms</font>"),
            fc, lastFps, pc, ping
            )
    end)

    if IS_MOBILE then
        for _, textLabel in ipairs(main:GetDescendants()) do
            if textLabel:IsA("TextLabel") then
                textLabel.TextSize = textLabel.TextSize * 0.8
            end
        end
    end

    return gui
end

local function updateGlobalGuiScale(newScale)
    GlobalGuiScale = newScale
    Config.GlobalGuiScale = newScale
    SaveConfig()

    MOBILE_SCALE = (IS_MOBILE and 0.75 or 1) * 0.8367 * (GlobalGuiScale ^ 0.5)

    local f = ((newScale / (_G.VXBuiltGuiScale or newScale)) ^ 0.5)
    _G.VXLiveScaleF = f
    for _, e in ipairs(_G.VXScaleRegistry or {}) do
        if e.ui and e.ui.Parent then e.ui.Scale = e.base * f end
    end
end
