    local settingsTweens = {}
    local function settingsKillTweens()
        for _, t in ipairs(settingsTweens) do pcall(function() t:Cancel() end) end
        table.clear(settingsTweens)
    end
    local function settingsPlay(inst, ti, props)
        local t = TweenService:Create(inst, ti, props)
        table.insert(settingsTweens, t)
        t:Play()
    end
    local function animateSettingsOpen()
        if settingsAnimating or settingsGui.Enabled then return end
        settingsAnimating = true
        settingsKillTweens()
        local f = _G.VXLiveScaleF or 1
        sFrame.BackgroundTransparency = SETTINGS_REST_BG_T
        local restPos = sFrame.Position

        openScale.Scale = SETTINGS_SCALE * 0.86 * f
        sFrame.Position = restPos - UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 26)
        sFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.5
        settingsGui.Enabled = true
        settingsPlay(openScale, TweenInfo.new(0.32, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Scale = SETTINGS_SCALE * f })
        settingsPlay(sFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.28, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Position = restPos, BackgroundTransparency = SETTINGS_REST_BG_T })
        task.delay(0.34, function()
            settingsKillTweens()
            openScale.Scale = SETTINGS_SCALE * (_G.VXLiveScaleF or 1)
            sFrame.Position = restPos
            sFrame.BackgroundTransparency = SETTINGS_REST_BG_T
            settingsAnimating = false
        end)
    end
    local function animateSettingsClose()
        if settingsAnimating or not settingsGui.Enabled then return end
        settingsAnimating = true
        settingsKillTweens()
        local f = _G.VXLiveScaleF or 1
        sFrame.BackgroundTransparency = SETTINGS_REST_BG_T
        local restPos = sFrame.Position

        settingsPlay(openScale, TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), { Scale = SETTINGS_SCALE * 0.88 * f })
        settingsPlay(sFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), { Position = restPos - UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 20), BackgroundTransparency = 0.6 })
        task.delay(0.19, function()
            settingsKillTweens()
            settingsGui.Enabled = false
            openScale.Scale = SETTINGS_SCALE * (_G.VXLiveScaleF or 1)
            sFrame.Position = restPos
            sFrame.BackgroundTransparency = SETTINGS_REST_BG_T
            settingsAnimating = false
        end)
    end
    _G.ToggleSettingsGui = function()
        if settingsGui.Enabled then animateSettingsClose() else animateSettingsOpen() end
    end

    local function setActiveTab(tabName)
        activeTabName = tabName
        for name, scroll in pairs(contentScrolls) do
            scroll.Visible = (name == tabName)
        end

        local _active = contentScrolls[tabName]
        if _active then

            _active.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 22)
            TweenService:Create(_active, TweenInfo.new(0.30, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 8) }):Play()
        end
        for name, btn in pairs(tabButtons) do
            local isActive = (name == tabName)

            local _tcol = isActive and Color3.fromRGB(58, 38, 96) or Color3.fromRGB(42, 43, 49)
            local _ttr  = isActive and 0.15 or 0.45
            TweenService:Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { BackgroundColor3 = _tcol, BackgroundTransparency = _ttr }):Play()
            local g = btn:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIGradient")
            if g then g.Enabled = isActive end
            local ab = btn:FindFirstChild("VX_AccentBar")
            if ab then TweenService:Create(ab, TweenInfo.new(0.22), { BackgroundTransparency = isActive and 0 or 1 }):Play() end
        end

    end

    for tabName, tabBtn in pairs(tabButtons) do
        tabBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() setActiveTab(tabName) end)
    end
    setActiveTab("Player")

    local function createSectionHeader(parent, text)

        local row = Instance.new("Frame", parent)
        row.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 28)
        row.BackgroundTransparency = 1

        local dot = Instance.new("Frame", row)
        dot.Size = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 5)
        dot.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0.5, -2)
        dot.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(160, 84, 240)
        dot.BorderSizePixel = 0
        Instance.new("UICorner", dot).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

        local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel", row)
        lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 1, 0)
        lbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 0)
        lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        lbl.Text = text
        lbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        lbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(207, 190, 231)
        lbl.TextSize = 12
        lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left

        local textW = 100
        pcall(function()
            local sz = game:GetService("TextService"):GetTextSize(text, 12, Enum.Font.Gotham, Vector2.new(1000, 28))
            textW = sz.X
        end)
        local line = Instance.new("Frame", row)
        line.Size = UDim2.new(1, -(20 + textW + 12 + 8), 0, 1)
        line.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20 + textW + 12, 0.5, 0)
        line.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent1
        line.BackgroundTransparency = 0.25
        line.BorderSizePixel = 0
        local lineGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient", line)
        lineGrad.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.1),
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.85),
        })

        return row
    end

    local function createToggleRow(parent, text, description, defaultValue, callback)

        local row = Instance.new("Frame", parent)
        row.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 40)
        row.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(12, 12, 14)
        row.BackgroundTransparency = 0.32
        row.BorderSizePixel = 0
        Instance.new("UICorner", row).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
        local rowLine = Instance.new("UIStroke", row)
        rowLine.Color = Color3.fromRGB(6, 6, 8)
        rowLine.Thickness = 1
        rowLine.Transparency = 0.85
        rowLine.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border

        local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel", row)
        lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -82, 1, 0)
        lbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 0)
        lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        lbl.Text = text
        lbl.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
        lbl.TextSize = 13
        lbl.TextColor3 = Theme.TextPrimary
        lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left

        local ON_COL = Color3.fromRGB(140, 80, 222)
        local OFF_COL = Color3.fromRGB(44, 45, 51)
        local isOn = defaultValue or false
        local toggleFrame = Instance.new("Frame", row)
        toggleFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 48, 0, 24)
        toggleFrame.Position = UDim2.new(1, -60, 0.5, -12)
        toggleFrame.BackgroundColor3 = isOn and ON_COL or OFF_COL
        Instance.new("UICorner", toggleFrame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1,0)

        local toggleDot = Instance.new("Frame", toggleFrame)
        toggleDot.Size = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 20)
        toggleDot.Position = isOn and UDim2.new(1, -22, 0.5, -10) or UDim2.new(0, 2, 0.5, -10)
        toggleDot.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
        Instance.new("UICorner", toggleDot).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1,0)
        VXToggleRing(toggleFrame, 5)

        local toggleBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", row)
        toggleBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,1,0)
        toggleBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        toggleBtn.Text = ""

        row.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
            TweenService:Create(row, TweenInfo.new(0.16), { BackgroundTransparency = 0.6 }):Play()
            TweenService:Create(rowLine, TweenInfo.new(0.16), { Transparency = 0.6 }):Play()
        end)
        row.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
            TweenService:Create(row, TweenInfo.new(0.16), { BackgroundTransparency = 0.32 }):Play()
            TweenService:Create(rowLine, TweenInfo.new(0.16), { Transparency = 0.85 }):Play()
        end)

        local entry
        local function setState(v, silent)
            isOn = v
            local newPos = isOn and UDim2.new(1, -22, 0.5, -10) or UDim2.new(0, 2, 0.5, -10)
            local newColor = isOn and ON_COL or OFF_COL
            TweenService:Create(toggleDot, TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Position = newPos}):Play()
            TweenService:Create(toggleFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {BackgroundColor3 = newColor}):Play()
            callback(isOn)
            if entry then
                for _, fn in ipairs(entry.listeners) do pcall(fn, isOn) end
            end

            if not silent then pcall(ShowNotification, text, isOn and "Enabled" or "Disabled") end
        end
        toggleBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            setState(not isOn)
        end)
        entry = VXRegisterFeature({
            name = text, kind = "toggle",
            get = function() return isOn end,
            set = setState,
        })

        return row, setState
    end

    local function createSliderRow(parent, text, description, min, max, default, suffix, callback, step)

        local function fmtVal(v)
            if step and step >= 1 then return tostring(math.floor(v + 0.5)) end

            local st = step or 0.1
            local snapped = math.floor(v / st + 0.5) * st
            local decimals = (st >= 0.1) and 1 or 2
            return string.format("%." .. decimals .. "f", snapped)
        end
        local row = Instance.new("Frame", parent)
        row.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 54)
        row.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(12, 12, 14)
        row.BackgroundTransparency = 0.32
        row.BorderSizePixel = 0
        Instance.new("UICorner", row).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
        local rowLine = Instance.new("UIStroke", row)
        rowLine.Color = Color3.fromRGB(6, 6, 8)
        rowLine.Thickness = 1
        rowLine.Transparency = 0.85
        rowLine.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border

        local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel", row)
        lbl.Size = UDim2.new(0.6, 0, 0, 24)
        lbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 5)
        lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        lbl.Text = text
        lbl.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
        lbl.TextSize = 13
        lbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(211, 194, 236)
        lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left

        local value = default or min
        local valLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel", row)
        valLbl.Size = UDim2.new(0, 70, 0, 24)
        valLbl.Position = UDim2.new(1, -84, 0, 5)
        valLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        valLbl.Text = fmtVal(value) .. (suffix or "")
        valLbl.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
        valLbl.TextSize = 13
        valLbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(160, 84, 240)
        valLbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right

        local sliderBg = Instance.new("Frame", row)
        sliderBg.Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 7)
        sliderBg.Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 37)
        sliderBg.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(29, 30, 33)
        Instance.new("UICorner", sliderBg).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1,0)

        local fill = Instance.new("Frame", sliderBg)
        fill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        fill.Size = UDim2.new((value - min)/(max - min), 0, 1, 0)
        Instance.new("UICorner", fill).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1,0)
        local fillGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient", fill)
        fillGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new{
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(92, 52, 158)),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(160, 84, 240)),
        }

        local knob = Instance.new("Frame", sliderBg)
        knob.Size = UDim2.new(0, 24, 0, 12)
        knob.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)

        knob.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(math.clamp((value - min)/(max - min), 0, 1), 0.5)
        knob.Position = UDim2.new((value - min)/(max - min), 0, 0.5, 0)
        Instance.new("UICorner", knob).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1,0)
        local knobStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", knob)
        knobStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(160, 84, 240)
        knobStroke.Thickness = 1
        knobStroke.Transparency = 0.15
        knobStroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border

        local dragging = false
        local function updateSlider(inputX)
            local pos = sliderBg.AbsolutePosition.X
            local size = sliderBg.AbsoluteSize.X
            local pct = math.clamp((inputX - pos) / size, 0, 1)
            value = min + (pct * (max - min))

            if step then
                value = math.clamp(math.floor(value / step + 0.5) * step, min, max)
            else
                value = math.floor(value * 10) / 10
            end
            local vpct = (max > min) and ((value - min) / (max - min)) or 0
            fill.Size = UDim2.new(vpct, 0, 1, 0)
            knob.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(vpct, 0.5)
            knob.Position = UDim2.new(vpct, 0, 0.5, 0)
            valLbl.Text = fmtVal(value) .. (suffix or "")
            callback(value)
        end

        sliderBg.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                dragging = true
                updateSlider(input.Position.X)
            end
        end)

        knob.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then dragging = true end
        end)

        UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then dragging = false end
        end)

        UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
            if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
                updateSlider(input.Position.X)
            end
        end)

        return row
    end

        local row = Instance.new("Frame", parent)

    local function createDropdownRow(parent, text, description, options, default, callback)
        local row = Instance.new("Frame", parent)
        row.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 40)
        row.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(12, 12, 14)
        row.BackgroundTransparency = 0.32
        row.BorderSizePixel = 0
        Instance.new("UICorner", row).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
        local rowLine = Instance.new("UIStroke", row)
        rowLine.Color = Color3.fromRGB(6, 6, 8)
        rowLine.Thickness = 1
        rowLine.Transparency = 0.85
        rowLine.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border

        local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel", row)
        lbl.Size = UDim2.new(0.6, 0, 1, 0)
        lbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 0)
        lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        lbl.Text = text
        lbl.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
        lbl.TextSize = 13
        lbl.TextColor3 = Theme.TextPrimary
        lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left

        local currentIndex = 1
        for i, opt in ipairs(options) do
            if opt == default then currentIndex = i; break end
        end

        local dropdownBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", row)
        dropdownBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 118, 0, 28)
        dropdownBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -130, 0.5, -14)
        dropdownBtn.AutoButtonColor = false
        dropdownBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(16, 11, 24)
        dropdownBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.35
        dropdownBtn.Text = options[currentIndex]
        dropdownBtn.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
        dropdownBtn.TextSize = 12
        dropdownBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(228, 216, 250)
        Instance.new("UICorner", dropdownBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
        local ddStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", dropdownBtn)
        ddStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(6, 6, 8)
        ddStroke.Thickness = 0.5
        ddStroke.Transparency = 0.5
        ddStroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
        dropdownBtn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
            TweenService:Create(dropdownBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.18), { BackgroundTransparency = 0.15 }):Play()
            TweenService:Create(ddStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.18), { Transparency = 0.2 }):Play()
        end)
        dropdownBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
            TweenService:Create(dropdownBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.18), { BackgroundTransparency = 0.35 }):Play()
            TweenService:Create(ddStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.18), { Transparency = 0.5 }):Play()
        end)

        dropdownBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            currentIndex = (currentIndex % #options) + 1
            dropdownBtn.Text = options[currentIndex]
            callback(options[currentIndex])
            pcall(ShowNotification, text, options[currentIndex])
        end)

        return row
    end

    local function createKeybindRow(parent, text, description, defaultKey, callback)
        local row = Instance.new("Frame", parent)
        row.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 40)
        row.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(12, 12, 14)
        row.BackgroundTransparency = 0.32
        row.BorderSizePixel = 0
        Instance.new("UICorner", row).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
        local rowLine = Instance.new("UIStroke", row)
        rowLine.Color = Color3.fromRGB(6, 6, 8)
        rowLine.Thickness = 1
        rowLine.Transparency = 0.85
        rowLine.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border

        local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel", row)
        lbl.Size = UDim2.new(0.6, 0, 0, 18)
        lbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 6)
        lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        lbl.Text = text
        lbl.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
        lbl.TextSize = 12
        lbl.TextColor3 = Theme.TextPrimary
        lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left

        local currentKey = (defaultKey ~= nil and defaultKey ~= "") and defaultKey or "None"
        local keyBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", row)
        keyBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 92, 0, 28)
        keyBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -104, 0.5, -14)
        keyBtn.AutoButtonColor = false
        keyBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(16, 11, 24)
        keyBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.35
        keyBtn.Text = currentKey
        keyBtn.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
        keyBtn.TextSize = 12
        keyBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(228, 216, 250)
        Instance.new("UICorner", keyBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
        local kbStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", keyBtn)
        kbStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(6, 6, 8)
        kbStroke.Thickness = 0.5
        kbStroke.Transparency = 0.5
        kbStroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
        keyBtn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
            TweenService:Create(keyBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.18), { BackgroundTransparency = 0.15 }):Play()
            TweenService:Create(kbStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.18), { Transparency = 0.2 }):Play()
        end)
        keyBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
            TweenService:Create(keyBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.18), { BackgroundTransparency = 0.35 }):Play()
            TweenService:Create(kbStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.18), { Transparency = 0.5 }):Play()
        end)

        local isCapturing = false
        keyBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            if isCapturing then return end
            isCapturing = true
            _G.isBindingKey = true
            local oldText = keyBtn.Text
            keyBtn.Text = "..."
            keyBtn.TextColor3 = Theme.Warning

            local con
            con = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
                if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
                    isCapturing = false
                    con:Disconnect()

                    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Backspace then
                        currentKey = "None"
                        keyBtn.Text = "None"
                        keyBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(228, 216, 250)
                        callback("")
                    else
                        currentKey = input.KeyCode.Name
                        keyBtn.Text = currentKey
                        keyBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(160, 84, 240)
                        callback(currentKey)
                    end
                    task.delay(0.1, function() _G.isBindingKey = false end)
                end
            end)

            task.delay(5, function()
                if isCapturing then
                    keyBtn.Text = oldText
                    keyBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(160, 84, 240)
                    isCapturing = false
                    _G.isBindingKey = false
                    if con then con:Disconnect() end
                end
            end)
        end)

        local function setKey(k)
            currentKey = (k ~= nil and k ~= "") and k or "None"
            keyBtn.Text = currentKey
            keyBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(228, 216, 250)
        end

        return row, setKey
    end

        createSliderRow(perfScroll, "Dark Mode Intensity", "0% = Midnight only, 100% = Complete dark",
            0, 100, Config.NightVisionStrength or 100, "%",
            function(val)
            Config.NightVisionStrength = val
            SaveConfig()

            if Config.DarkMode then enableDarkMode() end
        end, 1)

        createSliderRow(perfScroll, "Field of View (FOV)", "Camera field of view", 70, 120, Config.FOV or 70, "°", function(val)
            val = math.floor(val + 0.5)
            Config.FOV = val

                Workspace.CurrentCamera.FieldOfView = val

    local miscScroll = contentScrolls["Misc"]
    if miscScroll then

        do
            local b64chars = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
            local function base64encode(data)
                return (data:gsub('.', function(x)
                    local r, b = '', x:byte()
                    for i = 8, 1, -1 do r = r .. (b % 2 ^ i - b % 2 ^ (i - 1) > 0 and '1' or '0') end
                    return r
                end):gsub('%d%d%d?%d?%d?%d?', function(x)
                    if (#x < 6) then x = x .. '0' end
                    if (#x < 6) then x = x .. '0' end
                    local c = 0
                    for i = 1, 6 do c = c + (x:sub(i, i) == '1' and 2 ^ (6 - i) or 0) end
                    return b64chars:sub(c + 1, c + 1)
                end) .. ({ '', '==', '=' })[#data % 3 + 1])
            end
            local function base64decode(data)
                data = string.gsub(data, '[^' .. b64chars .. '=]', '')
                return (data:gsub('.', function(x)
                    if (x == '=') then return '' end
                    local r, f = '', (b64chars:find(x) - 1)
                    for i = 6, 1, -1 do r = r .. (f % 2 ^ i - f % 2 ^ (i - 1) > 0 and '1' or '0') end
                    return r
                end):gsub('%d%d%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?', function(x)
                    if (#x ~= 8) then return '' end
                    local c = 0
                    for i = 1, 8 do c = c + (x:sub(i, i) == '1' and 2 ^ (8 - i) or 0) end
                    return string.char(c)
                end))
            end

            local function serializeConfig()

                local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
                local SKIP_EXPORT = { PrivateServerLink = true, PrivateServerLinkCode = true, PrivateServerPlaceId = true }
                local ok, json = pcall(function()
                    local diff = {}
                    for k, v in pairs(Config) do
                        if not SKIP_EXPORT[k] then
                            local dv = DefaultConfig and DefaultConfig[k]
                            local same
                            if type(v) == "table" or type(dv) == "table" then
                                local okA, a = pcall(HttpService.JSONEncode, HttpService, v)
                                local okB, b = pcall(HttpService.JSONEncode, HttpService, dv)
                                same = okA and okB and a == b
                            else
                                same = (v == dv)
                            end
                            if not same then diff[k] = v end
                        end
                    end
                    return HttpService:JSONEncode(diff)
                end)
                return ok and json or nil
            end
            local function applyImportedConfig(jsonStr)
                local ok, tbl = pcall(function()
                    return game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONDecode(jsonStr)
                end)
                if not ok or type(tbl) ~= "table" then return false, "Invalid config data" end
                for k, v in pairs(tbl) do Config[k] = v end
                SaveConfig()

                if _G.VXRefreshPriority then pcall(_G.VXRefreshPriority) end
                _G.VXPriorityStamp = (_G.VXPriorityStamp or 0) + 1
                pcall(function()
                    if Config.FOV and Workspace.CurrentCamera then
                        Workspace.CurrentCamera.FieldOfView = Config.FOV
                    end
                end)
                if applyGraphicsStrip then pcall(applyGraphicsStrip) end
                if _G.VXSetXRay then pcall(_G.VXSetXRay, Config.XRay) end

                pcall(function()
                    if SharedState.SetStealMode then
                        local m = nil
                        if Config.StealNearest then m = "Nearest"
                        elseif Config.StealPriority then m = "Priority"
                        elseif Config.StealHighest then m = "Highest"
                        elseif Config.AutoStealBrainrots and Config.LastBrainrotMode then m = Config.LastBrainrotMode end
                        SharedState.SetStealMode(m)
                    end
                end)
                return true
            end

        local _psOwnerToken = 0
        local function updatePSOwner()
            local uid = tonumber(Config.PrivateServerOwnerId) or 0
            local hasLink = (Config.PrivateServerLink or "") ~= ""

            if hasLink and uid <= 0 and game.PrivateServerId ~= "" and (game.PrivateServerOwnerId or 0) > 0 then
                local linkedPlace = tonumber(Config.PrivateServerPlaceId) or 0
                if linkedPlace == 0 or linkedPlace == game.PlaceId then
                    uid = game.PrivateServerOwnerId
                    Config.PrivateServerOwnerId = uid
                    SaveConfig()
                end
            end
            if not hasLink or uid <= 0 then
                ownerAvatar.Image = ""
                ownerName.Text = ""
                ownerUser.Text = ""
                return
            end
            _psOwnerToken = _psOwnerToken + 1
            local myToken = _psOwnerToken
            ownerAvatar.Image = "rbxthumb://type=AvatarHeadShot&id=" .. tostring(uid) .. "&w=150&h=150"
            ownerName.Text = "Loading..."
            ownerUser.Text = ""
            task.spawn(function()
                local dispName, userName
                pcall(function()
                    local infos = game:GetService("UserService"):GetUserInfosByUserIdsAsync({ uid })
                    if infos and infos[1] then dispName = infos[1].DisplayName; userName = infos[1].Username end
                end)
                if not userName then
                    pcall(function() userName = game:GetService("Players"):GetNameFromUserIdAsync(uid) end)
                end
                if myToken ~= _psOwnerToken then return end
                ownerName.Text = dispName or userName or ("User " .. tostring(uid))
                ownerUser.Text = userName and ("@" .. userName) or ""
            end)
        end

            local CMD_DEFS = {
                balloon     = { label = "Balloon" },
                inverse     = { label = "Inverse" },
                jail        = { label = "Jail" },
                jumpscare   = { label = "Jumpscare" },

            local CMD_DEFAULT_ORDER = {"balloon", "inverse", "jail", "jumpscare", "morph",
            "nightvision", "ragdoll", "rocket", "tiny"}
            local function normalizedOrder()
                local seen, out = {}, {}
                for _, id in ipairs(Config.AdminCmdOrder or {}) do
                    if CMD_DEFS[id] and not seen[id] then seen[id] = true; out[#out + 1] = id end
                end
                for _, id in ipairs(CMD_DEFAULT_ORDER) do
                    if not seen[id] then out[#out + 1] = id end
                end
                return out
            end
            Config.AdminCmdOrder = normalizedOrder()
            _G.VXAdminCmdOrder = Config.AdminCmdOrder
            _G.VXAdminCmdDelay = tonumber(Config.AdminCmdDelay) or 0

            createSectionHeader(adminScroll, "COMMAND SEQUENCER")

            local seqHolder = Instance.new("Frame", adminScroll)
            seqHolder.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 0)
            seqHolder.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
            seqHolder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            local seqLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout", seqHolder)
            seqLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 4)
            seqLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder

            local rebuildSeq
            rebuildSeq = function()
                for _, ch in ipairs(seqHolder:GetChildren()) do
                    if ch:IsA("Frame") then ch:Destroy() end
                end
                local function seqDepth(el)
                    local g = Instance.new("UIGradient", el)

        local function orderSource()
            if mgrMode == "Blacklist" then return blacklist end
            if mgrMode == "Mutation" then return mutationOrder end
            if mgrMode == "Traits" then return traitOrder end
            return customPriorityList
        end

        local function inOrder(name)
            local src = orderSource()
            local lo = tostring(name):lower()
            for i, n in ipairs(src) do if tostring(n):lower() == lo then return i end end
            return nil
        end

        local function inPriority(name)
            for i, n in ipairs(customPriorityList) do if n:lower() == name:lower() then return i end end
            return nil
        end
        local function inBlacklist(name)
            for i, n in ipairs(blacklist) do if n:lower() == name:lower() then return i end end
            return nil
        end

        local function autoSave()
            Config.PriorityList = {}
            for i = 1, #customPriorityList do Config.PriorityList[i] = customPriorityList[i] end
            Config.PriorityListInitialized = true
            Config.PriorityMinGen = {}
            for k, v in pairs(minGenMap) do Config.PriorityMinGen[k] = v end
            Config.PriorityBlacklist = {}
            for i = 1, #blacklist do Config.PriorityBlacklist[i] = blacklist[i] end
            Config.MutationPriorityList = {}
            for i = 1, #mutationOrder do Config.MutationPriorityList[i] = mutationOrder[i] end
            Config.TraitPriorityList = {}
            for i = 1, #traitOrder do Config.TraitPriorityList[i] = traitOrder[i] end
            SaveConfig()

            if _G.VXSetPriorityList then
                pcall(_G.VXSetPriorityList, Config.PriorityList)
            end
            _G.VXPriorityStamp = (_G.VXPriorityStamp or 0) + 1
            if _G.VXRefreshPriority then pcall(_G.VXRefreshPriority) end
            SharedState.SelectionDirty = true
            if SharedState.UpdateBrainrotSelectionUI then
                SharedState.ListNeedsRedraw = true
                SharedState.UpdateBrainrotSelectionUI()
            end
        end

        local function _vxShortNum(v)
            v = tonumber(v) or 0
            for _, u in ipairs({ {1e15,"Q"},{1e12,"T"},{1e9,"B"},{1e6,"M"},{1e3,"K"} }) do
                if math.abs(v) >= u[1] then
                    local s = string.format("%.2f", v / u[1]):gsub("%.?0+$", "")
                    return s .. u[2]
                end
            end
            return tostring(math.floor(v + 0.5))
        end
        local function fmtGen(v)
            return "$" .. _vxShortNum(v) .. "/s"
        end
        local function parseGenInput(txt)
            if not txt or txt == "" then return nil end
            txt = txt:gsub("[%$,%s]", ""):gsub("/s$", "")
            local plain = tonumber(txt)
            if plain then return plain end
            local num, suf = txt:match("^([%d%.]+)([KkMmBbTt])$")
            if num and suf then
                local mult = ({ k = 1e3, m = 1e6, b = 1e9, t = 1e12 })[suf:lower()]
                if mult and tonumber(num) then return tonumber(num) * mult end
            end
            return nil
        end

        local function fmtNumShort(v)
            if not v then return "" end
            return _vxShortNum(v)
        end

        local function priMoveTo(name, target)
            local src = orderSource()
            local pos = inOrder(name)
            if not pos then return end
            if target > #src then target = #src end
            if target == pos then return end
            table.remove(src, pos)
            table.insert(src, target, name)
            autoSave()
            renderOrder()
            renderGroups()
        end

            local idx = 1
            for i, key in ipairs(SUB_TABS) do
                if key == mgrMode then idx = i end
            end
            TweenService:Create(subInd, TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
                Position = UDim2.new(0.25 * (idx - 1), 3, 0, 3),
            }):Play()
            for _, key in ipairs(SUB_TABS) do
                subBtns[key].TextColor3 = (key == mgrMode) and Color3.new(1, 1, 1) or Theme.TextMuted

            orderLbl.Text = (mgrMode == "Blacklist") and "Blacklisted" or "My Order"
            allLbl.Text = (mgrMode == "Mutation" and "All Mutations")
            or (mgrMode == "Traits" and "All Traits")
            or "All Brainrots"
        end

        local function poolNames()
            local out, seen = {}, {}
            local src = (mgrMode == "Mutation") and "Mutations" or "Traits"
            pcall(function()
                local d = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Datas")
                local m = d and d:FindFirstChild(src)
                if not m then return end
                for k, v in pairs(require(m)) do
                    local nm = (type(v) == "table" and v.Name) or k
                    if type(nm) == "string" and nm ~= "" and nm ~= "None" and not seen[nm] then
                        seen[nm] = true
                        out[#out + 1] = nm
                    end
                end
            end)
            table.sort(out)
            return out
        end

            local searchLower = searchFilter:lower()

                ll.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                ll.Text = "Loading animals..."
                ll.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
                ll.TextSize = 10
                ll.TextColor3 = Theme.TextMuted
                return
            end
            local hasSearch = (searchFilter ~= "")
            local searchLower = searchFilter:lower()
            local lo = 0
            for _, rarity in ipairs(groupOrder) do
                local animals = animalGroups[rarity]

                local rCol = Theme.GoldHi
                local shown = {}
                for _, a in ipairs(animals) do
                    if not hasSearch or a.name:lower():find(searchLower, 1, true) then
                        table.insert(shown, a)
                    end
                end
                if #shown > 0 then
                    lo = lo + 1
                    local isOpen = expanded[rarity] or hasSearch

                    local selCount = 0
                    for _, a in ipairs(shown) do
                        if (mgrMode == "Priority" and inPriority(a.name)) or (mgrMode == "Blacklist" and inBlacklist(a.name)) then
                            selCount = selCount + 1
                        end
                    end

                    local head = Instance.new("Frame", groupsList)
                    head.Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 31)
                    head.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 18)
                    head.BackgroundTransparency = 0.08
                    head.BorderSizePixel = 0
                    head.LayoutOrder = lo
                    Instance.new("UICorner", head).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
                    prDepth(head)

                    local hAccent = Instance.new("Frame", head)
                    hAccent.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.16, 0)
                    hAccent.Size = UDim2.new(0, 3, 0.68, 0)
                    hAccent.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.GoldHi
                    hAccent.BorderSizePixel = 0
                    Instance.new("UICorner", hAccent).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 2)
                    local hAccGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient", hAccent)
                    hAccGrad.Rotation = 90
                    hAccGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
                        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Theme.GoldHi),
                        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Theme.GoldLo),
                    })

                    local hLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel", head)
                    hLbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -60, 1, 0)
                    hLbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 0)
                    hLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                    hLbl.Text = (isOpen and "▼ " or "▲ ") .. rarity .. "s"
                    hLbl.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
                    hLbl.TextSize = 10
                    if _G.VXRarity then _G.VXRarity.Apply(hLbl, rarity) else hLbl.TextColor3 = rCol end
                    hLbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left

                    local hCount = Instance.new("TextLabel", head)
                    hCount.Size = UDim2.new(0, 50, 1, 0)
                    hCount.Position = UDim2.new(1, -56, 0, 0)
                    hCount.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                    hCount.Text = selCount .. "/" .. #shown
                    hCount.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
                    hCount.TextSize = 9
                    hCount.TextColor3 = Theme.TextMuted
                    hCount.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right

                    local hBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", head)
                    hBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
                    hBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                    hBtn.Text = ""
                    hBtn.ZIndex = 10
                    hBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

                        expanded[rarity] = nowOpen
                        renderGroups()

                        if nowOpen then VXFadeInGui(groupsList, 0.22) end
                    end)

                    if isOpen then
                        for _, a in ipairs(shown) do
                            lo = lo + 1
                            local checkedIdx = (mgrMode == "Priority") and inPriority(a.name) or inBlacklist(a.name)
                            local arow = Instance.new("Frame", groupsList)
                            arow.Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 34)
                            arow.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 18)

                                chk.BackgroundColor3 = checkedIdx and Theme.GoldHi or Color3.fromRGB(26, 18, 40)
                                chk.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(24, 18, 6)
                            else
                                chk.BackgroundColor3 = checkedIdx and Color3.fromRGB(190, 62, 84) or Color3.fromRGB(26, 18, 40)
                                chk.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 235, 255)
                            end
                            Instance.new("UICorner", chk).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)
                            prDepth(chk)

                            local an = Instance.new("TextLabel", arow)
                            an.Size = UDim2.new(1, -128, 0, 15)
                            an.Position = UDim2.new(0, 30, 0, 2)
                            an.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                            an.Text = a.name
                            an.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
                            an.TextSize = 10
                            an.TextColor3 = Theme.TextPrimary
                            an.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
                            an.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd

                            local ag = Instance.new("TextLabel", arow)
                            ag.Size = UDim2.new(1, -128, 0, 12)
                            ag.Position = UDim2.new(0, 30, 0, 18)
                            ag.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                            ag.Text = "Gen " .. fmtGen(a.gen)
                            ag.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
                            ag.TextSize = 8
                            ag.TextColor3 = Theme.TextMuted
                            ag.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left

                            if mgrMode == "Priority" then
                                local minLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel", arow)
                                minLbl.Size = UDim2.new(0, 24, 1, 0)
                                minLbl.Position = UDim2.new(1, -96, 0, 0)
                                minLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                                minLbl.Text = "Min"
                                minLbl.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
                                minLbl.TextSize = 9
                                minLbl.TextColor3 = Theme.GoldHi
                                minLbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right

                                local minBox = Instance.new("TextBox", arow)
                                minBox.Size = UDim2.new(0, 60, 0, 22)
                                minBox.Position = UDim2.new(1, -66, 0.5, -11)
                                minBox.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(9, 9, 11)
                                minBox.BackgroundTransparency = 0.05
                                minBox.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
                                minBox.TextSize = 9
                                minBox.TextColor3 = Theme.TextPrimary
                                minBox.PlaceholderText = "—"
                                minBox.PlaceholderColor3 = Theme.TextMuted
                                minBox.ClearTextOnFocus = false

                                local mg = minGenMap[a.name:lower()]
                                minBox.Text = fmtNumShort(mg or math.floor(a.gen or 0))
                                Instance.new("UICorner", minBox).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)
                                minBox.FocusLost:Connect(function()
                                    local v = parseGenInput(minBox.Text)
                                    if v then
                                        minGenMap[a.name:lower()] = v
                                        minBox.Text = fmtNumShort(v)
                                    else
                                        minGenMap[a.name:lower()] = nil
                                        minBox.Text = fmtNumShort(math.floor(a.gen or 0))
                                    end
                                    autoSave(); renderOrder()
                                end)
                            end

                            chk.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                                if mgrMode == "Priority" then
                                    local pos = inPriority(a.name)
                                    if pos then table.remove(customPriorityList, pos)
                                    else table.insert(customPriorityList, a.name) end
                                else
                                    local pos = inBlacklist(a.name)
                                    if pos then table.remove(blacklist, pos)
                                    else table.insert(blacklist, a.name) end
                                end
                                autoSave(); renderGroups(); renderOrder()
                            end)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        local function _vxBuildCatalog()
            local ok = pcall(function()

                local all = (_G.VXAllAnimals and _G.VXAllAnimals()) or nil
                if type(all) ~= "table" or #all == 0 then

                    all = {}
                    local scan = (_G.VXScanBrainrots and _G.VXScanBrainrots()) or {}
                    for _, e in ipairs(scan) do
                        local gv = tonumber(e.gen or e.value) or 0
                        all[#all + 1] = { name = e.name, gen = gv,
                        rarity = (genTierWord and genTierWord(gv)) or "Common" }
                    end
                end
                local seen = {}
                for _, g in pairs(animalGroups) do table.clear(g) end
                table.clear(groupOrder)
                for _, e in ipairs(all) do
                    local nm = e.name
                    local gv = tonumber(e.gen) or 0
                    if type(nm) == "string" and nm ~= "" and not seen[nm:lower()] then
                        seen[nm:lower()] = true
                        local rarity = e.rarity or (genTierWord and genTierWord(gv)) or "Common"
                        animalGroups[rarity] = animalGroups[rarity] or {}
                        table.insert(animalGroups[rarity], { name = nm, gen = gv })
                        baseGenByName[nm:lower()] = gv
                    end
                end
                for _, list in pairs(animalGroups) do
                    table.sort(list, function(x, y) return (x.gen or 0) > (y.gen or 0) end)
                end
                local used = {}
                for _, r in ipairs(RARITY_ORDER) do
                    if animalGroups[r] and #animalGroups[r] > 0 then table.insert(groupOrder, r); used[r] = true end
                end
                for r in pairs(animalGroups) do
                    if not used[r] and #animalGroups[r] > 0 then table.insert(groupOrder, r) end
                end
            end)
            dbLoaded = ok
            renderGroups()
            renderOrder()
        end
        task.spawn(function()
            for _ = 1, 6 do
                _vxBuildCatalog()
                task.wait(2)
            end
        end)

        task.spawn(function()
            for _ = 1, 60 do
                if _G.VXSetPriorityList then break end
                task.wait(0.25)
            end
            if _G.VXSetPriorityList then
                pcall(_G.VXSetPriorityList, Config.PriorityList or {})
            end
        end)

        for _, key in ipairs(SUB_TABS) do
            subBtns[key].MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                mgrMode = key
                refreshSubTabs(); renderGroups(); renderOrder()
            end)
        end
        searchBox:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
            searchFilter = searchBox.Text
            renderGroups()
        end)
        resetBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            if mgrMode == "Priority" then customPriorityList = {}
            elseif mgrMode == "Mutation" then mutationOrder = {}
            elseif mgrMode == "Traits" then traitOrder = {}
            else blacklist = {} end
            autoSave(); renderGroups(); renderOrder()
        end)

        refreshSubTabs()
        renderGroups()
        renderOrder()
    end

    local keybindsScroll = contentScrolls["Keybinds"]
    if keybindsScroll then
        Config.FnKeys = Config.FnKeys or {}

        local kbResets = {}
        local function kbRow(text, desc, current, defaultKey, apply)
            local _, setKey = createKeybindRow(keybindsScroll, text, desc, current, apply)
            table.insert(kbResets, function()
                setKey(defaultKey)
                apply(defaultKey)
            end)
        end
        local function fnKeyRow(fname, desc)
            kbRow(fname, desc, Config.FnKeys[fname] or "", "", function(val)
                Config.FnKeys[fname] = val
                SaveConfig()
            end)
        end

        createSectionHeader(keybindsScroll, "MOVEMENT KEYBINDS")
        kbRow("Teleport Key", "Teleport to selected brainrot", Config.TpSettings.TpKey or "", "", function(val) Config.TpSettings.TpKey = val; SaveConfig() end)
        kbRow("Clone Key", "Activate Quantum Cloner", Config.TpSettings.CloneKey or "", "", function(val) Config.TpSettings.CloneKey = val; SaveConfig() end)
        kbRow("Direct Clone Key", "Grapple + instant clone + snap to target", Config.TpSettings.DirectCloneKey or "", "", function(val) Config.TpSettings.DirectCloneKey = val; SaveConfig() end)
        kbRow("Carpet Speed Key", "Toggle speed boost", Config.TpSettings.CarpetSpeedKey or "", "", function(val) Config.TpSettings.CarpetSpeedKey = val; SaveConfig() end)
        kbRow("Reset Key", "Reset character", Config.ResetKey or "", "", function(val) Config.ResetKey = val; SaveConfig() end)

        createSectionHeader(keybindsScroll, "FUNCTION KEYBINDS")

        kbRow("Ragdoll Self Key", "Ragdoll yourself", Config.RagdollSelfKey or "", "", function(val) Config.RagdollSelfKey = val; SaveConfig() end)
        kbRow("Auto Destroy Turrets Key", "Toggle auto-destroy turrets", Config.TurretKey or "", "", function(val) Config.TurretKey = val; SaveConfig() end)
        kbRow("Spam Nearest Key", "Spam commands at the nearest player", Config.SpamNearestKey or "", "", function(val) Config.SpamNearestKey = val; SaveConfig() end)
        kbRow("Spam Owner Key", "Spam commands at the nearest plot owner", Config.SpamOwnerKey or "", "", function(val) Config.SpamOwnerKey = val; SaveConfig() end)
        fnKeyRow("Auto Unlock on Steal", "Toggle auto unlock on steal")
        fnKeyRow("Back to Brainrot on Fail", "Toggle back to brainrot on fail")
        fnKeyRow("Clone After TP", "Toggle clone after TP")
        fnKeyRow("Go to Brainrot After TP", "Toggle go to brainrot after TP (needs Clone After TP on)")
        fnKeyRow("Path Visuals", "Toggle the neon teleport path visuals")

        createSectionHeader(keybindsScroll, "ESP KEYBINDS")
        fnKeyRow("Player ESP", "Toggle player ESP")
        fnKeyRow("Brainrot ESP", "Toggle brainrot ESP")
        fnKeyRow("Line ESP", "Toggle line ESP")
        fnKeyRow("Base ESP", "Toggle base ESP")
        fnKeyRow("Stealing ESP", "Toggle stealing ESP")
        fnKeyRow("Mine ESP", "Toggle mine ESP")

        createSectionHeader(keybindsScroll, "PANEL KEYBINDS")
        fnKeyRow("Show Admin Panel", "Show/hide the admin panel")
        fnKeyRow("Show Admin Control", "Show/hide admin control")
        fnKeyRow("Show Brainrot Selection", "Show/hide brainrot selection")
        fnKeyRow("Show Quick Panel", "Show/hide the quick panel")
        fnKeyRow("Show Actions Panel", "Show/hide the actions panel")
        fnKeyRow("Show Control Panel", "Show/hide the control panel")
        fnKeyRow("Show Steal Settings", "Show/hide steal settings")

        createSectionHeader(keybindsScroll, "UI KEYBINDS")
        kbRow("Menu Key", "Open settings menu", Config.MenuKey or "LeftControl", "LeftControl", function(val) Config.MenuKey = val; SaveConfig() end)
        kbRow("Click to AP Key", "Toggle Click to AP", Config.ClickToAPKeybind or "", "", function(val) Config.ClickToAPKeybind = val; SaveConfig() end)
        kbRow("Proximity AP Key", "Toggle Proximity AP", Config.ProximityAPKeybind or "", "", function(val) Config.ProximityAPKeybind = val; SaveConfig() end)
        kbRow("Rejoin Key", "Rejoin server", Config.RejoinKey or "", "", function(val) Config.RejoinKey = val; SaveConfig() end)
        kbRow("Kick Key", "Kick/shutdown game", Config.KickKey or "", "", function(val) Config.KickKey = val; SaveConfig() end)

        local kbResetRow = Instance.new("Frame", keybindsScroll)
        kbResetRow.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 40)
        kbResetRow.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(12, 12, 14)
        kbResetRow.BackgroundTransparency = 0.32
        kbResetRow.BorderSizePixel = 0
        kbResetRow.LayoutOrder = 9999
        Instance.new("UICorner", kbResetRow).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
        local kbResetLine = Instance.new("UIStroke", kbResetRow)
        kbResetLine.Color = Color3.fromRGB(6, 6, 8)
        kbResetLine.Thickness = 1
        kbResetLine.Transparency = 0.85
        kbResetLine.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border

        local kbResetLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel", kbResetRow)
        kbResetLbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -82, 1, 0)
        kbResetLbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 0)

        kbResetLbl.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
        kbResetLbl.TextSize = 13
        kbResetLbl.TextColor3 = Theme.TextPrimary

        local kbResetBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", kbResetRow)
        kbResetBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 70, 0, 28)
        kbResetBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -82, 0.5, -14)
        kbResetBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(26, 11, 16)
        kbResetBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.32
        kbResetBtn.AutoButtonColor = false
        kbResetBtn.Text = "RESET"
        kbResetBtn.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
        kbResetBtn.TextSize = 11
        kbResetBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 130, 150)

        kbResetBtnStroke.Color = Theme.Error
        kbResetBtnStroke.Thickness = 0.5
        kbResetBtnStroke.Transparency = 0.5
        kbResetBtnStroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
        kbResetBtn.MouseEnter:Connect(function() kbResetBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.55; kbResetBtnStroke.Transparency = 0.15 end)
        kbResetBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function() kbResetBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.32; kbResetBtnStroke.Transparency = 0.5 end)
        kbResetBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            for _, fn in ipairs(kbResets) do pcall(fn) end
            Config.FnKeys = {}
            SaveConfig()
            pcall(ShowNotification, "Keybinds", "All keybinds reset")
        end)
    end

    return settingsGui
end

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
    if processed or UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() or _G.isBindingKey then return end

    local function getSafeKey(keyName)
        if not keyName or keyName == "" then return nil end
        local success, result = pcall(function()
            return Enum.KeyCode[keyName]
        end)
        return success and result or nil
    end

    local tpKey = getSafeKey(Config.TpSettings.TpKey)
    if tpKey and input.KeyCode == tpKey then
        runTP()
        return
    end

    local cloneKey = getSafeKey(Config.TpSettings.CloneKey)
    if cloneKey and input.KeyCode == cloneKey then
        Clone()
        return
    end

    local directCloneKey = getSafeKey(Config.TpSettings.DirectCloneKey)
    if directCloneKey and input.KeyCode == directCloneKey then
        if _G.VXDirectClone then _G.VXDirectClone() end
        return
    end

    local resetKey = getSafeKey(Config.ResetKey)
    if resetKey and input.KeyCode == resetKey then
        if executeReset then executeReset() end
        return
    end

    local carpetKey = getSafeKey(Config.TpSettings.CarpetSpeedKey)
    if carpetKey and input.KeyCode == carpetKey then
        State.carpetSpeedEnabled = not State.carpetSpeedEnabled
        setCarpetSpeed(State.carpetSpeedEnabled)
        return
    end

    local turretKey = getSafeKey(Config.TurretKey)
    if turretKey and input.KeyCode == turretKey then
        if _G.ToggleAutoDestroyTurrets then _G.ToggleAutoDestroyTurrets()
        else Config.AutoDestroyTurrets = not Config.AutoDestroyTurrets; SaveConfig() end
        return
    end

    local spamNearestKey = getSafeKey(Config.SpamNearestKey)
    if spamNearestKey and input.KeyCode == spamNearestKey then
        if _G.VXSpamNearest then _G.VXSpamNearest() end
        return
    end

    local spamOwnerKey = getSafeKey(Config.SpamOwnerKey)
    if spamOwnerKey and input.KeyCode == spamOwnerKey then
        if _G.VXSpamOwner then _G.VXSpamOwner() end
        return
    end

    local ragdollKey = getSafeKey(Config.RagdollSelfKey)
    if ragdollKey and input.KeyCode == ragdollKey then
        if _G.runAdminCommand then
            _G.runAdminCommand(LocalPlayer, "ragdoll")
        end
        return
    end

    local rejoinKey = getSafeKey(Config.RejoinKey)
    if rejoinKey and input.KeyCode == rejoinKey then
        rejoinGame()
        return
    end

    local clickKey = getSafeKey(Config.ClickToAPKeybind)
    if clickKey and input.KeyCode == clickKey then

        if _G.ToggleClickToAP then _G.ToggleClickToAP()
        else Config.ClickToAP = not Config.ClickToAP; SaveConfig() end
        return
    end

    local proxKey = getSafeKey(Config.ProximityAPKeybind)
    if proxKey and input.KeyCode == proxKey then

        if _G.ToggleProximityAP then _G.ToggleProximityAP() end
        return
    end

    local kickKey = getSafeKey(Config.KickKey)
    if kickKey and input.KeyCode == kickKey then
        _G.VXShutdown()
        return
    end

    if type(Config.FnKeys) == "table" then
        for fname, keyName in pairs(Config.FnKeys) do
            if keyName and keyName ~= "" then
                local kc = getSafeKey(keyName)
                if kc and input.KeyCode == kc then
                    local e = VXFindFeature(fname)
                    if e and e.kind == "toggle" and e.get and e.set then
                        local turningOn = not e.get()

                        if not (fname == "Go to Brainrot After TP" and turningOn and not Config.TpSettings.CloneAfterTP) then
                            e.set(turningOn)
                        end
                    end
                    return
                end
            end
        end
    end

    local menuKey = getSafeKey(Config.MenuKey) or Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl
    if input.KeyCode == menuKey then
        if _G.ToggleSettingsGui then
            _G.ToggleSettingsGui()
        else
            local settingsGui = VXGui:FindFirstChild(_vxName("VXSettingsUI"))
            if settingsGui then
                settingsGui.Enabled = not settingsGui.Enabled
            end
        end
        return
    end
end)

function loadAllGUIs()

    local function buildNow(name, build)
        local function try()
            if VXGui:FindFirstChild(name) then return true end
            local ok = pcall(build)
            if not ok then
                pcall(ShowNotification, "VX", name .. " build failed (see F9 console)")
            end
            return VXGui:FindFirstChild(name) ~= nil
        end
        if try() then return end
        task.spawn(function()
            for attempt = 1, 4 do
                task.wait(0.5 * attempt)
                if try() then break end
            end
        end)
    end
    buildNow(_vxName("VXInvisPanel"), CreateControlPanel)

    RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()

    buildNow(_vxName("VXSettingsUI"), CreateSettingsGUI)
    _G.VXFeatureRegistryReady = true

    RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()

    _G.VXUpdateUIVisibility = function()
        local revealed = _G.VXRevealedGuis or {}
        local adUI = VXGui:FindFirstChild(_vxName("VXAdminPanel"))
        if adUI and revealed[_vxName("VXAdminPanel")] then adUI.Enabled = not Config.HideAdminPanel end
        local adControl = VXGui:FindFirstChild(_vxName("VXAdminControl"))
        if adControl and revealed[_vxName("VXAdminControl")] then adControl.Enabled = not Config.HideAdminControl end
        local bsUI = VXGui:FindFirstChild(_vxName("BrainrotSelectionUI"))
        if bsUI and revealed[_vxName("BrainrotSelectionUI")] then bsUI.Enabled = not Config.HideBrainrotSelection end
        local quickGui = VXGui:FindFirstChild(_vxName("VXQuickPanel"))
        if quickGui and revealed[_vxName("VXQuickPanel")] then quickGui.Enabled = Config.ShowQuickPanel end
        local actionsGui = VXGui:FindFirstChild(_vxName("VXActionsPanel"))
        if actionsGui and revealed[_vxName("VXActionsPanel")] then actionsGui.Enabled = Config.ShowActionsPanel == true end
        local invGui = VXGui:FindFirstChild(_vxName("VXInvisPanel"))
        if invGui and revealed[_vxName("VXInvisPanel")] then invGui.Enabled = Config.ShowInvisPanel end
    end

    local function buildHidden(name, build)
        buildNow(name, build)
        local g = VXGui:FindFirstChild(name)
        if g then g.Enabled = false end
    end

    buildHidden(_vxName("VXAdminPanel"), CreateAdminPanel)
    RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
    buildHidden(_vxName("VXAdminControl"), CreateAdminControlGUI)
    RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
    buildHidden(_vxName("VXStatusHUD"), CreateStatusHUD)
    RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()

    VXScheduleGuiReveal(_vxName("VXAdminPanel"), "AdminPanelDelay", function()
        return (not Config.HideAdminPanel) and true or false
    end)
    VXScheduleGuiReveal(_vxName("VXAdminControl"), "AdminControlDelay", function()
        return (not Config.HideAdminControl) and true or false
    end)
    VXScheduleGuiReveal(_vxName("VXStatusHUD"), "StatusHudDelay", function()
        return true
    end)

    do
        local sgDelay = tonumber(Config.SettingsGuiDelay) or 0
        if sgDelay > 0 and _G.ToggleSettingsGui then
            local origToggle = _G.ToggleSettingsGui
            local readyAt = (_G.VXBootT0 or os.clock()) + sgDelay
            _G.ToggleSettingsGui = function(...)
                if os.clock() < readyAt then return end
                return origToggle(...)
            end
        end
    end

    VXFireGuiReveal()

    task.delay(3, function()
        for _, n in ipairs({
            _vxName("VXStatusHUD"), _vxName("VXSettingsUI"), _vxName("VXAdminPanel"),
            _vxName("VXAdminControl"), _vxName("VXInvisPanel"), _vxName("BrainrotSelectionUI"),
            _vxName("VXQuickPanel"), _vxName("VXActionsPanel"),
        }) do
            local sg = VXGui:FindFirstChild(n)
            if sg then pcall(VXTextShine, sg) end
        end
    end)

    local TEXT_BUMP = 1.18
    local function _vxBumpText(root)
        if not root then return end
        local function bump(o)
            if (o:IsA("TextLabel") or o:IsA("TextButton") or o:IsA("TextBox")) and not o:GetAttribute("_vxTS") then
                o:SetAttribute("_vxTS", true)
                if not o.TextScaled and (o.TextSize or 0) > 0 then
                    pcall(function() o.TextSize = math.floor(o.TextSize * TEXT_BUMP + 0.5) end)
                end
            end
        end
        for _, d in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do bump(d) end
        root.DescendantAdded:Connect(bump)
    end

    for _, n in ipairs({
        _vxName("VXAdminPanel"), _vxName("VXAdminControl"),
        _vxName("VXInvisPanel"), _vxName("VXQuickPanel"), _vxName("VXActionsPanel"),
    }) do
        task.spawn(function()
            for _ = 1, 40 do
                local sg = VXGui:FindFirstChild(n)
                if sg then _vxBumpText(sg); return end
                task.wait(0.25)
            end
        end)
    end

    for _, n in ipairs({
        _vxName("VXStatusHUD"), _vxName("VXAdminPanel"), _vxName("VXAdminControl"),
        _vxName("VXInvisPanel"), _vxName("VXQuickPanel"), _vxName("VXActionsPanel"),
        _vxName("VXSettingsUI"), _vxName("BrainrotSelectionUI"),
    }) do
        task.spawn(function()
            for _ = 1, 40 do
                local sg = VXGui:FindFirstChild(n)
                if sg then if _G.VXGlowRoot then _G.VXGlowRoot(sg) end return end
                task.wait(0.25)
            end
        end)
    end

    _G._isTargetPlotUnlocked = function(plotName)

            if not plots then return false end

                if item:IsA("Model") then pcall(function() pos = item:GetPivot().Position end)
                elseif item:IsA("BasePart") then pos = item.Position end
                if pos then table.insert(unlockItems, { Object = item, Height = pos.Y }) end

            for _, desc in ipairs(floor1Door:GetDescendants()) do

            end
            for _, child in ipairs(floor1Door:GetChildren()) do

            end

        end)

    local function findAdorneeGlobal(animalData)

                        if spawn then return spawn end

    local Pathfinding = { lastPathCheck = {} }
    function Pathfinding:CheckCollision(origin, destination, character)
        local direction = destination - origin
        local rp = RaycastParams.new()
        rp.FilterDescendantsInstances = { character }
        rp.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        local result = workspace:Raycast(origin, direction, rp)
        if result and result.Instance then
            if result.Instance.CanCollide == false then
                return self:CheckCollision(result.Position + (direction.Unit * 0.1), destination, character)
            end
            return true
        end
        return false
    end

    -- =====================================================================
    --  RESOLVEDOR DE REMOTE  --  metodo do sabcom, ponta a ponta
    --
    --  O QUE ESTAVA AQUI ERA ADJACENCIA. Varria o ReplicatedStorage inteiro
    --  numa lista plana e casava flat[i] com flat[i+1]:
    --
    --      for i = 1, #flat, 2 do
    --          local a, b = flat[i], flat[i + 1]
    --          if b then pairedInst[b.name] = a.remote end
    --      end
    --
    --  ou seja, assumia que cada alias em texto claro fica GRUDADO no remote
    --  hasheado de verdade. O update do jogo acabou com isso: os aliases em
    --  texto claro foram todos pra uma REGIAO PROPRIA (alias la pelo indice
    --  397, remote real la pelo 6). O par nao existe mais -- entao Resolve()
    --  devolvia o remote que por acaso estivesse ao lado, ou o alias morto em
    --  texto claro, que NAO FAZ NADA quando disparado. Era isso que deixava
    --  "as remotes sem ativar", em todas as features que passam por aqui.
    --
    --  O jeito do sabcom, nesta ordem:
    --    1. lookup direto sem hash (o update expos muitos remotes assim)
    --    2. a FUNCAO DE HASH DO PROPRIO JOGO -- F1/F2 mais o GUID secreto,
    --       achados varrendo o heap atras das funcoes do modulo Net. Como e
    --       o mesmo hash que o jogo usa, sobrevive a rotacao por join.
    --    3. cross-prefix: RE -> RF -> URE
    --
    --  build() usa getgc(true), que varre o heap INTEIRO e e pesadissimo:
    --  no maximo uma tentativa a cada 15s, e desiste de vez depois de 4
    --  falhas -- senao cada resolve refaz a varredura e derruba o FPS.
    -- =====================================================================
    local _RemoteBypass = {}
    do
        local netFolder = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Packages"):WaitForChild("Net")
        local getupvalues = debug.getupvalues or getupvalues
        local getinfo = debug.getinfo or getinfo

        local F1, F2, secret

        local function isGuid(s)
            return type(s) == "string" and #s == 36
                and s:match("^%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%-%x%x%x%x%-%x%x%x%x%-%x%x%x%x%-%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x$") ~= nil
        end

        local _bufFromString = buffer.fromstring or function(s)
            local b = buffer.create(#s)
            buffer.writestring(b, 0, s)
            return b
        end

        local _lastBuild, _buildFails = 0, 0
        local function build()
            if F1 and secret then return true end
            if _buildFails >= 4 then return false end
            if (os.clock() - _lastBuild) < 15 then return false end
            _lastBuild = os.clock()
            _buildFails = _buildFails + 1
            if not getgc or type(getupvalues) ~= "function" or type(getinfo) ~= "function" then
                return false
            end
            local jobId = game.JobId
            local a, b
            local cands, seen = {}, {}
            local _cloneFn = clonefunction or function(f) return f end
            for _, v in getgc(true) do
                if typeof(v) == "function" then
                    local ok, info = pcall(getinfo, v)
                    if ok and info and info.source then
                        local src = info.source
                        local matched = (src == "=ReplicatedStorage.Packages.Net.Net")
                            or (src:find("ReplicatedStorage", 1, true) and src:find("Net", 1, true))
                        if matched then
                            local ok2, ups = pcall(getupvalues, v)
                            if ok2 and ups then
                                for _, up in pairs(ups) do
                                    if type(up) == "table" then
                                        local x, y, z = rawget(up, 1), rawget(up, 2), rawget(up, 3)
                                        if not a and type(x) == "function" and type(y) == "function" and type(z) == "string" then
                                            a, b = _cloneFn(x), _cloneFn(y)
                                        end
                                        for _, e in pairs(up) do
                                            if isGuid(e) and e ~= jobId and not seen[e] then
                                                seen[e] = true; cands[#cands + 1] = e
                                            end
                                        end
                                    elseif isGuid(up) and up ~= jobId and not seen[up] then
                                        seen[up] = true; cands[#cands + 1] = up
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            if not a then
                _G.VXLog("Net", "build() failed - no hashing functions found (direct lookup only)")
                return false
            end
            F1, F2 = a, b
            local okC, cipher = pcall(function() return F2("UseItem", jobId) end)
            if not okC then return false end
            if #cands == 1 then
                secret = cands[1]
                _G.VXLog("Net", "build() OK (single candidate)")
                return true
            end
            for _, sec in ipairs(cands) do
                local ok, h = pcall(function()
                    return F1(_bufFromString(cipher), _bufFromString(sec .. jobId))
                end)
                if ok and type(h) == "string" and netFolder:FindFirstChild("RE/" .. h) then
                    secret = sec
                    _G.VXLog("Net", "build() OK (multi candidate, resolved)")
                    return true
                end
            end
            _G.VXLog("Net", "build() failed - " .. #cands .. " GUID candidates, none resolved")
            return false
        end

        local _resolveWarned = {}
        -- 1) direto sem hash  2) hash do proprio jogo
        local function resolve(prefix, name)
            local direct = netFolder:FindFirstChild(prefix .. "/" .. name)
            if direct then return direct end
            if not (F1 and secret) and not build() then return nil end
            local jobId = game.JobId
            local ok, h = pcall(function()
                local c = F2(name, jobId)
                return F1(_bufFromString(c), _bufFromString(secret .. jobId))
            end)
            if not ok or type(h) ~= "string" then return nil end
            local remote = netFolder:FindFirstChild(prefix .. "/" .. h)
            if not remote then
                if not _resolveWarned[name] then
                    _resolveWarned[name] = true
                    _G.VXLog("Net", "resolve('" .. tostring(name) .. "') failed - no " .. prefix .. "/<hash>")
                end
                return nil
            end
            return remote
        end

        -- universal: tenta RE, RF, URE
        local function getRemoteAny(name)
            for _, pfx in ipairs({ "RE", "RF", "URE" }) do
                local r = resolve(pfx, name)
                if r then return r end
            end
            return nil
        end

        -- aceita "RE/Nome", "RF/Nome", "URE/Nome" ou so "Nome"
        _RemoteBypass.Resolve = function(fullName)
            if type(fullName) ~= "string" then return nil end
            for _, pfx in ipairs({ "URE", "RE", "RF" }) do
                local rest = fullName:match("^" .. pfx .. "/(.+)$")
                if rest then return resolve(pfx, rest) end
            end
            return getRemoteAny(fullName)
        end
        _RemoteBypass.ResolveAny = getRemoteAny
        -- Rebuild mantido pela API antiga; a resolucao agora e por hash, nao
        -- por um mapa pre-montado, entao nao ha mapa pra reconstruir.
        _RemoteBypass.Rebuild = function() return 0 end

        _RemoteBypass.MakeNetShim = function()
            return {
                RemoteEvent           = function(_, name) return resolve("RE", name) end,
                RemoteFunction        = function(_, name) return resolve("RF", name) end,
                UnreliableRemoteEvent = function(_, name) return resolve("URE", name) end,
                GetRemote             = function(_, name) return getRemoteAny(name) end,
                FireServer            = function(_, name, ...)
                    local r = getRemoteAny(name)
                    if not r then return false end
                    local args = { ... }
                    if r:IsA("RemoteFunction") then
                        return pcall(function() return r:InvokeServer(table.unpack(args)) end)
                    end
                    return pcall(function() r:FireServer(table.unpack(args)) end)
                end,
            }
        end

        -- mesma superficie que o sabcom expoe como _G.Net, para as partes do
        -- hub (e o resolveHashed do grapple) que procuram por ela
        _G.VXNet = _RemoteBypass.MakeNetShim()
        _G.Net = _G.Net or _G.VXNet
    end

    _G.VXGrappleValue = _G.VXGrappleValue or 0.33
    -- girar a camera pra mirar sacode a tela (e gira o personagem junto,
    -- via AutoRotate). A escrita em PlayerMouse ja mira sozinha, entao isto
    -- fica desligado. Ligue so se a mira sair errada em algum caso.
    if _G.VXGrappleMoveCamera == nil then _G.VXGrappleMoveCamera = false end
    -- ============================================================
    --  MODO REMOTE  --  O PADRAO AGORA
    --
    --  O que estava escrito aqui era: "TEM QUE SER Activate(). NAO
    --  TROQUE POR FireServer" -- porque mandar o UseItem direto "nao
    --  disparava nada" e o sabcom concluiu que a assinatura da Grapple
    --  Hook era irreproduzivel por estar ofuscada com Luraph.
    --
    --  A conclusao estava errada, e por dois motivos somados:
    --
    --   1. O REMOTE ERA O ERRADO. O par RE/RF de hash duplo e a ANCORA,
    --      nao o UseItem -- ele fica uma posicao antes (ver
    --      findUseItemByDualHash). Estava mandando payload certo pro
    --      destinatario errado.
    --   2. A ASSINATURA E DE DOIS ARGUMENTOS, nao tres:
    --      FireServer(clamp(Magnitude/120, 0, 2), pos). Sem peca alvo.
    --
    --  Com os dois corrigidos o FireServer funciona, e ele e melhor que
    --  o Activate() em tudo que importa: nao encosta no personagem, nao
    --  sacode a tela, nao depende do getgc achar a tabela do PlayerMouse,
    --  nao depende de Tool.Enabled, nao tem cooldown de engine pra
    --  contornar e nao precisa da trava de puxao.
    --
    --  _G.VXGrappleUseActivate = true  -> volta pro caminho antigo
    --  (Activate + mira no PlayerMouse + giro de camera + trava).
    -- ============================================================
    if _G.VXGrappleUseActivate == nil then _G.VXGrappleUseActivate = false end
    -- trava o giro do personagem durante o disparo (ver __VXGrappleDisparar)
    if _G.VXGrappleNoSpin == nil then _G.VXGrappleNoSpin = true end
    -- cancela o PUXAO: prende o CFrame e apaga os movers que o gancho
    -- pendura. Ativa igual, mas voce nao sai do lugar.
    if _G.VXGrappleNoPull == nil then _G.VXGrappleNoPull = true end
    -- "Down"      = mira no chao SOB os pes (puxao vertical, nao te arrasta)
    -- "Direction" = busca na horizontal, na direcao do destino/LookVector
    _G.VXGrappleAimMode = _G.VXGrappleAimMode or "Down"
    -- ============================================================
    --  MODO SABCOM  --  LIGADO POR PADRAO
    --
    --  Manda o disparo pelo porte do __sabcomGrappleDisparar
    --  (__VXGrappleDispararSabcom), que gira a camera em TODO tiro em
    --  vez de depender da escrita no PlayerMouse. E o que o sabcom faz,
    --  e e por isso que o sabcom dispara toda vez: a camera nunca falha,
    --  a escrita falha sempre que o getgc nao acha a tabela viva.
    --
    --  O preco e a tela sacudir por 4 frames a cada disparo (a camera
    --  volta sozinha depois). Se preferir a tela parada:
    --      _G.VXGrappleSabcom = false
    -- ============================================================
    if _G.VXGrappleSabcom == nil then _G.VXGrappleSabcom = true end
    do
        local PAYLOAD_FILE = "sxe_grapple_payload.txt"

        local _netFolder
        local function netFolder()
            if _netFolder and _netFolder.Parent then return _netFolder end
            local pkgs = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Packages")
            _netFolder = (pkgs and pkgs:FindFirstChild("Net")) or nil
            return _netFolder
        end

        local function isHashName(nm)
            return type(nm) == "string"
            and (nm:match("^RE/%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x") or nm:match("^RF/%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x")) ~= nil
        end
        local function isHashRemote(ch, className)
            return ch and ch:IsA(className) and isHashName(ch.Name)
        end

        -- ============================================================
        --  RESOLVER DO UseItem  --  A DIFERENCA E UMA SUBTRACAO
        --
