                burstDist = math.clamp(burstDist or 40, 8, 60)

                if #route > 1 then
                    local si = 1
                    while si < #route do
                        local a = (si == 1) and fromPos or route[si - 1]
                        if cClear(a, route[si + 1]) then
                            table.remove(route, si)
                        else
                            si = si + 1
                        end
                    end
                end
                local toPos = route[#route]

                local ground = {}
                local function pushG(p)
                    local g = Vector3.new(p.X, 0, p.Z)
                    if #ground == 0 or (ground[#ground] - g).Magnitude > 0.5 then ground[#ground + 1] = g end
                end
                pushG(fromPos)
                for _, wp in ipairs(route) do pushG(wp) end
                if #ground == 1 then ground[2] = ground[1] end

                local cum = { 0 }
                for i = 2, #ground do cum[i] = cum[i - 1] + (ground[i] - ground[i - 1]).Magnitude end
                local totalH = cum[#ground]
                local fromY, toY = fromPos.Y, toPos.Y
                local climb = toY - fromY

                local archBump = ((climb > 6) or (#ground > 2)) and math.min(10, totalH * 0.08) or 0

                local function archAt(h)
                    h = math.clamp(h, 0, totalH)
                    local seg = 1
                    while seg < #ground - 1 and cum[seg + 1] < h do seg = seg + 1 end
                    local segLen = cum[seg + 1] - cum[seg]
                    local t = (segLen > 0.001) and ((h - cum[seg]) / segLen) or 0
                    local gxz = ground[seg]:Lerp(ground[seg + 1], math.clamp(t, 0, 1))
                    local frac = (totalH > 0.001) and (h / totalH) or 1

                    local y = fromY + climb * frac + archBump * math.sin(math.pi * frac)
                    return Vector3.new(gxz.X, y, gxz.Z)
                end

                local pts = {}
                local STEP = math.max(2, burstDist * 0.2)
                local prev = Vector3.new(fromPos.X, fromY, fromPos.Z)
                local acc = 0
                local h = 0
                while h < totalH - 0.001 do
                    h = math.min(totalH, h + STEP)
                    local p = archAt(h)
                    acc = acc + (p - prev).Magnitude
                    local frac = (totalH > 0.001) and math.clamp(h / totalH, 0, 1) or 1
                    local stride = burstDist * (0.65 + 0.35 * math.sin(math.pi * frac))
                    if acc >= stride then pts[#pts + 1] = p; acc = 0 end
                    prev = p
                end

                if #pts > 0 and (pts[#pts] - toPos).Magnitude <= burstDist * 0.3 then
                    pts[#pts] = toPos
                elseif #pts == 0 or (pts[#pts] - toPos).Magnitude > 1 then
                    pts[#pts + 1] = toPos
                end
                return pts
            end

            _G.VXChainFly = function(hrp, route, endLabel, slowdownGoal, onSlowdownStart)
                if not hrp or not hrp.Parent or type(route) ~= "table" or #route == 0 then return end
                local hum = hrp.Parent and hrp.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                local burstDist = math.clamp(tonumber(Config.TpSettings.ChainMaxDist) or 50, 20, 60)
                local burstFreq = math.clamp(tonumber(Config.TpSettings.ChainBurstFreq) or 0.10, 0.05, 0.15)
                local finalPt = slowdownGoal or route[#route]

                local _healConn
                if hum then
                    local _maxHP = hum.MaxHealth
                    _healConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
                        if hum and hum.Parent then pcall(function() hum.Health = _maxHP end) end
                    end)
                end

                local wasAnchored = hrp.Anchored
                hrp.Anchored = false
                local glideVel = Vector3.zero
                local glideConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
                    if hrp and hrp.Parent then
                        hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = glideVel
                        hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
                    end
                end)

                local slowFired = false
                local function fireSlow()
                    if slowFired then return end
                    slowFired = true
                    if onSlowdownStart then task.spawn(onSlowdownStart) end
                end

                local pts = _G.VXChainBursts(hrp.Position, route, burstDist)
                local idx = 1
                local stall = 0
                local guardStart = os.clock()
                --  Burst teleports are the most rejectable thing this hub does:
                --  60 studs every 0.1s reads as ~600 studs/s to the server. When
                --  it pulls us back, shrink the burst and re-plan from where the
                --  server actually put us, instead of advancing through the rest
                --  of the route -- advancing was what left the route half walked
                --  and the teleport looking broken.
                local expected, lagbacks, guardBonus = nil, 0, 0
                local liveBurst = burstDist
                while idx <= #pts do
                    if os.clock() - guardStart > (25 + guardBonus) then break end
                    if not hrp or not hrp.Parent then break end
                    local pos = hrp.Position

                    if expected and (pos - expected).Magnitude > math.max(8, liveBurst * 0.5) then
                        lagbacks = lagbacks + 1
                        guardBonus = guardBonus + 1.5
                        liveBurst = math.max(12, liveBurst * 0.65)
                        expected = nil
                        stall = 0
                        pts = _G.VXChainBursts(pos, route, liveBurst)
                        idx = 1
                        glideVel = Vector3.zero
                        hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                        task.wait(burstFreq)
                        continue
                    end

                    local dest = pts[idx]

                    local skipR = (idx < #pts) and math.min(8, burstDist * 0.3) or 2
                    if (dest - pos).Magnitude < skipR then idx = idx + 1; stall = 0; continue end

                    if idx < #pts and (finalPt - dest).Magnitude > 35 then
                        local jx, jz = dest.X - pos.X, dest.Z - pos.Z
                        if (jx * jx + jz * jz) > 1 then
                            local perpJ = Vector3.new(-jz, 0, jx).Unit
                            dest = dest + perpJ * ((math.random() - 0.5) * burstDist * 0.12)
                            + Vector3.new(0, (math.random() - 0.5) * 2, 0)
                        end
                    end

                    local go, advance = nil, false
                    if cClear(pos, dest) then
                        go, advance = dest, true
                    else

                        local dirF = dest - pos
                        local perp = Vector3.new(-dirF.Z, 0, dirF.X)
                        perp = (perp.Magnitude > 0.1) and perp.Unit or Vector3.new(1, 0, 0)
                        local probes = {
                            dest + Vector3.new(0, math.min(12, burstDist * 0.4), 0),
                            dest + Vector3.new(0, math.min(22, burstDist * 0.7), 0),
                            dest + perp * 8,
                            dest - perp * 8,
                            dest + perp * 14 + Vector3.new(0, 8, 0),
                            dest - perp * 14 + Vector3.new(0, 8, 0),
                            dest + Vector3.new(0, -8, 0),
                        }
                        for _, pr in ipairs(probes) do
                            if cClear(pos, pr) then go, advance = pr, true; break end
                        end
                        if not go then

                            local dir = dirF.Unit
                            local safe = cClearDist(pos, dir, dirF.Magnitude)
                            if safe >= 6 then
                                go, advance = pos + dir * (safe - 1), false
                            else
                                go, advance = nil, true
                            end
                        end
                    end

                    if go then

                        local d = go - pos
                        if d.Magnitude > liveBurst then go = pos + d.Unit * liveBurst; advance = false end
                        if (finalPt - go).Magnitude <= 30 then fireSlow() end

                        local flatX, flatZ = go.X - pos.X, go.Z - pos.Z
                        if (flatX * flatX + flatZ * flatZ) > 0.25 then
                            hrp.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(go, go + Vector3.new(flatX, 0, flatZ).Unit)
                        else
                            local _, yaw = hrp.CFrame:ToEulerAnglesYXZ()
                            hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(go) * CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0)
                        end

                        local gd = advance and (pts[math.min(idx + 1, #pts)] - go) or Vector3.zero
                        if gd.Magnitude > 2 then

                            glideVel = gd.Unit * math.min(160, (burstDist / burstFreq) * 0.45)
                        else
                            glideVel = Vector3.zero
                        end
                        hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = glideVel
                        hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
                        if _G.VXStripNow then pcall(_G.VXStripNow) end

                        pcall(TPDot, go, Color3.fromRGB(224, 210, 255), 1.6)
                        expected = go
                        stall = 0
                    else
                        glideVel = Vector3.zero
                        stall = stall + 1
                    end

                    if advance then
                        idx = idx + 1
                    else
                        stall = stall + 1
                        if stall > 4 then idx = idx + 1; stall = 0 end
                    end

                    task.wait(burstFreq * (0.8 + math.random() * 0.4))
                end

                --  Closing pass. The burst loop can exit short of the goal --
                --  the 25s guard tripped, a probe skipped the last node, or
                --  the target drifted while we were in flight. Walk the last
                --  gap down with short clear-checked hops instead of just
                --  dropping the player wherever the loop happened to stop.
                if hrp and hrp.Parent then
                    for _ = 1, 8 do
                        local pos = hrp.Position
                        local gap = finalPt - pos
                        if gap.Magnitude <= 4 then break end
                        local step = math.min(gap.Magnitude, liveBurst * 0.6)
                        local go = pos + gap.Unit * step
                        if not cClear(pos, go) then
                            local lift = go + Vector3.new(0, 10, 0)
                            if cClear(pos, lift) then go = lift else break end
                        end
                        local _, yaw = hrp.CFrame:ToEulerAnglesYXZ()
                        hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(go) * CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0)
                        hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                        glideVel = Vector3.zero
                        pcall(TPDot, go, Color3.fromRGB(198, 150, 255), 1.4)
                        task.wait(burstFreq)
                    end
                end

                fireSlow()

                if lagbacks > 0 then
                    _G.VXLog("Teleport", string.format(
                        "chain: %d lagback%s - burst reduced to %d studs",
                        lagbacks, (lagbacks == 1) and "" or "s", math.floor(liveBurst + 0.5)))
                end

                if _healConn then _healConn:Disconnect(); _healConn = nil end
                if glideConn then glideConn:Disconnect(); glideConn = nil end
                if hrp and hrp.Parent then
                    hrp.Anchored = wasAnchored
                    hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                    hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
                end
            end
        end

        local function baseCoordForPlot(tbl, plot)
            for _, e in ipairs(tbl) do
                if e.plot == plot then return e.coord end
            end
            return nil
        end

        local function baseFacingForPlot(tbl, plot)
            for _, e in ipairs(tbl) do
                if e.plot == plot then return e.facing end
            end
            return nil
        end

        local function baseFaceX(tbl, plot)
            return (baseFacingForPlot(tbl, plot) == "EAST") and 1000 or -1000
        end

        local function getClosestBaseIdx(pos)
            local closest, dist = 1, math.huge
            for _, e in ipairs(BASES_LOW) do
                local c = e.coord
                local d = (Vector2.new(pos.X, pos.Z) - Vector2.new(c.X, c.Z)).Magnitude
                if d < dist then dist = d; closest = e.plot end
            end
            return closest
        end

        local GRAPPLE_FRONT_BASES_LOW = {
            [1] = Vector3.new(-476.52, -2, 220.94), [2] = Vector3.new(-476.52, -2, 113.77),
            [3] = Vector3.new(-476.52, -2, 6.18),   [4] = Vector3.new(-476.52, -2, -101.07),
            [5] = Vector3.new(-342.66, -2, 221.45), [6] = Vector3.new(-342.66, -2, 113.41),
            [7] = Vector3.new(-342.66, -2, 6.25),   [8] = Vector3.new(-342.66, -2, -99.73),
        }
        local GRAPPLE_FRONT_BASES_HIGH = {
            [1] = Vector3.new(-479.51, 18, 220.94), [2] = Vector3.new(-479.51, 18, 113.77),
            [3] = Vector3.new(-479.51, 18, 6.18),   [4] = Vector3.new(-479.51, 18, -101.07),
            [5] = Vector3.new(-339.48, 18, 221.45), [6] = Vector3.new(-339.48, 18, 113.41),
            [7] = Vector3.new(-339.48, 18, 6.25),   [8] = Vector3.new(-339.48, 18, -99.73),
        }
        local GRAPPLE_FRONT_Y_LOW = -3.048217
        local GRAPPLE_FRONT_Y_HIGH = 16.850713
        local GRAPPLE_FRONT_Z_CLAMP = 18
        local function buildGrappleFrontCandidate(plotIndex, isUpper, playerZ)
            local base = (isUpper and GRAPPLE_FRONT_BASES_HIGH[plotIndex]) or GRAPPLE_FRONT_BASES_LOW[plotIndex]
            if not base then return nil, nil end
            local frontY = isUpper and GRAPPLE_FRONT_Y_HIGH or GRAPPLE_FRONT_Y_LOW
            local frontZ = math.clamp(playerZ - base.Z, -GRAPPLE_FRONT_Z_CLAMP, GRAPPLE_FRONT_Z_CLAMP) + base.Z
            local coord = Vector3.new(base.X, frontY, frontZ)
            local faceDir = (plotIndex <= 4) and Vector3.new(-1, 0, 0) or Vector3.new(1, 0, 0)
            return coord, faceDir
        end

        local FRONT_Z_RANGE = 20
        local SIDE_X_RANGE = 20

        local function secondFloorRoutesHigh()
            return (Config.TpSettings and Config.TpSettings.SecondFloorRoute) == "High"
        end

        local function computeBaseApproach(hrp, petPos, petPlot)
            local isThirdFloor = petPos.Y > 25

            local isSecondFloorTarget = (not isThirdFloor) and petPos.Y > 10
            local routeUpper = isThirdFloor or (isSecondFloorTarget and secondFloorRoutesHigh())
            local plotIndex = petPlot or getClosestBaseIdx(petPos)
            local baseTable = routeUpper and BASES_HIGH or BASES_LOW
            local basePos = baseCoordForPlot(baseTable, plotIndex)
            if not basePos then return nil end

            local frontTargetPos, frontFaceDir = buildGrappleFrontCandidate(plotIndex, routeUpper, hrp.Position.Z)
            if not frontTargetPos then
                local clampedDelta = math.clamp(hrp.Position.Z - basePos.Z, -FRONT_Z_RANGE, FRONT_Z_RANGE)
                frontTargetPos = Vector3.new(basePos.X, basePos.Y, basePos.Z + clampedDelta)
            end

            local sidePlatformTable = routeUpper and SIDE_TP_HIGH or SIDE_TP_LOW
            local closestSide, closestSideDist = nil, math.huge
            for _, data in ipairs(sidePlatformTable) do
                if data.plot == plotIndex then
                    local c = data.coord
                    local d = math.sqrt((hrp.Position.X - c.X)^2 + (hrp.Position.Z - c.Z)^2)
                    if d < closestSideDist then closestSideDist = d; closestSide = data end
                end
            end
            local sidePos = nil
            local sideFacing = closestSide and closestSide.facing or nil
            if closestSide then
                local c = closestSide.coord
                local sideClampedDelta = math.clamp(hrp.Position.X - c.X, -SIDE_X_RANGE, SIDE_X_RANGE)
                sidePos = Vector3.new(c.X + sideClampedDelta, c.Y, c.Z)
            end

            local function _flatDist(a, b) return math.sqrt((a.X - b.X)^2 + (a.Z - b.Z)^2) end
            local distToFront = _flatDist(hrp.Position, frontTargetPos)
            local distToSide = sidePos and _flatDist(hrp.Position, sidePos) or math.huge

            local _am = (Config.TpSettings and Config.TpSettings.ApproachMode) or "Both"
            local useFrontApproach
            if _am == "Front" then
                useFrontApproach = true
            elseif _am == "Side" then
                useFrontApproach = (sidePos == nil)
            else
                useFrontApproach = (distToFront <= distToSide)
            end
            local targetBasePos = useFrontApproach and frontTargetPos or sidePos

            local faceDirection
            if useFrontApproach then
                local faceX = (baseFacingForPlot(baseTable, plotIndex) == "EAST") and 1000 or -1000
                faceDirection = Vector3.new(faceX, targetBasePos.Y, targetBasePos.Z)
            else
                local skyZ = (sideFacing == "NORTH") and -1000 or 1000
                faceDirection = Vector3.new(targetBasePos.X, targetBasePos.Y, targetBasePos.Z + skyZ)
            end

            local flightBasePos = targetBasePos
            if targetBasePos.Y > 0 then
                flightBasePos = Vector3.new(targetBasePos.X, targetBasePos.Y + 3.1, targetBasePos.Z)
            end

            return {
                plotIndex = plotIndex,
                isThirdFloor = isThirdFloor,
                routeUpper = routeUpper,
                targetBasePos = targetBasePos,
                flightBasePos = flightBasePos,
                faceDirection = faceDirection,
                useFrontApproach = useFrontApproach,
                sideFacing = sideFacing,
                frontFaceDir = frontFaceDir,
            }
        end

        do
            local _cachedAnimator, _cachedTrack, _cachedPeak = nil, nil, 0.35
            local function _findJumpAnim(char)
                local animScript = char and char:FindFirstChild("Animate")
                local jumpObj = animScript and animScript:FindFirstChild("jump")
                local anim = jumpObj and jumpObj:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Animation")
                if not anim then
                    anim = Instance.new("Animation")
                    anim.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://507765000"
                end
                return anim
            end
            local function _warm(char)
                pcall(function()
                    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") or char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
                    if not hum then return end
                    local animator = hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator") or hum:WaitForChild("Animator", 5)
                    if not animator then return end
                    local track = animator:LoadAnimation(_findJumpAnim(char))
                    track.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action
                    _cachedAnimator, _cachedTrack, _cachedPeak = animator, track, 0.35
                    local t0 = os.clock()
                    while track.Length <= 0.05 and os.clock() - t0 < 5 do task.wait(0.1) end
                    if track.Length > 0.05 and _cachedTrack == track then
                        _cachedPeak = math.min(track.Length * 0.4, 0.35)
                    end
                end)
            end
            task.spawn(function()
                if LP.Character then _warm(LP.Character) end
                LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(c) task.spawn(_warm, c) end)
            end)

            _stopAnchorPose = function()
                pcall(function()
                    local t = _G.VXAnchorPoseTrack
                    if t then t:Stop(0.1) end
                end)
                _G.VXAnchorPoseTrack = nil
            end
            _startAnchorPose = function(hum)
                _stopAnchorPose()
                pcall(function()
                    if not (hum and hum.Parent) then return end
                    local animator = hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
                    if not animator then return end
                    local track
                    if _cachedAnimator == animator and _cachedTrack then
                        track = _cachedTrack
                    else
                        track = animator:LoadAnimation(_findJumpAnim(hum.Parent))
                        track.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action
                        _cachedAnimator, _cachedTrack = animator, track
                    end
                    track:Play(0, 1, 0)
                    track.TimePosition = _cachedPeak
                    track:AdjustSpeed(0)
                    _G.VXAnchorPoseTrack = track
                end)
            end

            _G.VXStartAnchorPose = _startAnchorPose
            _G.VXStopAnchorPose  = _stopAnchorPose
        end

        _G.VXTpGen = _G.VXTpGen or 0
        local ARRIVE = 3

        local function vZero(hrp)
            if hrp then hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero; hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero end
        end

        local function zeroAllVelocity(char)
            if not char then return end
            for _, p in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
                if p:IsA("BasePart") then
                    p.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                    p.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
                    pcall(function() p.RotVelocity = Vector3.zero end)
                end
            end
            local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if hrp then
                for _, c in ipairs(hrp:GetChildren()) do
                    if c:IsA("LinearVelocity") or c:IsA("BodyVelocity") or c:IsA("BodyGyro")
                    or c:IsA("BodyPosition") or c:IsA("AngularVelocity") or c:IsA("AlignOrientation")
                    or c:IsA("AlignPosition") or c:IsA("BodyAngularVelocity") then
                        pcall(function() c:Destroy() end)
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        --  Corner smoothing: blend the steering direction toward the next
        --  waypoint as we approach the current one, so the route flows through
        --  turns instead of stopping dead at every node.
        local SMOOTH_RADIUS = 14

        --  The server re-simulates our movement and snaps us back when a single
        --  step is too large to be plausible. Speed alone was never clamped
        --  per-frame, so an FPS dip did the damage: at 500 studs/s a 0.25s
        --  frame asks for 125 studs in one step, which is an instant rejection.
        --  Cap the displacement per frame regardless of the configured speed.
        local MAX_STEP = 16
        --  How far backwards along our own travel direction counts as a
        --  rubberband rather than ordinary jitter.
        local LAGBACK_STUDS = 6

        local function velMoveThrough(hrp, waypoints, speedOverride, brakeAtEnd, _retried)
            if not hrp or not hrp.Parent or #waypoints == 0 then return end

            local _vmGen = _G.VXTpGen
            local _tries = tonumber(_retried) or 0
            vizPath(hrp.Position, waypoints)

            local wpIdx = 1
            local done = false
            local conn
            local function finish()
                if done then return end
                done = true
                if hrp and hrp.Parent and _G.VXTpGen == _vmGen then
                    hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                    hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero

                    if (hrp.Position - waypoints[#waypoints]).Magnitude <= 8 then
                        local _, y = hrp.CFrame:ToEulerAnglesYXZ()
                        hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(waypoints[#waypoints]) * CFrame.Angles(0, y, 0)
                    end
                end
                if conn then conn:Disconnect() end

            end

            local lastDist, stall = math.huge, 0
            local unstuckTried = 0
            --  speedScale backs off each time the server pulls us back, so a
            --  route that keeps getting rejected settles at a speed that sticks
            --  instead of fighting the server the whole way there.
            local speedScale, lagbacks, lagPenalty = 1, 0, 0
            local lastPos, lastDir = hrp.Position, nil
            conn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
                if not hrp or not hrp.Parent or done or _G.VXTpGen ~= _vmGen then
                    if conn then conn:Disconnect() end; done = true; return
                end
                equipCarpet()

                --  Lagback check, before anything reads our position: if we
                --  moved against the direction we were pushing, the server
                --  rejected the step rather than us drifting.
                local nowPos = hrp.Position
                if lastDir then
                    local moved = nowPos - lastPos
                    if moved:Dot(lastDir) < -LAGBACK_STUDS then
                        lagbacks = lagbacks + 1
                        lagPenalty = lagPenalty + 0.6
                        speedScale = math.max(0.35, speedScale * 0.6)
                        --  A snapback grows the distance to the waypoint, which
                        --  the stall counter would read as being stuck and then
                        --  abort the whole teleport. Reset it: we are not
                        --  stuck, we were pushed back and need to re-run it.
                        stall = 0
                        lastDist = math.huge
                        unstuckTried = 0
                    end
                end
                lastPos = nowPos

                local target = waypoints[wpIdx]
                local diff = target - nowPos
                local mag = diff.Magnitude
                --  Last node uses 0.6 instead of 0.1: the velocity cap below
                --  scales speed down to mag/dt near the target, so a 0.1 radius
                --  burned several frames crawling the final inch. finish()
                --  snaps the CFrame anyway, so the tighter radius bought
                --  nothing but a visible stall on arrival.
                local _arriveThreshold = (wpIdx == #waypoints) and 0.6 or ARRIVE
                if mag < _arriveThreshold then
                    wpIdx = wpIdx + 1
                    if wpIdx > #waypoints then finish(); return end
                    lastDist, stall = math.huge, 0
                    target = waypoints[wpIdx]
                    diff = target - hrp.Position
                    mag = diff.Magnitude
                end
                if mag > lastDist - 0.05 then stall = stall + 1 else stall = 0 end
                lastDist = mag
                if stall >= 18 then
                    if unstuckTried == 0 then

                        unstuckTried = 1
                        stall = 0; lastDist = math.huge
                        pcall(function()
                            hrp.Anchored = false
                            local h2 = hrp.Parent and hrp.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                            if h2 then h2.Sit = false; h2.PlatformStand = false end
                            for _, c in ipairs(hrp:GetChildren()) do
                                if c:IsA("LinearVelocity") or c:IsA("BodyVelocity") or c:IsA("BodyGyro")
                                or c:IsA("BodyPosition") or c:IsA("AngularVelocity") or c:IsA("AlignOrientation")
                                or c:IsA("AlignPosition") or c:IsA("BodyAngularVelocity") then
                                    c:Destroy()
                                end
                            end
                        end)
                    elseif unstuckTried == 1 then
                        --  Still pinned after clearing movers: most snags are a
                        --  lip or a doorframe, so hop over it before giving up.
                        unstuckTried = 2
                        stall = 0; lastDist = math.huge
                        pcall(function()
                            hrp.CFrame = hrp.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 6, 0)
                            hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 12, 0)
                        end)
                    else
                        finish(); return
                    end
                end
                if mag >= 0.1 then
                    local dir = diff.Unit

                    --  Ease into the next leg while still closing on this node.
                    local nxt = waypoints[wpIdx + 1]
                    if nxt and mag < SMOOTH_RADIUS then
                        local d2 = nxt - hrp.Position
                        if d2.Magnitude > 0.05 then
                            local blend = 1 - (mag / SMOOTH_RADIUS)
                            local mixed = dir:Lerp(d2.Unit, blend * 0.65)
                            if mixed.Magnitude > 0.05 then dir = mixed.Unit end
                        end
                    end

                    local speed = (speedOverride or getTpSpeed()) * speedScale

                    local frameDt = (dt and dt > 0) and dt or (1/60)
                    local maxSpeed = mag / frameDt
                    if speed > maxSpeed then speed = maxSpeed end
                    --  Never ask for more than MAX_STEP studs in one frame,
                    --  however long the frame turned out to be.
                    local stepCap = MAX_STEP / frameDt
                    if speed > stepCap then speed = stepCap end

                    lastDir = dir
                    hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(dir.X * speed, dir.Y * speed, dir.Z * speed)
                end
            end)
            local totalDist = 0
            local prev = hrp.Position
            for _, wp in ipairs(waypoints) do totalDist = totalDist + (prev - wp).Magnitude; prev = wp end
            local _spd = speedOverride or getTpSpeed()

            --  Baseline budget assumes the configured speed. MAX_STEP can cap
            --  us below that on a slow frame, and every lagback costs time on
            --  top, so the budget has to account for both or a route that was
            --  merely slowed gets abandoned as failed.
            local timeout = (totalDist / math.min(_spd, MAX_STEP * 60)) * 1.8 + 2
            --  Poll on Heartbeat against a real clock: the old task.wait(0.05)
            --  left up to 50ms of dead time after arrival, and the accumulator
            --  drifted away from wall time whenever FPS dropped.
            local _t0 = os.clock()
            while not done and (os.clock() - _t0) < (timeout + lagPenalty) do
                RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
                if _G.VXTpGen ~= _vmGen then break end
            end
            if lagbacks > 0 then
                _G.VXLog("Teleport", string.format(
                    "%d lagback%s on this leg - speed scaled to %d%%",
                    lagbacks, (lagbacks == 1) and "" or "s", math.floor(speedScale * 100 + 0.5)))
            end
            finish()
            vZero(hrp)

            --  Up to two corrective passes (was one) and a tighter accept
            --  radius, so a leg that ends short actually gets closed out.
            local _maxTries = (lagbacks > 0) and 4 or 2
            if _tries < _maxTries and _G.VXTpGen == _vmGen and hrp and hrp.Parent then
                local finalWp = waypoints[#waypoints]
                if (hrp.Position - finalWp).Magnitude > 4 then
                    local remaining = {}
                    for i = math.min(wpIdx, #waypoints), #waypoints do remaining[#remaining + 1] = waypoints[i] end
                    return velMoveThrough(hrp, remaining, speedOverride, brakeAtEnd, _tries + 1)
                end
            end
        end

        local _STRUCT = { ["structure base home"] = true, ["Wall"] = true, ["Floor"] = true, ["Roof"] = true }
        local _SKIP_NAME = { ["DeliveryHitbox"]=true, ["StealHitbox"]=true, ["LaserHitbox"]=true,
            ["AnimalTarget"]=true, ["Multiplier"]=true, ["Laser"]=true, ["Hitbox"]=true,
        ["Spawn"]=true, ["MainRoot"]=true, ["SecondFloor"]=true, ["ThirdFloor"]=true, ["Slope"]=true }
        local function _blocks(inst)
            if not inst then return false end
            if _SKIP_NAME[inst.Name] then return false end
            if inst.CanCollide then return true end
            if _STRUCT[inst.Name] then return true end
            local s = inst.Size
            if s and math.max(s.X * s.Y, s.X * s.Z, s.Y * s.Z) > 150 then return true end
            return false
        end
        local function _block(origin, target)
            local rp = RaycastParams.new()
            rp.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
            rp.IgnoreWater = true
            local skip = {}
            for _, pl in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if pl.Character then skip[#skip + 1] = pl.Character end
            end
            local o = origin
            for _ = 1, 16 do
                rp.FilterDescendantsInstances = skip
                local d = target - o
                if d.Magnitude < 0.05 then return nil end
                local res = workspace:Raycast(o, d, rp)
                if not res then return nil end
                if _blocks(res.Instance) then return res end
                skip[#skip + 1] = res.Instance
                o = res.Position + d.Unit * 0.3
            end
            return nil
        end
        local function _clear(a, b) return _block(a, b) == nil end
        local function _routeClear(pts)
            for i = 1, #pts - 1 do
                if not _clear(pts[i], pts[i + 1]) then return false end
            end
            return true
        end
        local _CLEARANCE = 8
        local _V_CLEAR = Vector3.new(0, 4, 0)
        local function _clearWide(a, b)
            if not _clear(a, b) then return false end
            if not _clear(a + _V_CLEAR, b + _V_CLEAR) then return false end
            local d = Vector3.new(b.X - a.X, 0, b.Z - a.Z)
            if d.Magnitude < 0.1 then return true end
            local p = Vector3.new(-d.Z, 0, d.X).Unit * _CLEARANCE
            return _clear(a + p, b + p) and _clear(a - p, b - p)
        end
        local function _pullWide(pts)
            if #pts <= 2 then return pts end
            local out = { pts[1] }
            local i = 1
            while i < #pts do
                local j = #pts
                while j > i + 1 and not _clearWide(out[#out], pts[j]) do j = j - 1 end
                out[#out + 1] = pts[j]
                i = j
            end
            return out
        end
        local _LIFT_HEIGHTS = { 6, 12, 20, 30 }
        local function _simpleLiftRoute(fromPos, toPos)
            for _, lift in ipairs(_LIFT_HEIGHTS) do
                local mid = (fromPos + toPos) / 2 + Vector3.new(0, lift, 0)
                local pts = { fromPos, mid, toPos }
                if _routeClear(pts) and _clearWide(fromPos, mid) and _clearWide(mid, toPos) then
                    return pts
                end
            end
            for _, lift in ipairs(_LIFT_HEIGHTS) do
                local flat = Vector3.new(toPos.X - fromPos.X, 0, toPos.Z - fromPos.Z)
                local slantDir = (flat.Magnitude > 0.5) and flat.Unit or Vector3.new(1, 0, 0)
                local slantLen = math.max(math.min(lift * 0.75, flat.Magnitude * 0.5), 6)
                local up   = fromPos + slantDir * slantLen + Vector3.new(0, lift, 0)
                local over = Vector3.new(toPos.X, up.Y, toPos.Z)
                local pts  = { fromPos, up, over, toPos }
                if _routeClear(pts) and _clearWide(fromPos, up) and _clearWide(up, over) and _clearWide(over, toPos) then
                    return pts
                end
            end
            return nil
        end
        local function _deVertical(fromPos, route)
            local out = {}
            local prev = fromPos
            for _, wp in ipairs(route) do
                local d = wp - prev
                local m = d.Magnitude
                if m > 10 and d.Y > 0 and (d.Y / m) > 0.85 then
                    local flat = Vector3.new(d.X, 0, d.Z)
                    local side = (flat.Magnitude > 0.5) and flat.Unit or Vector3.new(1, 0, 0)
                    local mid = prev + side * math.max(m * 0.35, 6) + Vector3.new(0, d.Y * 0.5, 0)
                    if _clear(prev, mid) and _clear(mid, wp) then
                        out[#out + 1] = mid
                    end
                end
                out[#out + 1] = wp
                prev = wp
            end
            return out
        end
        local PathfindingService = game:GetService("PathfindingService")
        local function computeRoute(fromPos, toPos, facingDir)
            if _clear(fromPos, toPos) then return _deVertical(fromPos, { toPos }) end

            local isFloor1Route = fromPos.Y <= 12 and toPos.Y <= 12

            if not isFloor1Route then
                local simple = _simpleLiftRoute(fromPos, toPos)
                if simple then return simple end
            end

            local entry = facingDir and (toPos - facingDir * 14) or toPos
            local groundTo = Vector3.new(entry.X, fromPos.Y, entry.Z)
            local path = PathfindingService:CreatePath({
                AgentRadius = 8, AgentHeight = 5, AgentCanJump = true, AgentJumpHeight = 10, AgentMaxSlope = 89,
            })

            local FLOAT = isFloor1Route and 0 or 3
            local nav = { fromPos }
            local ok = pcall(function()
                path:ComputeAsync(Vector3.new(fromPos.X, fromPos.Y, fromPos.Z), groundTo)
            end)
            if ok and path.Status == Enum.PathStatus.Success then
                local last = fromPos
                for _, wp in ipairs(path:GetWaypoints()) do
                    if (wp.Position - last).Magnitude >= 8 then

                        local wpY = isFloor1Route and fromPos.Y or (wp.Position.Y + FLOAT)
                        nav[#nav + 1] = Vector3.new(wp.Position.X, wpY, wp.Position.Z)
                        last = wp.Position
                    end
                end
            end
            local entryY = isFloor1Route and fromPos.Y or (entry.Y + FLOAT)
            nav[#nav + 1] = Vector3.new(entry.X, entryY, entry.Z)
            local route = _pullWide(nav)
            route[#route + 1] = toPos

            if #route >= 3 and math.abs(toPos.Y - fromPos.Y) >= 6 then
                local startY, endY = fromPos.Y, toPos.Y
                local total, cum = 0, { [1] = 0 }
                local prev = route[1]
                for i = 2, #route do
                    total = total + Vector3.new(route[i].X - prev.X, 0, route[i].Z - prev.Z).Magnitude
                    cum[i] = total
                    prev = route[i]
                end
                if total >= 1 then
                    for i = 2, #route - 1 do
                        local t = cum[i] / total
                        route[i] = Vector3.new(route[i].X, startY + (endY - startY) * t, route[i].Z)
                    end
                end
            end
            return _deVertical(fromPos, route)
        end

        -- ============================================================
        --  CLONE  --  metodo manual do sabcom, igual ponta a ponta
        --
        --  Tres desvios do sabcom estavam aqui, e cada um sozinho ja
        --  fazia o clone falhar em silencio:
        --
        --   1. FALTAVA hum:UnequipTools() ANTES do equip. No fluxo de TP
        --      quase sempre tem tapete ou grapple na mao, e o
        --      ToolsFrames.QuantumCloner so e montado quando o cloner
        --      entra como ferramenta ativa. Trocando por cima, o frame
        --      nao existia ainda -- o `if not tb then return false end`
        --      logo abaixo saia fora sem dizer nada.
        --
        --   2. OS TRES firesignal NUM pcall SO. Se o primeiro
        --      (MouseButton1Click) estourasse -- executor que nao suporta
        --      firesignal naquele signal, ou signal sem conexao -- os
        --      outros dois nunca rodavam. O sabcom poe cada um no SEU
        --      pcall justamente pra que um nao derrube os outros.
        --
        --   3. `return ok` devolvia o pcall dos firesignal. Com o item 2,
        --      um firesignal ruim marcava o clone inteiro como falho, e
        --      em runGuardedTP o `if _cloneOk then goToBrainrot(pet) end`
        --      abortava a ida ate o brainrot. Agora o retorno diz se o
        --      clone foi ACIONADO, que e o que o chamador quer saber.
        -- ============================================================
        -- Clique de botao igual ao resto do hub (o fireClick do Admin Panel):
        -- QUATRO signals, cada um no SEU pcall, e VirtualInputManager de
        -- reserva pra executor sem firesignal. O clone so mandava tres, todos
        -- num pcall unico e sem reserva nenhuma.
        local function _clickGuiButton(btn)
            if not btn then return false end
            if firesignal then
                pcall(firesignal, btn.MouseButton1Down)
                pcall(firesignal, btn.MouseButton1Up)
                pcall(firesignal, btn.Activated)
                pcall(firesignal, btn.MouseButton1Click)
                return true
            end
            return (pcall(function()
                local x = btn.AbsolutePosition.X + (btn.AbsoluteSize.X / 2)
                local y = btn.AbsolutePosition.Y + (btn.AbsoluteSize.Y / 2) + 58
                VirtualInputManager:SendMouseButtonEvent(x, y, 0, true, game, 0)
                task.wait()
                VirtualInputManager:SendMouseButtonEvent(x, y, 0, false, game, 0)
            end))
        end

        -- O frame do cloner so e montado depois que a tool vira a ATIVA, e
        -- isso leva alguns frames -- olhar uma vez so e desistir era metade da
        -- falha. Tenta o caminho conhecido e, se nao achar, varre os
        -- descendentes: o jogo ja remexeu nessa arvore antes.
        local function _findCloneButton(playerGui, deadline)
            if not playerGui then return nil end
            repeat
                local tf = playerGui:FindFirstChild("ToolsFrames")
                local qc = tf and tf:FindFirstChild("QuantumCloner")
                local tb = qc and qc:FindFirstChild("TeleportToClone")
                if tb then return tb end
                local scope = qc or tf or playerGui
                local deep = scope:FindFirstChild("TeleportToClone", true)
                if deep then return deep end
                RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
            until os.clock() > deadline
            return nil
        end

        local function doClone()
            _G.VXLog("Clone", "doClone: start")
            local char = LP.Character or LP.CharacterAdded:Wait()
            local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if not char or not hum then
                _G.VXLog("Clone", "no Character/Humanoid")
                return false
            end
            local cloner = (LP:FindFirstChild("Backpack") and LP.Backpack:FindFirstChild("Quantum Cloner"))
            or char:FindFirstChild("Quantum Cloner")
            if not cloner then
                _G.VXLog("Clone", "no Quantum Cloner in Backpack or Character")
                return false
            end

            pcall(function() hum:UnequipTools() end); task.wait()
            if cloner.Parent ~= char then
                pcall(function() hum:EquipTool(cloner) end)
                -- espera o equip MATERIALIZAR. task.wait() unico nao bastava:
                -- a tool so aparece no Character no frame seguinte, e as vezes
                -- mais tarde se o jogo re-equipa outra coisa por cima.
                local t0 = os.clock()
                repeat
                    RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
                until (LP.Character and LP.Character:FindFirstChild("Quantum Cloner"))
                or (os.clock() - t0) > 0.5
            end
            if not (LP.Character and LP.Character:FindFirstChild("Quantum Cloner")) then
                _G.VXLog("Clone", "Quantum Cloner failed to equip")
                return false
            end

            local tb = _findCloneButton(LP:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui"), os.clock() + 1)
            if not tb then
                _G.VXLog("Clone", "TeleportToClone button not found under PlayerGui")
                return false
            end

            _G.isCloning = true
            pcall(function() cloner:Activate() end)
            task.wait(0.05)
            pcall(function() tb.Visible = true end)
            _clickGuiButton(tb)
            task.delay(0.55, function() _G.isCloning = false end)
            return true
        end
        -- exposto pelo mesmo motivo que o sabcom expoe o dele: o motor
        -- automatico de Clone-TP reusa EXATAMENTE o metodo manual, em vez
        -- de manter uma segunda copia que diverge com o tempo
        _G.VXInstantClone = doClone

        local function _plotInBaseBox(plot, pos)
            if not plot then return false end
            local podiums = plot:FindFirstChild("AnimalPodiums")
            if not podiums then return false end
            local minX, maxX, minZ, maxZ = math.huge, -math.huge, math.huge, -math.huge
            local cnt = 0
            for _, p in ipairs(podiums:GetChildren()) do
                local base = p:FindFirstChild("Base")
                local spawn = base and base:FindFirstChild("Spawn")
                local checkPos = (spawn and spawn.Position) or (base and base.Position)
                if checkPos then
                    cnt = cnt + 1
                    minX = math.min(minX, checkPos.X); maxX = math.max(maxX, checkPos.X)
                    minZ = math.min(minZ, checkPos.Z); maxZ = math.max(maxZ, checkPos.Z)
                end
            end
            if cnt == 0 then return false end
            local centerX = (minX + maxX) / 2
            local centerZ = (minZ + maxZ) / 2
            local sizeX = (maxX - minX) + 13
            local sizeZ = (maxZ - minZ) + 8
            local maxY = (cnt <= 10 and 10) or (cnt <= 18 and 25) or 40
            return pos.Y <= maxY and pos.Y >= -10
            and math.abs(pos.X - centerX) <= sizeX / 2
            and math.abs(pos.Z - centerZ) <= sizeZ / 2
        end

        local tempPlatform = nil

        local function createTempPlatform()
            if tempPlatform then
                pcall(function() tempPlatform:Destroy() end)
                tempPlatform = nil
            end
            local char = LP.Character
            local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not hrp then return false end

            local footY = hrp.Position.Y - 3
            tempPlatform = Instance.new("Part")
            tempPlatform.Name = "VX_TempPlatform"
            tempPlatform.Size = Vector3.new(8, 0.2, 8)
            tempPlatform.Position = Vector3.new(hrp.Position.X, footY - 0.75, hrp.Position.Z)
            tempPlatform.Anchored = false
            tempPlatform.CanCollide = true
            tempPlatform.Transparency = 1
            tempPlatform.CanTouch = false
            tempPlatform.Parent = workspace

            local bodyPosition = Instance.new("BodyPosition")
            bodyPosition.Position = tempPlatform.Position
            bodyPosition.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, 0, math.huge)
            bodyPosition.Parent = tempPlatform

            local bodyVelocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
            bodyVelocity.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
            bodyVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(0, math.huge, 0)
            bodyVelocity.Parent = tempPlatform

            hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
            hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)

            local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if hum then
                hum.AutoRotate = true
                hum.JumpPower = 0
            end
            return true
        end

        local function destroyTempPlatform()
            if tempPlatform and tempPlatform.Parent then
                pcall(function() tempPlatform:Destroy() end)
                tempPlatform = nil
            end
            local char = LP.Character
            if char then
                local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if hum then
                    hum.AutoRotate = true
                    hum.JumpPower = 50
                end
            end
        end

        local function goToBrainrot(pet)
            if not pet then return end
            local exactPos = pet.position or pet.coord
            local char, hrp, hum
            local _t0 = os.clock()
            repeat
                char = LP.Character
                hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if hrp and hum then break end
                RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
            until os.clock() - _t0 > 3
            if not hrp or not hum then return end
            pcall(function() hrp.Anchored = false end)

            local plotIndex = getClosestBaseIdx(exactPos)
            local plotNameStr = (type(pet.plot) == "string") and pet.plot or nil

            hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero

            local _entryStart = os.clock()
            local _entrySafetyCap = 8
            local _entered = false
            local plotsFolder = workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")
            local targetPlot = plotsFolder and plotNameStr and plotsFolder:FindFirstChild(plotNameStr) or nil
            repeat
                char = LP.Character
                hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if not hrp then return end
                local p = hrp.Position
                local inBase = false
                if targetPlot then
                    inBase = _plotInBaseBox(targetPlot, p)
                elseif plotsFolder then
                    for _, plot in ipairs(plotsFolder:GetChildren()) do
                        if _plotInBaseBox(plot, p) then inBase = true; break end
                    end
                end
                if inBase then _entered = true; break end
                RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
            until os.clock() - _entryStart > _entrySafetyCap

            if not _entered then return end

            char = LP.Character
            hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if not hrp or not hum then return end

            if hrp and hrp.Parent then
                hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
            end

            local isSecondFloor = exactPos.Y > 10

            local _sfHigh = isSecondFloor and exactPos.Y <= 25 and secondFloorRoutesHigh()
            local basePosFace = BASES_FACE[plotIndex]
            local faceSign = (baseFacingForPlot(BASES_LOW, plotIndex) == "EAST") and 1 or -1

            local targetPart = pet._part
            if not targetPart and pet.animalData then
                if targetPlot then
                    local podiums = targetPlot:FindFirstChild("AnimalPodiums")
                    if podiums then
                        local podium = podiums:FindFirstChild(tostring(pet.slot))
                        if podium then
                            local base = podium:FindFirstChild("Base")
                            if base then
                                targetPart = base:FindFirstChild("Spawn") or base:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart") or base
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end

            local finalPos
            local finalFaceDir
            if targetPart then

                local offsetPosition = targetPart.Position + (targetPart.CFrame.LookVector * 3.5) + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)
                finalPos = offsetPosition
                if isSecondFloor and not _sfHigh then
                    finalPos = Vector3.new(offsetPosition.X, exactPos.Y - 6.75, offsetPosition.Z)
                end

                if basePosFace then
                    finalFaceDir = Vector3.new(basePosFace.X, finalPos.Y, basePosFace.Z)
                else
                    finalFaceDir = Vector3.new(exactPos.X + faceSign * 500, finalPos.Y, exactPos.Z)
                end
            else

                local lookOffset = Vector3.new(faceSign * 3.5, 0, 0)
                local nonOffsetPos = exactPos + lookOffset + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)
                finalPos = nonOffsetPos
                if isSecondFloor and not _sfHigh then
                    finalPos = Vector3.new(nonOffsetPos.X, exactPos.Y - 6.75, nonOffsetPos.Z)
                end

                if basePosFace then
                    finalFaceDir = Vector3.new(basePosFace.X, finalPos.Y, basePosFace.Z)
                else
                    finalFaceDir = Vector3.new(exactPos.X + faceSign * 500, finalPos.Y, exactPos.Z)
                end
            end

            pcall(TPPath, hrp.Position, { finalPos }, "BRAINROT", "post")
            hrp.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(finalPos, finalFaceDir)
            hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
            hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
            if _G.VXStealSuppress then pcall(_G.VXStealSuppress, false) end
            if _G.VXStealOnArrival then pcall(_G.VXStealOnArrival) end

            if isSecondFloor and not _sfHigh then
                createTempPlatform()
                local moved = false
                local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
                UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
                    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                        moved = true
                        destroyTempPlatform()
                    end
                end)
                task.delay(10, function()
                    if not moved then
                        destroyTempPlatform()
                    end
                end)
            end

            if isSecondFloor and not _sfHigh then
                createTempPlatform()
                local moved = false
                local conn = UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
                    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                        moved = true
                        destroyTempPlatform()
                    end
                end)
                local timeout = 0
                local stealWaitStart = os.clock()
                while not LP:GetAttribute("Stealing") and not moved and timeout < 80 do
                    if hrp.Position.Y > exactPos.Y + 5 then
                        destroyTempPlatform()
                        hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(finalPos, finalFaceDir)
                        break
                    end
                    if (os.clock() - stealWaitStart) > 4
                    and (hrp.Position - exactPos).Magnitude > 12 then
                        break
                    end
                    timeout = timeout + 1
                    task.wait(0.05)
                end
                destroyTempPlatform()
                if conn then conn:Disconnect() end
            end
        end

        local function _adminGetControls()
            local controls
            pcall(function()
                local playerScripts = LP:WaitForChild("PlayerScripts")
                local playerModule = require(playerScripts:WaitForChild("PlayerModule"))
                controls = playerModule:GetControls()
            end)
            return controls
        end

        local function teleportToPlayerBase(targetPlayer)
            if not targetPlayer then return false end

            local plot = nil
            local Plots = workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")
            if Plots then
                local dName = targetPlayer.DisplayName:lower()
                local pName = targetPlayer.Name:lower()

                for _, p in ipairs(Plots:GetChildren()) do
                    local sign = p:FindFirstChild("PlotSign")
                    if sign then
                        local surfaceGui = sign:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SurfaceGui", true)
                        local label = surfaceGui and surfaceGui:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextLabel", true)
                        if label then
                            local text = label.Text:lower()
                            if text:find(dName, 1, true) or text:find(pName, 1, true) then
                                plot = p
                                break
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end

            if not plot then
                return false
            end

            local char = LP.Character
            local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local hum = char and char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
            if not hrp or not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return false end
            if State.isTpMoving then return false end

            local plotIndex = tonumber(plot.Name) or getClosestBaseIdx(plot:GetPivot().Position)
            local basePos = baseCoordForPlot(BASES_LOW, plotIndex)
            if not basePos then return false end

            State.isTpMoving = true
            local Controls = _adminGetControls()
            if Controls then pcall(function() Controls:Disable() end) end

            local ok = pcall(function()
                clearTP()
                if _G.VXCreateSkyPlatform then _G.VXCreateSkyPlatform(basePos) end

                local gt = char:FindFirstChild("Grapple Hook") or LP.Backpack:FindFirstChild("Grapple Hook")
                if gt and gt:IsA("Tool") and hum then
                    if gt.Parent ~= char then hum:EquipTool(gt); task.wait(); gt = char:FindFirstChild("Grapple Hook") end
                end
                if gt and gt.Parent == char then
                    -- na direcao da BASE, nao pra onde o personagem estiver
                    -- virado: o VXFireGrapple2 achata isso no plano XZ e
                    -- procura o chao mais proximo que o item aceite (10-50
                    -- studs) nessa direcao.
                    if _G.VXFireGrapple2 then pcall(_G.VXFireGrapple2, basePos) end
                    task.wait(0.1)
                end
                -- a trava dura 0.45s e este caminho segue pro tapete/TP em
                -- 0.1s: solta antes de mover, senao ela prende o personagem
                if _G.VXGrappleReleaseLock then pcall(_G.VXGrappleReleaseLock) end
                pcall(function() hum:UnequipTools() end)
                task.wait()

                local carpetName = Config.TpSettings.Tool
                local carpet = LP.Backpack:FindFirstChild(carpetName) or char:FindFirstChild(carpetName)
                if carpet then
                    hum:EquipTool(carpet)
                    task.wait()
                end

                local waypoints
                if not waypoints then
                    waypoints = {}
                    local path = PathfindingService:CreatePath({
                        AgentRadius = 8, AgentHeight = 5, AgentCanJump = true, AgentJumpHeight = 10, AgentMaxSlope = 45,
                    })
                    local okPath = pcall(function()
                        path:ComputeAsync(hrp.Position, Vector3.new(basePos.X, hrp.Position.Y, basePos.Z))
                    end)
                    if okPath and path.Status == Enum.PathStatus.Success then
                        local last = hrp.Position
                        for _, wp in ipairs(path:GetWaypoints()) do
                            if (wp.Position - last).Magnitude >= 8 then
                                waypoints[#waypoints + 1] = wp.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
                                last = wp.Position
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    waypoints[#waypoints + 1] = basePos
                end

                TPPath(hrp.Position, waypoints, "BASE")

                local speed = Config.TpSettings.TpVelocity or 500
                local wpIdx = 1
                local totalDist = 0
                local prevP = hrp.Position
                for _, wp in ipairs(waypoints) do
                    totalDist = totalDist + (prevP - wp).Magnitude
                    prevP = wp
                end
                local maxTime = totalDist / math.max(speed, 1) + 5
                local startTime = os.clock()

                local lastDist, stall = math.huge, 0
                local prevDir = nil
                local PIVOT_COS = 0.95
                while wpIdx <= #waypoints do
                    if os.clock() - startTime > maxTime then break end
                    if not hrp.Parent then break end
                    local target = waypoints[wpIdx]
                    local diff = target - hrp.Position
                    local mag = diff.Magnitude
                    if mag < 3 then
                        wpIdx = wpIdx + 1
                        lastDist, stall = math.huge, 0
                    else
                        if mag > lastDist - 0.05 then stall = stall + 1 else stall = 0 end
                        lastDist = mag
                        if stall >= 18 then break end
                        local remaining = mag
                        for i = wpIdx, #waypoints - 1 do
                            remaining = remaining + (waypoints[i] - waypoints[i + 1]).Magnitude
                        end
                        local effectiveSpeed = math.max(speed * math.clamp(remaining / 15, 0, 1), 14)
                        local dir = diff.Unit
                        if prevDir and prevDir:Dot(dir) < PIVOT_COS then
                            prevDir = dir
                            hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                            hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
                            if _G.VXStripNow then pcall(_G.VXStripNow) end
                        else
                            prevDir = dir
                            hrp.Velocity = dir * effectiveSpeed
                        end
                    end
                    RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
                end

                if _G.VX_lvStop then pcall(_G.VX_lvStop, hrp) end
                hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
                local faceX = baseFaceX(BASES_LOW, plotIndex)
                hrp.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(basePos, Vector3.new(faceX, basePos.Y, basePos.Z))
            end)

            if Controls then pcall(function() Controls:Enable() end) end
            State.isTpMoving = false
            task.delay(6, function()
                if not State.isTpMoving then
                    if _G.VXDestroySkyPlatform then _G.VXDestroySkyPlatform() end
                end
            end)
            return ok
        end
        _G.VXTeleportToPlayerBase = teleportToPlayerBase

        local function _resolveOverride()
            local ov = _G.VXTpOverride
            if type(ov) ~= "table" then return nil end
            if ov.gen ~= _G.VXTpGen then return nil end
            if os.clock() >= (ov.expires or 0) then return nil end
            local plotsFolder = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")
            local plotInst = plotsFolder and ov.plot and plotsFolder:FindFirstChild(tostring(ov.plot))
            if not (plotInst and ov.slot) then return nil end

            local pos = getPetPosition(plotInst, tostring(ov.slot))
            if not pos then return nil end
            return {
                name = ov.name or "Slot", plot = tostring(ov.plot), slot = tostring(ov.slot),
                owner = ov.owner or "", position = pos, isCarpet = false,
                model = nil, _part = nil,
                animalData = { plot = tostring(ov.plot), slot = tostring(ov.slot), name = ov.name or "Slot" },
            }
        end

        local _lastUnresolvedLog = 0
        local function _resolveTarget()
            local ov = _resolveOverride()
            if ov then return ov end
            local sel = SharedState.SelectedPetData
            if not sel then return nil end
            local pos
            if sel.isCarpet then

                if Config.TpToCarpets ~= true then return nil end
                if sel._part and sel._part.Parent then
                    pos = sel._part.Position
                elseif sel.model and sel.model.Parent then
                    local part = sel.model.PrimaryPart or sel.model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
                    if part then sel._part = part; pos = part.Position end
                end
                if not pos then
                    for _, e in ipairs(SharedState.AllAnimalsCache or {}) do
                        if e.isCarpet and e._part and e._part.Parent
                        and (tostring(e.uid) == tostring(sel.uid) or e.name == sel.name) then
                            sel._part = e._part; sel._model = e._model or sel._model
                            sel.model = sel.model or e._model
                            pos = e._part.Position; break
                        end
                    end
                end
            else
                local plotsFolder = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")
                local plotInst = plotsFolder and sel.plot and plotsFolder:FindFirstChild(sel.plot)
                if plotInst and sel.slot then pos = getPetPosition(plotInst, sel.slot) end

                if not pos and sel._part and sel._part.Parent then pos = sel._part.Position end
                if not pos and typeof(sel.position) == "Vector3" then pos = sel.position end
            end
            if not pos then
                if (os.clock() - _lastUnresolvedLog) > 2 then
                    _lastUnresolvedLog = os.clock()
                    _G.VXLog("Teleport", string.format(
                        "Target unresolved - %s (plot %s slot %s) has no reachable position",
                        tostring(sel.petName or sel.name or "?"),
                        tostring(sel.plot or "nil"), tostring(sel.slot or "nil")))
                end
                return nil
            end
            return {
                name = sel.petName or sel.name, plot = sel.plot, slot = sel.slot, owner = sel.owner,
                uid = sel.uid, prompt = sel.prompt,
                position = pos, isCarpet = sel.isCarpet and true or false,
                model = sel._model or sel.model, _part = sel._part, animalData = sel.animalData,
            }
        end

        local _directCloneBusy = false
        local function directClone()
            if _directCloneBusy then return end
            _directCloneBusy = true
            task.spawn(function()
                local function done() _directCloneBusy = false end
                local char = LP.Character
                local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if not char or not hum then done() return end
                if not NetModule then pcall(loadNet) end

                local tool = char:FindFirstChild("Grapple Hook")
                or (LP:FindFirstChild("Backpack") and LP.Backpack:FindFirstChild("Grapple Hook"))
                if tool and tool.Parent ~= char then pcall(function() hum:EquipTool(tool) end) end
                task.wait(0.1)
                if char:FindFirstChild("Grapple Hook") then
                    if _G.VXFireGrapple2 then pcall(_G.VXFireGrapple2) end
                end
                -- idem: o clone + snap logo abaixo movem o personagem
                if _G.VXGrappleReleaseLock then pcall(_G.VXGrappleReleaseLock) end
                task.wait(0.15)

                doClone()

                local pet = _resolveTarget()
                if not pet or pet.isCarpet then done() return end
                local plotsFolder = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")
                local plotInst = plotsFolder and pet.plot and plotsFolder:FindFirstChild(pet.plot)
                if not plotInst then done() return end

                local hrp
                local inBase = false
                local deadline = os.clock() + 3
                while os.clock() < deadline do
                    char = LP.Character
                    hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    if hrp and _plotInBaseBox(plotInst, hrp.Position) then inBase = true break end
                    task.wait(0.05)
                end
                if not inBase or not hrp then done() return end

                local targetPart = pet._part
                if (not targetPart or not targetPart.Parent) and pet.animalData and type(findAdorneeGlobal) == "function" then
                    local okA, adorn = pcall(findAdorneeGlobal, pet.animalData)
                    if okA then targetPart = adorn end
                end
                if not (targetPart and targetPart.Parent) then done() return end

                local exactPos = pet.position
                local exactBrainrot = targetPart.Position
                local baseFinal = targetPart.Position + (targetPart.CFrame.LookVector * 3.5)
                local nonOffsetPos = baseFinal + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)
                local offsetPos = Vector3.new(baseFinal.X, exactPos.Y - 6.75, baseFinal.Z)
                local directClear = not Pathfinding:CheckCollision(hrp.Position, exactBrainrot, char)
                local offsetClear = false
                if exactPos.Y > 10 then
                    offsetClear = not Pathfinding:CheckCollision(hrp.Position, offsetPos, char)
                end
                if directClear or offsetClear then
                    local useOffset = (not directClear) and offsetClear
                    local dest = useOffset and offsetPos or nonOffsetPos

                    pcall(TPPath, hrp.Position, { dest }, "BRAINROT", "post")
                    pcall(function()
                        hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(dest)
                        hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                        hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
                    end)
                    if useOffset then
                        char = LP.Character
                        hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                        if hrp and hrp.Parent then
                            createTempPlatform()
                            local moved = false
                            local settleConn = UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
                                if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                                    moved = true; destroyTempPlatform()
                                end
                            end)
                            local _sTimeout = 0
                            local _sStart = os.clock()
                            while not LP:GetAttribute("Stealing") and not moved and _sTimeout < 80 do
                                if hrp.Position.Y > exactPos.Y + 5 then destroyTempPlatform(); break end
                                if (os.clock() - _sStart) > 4 and (hrp.Position - exactPos).Magnitude > 12 then break end
                                _sTimeout = _sTimeout + 1
                                task.wait(0.05)
                            end
                            destroyTempPlatform()
                            if settleConn then settleConn:Disconnect() end
                        end
                    end
                end
                done()
            end)
        end
        _G.VXDirectClone = directClone

        local function doVelocityTP()

            -- Solta a trava de puxao do grapple ANTES de qualquer coisa. O
            -- runTP dispara o grapple 0.12s atras e a trava dura 0.45s: sem
            -- este release ela ainda estaria prendendo o CFrame e apagando
            -- os movers que este TP esta prestes a criar.
            if _G.VXGrappleReleaseLock then pcall(_G.VXGrappleReleaseLock) end

            _G.VXTpGen = (tonumber(_G.VXTpGen) or 0) + 1
            local myGen = _G.VXTpGen
            local function _cur() return _G.VXTpGen == myGen end
            _G.PATHFINDING_ACTIVE = true

            if _G.VXStripNow then pcall(_G.VXStripNow) end
            clearViz()

            setVizPhase((Config.TpSettings and Config.TpSettings.CloneAfterTP == false) and nil or "pre")
            if not NetModule then pcall(loadNet) end

            local char = LP.Character
            local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if not hrp or not hum then
                _G.VXLog("Teleport", "Aborted - no character root or humanoid")
                if _cur() then _G.PATHFINDING_ACTIVE = false end; return
            end

            do

                local _sel = SharedState.SelectedPetData
                if _sel and _sel.isCarpet and Config.TpToCarpets ~= true and not _G.VXTpOverride then
                    _G.VXLog("Teleport", "Aborted - target is a carpet and 'TP to carpets' is off")
                    if _G.VXStealStatus then pcall(_G.VXStealStatus, "CARPET TP . OFF") end
                    if _cur() then _G.PATHFINDING_ACTIVE = false end; return
                end
            end

            local pet = _resolveTarget()
            if not pet then
                local _t0 = os.clock()
                while not pet and os.clock() - _t0 < 4 do task.wait(0.1); pet = _resolveTarget() end
            end
            if not pet then
                local _s = SharedState.SelectedPetData
                _G.VXLog("Teleport", "Aborted - no resolvable target after 4s"
                    .. (_s and (" (selected: " .. tostring(_s.petName or _s.name or "?") .. ")")
                    or " (nothing selected)"))
                if _cur() then _G.PATHFINDING_ACTIVE = false end; return
            end

            local _abFired = false
            local function _abFire()
                if _abFired then return end
                _abFired = true
                if Config.AntiBaiter ~= true or pet.isCarpet then return end
                task.spawn(function()
                    pcall(function()
                        local ownerName = pet.owner and tostring(pet.owner)
                        if not ownerName or ownerName == "" then return end
                        local ownerPlr = nil
                        for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                            if plr ~= LP and (plr.Name == ownerName or plr.DisplayName == ownerName) then ownerPlr = plr break end
                        end
                        if not ownerPlr then return end
                        if not ownerPlr:GetAttribute("Stealing") then return end
                        local carryIdx = ownerPlr:GetAttribute("StealingIndex")
                        if not carryIdx then return end
                        local candidates = {}
                        local sel = SharedState.SelectedPetData
                        if sel then
                            candidates[tostring(sel.index or "")] = true
                            candidates[tostring(sel.name or "")] = true
                            candidates[tostring(sel.petName or "")] = true
                            if sel.animalData then
                                candidates[tostring(sel.animalData.index or "")] = true
                                candidates[tostring(sel.animalData.name or "")] = true
                            end
                        end
                        candidates[tostring(pet.name or "")] = true
                        if candidates[tostring(carryIdx)] then
                            if _G.runAdminCommand then _G.runAdminCommand(ownerPlr, "ragdoll") end
                        end
                    end)
                end)
            end

            local function _abArmProximity(fallbackPos)
                if Config.AntiBaiter ~= true or pet.isCarpet then return end
                task.spawn(function()
                    local t0 = os.clock()
                    while (not _abFired) and _cur() and (os.clock() - t0) < 25 do
                        local c = LP.Character
                        local h = c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                        local goal = fallbackPos
                        if pet._part and pet._part.Parent then goal = pet._part.Position end
                        if h and h.Parent and goal and (h.Position - goal).Magnitude <= 30 then
