                            _abFire(); return
                        end
                        task.wait(0.05)
                    end
                end)
            end

            local _tpSpd = getTpSpeed()
            local isChain = (Config.TpSettings and Config.TpSettings.TeleportMethod == "Chain")
            local petPos = pet.position

            _G.VXLog("Teleport", string.format("Engaged - %s (%s) - %.0f studs at speed %d",
                tostring(pet.name or "?"),
                pet.isCarpet and "carpet target" or ("plot " .. tostring(pet.plot) .. " slot " .. tostring(pet.slot)),
                (hrp and petPos) and (hrp.Position - petPos).Magnitude or 0, _tpSpd))

            if pet.isCarpet then
                local maxHP = hum.MaxHealth; hum.Health = maxHP
                local healConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function() if hum and hum.Parent then hum.Health = maxHP end end)
                carpetEngage(); vZero(hrp)
                local function livePos()
                    if pet._part and pet._part.Parent then return pet._part.Position end
                    local m = pet.model
                    if not m or not m.Parent then return nil end
                    local part = m.PrimaryPart or m:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
                    return part and part.Position or nil
                end

                local CARPET_ZONE_Z = -137.66
                local CARPET_ZONE_SPOT = Vector3.new(-410, -5, -137)

                local CARPET_TP_Y = -4
                local function chasePoint(p)
                    if p and p.Z <= CARPET_ZONE_Z then return CARPET_ZONE_SPOT, true end
                    if p then return Vector3.new(p.X, CARPET_TP_Y, p.Z), false end
                    return p, false
                end

                local _approachTo = livePos() or petPos
                _approachTo = chasePoint(_approachTo)
                if _approachTo and (hrp.Position - _approachTo).Magnitude > 6 then
                    pcall(TPLabel, _approachTo, "CARPET", Color3.fromRGB(198, 150, 255))
                    if isChain then
                        local route = _G.VXChainRoute(hrp.Position, _approachTo, nil)
                        if route then _G.VXChainFly(hrp, route, nil, _approachTo, nil) end
                    else
                        local _route = computeRoute(hrp.Position, _approachTo, nil)
                        velMoveThrough(hrp, _route, _tpSpd, false)
                    end
                    char = LP.Character
                    hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                end

                local _t0 = os.clock()
                while os.clock() - _t0 < 8 do
                    if not _cur() then break end
                    if not hrp or not hrp.Parent then break end
                    local lp2 = livePos(); if not lp2 then break end
                    local goal, holding = chasePoint(lp2)
                    local diff = goal - hrp.Position
                    if diff.Magnitude <= 6 then
                        if not holding then break end
                        vZero(hrp)
                    else
                        equipCarpet()
                        hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = diff.Unit * _tpSpd
                    end
                    RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
                end

                if hrp and hrp.Parent and _cur() then
                    local _lpFinal = livePos()
                    if _lpFinal then
                        local _goalFinal, _holdFinal = chasePoint(_lpFinal)
                        if _goalFinal and not _holdFinal then
                            pcall(TPPath, hrp.Position, { _goalFinal }, "CARPET")
                            pcall(function()
                                hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(_goalFinal)
                                hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                                hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
                            end)
                        end
                    end
                end

                if hrp and hrp.Parent then
                    zeroAllVelocity(char)
                    local _pcd = VX_PRE_CLONE_DELAY
                    if _pcd > 0 then
                        local _ps = os.clock()
                        while os.clock() - _ps < _pcd do
                            if not _cur() then break end
                            task.wait()
                        end
                    end
                    if _stopAnchorPose then pcall(_stopAnchorPose) end
                end
                healConn:Disconnect(); if _cur() then _G.PATHFINDING_ACTIVE = false end

                if Config.Steal and Config.Steal.AutoStealEnabled then
                    task.defer(function()
                        if _G.VXCarpetOnArrival then pcall(_G.VXCarpetOnArrival) end
                    end)
                end
                return
            end

            local approach = computeBaseApproach(hrp, petPos)
            if not approach then if _cur() then _G.PATHFINDING_ACTIVE = false end; return end
            local flightBasePos = approach.flightBasePos
            local faceDirection = approach.faceDirection
            local routeFacingDir
            if not approach.useFrontApproach then
                routeFacingDir = (approach.sideFacing == "NORTH") and Vector3.new(0, 0, -1) or Vector3.new(0, 0, 1)
            end

            local exactPos = petPos
            local plotIndex = approach.plotIndex
            local isSecondFloor = exactPos.Y > 10
            local isThirdFloor = exactPos.Y > 25
            local isFirstFloor = exactPos.Y <= 10
            local basePosFace = BASES_FACE[plotIndex]
            local targetPart = pet._part
            if (not targetPart or not targetPart.Parent) and pet.animalData then
                targetPart = findAdorneeGlobal(pet.animalData)
            end

            if targetPart and targetPart.Parent then
                local char2 = LP.Character
                local exactBrainrot = targetPart.Position
                local baseFinal = targetPart.Position + (targetPart.CFrame.LookVector * 3.5)
                local nonOffsetPos = baseFinal + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)
                local offsetPos = Vector3.new(baseFinal.X, exactPos.Y - 6.75, baseFinal.Z)
                local directClear = not Pathfinding:CheckCollision(hrp.Position, exactBrainrot, char2)
                local offsetClear = false
                if isSecondFloor or isThirdFloor then
                    offsetClear = not Pathfinding:CheckCollision(hrp.Position, offsetPos, char2)
                end
                if directClear or offsetClear then
                    local useOffset = (not directClear) and offsetClear
                    local finalPos = useOffset and offsetPos or nonOffsetPos

                    local finalFaceDir
                    if basePosFace then
                        finalFaceDir = Vector3.new(basePosFace.X, finalPos.Y, basePosFace.Z)
                    else
                        local col = (plotIndex and plotIndex <= 4) and -500 or 500
                        finalFaceDir = Vector3.new(finalPos.X + col, finalPos.Y, finalPos.Z)
                    end
                    local fpMaxHP = hum.MaxHealth; hum.Health = fpMaxHP
                    local fpHeal = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function() if hum and hum.Parent then hum.Health = fpMaxHP end end)
                    carpetEngage(); vZero(hrp)

                    _abArmProximity(exactBrainrot)
                    velMoveThrough(hrp, { finalPos }, _tpSpd, true)
                    char = LP.Character
                    hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    if hrp and hrp.Parent then

                        hrp.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(hrp.Position, finalFaceDir)
                        zeroAllVelocity(char)
                    end

                    if useOffset and hrp and hrp.Parent then
                        createTempPlatform()
                        local moved = false
                        local settleConn = UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
                            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                                moved = true; destroyTempPlatform()
                            end
                        end)
                        local _sTimeout = 0
                        local _sStart = os.clock()
                        while not LP:GetAttribute("Stealing") and not moved and _sTimeout < 80 do
                            if not _cur() then break end
                            if hrp.Position.Y > exactPos.Y + 5 then
                                destroyTempPlatform(); break
                            end
                            if (os.clock() - _sStart) > 4 and (hrp.Position - exactPos).Magnitude > 12 then break end
                            _sTimeout = _sTimeout + 1
                            task.wait(0.05)
                        end
                        destroyTempPlatform()
                        if settleConn then settleConn:Disconnect() end
                    end
                    if fpHeal then fpHeal:Disconnect() end
                    if _cur() then _G.PATHFINDING_ACTIVE = false end; return
                end
            end

            local maxHP = hum.MaxHealth; hum.Health = maxHP
            local healConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function() if hum and hum.Parent then hum.Health = maxHP end end)

            carpetEngage(); vZero(hrp)
            if hrp and hrp.Parent then
                hrp.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(hrp.Position, faceDirection)
                hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
            end

            local ff = Instance.new("ForceField"); ff.Visible = false; ff.Parent = hrp.Parent

            --  The forcefield and the heal loop are what keep the flight from
            --  killing us, and they used to be torn down the instant the route
            --  finished. On an upward route that is exactly the wrong moment:
            --  we arrive at second-floor or roof height still moving, the guard
            --  drops, and the fall that follows lands unprotected. Hold the
            --  guard until the character is actually settled -- grounded, not
            --  in Freefall, vertical speed near zero -- or until a 5s cap.
            local _guardReleased = false
            local function releaseFlightGuard()
                if _guardReleased then return end
                _guardReleased = true
                task.spawn(function()
                    local t0 = os.clock()
                    while (os.clock() - t0) < 5 do
                        local c2 = LP.Character
                        local h2 = c2 and c2:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                        local hu2 = c2 and c2:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                        if not (h2 and hu2) then break end
                        local st = hu2:GetState()
                        local airborne = (st == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall)
                            or (st == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
                            or math.abs(h2.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y) > 3
                        if not airborne then
                            --  Grounded. Give the landing a beat to resolve
                            --  before dropping the guard.
                            task.wait(0.35)
                            break
                        end
                        RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
                    end
                    if ff and ff.Parent then ff:Destroy() end
                    if healConn then healConn:Disconnect() end
                end)
            end

            local isPlotUnlocked = _G._isTargetPlotUnlocked and _G._isTargetPlotUnlocked(pet.plot) or false

            local _sfLowRoute = not (isSecondFloor and not isThirdFloor and secondFloorRoutesHigh())
            local skipCloneSequence = (isFirstFloor or (isSecondFloor and _sfLowRoute)) and not isThirdFloor and isPlotUnlocked and approach.useFrontApproach
            local _willFinalHop = (skipCloneSequence and targetPart and targetPart.Parent) and true or false
            local _flightBrake = not _willFinalHop

            local _abUsesClone = (not skipCloneSequence)
            and not (Config.TpSettings and Config.TpSettings.CloneAfterTP == false)
            if not _abUsesClone then _abArmProximity(exactPos) end

            if isChain then
                local route = _G.VXChainRoute(hrp.Position, flightBasePos, routeFacingDir)
                if route then _G.VXChainFly(hrp, route, nil, flightBasePos, nil) end
            else
                local _route = computeRoute(hrp.Position, flightBasePos, routeFacingDir)
                velMoveThrough(hrp, _route, _tpSpd, _flightBrake)
            end

            char = LP.Character
            hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not hrp or not hrp.Parent or not hum then
                releaseFlightGuard()
                if _cur() then _G.PATHFINDING_ACTIVE = false end; return
            end

            if skipCloneSequence and targetPart and targetPart.Parent then
                if faceDirection then pcall(function() hrp.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(hrp.Position, faceDirection) end) end
                hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
                local finalBrainrotPos = targetPart.Position + (targetPart.CFrame.LookVector * 3.5) + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)
                if isSecondFloor then
                    local bf = targetPart.Position + (targetPart.CFrame.LookVector * 3.5)
                    finalBrainrotPos = Vector3.new(bf.X, exactPos.Y - 6.75, bf.Z)
                end
                if (hrp.Position - finalBrainrotPos).Magnitude > 3 then

                    velMoveThrough(hrp, { finalBrainrotPos }, _tpSpd, true)
                    char = LP.Character
                    hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                end
                if hrp and hrp.Parent then
                    local ffd
                    if basePosFace then
                        ffd = Vector3.new(basePosFace.X, hrp.Position.Y, basePosFace.Z)
                    else
                        ffd = Vector3.new(faceDirection.X, hrp.Position.Y, faceDirection.Z)
                    end
                    hrp.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(hrp.Position, ffd)
                    hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                    hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
                end

                if isSecondFloor and hrp and hrp.Parent then
                    createTempPlatform()
                    local moved = false
                    local settleConn = UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
                        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                            moved = true; destroyTempPlatform()
                        end
                    end)
                    local _sTimeout = 0
                    local _sStart = os.clock()
                    while not LP:GetAttribute("Stealing") and not moved and _sTimeout < 80 do
                        if not _cur() then break end
                        if hrp.Position.Y > exactPos.Y + 5 then destroyTempPlatform(); break end
                        if (os.clock() - _sStart) > 4 and (hrp.Position - exactPos).Magnitude > 12 then break end
                        _sTimeout = _sTimeout + 1
                        task.wait(0.05)
                    end
                    destroyTempPlatform()
                    if settleConn then settleConn:Disconnect() end
                end
                releaseFlightGuard()
                if _cur() then _G.PATHFINDING_ACTIVE = false end; return
            end

            local PRE_CLONE_DELAY = VX_PRE_CLONE_DELAY

            if pet and not pet.isCarpet and _G.VXStealBeginHold then
                pcall(_G.VXStealBeginHold, pet)
            end

            pcall(function()
                if faceDirection then
                    hrp.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(hrp.Position, Vector3.new(faceDirection.X, hrp.Position.Y, faceDirection.Z))
                end
            end)

            zeroAllVelocity(char)

            if PRE_CLONE_DELAY > 0 then
                local preStart = os.clock()
                while os.clock() - preStart < PRE_CLONE_DELAY do
                    if not _cur() then break end
                    task.wait()
                end
            end
            if _stopAnchorPose then pcall(_stopAnchorPose) end
            releaseFlightGuard()

            if not _cur() then return end

            -- Esta saida era MUDA, e e por ela que "o clone nao faz nada e
            -- nao aparece log nenhum": o padrao de "Clone After TP" na GUI e
            -- FALSE, o syncConfig copia esse false pra ca a cada 0.5s, e o TP
            -- volta aqui sem nunca chegar no doClone. Agora ela avisa.
            if Config.TpSettings and Config.TpSettings.CloneAfterTP == false then
                if not _G.__VXCloneOffWarned then
                    _G.__VXCloneOffWarned = true
                    _G.VXLog("Clone", "skipped - 'Clone After TP' is OFF (Teleport tab). "
                        .. "Turn it on, or call _G.VXInstantClone() to clone by itself.")
                end
                if _cur() then _G.PATHFINDING_ACTIVE = false end; return
            end
            _G.__VXCloneOffWarned = nil

            _abFire()

            pcall(function()
                local _c = LP.Character
                local _h = _c and _c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if _h then TPCloneMark(_h.Position) end
            end)
            local _cloneOk = doClone()
            if _cloneOk and (not Config.TpSettings or Config.TpSettings.GoToBrainrotAfterTP ~= false) then
                goToBrainrot(pet)
            end
            if _cur() then _G.PATHFINDING_ACTIVE = false end

            if Config.Steal and Config.Steal.AutoStealEnabled and pet then
                task.defer(function()
                    if _G.VXStealOnArrival then pcall(_G.VXStealOnArrival, pet.plot, pet.slot) end
                end)
            end
        end

        local _tpBusyToken = 0
        local function tpBusyBegin()
            _tpBusyToken = _tpBusyToken + 1
            local tok = _tpBusyToken
            _G.VXTeleportActive = true

            if _G.VXStealSuppress then pcall(_G.VXStealSuppress, true) end
            if _G.VXStripNow then pcall(_G.VXStripNow) end
            task.delay(30, function()
                if _tpBusyToken == tok then
                    _G.VXTeleportActive = false
                    if _G.VXStealSuppress then pcall(_G.VXStealSuppress, false) end
                end
            end)
            return tok
        end
        local function tpBusyEnd(tok)
            if _tpBusyToken == tok then _G.VXTeleportActive = false end
            if _G.VXStealSuppress then pcall(_G.VXStealSuppress, false) end
        end

        local function runGuardedTP()
            local tok = tpBusyBegin()
            pcall(doVelocityTP)
            tpBusyEnd(tok)
        end

        _G.VXStartSideTP = runGuardedTP

        runTP = function()
            task.spawn(function()
                local tok = tpBusyBegin()
                if type(_G.VXFireGrapple) == "function" then pcall(_G.VXFireGrapple); task.wait(0.12) end
                pcall(doVelocityTP)
                tpBusyEnd(tok)
            end)
        end
        Clone = function() task.spawn(function() if not NetModule then pcall(loadNet) end; doClone() end) end
        _G.VXRunTP = runTP

        _G.VXCancelTP = function()
            if _G.PATHFINDING_ACTIVE or _G.VXTeleportActive then
                _G.VXLog("Teleport", "Cancelled - character respawned mid-flight")
            end
            _G.VXTpGen = (tonumber(_G.VXTpGen) or 0) + 1
            _G.VXTpOverride = nil
            _G.PATHFINDING_ACTIVE = false
            _G.VXTeleportActive = false
            _tpBusyToken = _tpBusyToken + 1

            if _G.VXStealHoldCancel then pcall(_G.VXStealHoldCancel) end
            if _G.VXStealSuppress then pcall(_G.VXStealSuppress, false) end
            if _stopAnchorPose then pcall(_stopAnchorPose) end
        end

        local function hookTpAbort(char)
            local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

            hum.Died:Connect(function() _G.VXCancelTP() end)

            _G.VXCancelTP()
            task.defer(hookTpAbort, c)
        end)
    end

    local function isValidStealPrompt(prompt)
        if not prompt or not prompt.Parent or not prompt.Enabled then return false end
        local state = prompt:GetAttribute("State")
        local actionText = prompt.ActionText
        return state == "Steal" or state == "Grab" or actionText == "Steal" or actionText == "Grab"
    end

    _G.VXRefreshPriority = function()
        SharedState.SelectionDirty = true
        SharedState.ListNeedsRedraw = true
    end

    local function parseMoney(txt)
        if not txt then return nil end
        txt = txt:gsub("<[^>]+>", "")
        local num, suf = txt:match("([%d%.,]+)%s*([KkMmBbTt]?)")
        if not num then return nil end
        num = num:gsub(",", "")
        local n = tonumber(num); if not n then return nil end
        suf = suf:upper()
        if suf == "K" then n = n * 1e3
        elseif suf == "M" then n = n * 1e6
        elseif suf == "B" then n = n * 1e9
        elseif suf == "T" then n = n * 1e12 end
        return n
    end

    local function findTargetPromptForSlot(plot, slotName)
        local podiums = plot:FindFirstChild("AnimalPodiums")
        local podium = podiums and podiums:FindFirstChild(slotName)
        local base = podium and podium:FindFirstChild("Base")
        local spawn = base and base:FindFirstChild("Spawn")
        local att = spawn and spawn:FindFirstChild("PromptAttachment")
        if att then
            for _, ch in ipairs(att:GetChildren()) do
                if ch:IsA("ProximityPrompt") and isValidStealPrompt(ch) then
                    return ch, att.WorldPosition
                end
            end
            return nil, att.WorldPosition
        end
        return nil, nil
    end

        local function createServerGhost(position)
            if not ghostEnabled or errorOrbActive then return end
            local now = tick()
            if now - lastLagbackTime < 0.05 then return end
            lastLagbackTime = now
            if now - lagbackWindowStart > 1 then lagbackCallCount = 0; lagbackWindowStart = now end
            lagbackCallCount = lagbackCallCount + 1
            if lagbackCallCount >= 5 then
                if _G.AutoRecoverLagback and _G.invisibleStealEnabled and _G.toggleInvisibleSteal and not _G.RecoveryInProgress then
                    _G.RecoveryInProgress = true
                    task.defer(function()
                        pcall(_G.toggleInvisibleSteal)
                        task.wait(1.2)
                        _G.RecoveryInProgress = false
                    end)
                    return
                end
                createErrorOrb(); return
            end
            for _, g in pairs(serverGhosts) do if g and g.Parent then g:Destroy() end end
            serverGhosts = {}
            local red   = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
            local white = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
            local sg = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
            sg.Name = "LagbackNotification"; sg.ResetOnSpawn = false; sg.Parent = NotifGui
            makeLabel(sg, UDim2.new(0, 500, 0, 30), UDim2.new(0.5, -250, 0.15, 0), "LAGBACK DETECTED", red)
            makeLabel(sg, UDim2.new(0, 650, 0, 25), UDim2.new(0.5, -325, 0.15, 32),
                "DISABLE INVISIBLE STEAL NOW OR YOU WILL BE KILLED BY ANTICHEAT", white)
            task.delay(1.5, function() if sg and sg.Parent then sg:Destroy() end end)
            local ghost = Instance.new("Part")
            ghost.Name = "LagbackGhost"; ghost.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
            ghost.Size = Vector3.new(3, 3, 3); ghost.Color = red
            ghost.Material = Enum.Material.Glass; ghost.Transparency = 0.3
            ghost.CanCollide = false; ghost.Anchored = true; ghost.CastShadow = false
            ghost.Position = position + Vector3.new(0, 5, 0)
            ghost.Parent = Workspace.CurrentCamera
            local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
            bb.Size = UDim2.new(0, 400, 0, 60); bb.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 4, 0)
            bb.AlwaysOnTop = true; bb.Parent = ghost
            makeLabel(bb, UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 25), UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0),  "LAGBACK DETECTED", red)
            makeLabel(bb, UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 25), UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 25),
                "DISABLE INVISIBLE STEAL NOW OR YOU WILL BE KILLED BY ANTICHEAT", white)
            table.insert(serverGhosts, ghost)
        end

            pcall(function()

        local function removeFolders()
            local pf = Workspace:FindFirstChild(LocalPlayer.Name)

            local dr = pf:FindFirstChild("DoubleRig")
            if dr then
                local rr = dr:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or dr:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")

                dr:Destroy()

            if cs then cs:Destroy() end
            local conn = pf.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)

                    task.defer(function()

                        if rr and ghostEnabled then createServerGhost(rr.Position) end

        local function doClone()
            local character = LocalPlayer.Character
            if character and character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") and character.Humanoid.Health > 0 then
                hip     = character.Humanoid.HipHeight
                oldRoot = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if not oldRoot or not oldRoot.Parent then return false end
                for _, c in pairs(oldRoot:GetChildren()) do
                    if c:IsA("Attachment") and c.Name:find("Beam") then c:Destroy() end
                end
                for _, c in pairs(oldRoot:GetChildren()) do if c:IsA("Beam") then c:Destroy() end end
                local tmp = Instance.new("Model"); tmp.Parent = game
                character.Parent = tmp
                clone = oldRoot:Clone()
                for _, c in ipairs(clone:GetChildren()) do
                    if c:IsA("LinearVelocity") or c:IsA("BodyVelocity") or c:IsA("VectorForce")
                    or (c:IsA("Attachment") and (c.Name == "LVAttachment" or c.Name == "InvisLVAtt")) then
                        pcall(function() c:Destroy() end)
                    end
                end
                clone.Parent   = character
                clone.Anchored = false
                oldRoot.Parent = Workspace.CurrentCamera
                clone.CFrame   = oldRoot.CFrame
                character.PrimaryPart = clone
                character.Parent = Workspace
                for _, v in pairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
                    if v:IsA("Weld") or v:IsA("Motor6D") or v:IsA("WeldConstraint") then
                        if v.Part0 == oldRoot then v.Part0 = clone end
                        if v.Part1 == oldRoot then v.Part1 = clone end
                    end
                end
                tmp:Destroy(); return true
            end
            return false
        end

        local function revertClone()
            local character = LocalPlayer.Character
            local g_hum     = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if not oldRoot or not oldRoot:IsDescendantOf(Workspace) or not character or not g_hum or g_hum.Health <= 0 then
                return
            end
            local tmp = Instance.new("Model"); tmp.Parent = game
            character.Parent = tmp
            oldRoot.Parent = character; character.PrimaryPart = oldRoot
            character.Parent = Workspace; oldRoot.CanCollide = true
            for _, v in pairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
                if v:IsA("Weld") or v:IsA("Motor6D") or v:IsA("WeldConstraint") then
                    if v.Part0 == clone then v.Part0 = oldRoot end
                    if v.Part1 == clone then v.Part1 = oldRoot end
                end
            end
            if clone then
                local p = clone.CFrame; clone:Destroy(); clone = nil
                oldRoot.CFrame = p
            end
            pcall(function()
                local _rra = oldRoot and oldRoot:FindFirstChild("RootRigAttachment")
                if _rra then
                    for _, d in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
                        if d:IsA("AnimationConstraint") and d.Name == "Root" then
                            if d.Attachment0 == nil or d.Attachment0.Parent == nil then d.Attachment0 = _rra end
                            break
                        end
                    end
                end
            end)
            oldRoot = nil
            if character and character.Humanoid then character.Humanoid.HipHeight = hip end
            _G.JAF_InvisSurface = false
            clearAllGhosts()
        end

        local function animationTrickery()
            if not (animPlaying and _G.invisibleStealEnabled) then return end
            local character = LocalPlayer.Character
            if character and character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") and character.Humanoid.Health > 0 then
                local anim = Instance.new("Animation")
                anim.AnimationId = "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=18537363391"
                local humanoid = character.Humanoid
                local animator = humanoid:FindFirstChild("Animator") or Instance.new("Animator", humanoid)
                local animTrack = animator:LoadAnimation(anim)
                animTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action4
                animTrack:Play(0, 1, 0); anim:Destroy()
                for _, t in ipairs(tracks) do pcall(function() t:Stop() end) end
                table.clear(tracks)
                table.insert(tracks, animTrack)

                _G.VXInvisAnimTrack = animTrack
                animTrack.Stopped:Connect(function()
                    if animPlaying and _G.invisibleStealEnabled then animationTrickery() end
                end)
                task.delay(0, function()
                    animTrack.TimePosition = 0.7
                    task.delay(0.3, function() if animTrack then animTrack:AdjustSpeed(math.huge) end end)
                end)
            end
        end

        local function invisTurnOff()
            if animPlaying then _G.VXLog("Invis", "Invisible steal disabled") end
            animPlaying = false
            _G.invisibleStealEnabled = false
            _G.invisAutoActive       = false
            Config.Steal.InvisStealEnabled = false
            setToggle("Invisible Steal", false)
            for _, t in pairs(tracks) do pcall(function() t:Stop() end) end
            tracks = {}
            _G.VXInvisAnimTrack = nil
            do
                local _ch  = LocalPlayer.Character
                local _hum = _ch and _ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                local _anr = _hum and _hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
                if _anr then
                    for _, ft in ipairs(_anr:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
                        if ft.Animation and tostring(ft.Animation.AnimationId):find("18537363391") then
                            pcall(function() ft:AdjustSpeed(1); ft:Stop(0) end)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            if connection then connection:Disconnect(); connection = nil end
            if _invisSF    then pcall(function() _invisSF:Destroy()    end); _invisSF    = nil end
            if _invisSFAtt then pcall(function() _invisSFAtt:Destroy() end); _invisSFAtt = nil end
            for _, c in ipairs(folderConnections) do if c then pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end end
            folderConnections = {}
            pcall(revertClone)
            local character = LocalPlayer.Character
            local humanoid  = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local hrp       = character and (character.PrimaryPart or character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
            if character then
                for _, p in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
                    if p:IsA("BasePart") then pcall(function() p.Anchored = false end) end
                end
            end
            if hrp then
                pcall(function()
                    local pos = hrp.Position
                    hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos.X, pos.Y, pos.Z) * CFrame.Angles(0, hrp.Orientation.Y * math.pi / 180, 0)
                    hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity  = Vector3.zero
                    hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
                end)
            end
            if humanoid then
                pcall(function() humanoid.PlatformStand = false end)
                pcall(function() humanoid.Sit           = false end)
                pcall(function() humanoid.AutoRotate    = true  end)
                pcall(function() if humanoid.WalkSpeed  <= 0 then humanoid.WalkSpeed  = 16 end end)
                pcall(function() if humanoid.JumpPower  <= 0 and humanoid.UseJumpPower then humanoid.JumpPower = 50 end end)
                pcall(function() humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp)  end)
                pcall(function() humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall)   end)
            end
            pcall(function()
                local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera
                if cam and humanoid then
                    cam.CameraSubject = humanoid
                    cam.CameraType    = Enum.CameraType.Custom
                end
            end)
            pcall(function()
                local pm = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerScripts")
                if pm then pm = pm:FindFirstChild("PlayerModule") end
                if pm then require(pm):GetControls():Enable() end
            end)
            clearAllGhosts()
            if _G.updateMovementPanelInvisVisual then pcall(_G.updateMovementPanelInvisVisual, false) end
            _invisToggleCooldown = tick()
        end

        local function invisTurnOn()
            if animPlaying then return true end
            local character = LocalPlayer.Character
            if not character or character.Parent == nil then return false end
            local humanoid  = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return false end
            if not (character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or character.PrimaryPart) then return false end
            _G.VXLog("Invis", "Invisible steal enabled - rotation " .. tostring(_G.InvisStealAngle))
            animPlaying = true
            _G.invisibleStealEnabled = true
            Config.Steal.InvisStealEnabled = true
            setToggle("Invisible Steal", true)
            if _G.updateMovementPanelInvisVisual then pcall(_G.updateMovementPanelInvisVisual, true) end
            tracks = {}; removeFolders()
            local success = doClone()
            if not success then
                animPlaying = false
                _G.invisibleStealEnabled = false
                Config.Steal.InvisStealEnabled = false
                setToggle("Invisible Steal", false)
                if _G.updateMovementPanelInvisVisual then pcall(_G.updateMovementPanelInvisVisual, false) end
                return false
            end
            if success then
                if _G.JAF_InvisFreezeOnEngage ~= false then
                    pcall(function()
                        local pm = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerScripts")
                        pm = pm and pm:FindFirstChild("PlayerModule")
                        if pm then require(pm):GetControls():Enable() end
                    end)
                    local _fc    = LocalPlayer.Character
                    local _froot = _fc and (_fc.PrimaryPart or _fc:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
                    local _fhum  = _fc and _fc:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                    if _froot then
                        pcall(function()
                            _froot.AssemblyLinearVelocity  = Vector3.zero
                            _froot.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
                            _froot.Anchored = false
                        end)
                    end
                    if oldRoot then
                        pcall(function()
                            oldRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity  = Vector3.zero
                            oldRoot.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
                        end)
                    end
                    if _fhum then
                        pcall(function() _fhum:Move(Vector3.zero, false) end)
                        pcall(function() if _fhum.PlatformStand then _fhum.PlatformStand = false end end)
                        pcall(function() if _fhum.Sit           then _fhum.Sit           = false end end)
                        pcall(function() if _fhum.WalkSpeed <= 0 then _fhum.WalkSpeed    = 16    end end)
                    end
                end
                if _G.JAF_InvisFold ~= false then task.wait(0.05); animationTrickery() end
                task.defer(function()
                    if _G.resetBrainrotBeam then pcall(_G.resetBrainrotBeam) end
                    if _G.resetPlotBeam then pcall(_G.resetPlotBeam) end
                    task.wait(0.1)
                    if _G.updateBrainrotBeam then pcall(_G.updateBrainrotBeam) end
                    if _G.createPlotBeam then pcall(_G.createPlotBeam) end
                end)
                local lastSetPosition = nil
                local skipFrames      = 5
                local _invisFastMode  = false
                local _invisSlowAccum = 0
                connection = RunService.PreSimulation:Connect(function(_psDt)
                    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
                    if char and char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") and char.Humanoid.Health > 0 and oldRoot then
                        local root = char.PrimaryPart or char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                        if root then
                            if _G.JAF_InvisRagdollGuard ~= false then
                                pcall(function()
                                    if (LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("RagdollEndTime") or 0) > 0 then
                                        LocalPlayer:SetAttribute("RagdollEndTime", 0)
                                    end
                                    local _h = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                                    if _h then
                                        if _h.PlatformStand then _h.PlatformStand = false end
                                        local _s = _h:GetState()
                                        if _s == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics
                                        or _s == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll
                                        or _s == Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown then
                                            _h:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp)
                                        end
                                    end
                                    if invisRagdollACChar ~= char then
                                        invisRagdollACChar = char; invisRagdollACs = {}
                                        for _, d in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
                                            if d:IsA("AnimationConstraint") then table.insert(invisRagdollACs, d) end
                                        end
                                    end
                                    for _, ac in ipairs(invisRagdollACs) do
                                        if ac.Parent and not ac.Enabled then ac.Enabled = true end
                                    end
                                end)
                            end
                            if skipFrames > 0 then
                                skipFrames = skipFrames - 1; lastSetPosition = nil
                            elseif lastSetPosition and ghostEnabled then
                                local currentPos  = oldRoot.Position
                                local jumpDist    = (currentPos - lastSetPosition).Magnitude

                                if jumpDist > 16 and not _G.RecoveryInProgress
                                and LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("Stealing")
                                and not autoInvisBlocked()
                                and (tick() - (_G.__lastAutoRecoverT or 0)) > 1.5 then
                                    _G.__lastAutoRecoverT = tick()
                                    lastSetPosition = nil; createServerGhost(currentPos)
                                    if _G.AutoRecoverLagback and _G.setInvisibleSteal then
                                        _G.RecoveryInProgress = true
                                        local _recChar = LocalPlayer.Character
                                        task.spawn(function()
                                            pcall(_G.setInvisibleSteal, false)
                                            task.wait(0.6)
                                            if LocalPlayer.Character == _recChar
                                            and LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("Stealing")
                                            and not autoInvisBlocked() then
                                                pcall(_G.setInvisibleSteal, true)
                                            end
                                            _G.RecoveryInProgress = false
                                        end)
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                            if clone then clone.CanCollide = (_G.JAF_InvisCloneCollide ~= false) end
                            if not oldRoot then return end
                            for _, c in pairs(oldRoot:GetChildren()) do
                                if c:IsA("Beam") or (c:IsA("Attachment") and c.Name:find("Beam")) then c:Destroy() end
                            end

                            local rotAngle = (_G.AutoRotateInvis and _G.CurrentInvisRotation) or _G.InvisStealAngle or 225

                            local sa = math.clamp(tonumber(_G.SinkSliderValue) or 8, 5, 10) * 0.5
                            local _rv    = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
                            local _xzSpd = Vector3.new(_rv.X, 0, _rv.Z).Magnitude
                            local _hyDt  = tonumber(_psDt) or (1/60)
                            if _invisFastMode then
                                if _xzSpd < (_G.JAF_InvisFastExit or 17) then
                                    _invisSlowAccum = _invisSlowAccum + _hyDt
                                    if _invisSlowAccum > 0.15 then _invisFastMode = false end
                                else
                                    _invisSlowAccum = 0
                                end
                            elseif _xzSpd > (_G.JAF_InvisFastEnter or 22) then
                                _invisFastMode = true; _invisSlowAccum = 0
                            end
                            if _invisFastMode and _G.JAF_InvisSpeedFix ~= false and not _G.JAF_InvisSurface then
                                if not _invisSF or _invisSF.Parent ~= oldRoot then
                                    if _invisSF    then pcall(function() _invisSF:Destroy()    end) end
                                    if _invisSFAtt then pcall(function() _invisSFAtt:Destroy() end) end
                                    _invisSFAtt = Instance.new("Attachment")
                                    _invisSFAtt.Name   = "InvisLVAtt"
                                    _invisSFAtt.Parent = oldRoot
                                    _invisSF = Instance.new("LinearVelocity")
                                    _invisSF.Name                   = "InvisSpeedForce"
                                    _invisSF.Attachment0            = _invisSFAtt
                                    _invisSF.RelativeTo             = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
                                    _invisSF.VelocityConstraintMode = Enum.VelocityConstraintMode.Vector
                                    _invisSF.ForceLimitMode         = Enum.ForceLimitMode.PerAxis
                                    _invisSF.MaxAxesForce           = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
                                    _invisSF.Parent                 = oldRoot
                                end
                                local _yv = math.clamp(
                                    ((root.Position.Y - sa) - oldRoot.Position.Y) * (_G.JAF_InvisYGain or 25),
                                    -150, 150)
                                local _gx = _G.JAF_InvisXZGain or 8
                                local _vx = _rv.X + math.clamp((root.Position.X - oldRoot.Position.X) * _gx, -15, 15)
                                local _vz = _rv.Z + math.clamp((root.Position.Z - oldRoot.Position.Z) * _gx, -15, 15)
                                local _hv = Vector3.new(_vx, 0, _vz)
                                local _mxz = _G.JAF_InvisMaxXZ or 65
                                if _hv.Magnitude > _mxz then _hv = _hv.Unit * _mxz end
                                _invisSF.VectorVelocity = Vector3.new(_hv.X, _yv, _hv.Z)
                                _invisSF.Enabled        = true
                                oldRoot.CFrame = CFrame.new(oldRoot.Position)
                                * root.CFrame.Rotation
                                * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(rotAngle), 0, 0)
                                oldRoot.CanCollide = false
                            else
                                if _invisSF and _invisSF.Enabled then _invisSF.Enabled = false end
                                local cf = root.CFrame - Vector3.new(0, sa, 0)
                                oldRoot.CFrame = cf * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(rotAngle), 0, 0)
                                if _G.JAF_InvisSurface then oldRoot.CFrame = root.CFrame end
                                oldRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
                                oldRoot.CanCollide = false
                            end
                            lastSetPosition = _G.JAF_InvisSurface and nil or oldRoot.Position
                        end
                    end
                end)
            end
            return true
        end

        local function toggle()
            if _G.invisibleStealEnabled then invisTurnOff() else removeFolders(); invisTurnOn() end
        end

        _G.toggleInvisibleSteal = function()
            if (tick() - _invisToggleCooldown) < 0.3 then return end
            toggle()
        end
        _G._forceInvisToggle    = toggle
        _G.enableV1SemiInvis    = function() removeFolders(); invisTurnOn() end
        _G.disableV1SemiInvis   = invisTurnOff
        _G.setInvisibleSteal = function(on)
            on = on and true or false
            if on and not _G.invisibleStealEnabled then removeFolders(); invisTurnOn()
            elseif (not on) and _G.invisibleStealEnabled then invisTurnOff() end
            if _G.updateMovementPanelInvisVisual then pcall(_G.updateMovementPanelInvisVisual, _G.invisibleStealEnabled == true) end
        end
        _G.forceToggleInvisibleSteal = function(wantOn)
            if wantOn and not animPlaying then invisTurnOn()
            elseif not wantOn and animPlaying then invisTurnOff() end
        end

        _G._InvisOnStealV1 = { autoOnSteal = Config.Steal.AutoInvisDuringSteal == true }
        _G.startInvisOnStealV1 = function()
            Config.Steal.AutoInvisDuringSteal = true
            _G.AutoInvisDuringSteal = true
            if _G._InvisOnStealV1 then _G._InvisOnStealV1.autoOnSteal = true end
        end
        _G.stopInvisOnStealV1 = function()
            Config.Steal.AutoInvisDuringSteal = false
            _G.AutoInvisDuringSteal = false
            if _G._InvisOnStealV1 then _G._InvisOnStealV1.autoOnSteal = false end
        end

        _G._vxSyncInvisGlobals = function()
            _G.InvisStealAngle      = Config.Steal.InvisStealAngle
            _G.SinkSliderValue      = Config.Steal.SinkSliderValue
            _G.AutoRecoverLagback   = Config.Steal.AutoRecoverLagback ~= false
            _G.AutoInvisDuringSteal = Config.Steal.AutoInvisDuringSteal == true
            if _G._InvisOnStealV1 then
                _G._InvisOnStealV1.autoOnSteal = Config.Steal.AutoInvisDuringSteal == true
            end
        end
        _G._vxSyncInvisGlobals()

        local function invisEngaged()
            return animPlaying == true
            and connection ~= nil
            and oldRoot ~= nil and oldRoot.Parent ~= nil
            and clone   ~= nil and clone.Parent   ~= nil
        end
        local function charReadyForInvis()
            local ch = LocalPlayer.Character
            if not ch or ch.Parent == nil then return false end
            local hum = ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local hrp = ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or ch.PrimaryPart
            return (hum and hum.Health > 0 and hrp and hrp.Parent) and true or false
        end

        player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Stealing"):Connect(function()
            if not player:GetAttribute("Stealing") then clearInvisSuppress() end
        end)

        task.spawn(function()
            local streakStart = nil
            local offSince    = nil
            local lastTry     = 0
            local failStreak  = 0
            while true do
                RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
                pcall(function()

                    local auto = Config.Steal.AutoInvisDuringSteal == true
                    if _G._InvisOnStealV1 then _G._InvisOnStealV1.autoOnSteal = auto end
                    if not auto then
                        streakStart, offSince = nil, nil
                        failStreak = 0
                        _autoInvisOwned = false
                        return
                    end
                    if player:GetAttribute("Stealing") == true then
                        offSince = nil
                        streakStart = streakStart or tick()

                        if invisEngaged() then
                            _autoInvisOwned = true
                            failStreak = 0
                            return
                        end

                        if autoInvisBlocked() then return end
                        if _G.RecoveryInProgress then return end

                        local delay = math.clamp(tonumber(Config.Steal.AutoInvisDelay) or 0.3, 0, 3)
                        if (tick() - streakStart) < delay then return end

                        local gap = (failStreak >= 4) and 0.5 or 0.12
                        if tick() - lastTry < gap then return end
                        lastTry = tick()

                        if animPlaying or _G.invisibleStealEnabled then pcall(invisTurnOff) end
                        if charReadyForInvis() then
                            pcall(removeFolders)
                            local ok, res = pcall(invisTurnOn)
                            if ok and res == true and _G.invisibleStealEnabled then
                                _autoInvisOwned = true
                                failStreak = 0
                            else
                                failStreak = failStreak + 1
                            end
                        end
                    else
                        failStreak = 0
                        if streakStart or animPlaying or _G.invisibleStealEnabled then
                            offSince = offSince or tick()
                            local grace = math.clamp(tonumber(Config.Steal.AutoInvisGrace) or 0.3, 0.1, 3)
                            if tick() - offSince >= grace then
                                if (animPlaying or _G.invisibleStealEnabled) and _autoInvisOwned then
                                    pcall(invisTurnOff)
                                end
                                streakStart, offSince = nil, nil
                                _autoInvisOwned = false
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end)
            end
        end)

        player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(newChar)

            suppressAutoInvis(2.5)
            _G.RecoveryInProgress = false
            _autoInvisOwned = false
            task.wait(0.1)
            clearErrorOrb(); clearAllGhosts(); lagbackCallCount = 0
            pcall(function() for _, c in pairs(Workspace.CurrentCamera:GetChildren()) do if c:IsA("BasePart") and c.Name == "HumanoidRootPart" then c:Destroy() end end end)
            if oldRoot then pcall(function() oldRoot:Destroy() end); oldRoot = nil end
            if clone then pcall(function() clone:Destroy() end); clone = nil end
            if connection then connection:Disconnect(); connection = nil end
            if _invisSF    then pcall(function() _invisSF:Destroy()    end); _invisSF    = nil end
            if _invisSFAtt then pcall(function() _invisSFAtt:Destroy() end); _invisSFAtt = nil end
            animPlaying = false; _G.invisibleStealEnabled = false
            Config.Steal.InvisStealEnabled = false
            setToggle("Invisible Steal", false)
            if _G.updateMovementPanelInvisVisual then pcall(_G.updateMovementPanelInvisVisual, false) end
            task.wait(0.2)
            local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
            if camera and newChar then
                local h = newChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if h then camera.CameraSubject = h; camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom end
            end
        end)

        task.spawn(function()
            _G.AntiDieDisabled = false
            local function setupAntiDie()
                if _G.AntiDieDisabled or not Config.Steal.AntiDie then return end
                local character = player.Character
                if not character then return end
                local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if not humanoid then return end
                if _G.AntiDieConnection then pcall(function() _G.AntiDieConnection:Disconnect() end) end
                _G.AntiDieConnection = humanoid:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Health"):Connect(function()
                    if _G.AntiDieDisabled or not Config.Steal.AntiDie then return end
                    if humanoid.Health <= 0 then
                        humanoid.Health = humanoid.MaxHealth
                    end
                end)
            end
            _G.setupAntiDie = setupAntiDie
            setupAntiDie()
            player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
                task.wait(0.5)
                if not _G.AntiDieDisabled and Config.Steal.AntiDie then
                    setupAntiDie()
                end
            end)
        end)

        local function setupDeathListener()
            local ch = player.Character
            if ch then
                local h = ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if h then h.Died:Connect(function() clearErrorOrb(); clearAllGhosts(); lagbackCallCount = 0 end) end
            end
        end
        setupDeathListener()
        player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function() task.wait(0.1); setupDeathListener() end)

        _G.VXInvisActive = false

        do
            local shim = setmetatable({}, {
                __index = function(t, k)
                    if k == "semiInvisEnabled" then return _G.invisibleStealEnabled == true end
                    if k == "ROTATION" then return _G.InvisStealAngle end
                    if k == "autoRotateEnabled" then return _G.AutoRotateInvis == true end
                    return rawget(t, k)
                end,
                __newindex = function(t, k, v)
                    if k == "ROTATION" then _G.InvisStealAngle = v; return end
                    if k == "autoRotateEnabled" then _G.AutoRotateInvis = v; return end
                    rawset(t, k, v)
                end,
            })
            _G.InvisOnStealV1 = shim
            State.InvisOnStealV1 = shim
            State.InvisStealGui = State.InvisStealGui or { isInvisActive = false }
            State.startInvisOnStealV1 = function()
                if Config.Steal.AutoInvisDuringSteal then pcall(_G.startInvisOnStealV1) end
            end
            State.stopInvisOnStealV1 = function() pcall(_G.stopInvisOnStealV1) end
            State.createInvisStealGui = function() end
            State.enableV1SemiInvis = function()
                if not _G.invisibleStealEnabled then pcall(_G.toggleInvisibleSteal) end
            end
            State.disableV1SemiInvis = function()
                if _G.invisibleStealEnabled then pcall(_G.toggleInvisibleSteal) end
            end
        end

        _G.VX_autoRLast, _G.VX_autoRDir, _G.VX_autoRNext = 210, 1, 0
        RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            _G.VXInvisActive = _G.invisibleStealEnabled or false
            if State.InvisStealGui then State.InvisStealGui.isInvisActive = _G.invisibleStealEnabled or false end

            if _G.AutoRotateInvis then
                if _G.invisibleStealEnabled == true then
                    local now = tick()
                    if now >= _G.VX_autoRNext then
                        _G.VX_autoRLast = _G.VX_autoRLast + _G.VX_autoRDir * 2
                        if _G.VX_autoRLast >= 225 then _G.VX_autoRLast = 225; _G.VX_autoRDir = -1
                        elseif _G.VX_autoRLast <= 195 then _G.VX_autoRLast = 195; _G.VX_autoRDir = 1 end
                        _G.VX_autoRLast = math.clamp(_G.VX_autoRLast, 180, 360)
                        _G.VX_autoRNext = now + 0.15
                    end
                    _G.CurrentInvisRotation = _G.VX_autoRLast
                else
                    _G.VX_autoRLast, _G.VX_autoRDir, _G.VX_autoRNext = 210, 1, 0
                    _G.CurrentInvisRotation = 210
                end
            else
                _G.CurrentInvisRotation = nil
            end
        end)
    end

    do

        local TICK            = 0.10
        local CARPET_BUY_DUR  = 0.10
        local STEAL_HOLD      = 1.30
        local PLOT_RADIUS     = 9999
        local CARPET_RADIUS   = 17
        _G.VXStealHoldTime = STEAL_HOLD
        _G.VXCloneHopCost  = 0.30
        local BIND_MAX        = 40

        local function rootPart()
            local c = LocalPlayer.Character
            return c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        end
        local function carrying() return LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("Stealing") == true end
        local function stealOn()  return Config.Steal and Config.Steal.AutoStealEnabled == true end
        local function status(t)  if _G.VXStealStatus then pcall(_G.VXStealStatus, t) end end

        local getSignalConnections = getconnections or get_signal_cons
        local _cbCache = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
        local function callbacksFor(prompt)
            local cached = _cbCache[prompt]
            if cached then return cached end
            local function gather(signal)
                local out = {}
                if not (getSignalConnections and signal) then return out end
                local ok, conns = pcall(getSignalConnections, signal)
                if ok and type(conns) == "table" then
                    for _, cn in ipairs(conns) do
                        local fn = cn.Function
                        if not fn and type(cn.Get) == "function" then
                            local okGet, got = pcall(cn.Get, cn)
                            if okGet then fn = got end
                        end
                        if type(fn) == "function" then out[#out + 1] = fn end
                    end
                end
                return out
            end
            cached = {
                hold    = gather(prompt.PromptButtonHoldBegan),
                trigger = gather(prompt.Triggered),
            }
            _cbCache[prompt] = cached
            return cached
        end

        local function firePrompt(prompt)
            if not (prompt and prompt.Parent) then return false end
            local cbs = callbacksFor(prompt)

            if _G.VXStripNow then pcall(_G.VXStripNow) end
            _G.VXSafeNetCall(function()
                for _, fn in ipairs(cbs.hold) do task.spawn(fn) end
                pcall(function() prompt:InputHoldBegin() end)
                for _, fn in ipairs(cbs.trigger) do task.spawn(fn) end
                if #cbs.trigger == 0 and typeof(fireproximityprompt) == "function" then
                    pcall(fireproximityprompt, prompt)
                end
                pcall(function() prompt:InputHoldEnd() end)
            end)
            return true
        end

        local _holdBusy = false
        local _stealSuppressed = false
        local _holdStartedAt = 0
        local _holdPrompt = nil

        local function _stealLock(uid, secs)
            SharedState.StealLockUid = uid
            SharedState.StealLockUntil = tick() + (secs or (STEAL_HOLD + 0.6))
        end
        local function _stealUnlock()
            SharedState.StealLockUid = nil
            SharedState.StealLockUntil = 0
        end
        _G.VXStealLock = _stealLock
        _G.VXStealUnlock = _stealUnlock

        local _holdGen = 0

        local function _endHold()
            local p = _holdPrompt
            _holdGen = _holdGen + 1
            _holdBusy, _holdStartedAt, _holdPrompt = false, 0, nil
            if p then
                _G.VXSafeNetCall(function() pcall(function() p:InputHoldEnd() end) end)
            end
        end

        _G.VXStealHoldCancel = function() pcall(_endHold); pcall(_stealUnlock) end
        _G.VXStealHoldElapsed = function()
            if not _holdBusy or _holdStartedAt <= 0 then return 0 end
            return os.clock() - _holdStartedAt
        end

        local function holdSteal(prompt, uid)
            if _holdBusy then return true end
            if not (prompt and prompt.Parent) then return false end

            _holdGen = _holdGen + 1
            local gen = _holdGen
            local startedAt = os.clock()
            _holdBusy = true
            _holdPrompt = prompt
            _holdStartedAt = startedAt
            _stealLock(uid)

            task.spawn(function()
                local cbs = callbacksFor(prompt)
                if _G.VXStripNow then pcall(_G.VXStripNow) end
                _G.VXSafeNetCall(function()
                    for _, fn in ipairs(cbs.hold) do task.spawn(fn) end
                    pcall(function() prompt:InputHoldBegin() end)
                end)

                local ok = true
                while os.clock() - startedAt < STEAL_HOLD do
                    if _holdGen ~= gen or not prompt.Parent or carrying() or not stealOn() then
                        ok = false
                        break
                    end
                    _stealLock(uid, 1.0)
                    RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
                end

                if _holdGen ~= gen then return end

                if ok then
                    local held = os.clock() - startedAt
                    _G.VXSafeNetCall(function()
                        for _, fn in ipairs(cbs.trigger) do task.spawn(fn) end
                        if #cbs.trigger == 0 and typeof(fireproximityprompt) == "function" then
                            pcall(fireproximityprompt, prompt)
                        end
                        pcall(function() prompt:InputHoldEnd() end)
                    end)
                    _holdGen = _holdGen + 1
                    _holdBusy, _holdStartedAt, _holdPrompt = false, 0, nil
                    _G.VXLog("Steal", string.format("Grab fired - %.2fs held, uid %s", held, tostring(uid)))
                    task.delay(0.4, _stealUnlock)
                else
                    _endHold()
                    _stealUnlock()
                end
            end)
            return true
        end

        _G.VXStealSuppress = function(on)
            on = on and true or false
            if _stealSuppressed == on then return end
            _stealSuppressed = on
            if on then
                _endHold()
                local sel = SharedState.SelectedPetData
                if sel and not sel.isCarpet and sel.uid ~= nil then
                    SharedState.StealLockUid = tostring(sel.uid)
                    SharedState.StealLockUntil = tick() + 30
                else
                    _stealUnlock()
                end
            elseif not _holdBusy then
                local until_ = SharedState.StealLockUntil or 0
                local grace = tick() + 2
                if until_ > grace then SharedState.StealLockUntil = grace end
            end
        end

        _G.VXStealSuppressed = function() return _stealSuppressed end

        local function promptPosition(prompt)
            local p = prompt and prompt.Parent
            if not p then return nil end
            if p:IsA("Attachment") then return p.WorldPosition end
            if p:IsA("BasePart") then return p.Position end
            return nil
        end

        local function plotPrompt(sel)
            local p = sel.prompt
            if p and typeof(p) == "Instance" and p:IsA("ProximityPrompt") and p.Parent then return p end
            local plots = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")
            local plot = plots and sel.plot and plots:FindFirstChild(tostring(sel.plot))
            if not plot then return nil end
            local podiums = plot:FindFirstChild("AnimalPodiums")
            local podium = podiums and sel.slot and podiums:FindFirstChild(tostring(sel.slot))
            if not podium then return nil end
            local base = podium:FindFirstChild("Base")
            local spawn = base and base:FindFirstChild("Spawn")
            local attach = spawn and spawn:FindFirstChild("PromptAttachment")
            if attach then
                for _, d in ipairs(attach:GetChildren()) do
                    if d:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then return d end
                end
            end
            for _, d in ipairs(podium:GetDescendants()) do
                if d:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then return d end
            end
            return nil
        end

        _G.VXStealBeginHold = function(sel)
            sel = sel or SharedState.SelectedPetData
            if not sel or sel.isCarpet or sel.uid == nil then return false end
            if not stealOn() or carrying() then return false end
            if _holdBusy then return true end
            local prompt = plotPrompt(sel)
            if not (prompt and prompt.Parent) then return false end
            local started = holdSteal(prompt, tostring(sel.uid))
            if started then
                _G.VXLog("Steal", string.format("Hold started - %.2fs to complete, uid %s",
                    STEAL_HOLD, tostring(sel.uid)))
            end
            return started
        end

        local function isPurchasePrompt(p)
            if not (p and p:IsA("ProximityPrompt")) then return false end
            local t = (p.ActionText or ""):lower()
            return t:find("purchase", 1, true) ~= nil
            or t:find("comprar", 1, true) ~= nil
            or t:find("buy", 1, true) ~= nil
        end

        local function promptPart(prompt)
            local parent = prompt and prompt.Parent
            if not parent then return nil end
            local real = parent:IsA("Attachment") and parent.Parent or parent
            return (real and real:IsA("BasePart")) and real or nil
        end

        local function carpetPart(sel)
            local p = sel and sel._part
            if p and p.Parent then return p end
            local m = sel and sel._model
            if m and m.Parent then
                return m:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or m.PrimaryPart
                or m:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
            end
            return nil
        end

        local CV_RESCAN = 5
        local CV_BUDGET = 1200
        local _cvList, _cvAt, _cvBusy = {}, 0, false

        local function scanPurchasePrompts()
            _cvAt = os.clock()
            local found = {}
            pcall(function()
                for _, obj in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
                    if isPurchasePrompt(obj) then
                        local part = promptPart(obj)
                        if part then found[#found + 1] = { prompt = obj, part = part } end
                    end
                end
            end)
            _cvList = found
            return found
        end

        local function sweepPurchasePrompts()
            if _cvBusy then return end
            _cvBusy = true
            _cvAt = os.clock()
            task.spawn(function()
                local found = {}
                local ok = pcall(function()
                    local stack, seen = { Workspace }, 0
                    while #stack > 0 do
                        local node = table.remove(stack)
                        local okC, kids = pcall(node.GetChildren, node)
                        if okC and type(kids) == "table" then
                            for _, c in ipairs(kids) do
                                if isPurchasePrompt(c) then
                                    local part = promptPart(c)
                                    if part then found[#found + 1] = { prompt = c, part = part } end
                                else
                                    stack[#stack + 1] = c
                                end
                                seen = seen + 1
                                if seen >= CV_BUDGET then
                                    seen = 0
                                    RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end)
                if ok then _cvList = found end
                _cvAt   = os.clock()
                _cvBusy = false
            end)
        end

        pcall(function()
            local PPS = game:GetService("ProximityPromptService")
            PPS.PromptShown:Connect(function(prompt)
                if not isPurchasePrompt(prompt) then return end
                for _, e in ipairs(_cvList) do
                    if e.prompt == prompt then return end
                end
                local part = promptPart(prompt)
                if part then _cvList[#_cvList + 1] = { prompt = prompt, part = part } end
            end)
        end)

        local function carpetPrompt(sel)
            local p = sel.prompt
            if p and typeof(p) == "Instance" and p:IsA("ProximityPrompt") and p.Parent then return p end
            local target = carpetPart(sel)
            if not (target and target.Parent) then return nil end

            if _G.VXBuyPromptFor then
                local ok, hit = pcall(_G.VXBuyPromptFor, sel._model, target.Position)
                if ok and hit then return hit end
            end

            if (os.clock() - _cvAt) > CV_RESCAN then sweepPurchasePrompts() end
            local best, bestDist = nil, math.huge
            local tp = target.Position
            local dead
            for i = 1, #_cvList do
                local e = _cvList[i]
                if e.prompt.Parent and e.part.Parent then
                    local d = (tp - e.part.Position).Magnitude
                    if d < bestDist then bestDist = d; best = e.prompt end
                else
                    dead = dead or {}
                    dead[#dead + 1] = i
                end
            end

            if dead then
                for i = #dead, 1, -1 do table.remove(_cvList, dead[i]) end
            end
            if best and bestDist <= BIND_MAX then return best end
            return nil
        end

        _G.VXCarpetState  = _G.VXCarpetState or { hasPrompt = false, inRange = false, dist = math.huge, t = 0 }
        _G.VXCarpetBuyDur = CARPET_BUY_DUR

        local function runOnce()
            if not stealOn() then status("AUTO STEAL . OFF") return end
            if carrying() then status("CARRYING") return end
            if _stealSuppressed then status("AUTO STEAL . ARMED") return end
            local sel = SharedState.SelectedPetData
            if not sel then status("AUTO STEAL . NO TARGET") return end
            local root = rootPart()
            if not root then return end
            local st = _G.VXCarpetState
            local name = tostring(sel.petName or sel.name or "TARGET"):upper()

            if sel.isCarpet then

                if Config.DisableCarpetBuying == true then
                    st.hasPrompt, st.inRange, st.dist, st.t = false, false, math.huge, os.clock()
                    status("CARPET BUYING . OFF . " .. name)
                    return
                end
                local part = carpetPart(sel)
                local dist = (part and part.Parent)
                and (root.Position - part.Position).Magnitude or math.huge
                if dist > CARPET_RADIUS then
                    st.hasPrompt, st.inRange, st.dist, st.t = false, false, dist, os.clock()
                    status("CARPET . " .. ((dist < math.huge) and math.floor(dist + 0.5) or "?") .. " STUDS . " .. name)
                    return
                end
                local prompt = carpetPrompt(sel)
                if not prompt then
                    st.hasPrompt, st.inRange, st.dist, st.t = false, true, dist, os.clock()
                    status("CARPET . NO PURCHASE PROMPT . " .. name)
                    return
                end
                st.hasPrompt, st.inRange, st.dist, st.t = true, true, dist, os.clock()

                if _G.firePurchaseNatural then
                    pcall(_G.firePurchaseNatural, prompt)
                else
                    firePrompt(prompt)
                end
                status("CARPET . BUYING . " .. name)
                return
            end

            st.hasPrompt, st.inRange = false, false
            local prompt = plotPrompt(sel)
            if not prompt then status("NO STEAL PROMPT . " .. name) return end
            local pos = promptPosition(prompt) or sel.position
            local dist = pos and (root.Position - pos).Magnitude or math.huge
            if dist > PLOT_RADIUS then
                status("OUT OF RANGE . " .. name)
                return
            end

            holdSteal(prompt, tostring(sel.uid))
            status("STEALING . " .. name)
        end

        local _pumpAt = 0
        local function pump()
            local now = os.clock()
            if (now - _pumpAt) < 0.03 then return end
            _pumpAt = now
            pcall(runOnce)
        end

        task.spawn(function()
            task.wait(1)
            while true do
                if stealOn() then
                    task.wait(TICK)
                    pump()
                else
                    task.wait(0.5)
                end
            end
        end)

        pcall(function()
            LocalPlayer:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Stealing"):Connect(function()
                _G.VXStealPhase = carrying() and "CARRYING" or _G.VXStealPhase
                pump()
            end)
        end)

        pcall(function()
            SharedState.OnBrainrotList(function()
                if stealOn() then pump() end
            end)
        end)

        pcall(function()
            LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
                task.delay(0.35, function() if stealOn() then pump() end end)
            end)
        end)

        _G.VXStealPump       = pump
        _G.VXStealOnArrival  = function() pcall(runOnce) end
        _G.VXStealFireNearest = function() pcall(runOnce) end
        _G.VXCarpetOnArrival = function()
            pcall(scanPurchasePrompts)
            pcall(runOnce)
        end
        _G.VXAutoStealCancel = function() status("AUTO STEAL . OFF") end
        _G.VXCarpetPart      = carpetPart
        _G.VXCarpetRescan    = scanPurchasePrompts
        _G.VXCarpetBuyRadius = CARPET_RADIUS
    end

    if type(_G.VXStealStatus) ~= "function" then
        _G.VXStealStatus = function(_txt) end
    end

    local function _vxShortNum(v)
        v = tonumber(v) or 0
        for _, u in ipairs({ {1e15,"Q"}, {1e12,"T"}, {1e9,"B"}, {1e6,"M"}, {1e3,"K"} }) do
            if math.abs(v) >= u[1] then
                local s = string.format("%.2f", v / u[1]):gsub("%.?0+$", "")
                return s .. u[2]
            end
        end
        return tostring(math.floor(v + 0.5))
    end
    local function _vxGenText(v) return "$" .. _vxShortNum(v) .. "/s" end

    local function syncConfig()
        local g = _G.__VXGuiConfig
        if type(g) ~= "table" then return end
        local gt = g.TpSettings or {}
        local t = Config.TpSettings
        if gt.TpVelocity          ~= nil then t.TpVelocity          = tonumber(gt.TpVelocity) or t.TpVelocity end
        if gt.TeleportMethod      ~= nil then t.TeleportMethod      = gt.TeleportMethod end
        if gt.PathVisuals         ~= nil then t.PathVisuals         = gt.PathVisuals and true or false end
        if gt.SecondFloorRoute    ~= nil then t.SecondFloorRoute    = gt.SecondFloorRoute end
        if gt.CloneAfterTP        ~= nil then t.CloneAfterTP        = gt.CloneAfterTP and true or false end
