        if gt.GoToBrainrotAfterTP ~= nil then t.GoToBrainrotAfterTP = gt.GoToBrainrotAfterTP and true or false end
        if gt.ChainBurstFreq      ~= nil then t.ChainBurstFreq      = tonumber(gt.ChainBurstFreq) or t.ChainBurstFreq end
        if gt.ChainMaxDist        ~= nil then t.ChainMaxDist        = tonumber(gt.ChainMaxDist) or t.ChainMaxDist end
        if gt.TpOnLoad            ~= nil then t.TpOnLoad            = gt.TpOnLoad and true or false end
        if gt.Tool                ~= nil then t.Tool                = gt.Tool end
        if g.MinGenForAutoTP      ~= nil then Config.MinGenForAutoTP = tonumber(g.MinGenForAutoTP) or 0 end
        if g.TpToCarpets          ~= nil then Config.TpToCarpets     = g.TpToCarpets and true or false end
        if g.AntiBaiter           ~= nil then Config.AntiBaiter      = g.AntiBaiter and true or false end
        if g.DisableCarpetBuying  ~= nil then Config.DisableCarpetBuying = g.DisableCarpetBuying and true or false end
        if type(g.AutoTPAlertSoundID) == "string" then
            local n = g.AutoTPAlertSoundID:gsub("%D", "")
            if n ~= "" then Config.AutoTPAlertSoundID = n end
        end

        do
            local mode = _vxDeriveStealMode(g)
            if mode then
                Config.StealMode = mode
                Config.Steal.AutoStealMode = mode
                Config.Steal.AutoStealEnabled = true
            elseif Config.Steal.AutoStealEnabled then

                Config.Steal.AutoStealEnabled = false
                if _G.VXAutoStealCancel then pcall(_G.VXAutoStealCancel) end
            end
        end

        if g.InvisStealAngle      ~= nil then Config.Steal.InvisStealAngle      = math.clamp(tonumber(g.InvisStealAngle) or 225, 180, 360) end
        if g.SinkSliderValue      ~= nil then Config.Steal.SinkSliderValue      = math.clamp(tonumber(g.SinkSliderValue) or 8, 5, 10) end
        if g.AutoInvisDuringSteal ~= nil then Config.Steal.AutoInvisDuringSteal = g.AutoInvisDuringSteal and true or false end

        if g.PriorityListInitialized == true and type(g.PriorityList) == "table" then
            local nl = {}
            for i = 1, #g.PriorityList do
                if type(g.PriorityList[i]) == "string" then nl[#nl + 1] = g.PriorityList[i] end
            end
            Config.PriorityList = nl
        end
    end
    syncConfig()
    task.spawn(function() while true do task.wait(0.5); pcall(syncConfig) end end)

    do
        local g = _G.__VXGuiConfig or {}
        _G.InvisStealAngle      = tonumber(g.InvisStealAngle) or _G.InvisStealAngle
        _G.SinkSliderValue      = tonumber(g.SinkSliderValue) or _G.SinkSliderValue
        _G.AutoInvisDuringSteal = g.AutoInvisDuringSteal and true or false
    end

    local _lastAlertAt = 0
    local function playAlert()

        if (os.clock() - _lastAlertAt) < 1.5 then return end
        _lastAlertAt = os.clock()

        local raw = Config.AutoTPAlertSoundID
        if raw == nil or raw == "" then return end
        local id = tostring(raw):gsub("%D", "")
        if id == "" then return end

        pcall(function()
            local s = Instance.new("Sound")
            s.Name = _vxName("VXAlertSound")
            s.SoundId = "rbxassetid://" .. id
            s.Volume = 3
            s.PlayOnRemove = false
            s.Parent = game:GetService("SoundService")

            task.spawn(function()
                local t0 = os.clock()
                while not s.IsLoaded and (os.clock() - t0) < 5 do task.wait(0.05) end
                pcall(function() s:Play() end)
            end)
            game:GetService("Debris"):AddItem(s, 15)
        end)
        _G.VXLog("Alert", "Alert sound played - asset " .. id)
    end

    do
        local seenUids, primed, lastAlert = {}, false, 0
        local _floorWarned = false

        local function isPriority(name)
            local list = Config.PriorityList
            if type(list) ~= "table" or name == nil then return false end
            local want = tostring(name):lower()
            for _, n in ipairs(list) do
                if tostring(n):lower() == want then return true end
            end
            return false
        end

        SharedState.OnBrainrotList(function()
            local cache = SharedState.AllAnimalsCache
            if type(cache) ~= "table" then return end

            local current, fresh = {}, {}

            local settled = SharedState.VXCoverageDone == true
            and (os.clock() - (SharedState.VXCoverageAt or math.huge)) > 3

            for _, p in ipairs(cache) do
                local uid = tostring(p.uid or "")
                if uid ~= "" then
                    current[uid] = true
                    if primed and settled and not seenUids[uid] then
                        fresh[#fresh + 1] = p
                    end
                end
            end
            seenUids = current
            primed = true

            if #fresh == 0 then return end
            if (os.clock() - lastAlert) <= 3 then return end

            local floorGen = _G.VXBaseGenByName and _G.VXBaseGenByName("Globa Steppa") or nil
            if not floorGen then
                if not _floorWarned then
                    _floorWarned = true
                    _G.VXLog("Spawn", "Globa Steppa base generation unresolved - spawn alerts held until animal data loads")
                end
                return
            end

            local cands = {}
            for _, p in ipairs(fresh) do
                local baseGen = _G.VXBaseGenByName(p.name)
                if baseGen and baseGen >= floorGen then cands[#cands + 1] = p end
            end
            if #cands == 0 then return end

            local rankOf = {}
            pcall(function()
                local ranked = _G.VXGetPets and _G.VXGetPets() or nil
                if type(ranked) ~= "table" then return end
                for i, e in ipairs(ranked) do
                    local u = tostring(e.uid or "")
                    if u ~= "" and rankOf[u] == nil then rankOf[u] = i end
                end
            end)

            table.sort(cands, function(a, b)
                local ra = rankOf[tostring(a.uid)] or math.huge
                local rb = rankOf[tostring(b.uid)] or math.huge
                if ra ~= rb then return ra < rb end
                return (tonumber(a.genValue) or 0) > (tonumber(b.genValue) or 0)
            end)

            local best = cands[1]
            lastAlert = os.clock()
            local mode = (SharedState.GetStealMode and SharedState.GetStealMode()) or "Highest"
            _G.VXLog("Spawn", string.format(
                "%s appeared - %s - mutation %s - best of %d new (%s mode)%s",
                tostring(best.name), tostring(best.genText or "$0/s"),
                tostring(best.mutation or "None"), #cands, tostring(mode),
                isPriority(best.name) and " - on priority list" or ""))
            if _G.VXShowAutoTPNotif then
                pcall(_G.VXShowAutoTPNotif, best.name, best.genText, best.index, best, "")
            end
            playAlert()
        end)
    end

    local _VALID_MODE = { Nearest = true, Highest = true, Priority = true }
    _G.VXSetStealMode = function(modeName)
        if not _VALID_MODE[modeName] then modeName = nil end
        if modeName then
            Config.StealMode = modeName
            Config.Steal.AutoStealMode = modeName
            Config.Steal.AutoStealEnabled = true
        else
            Config.Steal.AutoStealEnabled = false
            if _G.VXAutoStealCancel then pcall(_G.VXAutoStealCancel) end
        end
    end

    _G.VXGetPriorityList = function()
        local out = {}
        for i, n in ipairs(Config.PriorityList or {}) do out[i] = n end
        return out
    end
    _G.VXSetPriorityList = function(list)
        if type(list) ~= "table" then return end
        local nl = {}
        for i = 1, #list do if type(list[i]) == "string" then nl[#nl + 1] = list[i] end end

        Config.PriorityList = nl
    end

    local _buildPetList
    do
        local allAnimalsCache = {}
        SharedState.AllAnimalsCache = allAnimalsCache

        local _AD, _MD, _TD

        local function _data()
            if _AD then return true end

            local pre = SharedState.Pre
            if pre and pre.Animals then
                _AD, _MD, _TD = pre.Animals, pre.Mutations, pre.Traits
            end
            local ok = _AD ~= nil or pcall(function()
                local d = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Datas")
                _AD = require(d:WaitForChild("Animals"))
                _MD = require(d:WaitForChild("Mutations"))
                _TD = require(d:WaitForChild("Traits"))
            end)
            if ok and _AD and not _G.VXAnimalIndexByDisplay then
                pcall(function()
                    local map = {}
                    for idx, info in pairs(_AD) do
                        if type(info) == "table" and info.DisplayName then
                            map[tostring(info.DisplayName):lower()] = tostring(idx)
                        end
                    end
                    _G.VXAnimalIndexByDisplay = map
                end)
            end
            return ok and _AD ~= nil
        end

        local function _resolveIndex(nm)
            if nm == nil then return nil end
            if not _data() then return nil end
            if _AD[nm] ~= nil then return nm end
            local map = _G.VXAnimalIndexByDisplay
            local i = map and map[tostring(nm):lower()]
            if i ~= nil and _AD[i] ~= nil then return i end
            return nil
        end
        _G.VXResolveAnimalIndex = _resolveIndex

        local function _plotOwnerName(plot)
            local sign = plot:FindFirstChild("PlotSign")
            if not sign then return "" end
            local gui = sign:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SurfaceGui", true)
            if not gui then return "" end
            local label = gui:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextLabel", true)
            if not label then return "" end
            local text = label.Text
            if not text or text == "" or text:lower():find("empty") then return "" end
            local owner = text:match("^(.+)'s Base$") or text
            return (owner:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", ""))
        end
        _G.VXPlotSignOwner = _plotOwnerName

        local function _podiumAnimal(podium)
            for _, d in ipairs(podium:GetDescendants()) do
                if d:IsA("Model") then
                    local idx = _resolveIndex(d.Name)
                    if idx ~= nil then return d, idx end
                end
            end
            return nil, nil
        end

        local function _attrs(inst)
            local ok, a = pcall(function() return inst:GetAttributes() end)
            if not ok or type(a) ~= "table" then return "" end
            local parts = {}
            for k, v in pairs(a) do parts[#parts + 1] = tostring(k) .. "=" .. tostring(v) end
            if #parts == 0 then return "" end
            table.sort(parts)
            return "   {" .. table.concat(parts, ", "):sub(1, 150) .. "}"
        end

        _G.VXTree = function(root, maxDepth, maxKids, tag)
            if not root then return end
            tag = tag or "Tree"
            maxDepth = maxDepth or 4
            maxKids = maxKids or 12
            _G.VXLog(tag, root:GetFullName() .. "  [" .. root.ClassName .. "]" .. _attrs(root))
            local function walk(inst, depth, prefix)
                if depth > maxDepth then return end
                local kids = inst:GetChildren()
                for i, c in ipairs(kids) do
                    if i > maxKids then
                        _G.VXLog(tag, prefix .. "... +" .. (#kids - maxKids) .. " more")
                        break
                    end
                    _G.VXLog(tag, prefix .. c.Name .. "  [" .. c.ClassName .. "]" .. _attrs(c))
                    walk(c, depth + 1, prefix .. "|  ")
                end
            end
            walk(root, 1, "|  ")
        end

        _G.VXDumpStructure = function()
            _G.VXRule("Struct", "Workspace Layout")
            local wsNames = {}
            for _, c in ipairs(Workspace:GetChildren()) do wsNames[#wsNames + 1] = c.Name end
            table.sort(wsNames)
            _G.VXLog("Struct", "Workspace children: " .. table.concat(wsNames, ", "):sub(1, 300))

            local plots = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")
            if not plots then
                _G.VXLog("Struct", "Workspace.Plots MISSING - plots may have been renamed/moved")
                return
            end

            local myPlot = _G.VXFindMyPlot and _G.VXFindMyPlot() or nil
            local target, targetPods
            for _, plot in ipairs(plots:GetChildren()) do
                local pods = plot:FindFirstChild("AnimalPodiums")
                if pods and plot ~= myPlot then
                    for _, pd in ipairs(pods:GetChildren()) do
                        for _, d in ipairs(pd:GetDescendants()) do
                            if d:IsA("Model") then target, targetPods = plot, pods break end
                        end
                        if target then break end
                    end
                end
                if target then break end
            end
            if not target then
                _G.VXLog("Struct", "No plot has any Model under AnimalPodiums - dumping first plot raw")
                target = plots:GetChildren()[1]
                targetPods = target and target:FindFirstChild("AnimalPodiums")
            end

            _G.VXRule("Struct", "Plot " .. tostring(target and target.Name))
            if targetPods then
                local pods = targetPods:GetChildren()
                _G.VXLog("Struct", "AnimalPodiums has " .. #pods .. " children")
                for i, pd in ipairs(pods) do
                    if i > 3 then break end
                    _G.VXTree(pd, 4, 10, "Struct")
                end
            else
                _G.VXLog("Struct", "This plot has no AnimalPodiums child")
                _G.VXTree(target, 2, 14, "Struct")
            end

            _G.VXRule("Struct", "Working Carpet Reference")
            local rma = Workspace:FindFirstChild("RenderedMovingAnimals")
            if rma then
                local first = rma:GetChildren()[1]
                _G.VXLog("Struct", "RenderedMovingAnimals has " .. #rma:GetChildren() .. " children")
                if first then _G.VXTree(first, 2, 8, "Struct") end
            else
                _G.VXLog("Struct", "RenderedMovingAnimals MISSING")
            end

            _G.VXRule("Struct", "Name Resolution Test")
            local tested, resolved = 0, 0
            if targetPods then
                for _, pd in ipairs(targetPods:GetChildren()) do
                    for _, d in ipairs(pd:GetDescendants()) do
                        if d:IsA("Model") and tested < 10 then
                            tested = tested + 1
                            local hit = _AD and (_AD[d.Name] ~= nil)
                            if hit then resolved = resolved + 1 end
                            _G.VXLog("Struct", string.format("Model '%s' under %s -> %s",
                                d.Name, pd.Name, hit and "RESOLVES in Datas.Animals" or "NOT in Datas.Animals"))
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            _G.VXField("Struct", "Models tested", tested)
            _G.VXField("Struct", "Resolved by name", resolved)
            _G.VXField("Struct", "Datas.Animals loaded", _AD and "Yes" or "NO")
            _G.VXRule("Struct", "End Structure Dump")
        end

        _G.VXDiag = function()
            local F = _G.VXField
            _G.VXRule("Diag", "Plot Scanner Diagnostic")

            F("Diag", "Scan source", "Synchronizer CacheTable via VXSProp, + rendered Models")
            F("Diag", "Channel discovery", tostring(_G.VXSyncDiag or "not resolved yet"))
            F("Diag", "StreamingEnabled", tostring(Workspace.StreamingEnabled))

            local plots = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")
            F("Diag", "Workspace.Plots", plots and (#plots:GetChildren() .. " plots") or "MISSING")
            if plots then
                for _, plot in ipairs(plots:GetChildren()) do
                    -- mesmo resolvedor do scan (UUID -> "Plot"..Order), senao o
                    -- diagnostico acusa "no channel" em base que o scan le bem
                    local ch = _G.VXPlotChannel and _G.VXPlotChannel(plot)
                    if not ch then
                        F("Diag", "Plot " .. plot.Name, "no channel (UUID nor Plot" ..
                            tostring(plot:GetAttribute("Order")) .. ")")
                    else
                        local al = _G.VXSProp(ch, "AnimalList")
                        local ow = _G.VXSProp(ch, "Owner")
                        local cnt = 0
                        if type(al) == "table" then for _ in pairs(al) do cnt = cnt + 1 end end
                        local oname = "nil"
                        if type(ow) == "table" then oname = tostring(rawget(ow, "Name"))
                        elseif ow ~= nil then oname = tostring(ow) end
                        local pods = plot:FindFirstChild("AnimalPodiums")
                        local filled = 0
                        if pods then
                            for _, pd in ipairs(pods:GetChildren()) do
                                if _podiumAnimal(pd) then filled = filled + 1 end
                            end
                        end
                        F("Diag", "Plot " .. plot.Name, string.format(
                            "AnimalList=%s(%d) Owner=%s inServer=%s sign=%s streamed=%d",
                            (type(al) == "table") and "table" or tostring(al), cnt, oname,
                            (oname ~= "nil" and Players:FindFirstChild(oname)) and "yes" or "NO",
                            (_plotOwnerName(plot) ~= "" and _plotOwnerName(plot) or "-"), filled))
                    end
                    local pods = plot:FindFirstChild("AnimalPodiums")
                    if pods then
                        local models = 0
                        for _, pd in ipairs(pods:GetChildren()) do
                            for _, d in ipairs(pd:GetChildren()) do
                                if d:IsA("Model") then models = models + 1 end
                            end
                        end
                        F("Diag", "  Podiums " .. plot.Name, #pods:GetChildren() .. " podiums, " .. models .. " models on them")
                    end
                end
            end
            F("Diag", "Cache size", #(SharedState.AllAnimalsCache or {}))
            _G.VXRule("Diag", "End Diagnostic")
        end

        local function _vxGen(index, mutation, traits)
            if not _data() then return 0 end
            local info = _AD[index]
            if not info or not info.Generation then return 0 end
            local mult = 1
            if mutation and mutation ~= "None" and mutation ~= "" then
                local m = _MD[mutation]
                if m and m.Modifier then mult = mult + m.Modifier end
            end
            if type(traits) == "table" then
                for _, tr in ipairs(traits) do
                    local t = _TD[tr]
                    if t and t.MultiplierModifier then mult = mult + t.MultiplierModifier end
                end
            end
            return info.Generation * mult
        end
        _G._vxGen = _G._vxGen or _vxGen

        local _baseGenCache = {}
        _G.VXBaseGenByName = _G.VXBaseGenByName or function(name)
            if not name then return nil end
            local key = tostring(name):lower()
            local hit = _baseGenCache[key]
            if hit ~= nil then return hit or nil end
            local g = nil
            if _data() then
                local idx = _G.VXAnimalIndexByDisplay and _G.VXAnimalIndexByDisplay[key]
                local info = (idx and _AD[idx]) or _AD[name]
                if not info then
                    for _, inf in pairs(_AD) do
                        if type(inf) == "table" and inf.DisplayName and inf.DisplayName:lower() == key then
                            info = inf; break
                        end
                    end
                end
                if type(info) == "table" then g = info.Generation end
            end
            _baseGenCache[key] = g or false
            return g
        end

        _G.VXAllAnimals = function()
            if not _data() then return {} end
            local out = {}
            for idx, info in pairs(_AD) do
                if type(info) == "table" and info.DisplayName then
                    out[#out + 1] = {
                        name = info.DisplayName,
                        rarity = info.Rarity or "Common",
                        gen = tonumber(info.Generation) or 0,
                    }
                end
            end
            return out
        end

        local _entryPool, _poolSeen, _poolGen = {}, {}, 0
        _buildPetList = function()
            local out = {}
            local cache = SharedState.AllAnimalsCache
            if not cache or type(cache) ~= "table" then return out end
            local g = _G.__VXGuiConfig or {}
            local minGen = parseMoney(tostring(g.MinGenForNearest or "")) or 0
            if minGen <= 0 then
                minGen = parseMoney(tostring((g.TpSettings and g.TpSettings.MinGenForTp) or "")) or 0
            end
            local BLACKLIST_SET, PRIORITY_MIN = {}, {}
            if type(g.PriorityBlacklist) == "table" then
                for _, n in ipairs(g.PriorityBlacklist) do
                    if type(n) == "string" then BLACKLIST_SET[n:lower()] = true end
                end
            end
            if type(g.PriorityMinGen) == "table" then
                for k, v in pairs(g.PriorityMinGen) do
                    if type(k) == "string" and tonumber(v) then PRIORITY_MIN[k:lower()] = tonumber(v) end
                end
            end

            local prioRank = {}
            for i, pName in ipairs(Config.PriorityList or {}) do
                local k = tostring(pName):lower()
                if prioRank[k] == nil then prioRank[k] = i end
            end

            _poolGen = _poolGen + 1
            for _, a in ipairs(cache) do

                local lname = a and a._lname
                if a and lname == nil then
                    lname = a.name and tostring(a.name):lower() or false
                    a._lname = lname
                end
                --  Debris pets have no podium, so no slot and no prompt --
                --  plotPrompt() cannot resolve one and the steal would sit on
                --  "NO STEAL PROMPT" forever. Gate them behind the existing
                --  TP to Stolen toggle, which is the setting that already means
                --  "consider brainrots that are not on a podium".
                local debrisOk = (not a) or (not a.isDebris) or (Config.TpToStolen == true)
                if a and debrisOk and (a.genValue or 0) >= 1
                and not (lname and BLACKLIST_SET[lname]) then
                    local lidx = a._lindex
                    if lidx == nil then
                        lidx = a.index and tostring(a.index):lower() or false
                        a._lindex = lidx
                    end
                    local isBrainrot = ((tonumber(a.genValue) or 0) >= 10000000)
                    local isPriority = (lname and prioRank[lname] ~= nil)
                    or (lidx and prioRank[lidx] ~= nil)
                    if minGen > 0 and (tonumber(a.genValue) or 0) < minGen and not isBrainrot and not isPriority then
                    else
                        local key = a.uid or a
                        local e = _entryPool[key]
                        if not e then e = {}; _entryPool[key] = e end
                        _poolSeen[key] = _poolGen

                        e.name = a.name; e.petName = a.name
                        e.mpsText = a.genText; e.mpsValue = a.genValue; e.mps = a.genValue
                        e.petValue = a.petValue or 0; e.value = a.petValue or 0
                        e.rarity = a.rarity; e.price = a.price
                        e.owner = a.owner; e.plot = a.plot; e.slot = a.slot; e.uid = a.uid
                        e.mutation = a.mutation; e.traits = a.traits; e.animalData = a; e.index = a.index
                        e.prompt = a.prompt; e.position = a.position

                        e.isCarpet = a.isCarpet; e._part = a._part; e._model = a._model; e.model = a.model
                        e._lname = lname
                        out[#out + 1] = e
                    end
                end
            end

            if g.TpToStolen and _G.VXGetSteals then
                local okSteals, steals = pcall(_G.VXGetSteals)
                if okSteals and type(steals) == "table" then
                    for _, sd in pairs(steals) do
                        local plr = sd and sd.player
                        local podium = sd and sd.currentPodium
                        if plr and plr.Parent and plr ~= LocalPlayer and podium and podium.Parent then
                            local idxName = plr:GetAttribute("StealingIndex")
                            local lidxName = idxName and tostring(idxName):lower() or nil

                            local liveDup = false
                            if lidxName then
                                for _, e2 in ipairs(cache) do
                                    if not e2.isCarpet
                                    and ((e2.index and tostring(e2.index):lower() == lidxName)
                                        or (e2.name and tostring(e2.name):lower() == lidxName)) then
                                        liveDup = true
                                        break
                                    end
                                end
                            end

                            local myPlot = _G.VXFindMyPlot and _G.VXFindMyPlot() or nil
                            local ownPlot = myPlot and sd.plot and tostring(sd.plot) == myPlot.Name

                            if lidxName and not BLACKLIST_SET[lidxName]
                            and not liveDup and not ownPlot then

                                local genV, genT, rar, mut, trt = 0, "$0/s", nil, "None", nil
                                local row = sd.petRow
                                if not row then
                                    for _, e2 in ipairs(cache) do
                                        if e2.name == idxName or e2.index == idxName then row = e2 break end
                                    end
                                end
                                local dispName = idxName
                                if row then
                                    genV = row.genValue or 0; genT = row.genText or genT
                                    rar = row.rarity; mut = row.mutation or mut; trt = row.traits
                                    if row.name then dispName = row.name end
                                end

                                if dispName == idxName and _AD then
                                    local info = _AD[idxName]
                                    if type(info) == "table" and info.DisplayName then
                                        dispName = info.DisplayName
                                    end
                                end
                                local base = podium:FindFirstChild("Base")
                                local spawnP = base and base:FindFirstChild("Spawn")
                                local part = spawnP or base or (podium:IsA("BasePart") and podium)
                                local isPriority = prioRank[lidxName] ~= nil
                                local plotName, slotName = sd.plot, sd.slot
                                if part and plotName and slotName
                                and not (minGen > 0 and genV < minGen and not isPriority) then
                                    local key = "STOLEN_" .. plr.UserId
                                    local e = _entryPool[key]
                                    if not e then e = {}; _entryPool[key] = e end
                                    _poolSeen[key] = _poolGen

                                    e.name = dispName; e.petName = dispName
                                    e.mpsText = genT; e.mpsValue = genV; e.mps = genV
                                    e.petValue = 0; e.value = 0
                                    e.rarity = rar; e.price = nil
                                    e.owner = plr.Name
                                    e.plot = tostring(plotName); e.slot = tostring(slotName); e.uid = key
                                    e.mutation = mut; e.traits = trt; e.index = idxName
                                    e.animalData = { plot = tostring(plotName), slot = tostring(slotName),
                                    name = dispName, index = idxName, uid = key }
                                    e.prompt = nil; e.position = part.Position

                                    e.isCarpet = nil; e.isStolen = true
                                    e._part = part; e._model = nil; e.model = nil
                                    e._lname = lidxName
                                    out[#out + 1] = e
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end

            for k, seenGen in pairs(_poolSeen) do
                if seenGen ~= _poolGen then _poolSeen[k] = nil; _entryPool[k] = nil end
            end

            local mode = (g.StealNearest and "Nearest") or (g.StealPriority and "Priority")
            or (g.StealHighest and "Highest") or nil
            if mode == "Priority" then

                local mutRank = {}
                for i, mName in ipairs(g.MutationPriorityList or {}) do
                    local k = tostring(mName):lower()
                    if mutRank[k] == nil then mutRank[k] = i end
                end
                local traitRank = {}
                for i, tName in ipairs(g.TraitPriorityList or {}) do
                    local k = tostring(tName):lower()
                    if traitRank[k] == nil then traitRank[k] = i end
                end

                for _, p in ipairs(out) do
                    local ln = p._lname
                    local r = (ln and prioRank[ln]) or 999
                    local mn = ln and PRIORITY_MIN[ln]
                    if mn and (p.mpsValue or 0) < mn then r = 999 end
                    p._prank = r

                    local mu = p.mutation
                    p._mrank = (mu and mu ~= "None" and mutRank[tostring(mu):lower()]) or 999

                    local best = 999
                    if p.traits and p.traits ~= "None" and p.traits ~= "" then
                        for tName in tostring(p.traits):gmatch("[^,]+") do
                            local tk = tName:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", ""):lower()
                            local tr = traitRank[tk]
                            if tr and tr < best then best = tr end
                        end
                    end
                    p._trank = best
                end

                table.sort(out, function(a, b)
                    if a._prank ~= b._prank then return a._prank < b._prank end
                    if a._mrank ~= b._mrank then return a._mrank < b._mrank end
                    if a._trank ~= b._trank then return a._trank < b._trank end
                    return (a.mpsValue or 0) > (b.mpsValue or 0)
                end)
            elseif mode == "Nearest" then
                local hrp = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if hrp then
                    local hp = hrp.Position
                    for _, p in ipairs(out) do
                        local pos = p.position
                        if not pos then
                            local part = p.animalData and findAdorneeGlobal(p.animalData)
                            pos = part and part.Position or nil
                        end
                        p.distance = pos and (hp - pos).Magnitude or math.huge
                    end
                    table.sort(out, function(a, b) return (a.distance or math.huge) < (b.distance or math.huge) end)
                end
            else
                table.sort(out, function(a, b) return (a.mpsValue or 0) > (b.mpsValue or 0) end)
            end
            return out
        end

        task.spawn(function()
            if not _data() then return end

            local NumberUtils
            pcall(function()
                NumberUtils = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Utils", 5):WaitForChild("NumberUtils", 5))
            end)
            local function genText(gv)
                if NumberUtils and NumberUtils.ToString then
                    local ok, s = pcall(function() return NumberUtils:ToString(gv) end)
                    if ok and s then return "$" .. s .. "/s" end
                end
                return _vxGenText(gv)
            end

            local lastAnimalData = {}

            -- devolve quantas linhas saiu: os caminhos de saida antecipada do
            -- scan precisam saber se o cache MUDOU pra republicar. Antes eles
            -- dropavam em silencio e a UI seguia mostrando o pet que ja tinha
            -- sido removido, ate a proxima mudanca de hash de outra base.
            local function dropPlot(name)
                local n = 0
                for i = #allAnimalsCache, 1, -1 do
                    if allAnimalsCache[i].plot == name then
                        table.remove(allAnimalsCache, i); n = n + 1
                    end
                end
                return n
            end

            local _uiDirty = false
            task.spawn(function()

                local bsName = _vxName("BrainrotSelectionUI")
                local wasRevealed = false
                while true do
                    task.wait(0.08)

                    local revealedMap = _G.VXRevealedGuis
                    local isRevealed = (revealedMap == nil) or (revealedMap[bsName] == true)
                    if isRevealed and not wasRevealed then
                        wasRevealed = true
                        _uiDirty = true
                    end
                    if _uiDirty then
                        _uiDirty = false

                        if isRevealed and SharedState.UpdateBrainrotSelectionUI then
                            pcall(SharedState.UpdateBrainrotSelectionUI)
                        end

                        if SharedState.NotifyBrainrotList then
                            pcall(SharedState.NotifyBrainrotList)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end)

            local _cacheDirty = false
            local function _sortCache()
                table.sort(allAnimalsCache, function(a, b)
                    if a.genValue ~= b.genValue then return a.genValue > b.genValue end
                    return tostring(a.uid) < tostring(b.uid)
                end)
            end

            local function publish()
                SharedState.AllAnimalsCache = allAnimalsCache
                SharedState.ListNeedsRedraw = true
                SharedState.SelectionDirty = true
                _cacheDirty = true
                _uiDirty = true
            end

            _G.VXFlushCache = function()
                if not _cacheDirty then return end
                _cacheDirty = false
                _sortCache()
                if not SharedState.SelectedPetData then
                    local pets = _buildPetList()
                    if #pets > 0 then SharedState.SelectedPetData = pets[1] end
                end
            end

            task.spawn(function()
                while true do
                    RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
                    if _cacheDirty then pcall(_G.VXFlushCache) end
                end
            end)

            local function _isFusingAnimal(ad)
                if type(ad) ~= "table" then return false end
                local m = ad.Machine
                if type(m) == "table" and (m.Type == "Fuse" or m.Type == "Duel"
                    or m.Type == "Trade" or m.Type == "Crafting") then
                    return true
                end
                if ad.Fusing or ad.IsFusing or ad.FusingWith then return true end
                local fe = tonumber(ad.FuseEndTime)
                if fe and fe > Workspace:GetServerTimeNow() then return true end
                return false
            end
            _G.VXIsFusing = _isFusingAnimal

            -- (getAnimalHash removido: o hash agora e montado sobre as linhas
            -- que o scan realmente produziu -- ver scanSinglePlot.)

            SharedState.PlotScanStats = SharedState.PlotScanStats or { plots = 0, channels = 0 }
            SharedState.PlotScanStats.resolved = 0
            SharedState.CarpetPasses = 0
            SharedState.VXCoverageDone = false

            local _plotResolved, _resolvedN = {}, 0
            local function _markResolved(name)
                if _plotResolved[name] then return end
                _plotResolved[name] = true
                _resolvedN = _resolvedN + 1
                local st = SharedState.PlotScanStats
                if not st then return end
                st.resolved = _resolvedN
                if (st.plots or 0) > 0 and _resolvedN >= st.plots and not SharedState.VXCoverageDone then
                    SharedState.VXCoverageDone = true
                    SharedState.VXCoverageAt = os.clock()
                end
            end
            local function _unmarkResolved(name)
                if not _plotResolved[name] then return end
                _plotResolved[name] = nil
                _resolvedN = math.max(0, _resolvedN - 1)
                local st = SharedState.PlotScanStats
                if st then st.resolved = _resolvedN end
            end

            local _prevSlots = {}
            _G.VXRemovedAnimals = {}
            local _removedN = 0

            local function _recordRemoved(rec, plotName, slotName)
                local idx = rec.index
                if idx == nil then return end
                local aInfo = _AD and _AD[idx]
                local mut = rec.mutation
                if mut == nil or mut == "" then mut = "None" end
                if mut == "Yin Yang" then mut = "YinYang" end
                local gv = _vxGen(idx, rec.mutation, rec.tarr) or 0
                if type(gv) ~= "number" then gv = 0 end

                local row = {
                    name = (aInfo and aInfo.DisplayName) or tostring(idx),
                    index = idx,
                    mutation = tostring(mut),
                    traits = (#rec.tarr > 0) and table.concat(rec.tarr, ", ") or "None",
                    rarity = aInfo and aInfo.Rarity or nil,
                    price = aInfo and aInfo.Price or nil,
                    genValue = gv, genText = genText(gv),
                    plot = plotName, slot = slotName,
                    at = os.clock(),
                }
                local store = _G.VXRemovedAnimals
                store[tostring(idx):lower()] = row
                store[tostring(row.name):lower()] = row

                _removedN = _removedN + 1
                if _removedN >= 40 then
                    _removedN = 0
                    local now = os.clock()
                    for k, v in pairs(store) do
                        if type(v) ~= "table" or (now - (v.at or 0)) > 180 then store[k] = nil end
                    end
                end
            end

            local function _traitArray(t)
                local out = {}
                if type(t) == "table" then
                    for _, tv in next, t do
                        local s = tostring(tv)
                        if s ~= "" and s ~= "None" then out[#out + 1] = s end
                    end
                end
                return out
            end

            -- ========================================================
            --  CANAL DO PLOT  --  UUID primeiro, "PlotN" (Order) de reserva
            --
            --  ESTA ERA A PRIMEIRA DAS TRES FALHAS. O scan resolvia o canal
            --  so por plot.Name, que e o UUID do Model. O jogo passou a
            --  nomear os canais como Plot1, Plot2... entao VXSyncGet(uuid)
            --  devolvia nil pra TODAS as bases e o `if not ch then return end`
            --  logo abaixo matava o scan na primeira linha -- sem erro
            --  nenhum, so lista vazia a sessao inteira.
            --
            --  UUID PRIMEIRO de proposito: e a chave do proprio Model, entao
            --  se resolve e inequivocamente o canal DAQUELE plot. Ja
            --  "Plot"..Order e um palpite -- se o Order for 0-based ou
            --  estiver deslocado da numeracao dos canais, casa os podiums de
            --  um plot com os slots de outro, e getPetPosition devolve uma
            --  posicao REAL e plausivel no podium errado.
            -- ========================================================
            local function _plotChannel(plot)
                if not plot then return nil end
                return _G.VXPlotChannel and _G.VXPlotChannel(plot) or nil
            end

            -- leitura na ordem: CacheTable -> campo direto -> :Get.
            -- VXSProp sozinho le SO o CacheTable do cliente, que fica vazio
            -- enquanto o pet nao carrega na cena -- terceira falha.
            local function _readChannel(ch, key)
                if type(ch) ~= "table" or key == nil then return nil end
                local v = _G.VXSProp and _G.VXSProp(ch, key)
                if v ~= nil then return v end
                pcall(function() v = rawget(ch, key) end)
                if v ~= nil then return v end
                pcall(function() if type(ch.Get) == "function" then v = ch:Get(key) end end)
                return v
            end

            -- os pets vem em AnimalList ou Animals, dependendo do servidor.
            -- AnimalList PRIMEIRO: e nas chaves dessa tabela que os nomes dos
            -- podiums batem. Se Animals for indexado de outro jeito (array
            -- 1..n, UUID), o slot cai noutro namespace e o TP resolve um
            -- podium errado, sem erro nenhum. Animals fica so de reserva.
            local function _petList(ch)
                local al = _readChannel(ch, "AnimalList")
                if type(al) == "table" then return al end
                al = _readChannel(ch, "Animals")
                if type(al) == "table" then return al end
                return nil
            end

            -- a entrada aparece em varios formatos dependendo do servidor
            local function _normalizeEntry(ad)
                if type(ad) == "string" then return ad, nil, nil end
                if type(ad) ~= "table" then return nil end
                local idx = ad.Index or ad.AnimalIndex or ad.Animal or ad.Name
                if type(idx) ~= "string" then return nil end
                return idx, ad.Mutation, ad.Traits
            end

            -- ========================================================
            --  FALLBACK: MODELS RENDERIZADOS
            --
            --  Funciona SEM canal nenhum -- era a saida que faltava quando
            --  VXSyncGet devolvia nil pra tudo. So filhos DIRETOS de
            --  Plots.<UUID>: varrer o workspace inteiro traria pets de
            --  evento, maquinas e personagens.
            -- ========================================================
            local _catalog
            local function _buildCatalog()
                if _catalog then return _catalog end
                _catalog = {}
                pcall(function()
                    for idx, info in pairs(_AD or {}) do
                        if type(idx) == "string" then
                            _catalog[idx:lower()] = idx
                            if type(info) == "table" and type(info.DisplayName) == "string" then
                                _catalog[info.DisplayName:lower()] = idx
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end)
                return _catalog
            end

            local _SUF = { K = 1e3, M = 1e6, B = 1e9, T = 1e12, Q = 1e15,
                           Qi = 1e18, Sx = 1e21, Sp = 1e24, Oc = 1e27 }

            -- ultimo recurso pro MPS: le o "$X/s" que o proprio pet mostra
            local function _mpsFromText(model)
                for _, d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
                    if d:IsA("TextLabel") and type(d.Text) == "string" then
                        local num, suf = d.Text:match("%$%s*([%d%.]+)%s*(%a*)%s*/s")
                        if num then
                            local v = tonumber(num)
                            if v then
                                if suf and suf ~= "" then
                                    local m = _SUF[suf] or _SUF[suf:sub(1, 1):upper() .. (suf:sub(2) or "")]
                                    if m then v = v * m end
                                end
                                return v
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                return nil
            end

            -- o slot sai do podium mais proximo, nunca do pivot do Model: o
            -- destino do TP tem que continuar vindo do sistema de podiums.
            -- posicoes em cache -- eles nao se movem, e recalcular GetPivot de
            -- todos, por Model, a cada scan, era o custo que obrigava o
            -- intervalo a ficar alto.
            local _podCache = {}
            local function _podiumsOf(plot)
                local c = _podCache[plot.Name]
                if c then return c end
                local podiums = plot:FindFirstChild("AnimalPodiums")
                if not podiums then return nil end
                local kids = podiums:GetChildren()
                local list, numeric = {}, 0
                for _, pod in ipairs(kids) do
                    -- SO podium de verdade: o nome do slot e sempre numerico.
                    -- Sem esta guarda um "Decorations" virava slot e o TP
                    -- resolvia o pivot desse objeto -- posicao arbitraria.
                    if tonumber(pod.Name) then
                        numeric = numeric + 1
                        local ok, pp = pcall(function() return pod:GetPivot().Position end)
                        if ok then list[#list + 1] = { name = pod.Name, pos = pp } end
                    end
                end
                if #list == 0 then return nil end
                -- so guarda quando TUDO ja replicou: com StreamingEnabled o
                -- folder aparece parcial, e cachear 2 de 8 podiums congelava
                -- o mapa incompleto pela sessao inteira.
                if #list == numeric and numeric > 0 then _podCache[plot.Name] = list end
                return list
            end

            local function _slotOfModel(plot, model)
                local list = _podiumsOf(plot)
                if not list then return nil end
                local ok, pivot = pcall(function() return model:GetPivot().Position end)
                if not ok then return nil end
                local best, bestD
                for _, pod in ipairs(list) do
                    local d = (pod.pos - pivot).Magnitude
                    if not bestD or d < bestD then bestD, best = d, pod.name end
                end
                if best and bestD and bestD <= 8 then return best end
                return nil
            end

            local _diagPrev = ""

            local function scanSinglePlot(plot) pcall(function()
                    if _G.VXDisablePlotScan == true then return end

                    local name = plot.Name
                    local ch = _plotChannel(plot)

                    -- ---------- dono ----------
                    -- SEM exigir que ele esteja online. Era a segunda falha:
                    -- `not Players:FindFirstChild(owner.Name)` apagava do cache
                    -- toda base cujo dono tivesse deslogado -- e roubar de base
                    -- de gente offline e justamente o caso mais comum.
                    local ownerName = ""
                    if ch then
                        local o = _readChannel(ch, "Owner")
                        if typeof(o) == "string" then ownerName = o
                        elseif typeof(o) == "Instance" and o:IsA("Player") then ownerName = o.Name
                        elseif type(o) == "table" then
                            local n = rawget(o, "Name")
                            local uid = rawget(o, "UserId")
                            if n then ownerName = tostring(n)
                            elseif uid then
                                local p = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(uid)
                                if p then ownerName = p.Name end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    if ownerName == "" then
                        -- "SUA BASE"/"YOUR BASE" no PlotSign nao e um nome
                        pcall(function()
                            local t = plot.PlotSign.SurfaceGui.Frame.TextLabel.Text
                            if t and t ~= "" then
                                local low = t:lower()
                                if not (low:find("sua base") or low:find("your base") or low:find("^empty")) then
                                    ownerName = (t:gsub("'s Base$", ""):gsub(" Base$", ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$"))
                                end
                            end
                        end)
                    end

                    _markResolved(name)

                    if ownerName ~= "" and (ownerName == LocalPlayer.Name or ownerName == LocalPlayer.DisplayName) then
                        _prevSlots[name] = nil
                        lastAnimalData[name] = nil
                        if dropPlot(name) > 0 then publish() end
                        return
                    end

                    local seen, fresh, freshTarr = {}, {}, {}
                    local nSync, nRend = 0, 0

                    local function addPet(idx, mut, traits, slot, mpsFallback, viaSync, adRaw)
                        if type(idx) ~= "string" or slot == nil then return end
                        local aInfo = _AD and _AD[idx]
                        if not aInfo then return end
                        if aInfo.Egg == true or aInfo.LuckyBlock == true then return end
                        if adRaw ~= nil and _isFusingAnimal(adRaw) then return end

                        -- CHAVE SO POR SLOT. Com o Index junto, as duas
                        -- passagens so colidiam quando ja concordavam sobre o
                        -- animal -- ou seja, exatamente quando nao importava.
                        -- Se o canal dizia slot 5 = Cow e o Model renderizado
                        -- ainda era o Dragon anterior, as chaves diferiam e OS
                        -- DOIS entravam: duas linhas com o mesmo uid e o mesmo
                        -- slot, e o TP parava no pet errado.
                        local slotName = tostring(slot)
                        if seen[slotName] then return end   -- sync tem preferencia
                        seen[slotName] = true

                        local m = mut
                        if m == nil or m == "" then m = "None" end
                        if m == "Yin Yang" then m = "YinYang" end

                        local tarr = _traitArray(traits)
                        local tTxt = (#tarr > 0) and table.concat(tarr, ", ") or "None"

                        local gv = _vxGen(idx, mut, tarr)
                        -- mpsFallback vem como FUNCAO, nao valor: Lua avalia o
                        -- argumento antes de chamar, entao passar o valor ja
                        -- pronto rodava o GetDescendants do _mpsFromText pra
                        -- TODO pet renderizado, de TODO plot, a cada scan --
                        -- inclusive quando o _vxGen acima ja tinha resolvido.
                        if (type(gv) ~= "number" or gv == 0) and type(mpsFallback) == "function" then
                            gv = mpsFallback() or gv
                        end
                        if type(gv) ~= "number" then return end

                        local prompt, pos = findTargetPromptForSlot(plot, slotName)
                        fresh[#fresh + 1] = {
                            name = aInfo.DisplayName or idx, index = idx,
                            genText = genText(gv), genValue = gv,
                            petValue = aInfo.Price or 0,
                            mutation = tostring(m), traits = tTxt, owner = ownerName,
                            rarity = aInfo.Rarity, price = aInfo.Price,
                            plot = name, slot = slotName,
                            uid = name .. "_" .. slotName,
                            prompt = prompt, position = pos,
                        }
                        freshTarr[slotName] = tarr
                        if viaSync then nSync = nSync + 1 else nRend = nRend + 1 end
                    end

                    -- ---------- 1. Synchronizer ----------
                    local al = ch and _petList(ch) or nil
                    if type(al) == "table" then
                        for slot, ad in next, al do
                            local idx, mut, traits = _normalizeEntry(ad)
                            if idx then addPet(idx, mut, traits, slot, nil, true, ad) end
                        end
                    end

                    -- ---------- 2. Models renderizados ----------
                    local cat = _buildCatalog()
                    for _, mdl in ipairs(plot:GetChildren()) do
                        if mdl:IsA("Model") then
                            local idx = cat[mdl.Name:lower()]
                            if idx then
                                local slot = _slotOfModel(plot, mdl)
                                if slot then
                                    addPet(idx, mdl:GetAttribute("Mutation"), nil, slot,
                                           function() return _mpsFromText(mdl) end, false, nil)
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end

                    if #fresh == 0 and not al then
                        _prevSlots[name] = nil
                        lastAnimalData[name] = nil
                        if dropPlot(name) > 0 then publish() end
                        return
                    end

                    -- HASH SOBRE O RESULTADO REAL, nao sobre a AnimalList crua.
                    --
                    -- getAnimalHash(al) tinha tres buracos:
                    --  * sem canal, getAnimalHash(nil) = "" -- o cache
                    --    congelava com o pet antigo pra sempre.
                    --  * Traits nao entravam no hash, mas entram no _vxGen ->
                    --    genValue e ordenacao ficavam velhos.
                    --  * ownerName nao entrava. O nome so resolve quando o
                    --    canal chega; se a lista nao mudasse nessa janela, o
                    --    "" ficava gravado -- e todo filtro e
                    --    `owner ~= LocalPlayer`, que "" atravessa.
                    local parts = { ownerName }
                    for _, p in ipairs(fresh) do
                        parts[#parts + 1] = p.slot .. "|" .. tostring(p.index)
                            .. "|" .. p.mutation .. "|" .. p.traits
                    end
                    table.sort(parts)          -- next() nao tem ordem estavel
                    local hash = table.concat(parts, ";")
                    if lastAnimalData[name] == hash then return end

                    -- ---------- pets que sairam ----------
                    -- nowSlots sai da AnimalList CRUA quando ela existe: um pet
                    -- que entrou em fusao continua no plot (o addPet so nao o
                    -- lista), e marca-lo como removido enveneraria o
                    -- VXRemovedAnimals.
                    local prev = _prevSlots[name]
                    local nowSlots = {}
                    if type(al) == "table" then
                        for slot, ad in next, al do
                            local idx, mut, traits = _normalizeEntry(ad)
                            if idx then
                                nowSlots[tostring(slot)] =
                                    { index = idx, mutation = mut, tarr = _traitArray(traits) }
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    for _, p in ipairs(fresh) do
                        if nowSlots[p.slot] == nil then
                            nowSlots[p.slot] =
                                { index = p.index, mutation = p.mutation, tarr = freshTarr[p.slot] or {} }
                        end
                    end
                    if prev then
                        for slotName, old in next, prev do
                            local cur = nowSlots[slotName]
                            if cur == nil or cur.index ~= old.index then
                                _recordRemoved(old, name, slotName)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    _prevSlots[name] = nowSlots

                    dropPlot(name)
                    for _, p in ipairs(fresh) do allAnimalsCache[#allAnimalsCache + 1] = p end
                    lastAnimalData[name] = hash
                    publish()

                    -- diagnostico: so imprime quando o quadro geral muda
                    local plotsN = 0
                    pcall(function() plotsN = #Workspace.Plots:GetChildren() end)
                    local line = ("pets=%d sync=%d rendered=%d plots=%d")
                        :format(#allAnimalsCache, nSync, nRend, plotsN)
                    if line ~= _diagPrev then
                        _diagPrev = line
                        _G.VXLog("Scanner", line)
                    end
            end) end

            SharedState.PlotScanStats = SharedState.PlotScanStats or { plots = 0, channels = 0 }
            local _channelSeen = {}
            local _plots = (SharedState.Pre and SharedState.Pre.Plots)
            or Workspace:WaitForChild("Plots", 8)
            if not _plots then return end

            _G.refreshAllPets = function()
                if SharedState.FastScan ~= false then
                    for _, p in ipairs(_plots:GetChildren()) do
                        pcall(scanSinglePlot, p)
                    end
                else
                    for k in pairs(lastAnimalData) do lastAnimalData[k] = nil end
                end
            end

            local function setupPlotListener(plot, phase)
                if not _channelSeen[plot.Name] then
                    _channelSeen[plot.Name] = true
                    local st = SharedState.PlotScanStats
                    st.channels = (st.channels or 0) + 1
                end
                scanSinglePlot(plot)

                local _conns = {}
                local _queued, _dead = false, false

                local function requestScan(delay)
                    if _dead or _queued then return end
                    _queued = true
                    task.delay(delay or 0, function()
                        _queued = false
                        if not _dead and plot.Parent then scanSinglePlot(plot) end
                    end)
                end

                local function bindPodiums(pods)
                    if not pods then return end
                    _conns[#_conns + 1] = pods.ChildAdded:Connect(function() requestScan(0.12) end)
                    _conns[#_conns + 1] = pods.ChildRemoved:Connect(function() requestScan(0.04) end)
                    _conns[#_conns + 1] = pods.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d)
                        if d:IsA("Model") or d:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then requestScan(0.12) end
                    end)
                    _conns[#_conns + 1] = pods.DescendantRemoving:Connect(function(d)
                        if d:IsA("Model") then requestScan(0.04) end
                    end)
                end

                bindPodiums(plot:FindFirstChild("AnimalPodiums"))

                _conns[#_conns + 1] = plot.ChildAdded:Connect(function(c)
                    if c.Name == "AnimalPodiums" then
                        bindPodiums(c)
                        requestScan(0.12)
                    elseif c:IsA("Model") then
                        requestScan(0.08)
                    end
                end)
                _conns[#_conns + 1] = plot.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(c)
                    if c.Name == "AnimalPodiums" or c:IsA("Model") then requestScan(0.04) end
                end)
                _conns[#_conns + 1] = plot.AttributeChanged:Connect(function() requestScan(0.1) end)

                _G.VXPlotRescan = _G.VXPlotRescan or {}
                _G.VXPlotRescan[plot.Name] = requestScan

                task.spawn(function()
                    if phase and phase > 0 then task.wait(phase) end
                    requestScan(0)

                    local born = os.clock()
                    while (os.clock() - born) < 3 and plot.Parent do
                        task.wait(0.25)
                        scanSinglePlot(plot)
                    end

                    while plot.Parent do
                        task.wait(SharedState.FastScan == false and 15 or 8)
                        if plot.Parent then scanSinglePlot(plot) end
                    end

                    _dead = true
                    for _, c in ipairs(_conns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
                    table.clear(_conns)
                    if _G.VXPlotRescan then _G.VXPlotRescan[plot.Name] = nil end
                end)
            end

            task.spawn(function()
                local t0 = os.clock()
                repeat task.wait(0.25) until SharedState.VXCoverageDone or (os.clock() - t0) > 12
                task.wait(1.5)
                local plotCount = 0
                for _, e in ipairs(allAnimalsCache) do
                    if not e.isCarpet then plotCount = plotCount + 1 end
                end
                if plotCount > 0 then
                    _G.VXLog("Scanner", string.format("Plot scan healthy - %d plot brainrots cached", plotCount))
                    return
                end
                _G.VXLog("Scanner", "NO plot brainrots found - dumping live structure")
                pcall(_G.VXDumpStructure)
                pcall(_G.VXDiag)
            end)

            pcall(function()
                local g = getgenv and getgenv()
                if type(g) == "table" then
                    g.VXDumpStructure = _G.VXDumpStructure
                    g.VXDiag = _G.VXDiag
                    g.VXTree = _G.VXTree
                end
            end)

            local plots = _plots
            SharedState.PlotScanStats.plots = #plots:GetChildren()
            do

                local kids = plots:GetChildren()
                local n = #kids
                for i, p in ipairs(kids) do
                    task.spawn(setupPlotListener, p, (n > 0) and ((i - 1) * (0.5 / n)) or 0)
                end
            end
            SharedState.InitialScanComplete = true
            plots.ChildAdded:Connect(function(p)
                SharedState.PlotScanStats.plots = #plots:GetChildren()
                task.wait(0.5 + math.random() * 0.5)
                task.spawn(setupPlotListener, p, math.random() * 0.5)
            end)
            plots.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(p)
                lastAnimalData[p.Name] = nil
                if _channelSeen[p.Name] then
                    _channelSeen[p.Name] = nil
                    local st = SharedState.PlotScanStats
                    st.channels = math.max(0, (st.channels or 1) - 1)
                end
                _unmarkResolved(p.Name)
                _prevSlots[p.Name] = nil
                SharedState.PlotScanStats.plots = #plots:GetChildren()
                dropPlot(p.Name)
                SharedState.ListNeedsRedraw = true
                SharedState.SelectionDirty = true
            end)

            task.spawn(function()
                local byDisplay = {}
                for idx, info in pairs(_AD) do
                    if type(info) == "table" and info.DisplayName then
                        byDisplay[tostring(info.DisplayName):lower()] = idx
                    end
                end
                local function resolveIndex(nm)
                    if nm == nil then return nil end
                    if _AD[nm] then return nm end
                    local i = byDisplay[tostring(nm):lower()]
                    if i and _AD[i] then return i end
                    return nil
                end
                local _cid = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
                local _cidN = 0

                local function carpetUid(m)
                    local id = _cid[m]
                    if not id then _cidN = _cidN + 1; id = "CARPET_" .. _cidN; _cid[m] = id end
                    return id
                end
                local function dropCarpets()
                    for i = #allAnimalsCache, 1, -1 do
                        if allAnimalsCache[i].isCarpet then table.remove(allAnimalsCache, i) end
                    end
                end
                local _lastHash = ""

                local _sigBuf = {}

                local _partCache = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
                local function carpetPartOf(m)
                    local p = _partCache[m]
                    if p and p.Parent then return p end
                    p = m:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or m.PrimaryPart
                    or m:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
                    if p then _partCache[m] = p end
                    return p
                end

                local function carpetSignature(root)
                    local n = 0
                    for _, m in ipairs(root:GetChildren()) do
                        if m:IsA("Model") then

                            local part = carpetPartOf(m)
                            _sigBuf[n + 1] = carpetUid(m)
                            _sigBuf[n + 2] = m.Name
                            _sigBuf[n + 3] = tostring(m:GetAttribute("__mutation")
                                or m:GetAttribute("Mutation") or "")
                            _sigBuf[n + 4] = tostring(m:GetAttribute("Traits") or "")
                            _sigBuf[n + 5] = part and "1" or "0"
                            n = n + 5
                        end
                    end
                    for i = #_sigBuf, n + 1, -1 do _sigBuf[i] = nil end
                    return table.concat(_sigBuf, "\1")
                end
                local function scanCarpets() pcall(function()
                        local root = Workspace:FindFirstChild("RenderedMovingAnimals")

                        for _, e in ipairs(allAnimalsCache) do
                            if e.isCarpet and e._part and e._part.Parent then e.position = e._part.Position end
                        end

                        local sig = root and carpetSignature(root) or ""
                        if sig == _lastHash then return end
                        _lastHash = sig

                        local built = {}
                        if root then
                            for _, m in ipairs(root:GetChildren()) do
                                if m:IsA("Model") then
                                    local idx = resolveIndex(m.Name)
                                    local info = idx and _AD[idx]
                                    if info then
                                        local part = carpetPartOf(m)
                                        if part then
                                            local mut = m:GetAttribute("__mutation") or m:GetAttribute("Mutation") or "None"
                                            if mut == "Yin Yang" then mut = "YinYang" end
                                            local traitsTbl
                                            local tAttr = m:GetAttribute("Traits")
                                            if type(tAttr) == "string" and tAttr ~= "" and tAttr ~= "None" then
                                                traitsTbl = {}
                                                for t in tAttr:gmatch("[^,%s]+") do traitsTbl[#traitsTbl + 1] = t end
                                            end
                                            local gv = _vxGen(idx, (mut ~= "None") and mut or nil, traitsTbl) or 0
                                            if type(gv) ~= "number" then gv = 0 end
                                            local traitsText = (traitsTbl and #traitsTbl > 0)
                                            and table.concat(traitsTbl, ", ") or "None"
                                            local uid = carpetUid(m)
                                            local dName = info.DisplayName or m.Name
                                            local prompt
                                            for _, d in ipairs(m:GetDescendants()) do
                                                if d:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then prompt = d break end
                                            end
                                            built[#built + 1] = {
                                                name = dName, petName = dName, index = idx,
                                                genText = genText(gv), genValue = gv,
                                                petValue = info.Price or 0, price = info.Price, rarity = info.Rarity,
                                                mutation = mut, traits = traitsText, owner = "",
                                                plot = nil, slot = nil, uid = uid,
                                                isCarpet = true, _model = m, _part = part,
                                                position = part.Position, prompt = prompt,
                                                animalData = { isCarpet = true, name = dName, index = idx,
                                                    genText = genText(gv), genValue = gv, mutation = mut,
                                                uid = uid, price = info.Price, rarity = info.Rarity },
                                            }
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end

                        dropCarpets()
                        for _, e in ipairs(built) do table.insert(allAnimalsCache, e) end
                        publish()
                end) end

                _G.rescanCarpetNow = function()
                    pcall(scanCarpets)
                    SharedState.CarpetPasses = (SharedState.CarpetPasses or 0) + 1
                    SharedState.CarpetScanComplete = true
                end

                local function pass()
                    scanCarpets()
                    SharedState.CarpetPasses = (SharedState.CarpetPasses or 0) + 1
                    SharedState.CarpetScanComplete = true
                end

                pass()

                local _cQueued = false
                --  ===========================================================
                --  DEBRIS SCANNER
                --
                --  Third cache source, alongside the plot and carpet scanners.
                --  The plot scanner reads AnimalList off each plot channel, so
                --  it only ever sees brainrots sitting on a podium. Anything in
                --  Workspace.Debris -- in transit, dropped, or mid-steal -- is
                --  invisible to it. This reads the AnimalOverhead SurfaceGui
                --  directly off the Debris containers instead, which is the only
                --  place that data exists for a pet that is not on a podium.
                --
                --  Entries are written in the cache's own field shape (name /
                --  index / genText / genValue / rarity / position / plot / uid)
                --  so _buildPetList consumes them unchanged. They carry no slot
                --  and no prompt, because a Debris pet has neither -- which is
                --  also why this does not replace the podium scanner: the steal
                --  and teleport paths resolve their prompt through plot+slot.
                --  ===========================================================
                local DBR_MIN_X, DBR_MAX_X = -545, -275
                local DBR_MIN_Z, DBR_MAX_Z = -145, 265
                --  The strip between these X values is the central walkway --
                --  pets read there are passing through, not stealable.
                local DBR_SKIP_X0, DBR_SKIP_X1 = -435, -385

                local _BB_SX = { -1, 1, -1, 1, -1, 1, -1, 1 }
                local _BB_SY = { -1, -1, 1, 1, -1, -1, 1, 1 }
                local _BB_SZ = { -1, -1, -1, -1, 1, 1, 1, 1 }

                local function dbrLabel(parent, name)
                    local c = parent:FindFirstChild(name)
                    if c and c:IsA("TextLabel") then return c.Text or "" end
                    return ""
                end

                local function dbrIsLuckyBlock(name)
                    return tostring(name or ""):lower():find("lucky block", 1, true) ~= nil
                end

                --  Centre of the pet's bounding box, not its pivot: a model
                --  pivoted at its feet teleports you into the floor.
                local function dbrCentre(src)
                    local out = nil
                    if src:IsA("Model") then
                        local ok, bb = pcall(function() return src:GetBoundingBox() end)
                        if ok and bb then return bb.Position end
                    end
                    local mnX, mnY, mnZ = math.huge, math.huge, math.huge
                    local mxX, mxY, mxZ = -math.huge, -math.huge, -math.huge
                    local found = false
                    for _, part in ipairs(src:GetDescendants()) do
                        if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                            local cf, sz = part.CFrame, part.Size
                            local hx, hy, hz = sz.X * 0.5, sz.Y * 0.5, sz.Z * 0.5
                            for i = 1, 8 do
                                local w = cf * Vector3.new(_BB_SX[i] * hx, _BB_SY[i] * hy, _BB_SZ[i] * hz)
                                if w.X < mnX then mnX = w.X end
                                if w.Y < mnY then mnY = w.Y end
                                if w.Z < mnZ then mnZ = w.Z end
                                if w.X > mxX then mxX = w.X end
                                if w.Y > mxY then mxY = w.Y end
                                if w.Z > mxZ then mxZ = w.Z end
                                found = true
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    if found then
                        out = Vector3.new((mnX + mxX) * 0.5, (mnY + mxY) * 0.5, (mnZ + mxZ) * 0.5)
                    elseif src:IsA("BasePart") then
                        out = src.Position
                    else
                        local ok, cf = pcall(function() return src:GetPivot() end)
                        if ok and cf then out = cf.Position end
                    end
                    return out
                end

                local function dbrOwnPlot(plotsFolder)
                    for _, plot in ipairs(plotsFolder:GetChildren()) do
                        local o = plot:FindFirstChild("Owner")
                            or plot:FindFirstChild("PlotOwner")
                            or plot:FindFirstChild("OwnerValue")
                        if o then
                            if o:IsA("ObjectValue") and o.Value == LocalPlayer then return plot end
                            if (o:IsA("IntValue") or o:IsA("NumberValue"))
                                and o.Value == LocalPlayer.UserId then return plot end
                            if o:IsA("StringValue")
                                and (o.Value == LocalPlayer.Name or o.Value == LocalPlayer.DisplayName) then
                                return plot
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    return nil
                end

                local function dropDebris()
                    for i = #allAnimalsCache, 1, -1 do
                        if allAnimalsCache[i].isDebris then table.remove(allAnimalsCache, i) end
                    end
                end

                local _dbrLastHash = ""
                local function scanDebris() pcall(function()
                    local debris = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Debris")
                    local plotsFolder = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")
                    if not (debris and plotsFolder) then
                        if _dbrLastHash ~= "" then
                            _dbrLastHash = ""
                            dropDebris()
                            publish()
                        end
                        return
                    end

                    local ownPlot = dbrOwnPlot(plotsFolder)
                    local ownPivot = nil
                    if ownPlot then
