                        pcall(function() ownPivot = ownPlot:GetPivot().Position end)
                    end

                    local fresh, seen = {}, {}
                    for _, container in ipairs(debris:GetChildren()) do
                        local overhead = container:FindFirstChild("AnimalOverhead")
                        if overhead and overhead:IsA("SurfaceGui") then
                            local nm = dbrLabel(overhead, "DisplayName")
                            local adornee = overhead.Adornee
                            if nm ~= "" and nm ~= "N/A" and adornee and not dbrIsLuckyBlock(nm) then
                                local genText = dbrLabel(overhead, "Generation")
                                local rarity  = dbrLabel(overhead, "Rarity")
                                local stolenLbl = overhead:FindFirstChild("Stolen")
                                local isStolen = stolenLbl ~= nil
                                    and stolenLbl:IsA("TextLabel") and stolenLbl.Visible

                                local pos = dbrCentre(adornee)
                                local keep = pos ~= nil
                                --  A pet already being carried can be anywhere on
                                --  the map, so the bounds only apply to settled ones.
                                if keep and not isStolen then
                                    if pos.X < DBR_MIN_X or pos.X > DBR_MAX_X
                                        or pos.Z < DBR_MIN_Z or pos.Z > DBR_MAX_Z then
                                        keep = false
                                    elseif pos.X > DBR_SKIP_X0 and pos.X < DBR_SKIP_X1 then
                                        keep = false
                                    end
                                end
                                --  Never list our own base back to us.
                                if keep and ownPlot and not isStolen then
                                    local mine = adornee:IsDescendantOf(ownPlot)
                                    if not mine and ownPivot then
                                        mine = math.abs(pos.X - ownPivot.X) < 32
                                            and math.abs(pos.Z - ownPivot.Z) < 32
                                    end
                                    if mine then keep = false end
                                end

                                if keep then
                                    local plotName = nil
                                    local curr = adornee
                                    while curr and curr ~= Workspace do
                                        if curr.Parent == plotsFolder then plotName = curr.Name break end
                                        curr = curr.Parent
                                    end

                                    local uid = "DBR#" .. nm .. "#"
                                        .. tostring(math.floor(pos.X * 10))
                                        .. "#" .. tostring(math.floor(pos.Z * 10))
                                    if not seen[uid] then
                                        seen[uid] = true
                                        local part = adornee:IsA("BasePart") and adornee
                                            or adornee:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
                                        fresh[#fresh + 1] = {
                                            name     = nm,
                                            index    = nm,
                                            genText  = genText,
                                            genValue = parseMoney(genText) or 0,
                                            rarity   = rarity,
                                            position = pos,
                                            plot     = plotName or "Debris",
                                            uid      = uid,
                                            model    = adornee,
                                            _model   = adornee,
                                            _part    = part,
                                            isDebris = true,
                                            isStolen = isStolen,
                                        }
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end

                    --  Only rebuild the cache slice when the picture changed.
                    local sig = {}
                    for _, e in ipairs(fresh) do sig[#sig + 1] = e.uid end
                    table.sort(sig)
                    local hash = table.concat(sig, "\1")
                    if hash == _dbrLastHash then return end
                    _dbrLastHash = hash

                    dropDebris()
                    for _, e in ipairs(fresh) do allAnimalsCache[#allAnimalsCache + 1] = e end
                    publish()
                end) end

                local _dbrQueued = false
                local function requestDebrisScan(delay)
                    if _dbrQueued then return end
                    _dbrQueued = true
                    task.delay(delay or 0, function()
                        _dbrQueued = false
                        scanDebris()
                    end)
                end
                _G.VXDebrisRequestScan = requestDebrisScan

                local function bindDebrisRoot(root)
                    if not root then return end
                    root.ChildAdded:Connect(function() requestDebrisScan(0.08) end)
                    root.ChildRemoved:Connect(function() requestDebrisScan(0.04) end)
                end
                bindDebrisRoot(Workspace:FindFirstChild("Debris"))
                Workspace.ChildAdded:Connect(function(c)
                    if c.Name == "Debris" then
                        bindDebrisRoot(c)
                        requestDebrisScan(0.08)
                    end
                end)
                requestDebrisScan(0.5)

                --  A carried pet moves every frame, so keep its cached position
                --  live the same way carpets are kept live below.
                RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
                    local cache = SharedState.AllAnimalsCache
                    if not cache then return end
                    for i = 1, #cache do
                        local e = cache[i]
                        if e.isDebris and e._part and e._part.Parent then
                            e.position = e._part.Position
                        end
                    end
                end)

                local function requestCarpetScan(delay)
                    if _cQueued then return end
                    _cQueued = true
                    task.delay(delay or 0, function()
                        _cQueued = false
                        pass()
                    end)
                end
                _G.VXCarpetRequestScan = requestCarpetScan

                local function bindCarpetRoot(root)
                    if not root then return end
                    root.ChildAdded:Connect(function() requestCarpetScan(0.05) end)
                    root.ChildRemoved:Connect(function() requestCarpetScan(0.02) end)
                end

                local _root = Workspace:FindFirstChild("RenderedMovingAnimals")
                bindCarpetRoot(_root)
                Workspace.ChildAdded:Connect(function(c)
                    if c.Name == "RenderedMovingAnimals" then
                        bindCarpetRoot(c)
                        requestCarpetScan(0.05)
                    end
                end)

                RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
                    local cache = SharedState.AllAnimalsCache
                    if not cache then return end
                    for i = 1, #cache do
                        local e = cache[i]
                        if e.isCarpet and e._part and e._part.Parent then
                            e.position = e._part.Position
                        end
                    end
                end)

                task.spawn(function()
                    while true do
                        task.wait(SharedState.FastScan == false and 6 or 3)
                        pass()
                    end
                end)
            end)

            SharedState.VXScanBarrier = false
            SharedState.VXScanBarrierFast = false
            SharedState.VXScanBarrierAt = nil
            SharedState.CarpetPasses = SharedState.CarpetPasses or 0

            _G.VXWaitInitialScan = function(timeout)
                local lim = tonumber(timeout) or 12
                local t0 = os.clock()
                while SharedState.VXScanBarrier ~= true do
                    if os.clock() - t0 > lim then return false end
                    task.wait()
                end
                return true
            end

            _G.VXWaitScanFast = function(timeout)
                local lim = tonumber(timeout) or 12
                local t0 = os.clock()
                while SharedState.VXScanBarrierFast ~= true and SharedState.VXScanBarrier ~= true do
                    if os.clock() - t0 > lim then return false end
                    RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
                end
                return true
            end

            task.spawn(function()
                local BARRIER_SETTLE = 0.25
                local BARRIER_STALL = 0.60
                local BARRIER_LIMIT = 10
                local t0 = os.clock()
                local firstFull = nil
                local lastN, lastProgressAt = -1, os.clock()

                local function finish(how, plotsN, resolvedN)
                    SharedState.VXScanBarrier = true
                    SharedState.VXScanBarrierFast = true
                    SharedState.VXScanBarrierAt = os.clock()
                    local plotN, carpetN = 0, 0
                    for _, e in ipairs(allAnimalsCache) do
                        if e.isCarpet then carpetN = carpetN + 1 else plotN = plotN + 1 end
                    end
                    _G.VXLog("Scanner", string.format(
                        "Initial sync scan %s in %.2fs - %d of %d plots resolved - %d plot + %d carpet brainrots",
                        how, os.clock() - t0, resolvedN, plotsN, plotN, carpetN))
                end

                local lastSweepAt = 0
                while true do

                    if (os.clock() - lastSweepAt) >= 0.5 then
                        lastSweepAt = os.clock()
                        for _, p in ipairs(_plots:GetChildren()) do
                            pcall(scanSinglePlot, p)
                        end
                        if _G.rescanCarpetNow then pcall(_G.rescanCarpetNow) end
                    end

                    local st = SharedState.PlotScanStats or {}
                    local plotsN = tonumber(st.plots) or 0
                    local resolvedN = tonumber(st.resolved) or 0

                    if resolvedN ~= lastN then
                        lastN = resolvedN
                        lastProgressAt = os.clock()
                    end

                    local plotsOk = (_G.VXDisablePlotScan == true)
                    or (plotsN > 0 and resolvedN >= plotsN)
                    local plotsStalled = (resolvedN > 0)
                    and ((os.clock() - lastProgressAt) >= BARRIER_STALL)
                    local carpetsOk = (SharedState.CarpetPasses or 0) > 0

                    if carpetsOk and (plotsOk or plotsStalled) then

                        if not SharedState.VXScanBarrierFast then
                            SharedState.VXScanBarrierFast = true
                            _G.VXLog("Scanner", string.format(
                                "Scan usable in %.3fs - %d of %d plots resolved - auto-TP released",
                                os.clock() - t0, resolvedN, plotsN))
                        end
                        firstFull = firstFull or os.clock()
                        local need = plotsOk and BARRIER_SETTLE or 0
                        if os.clock() - firstFull >= need then
                            finish(plotsOk and "complete" or "settled (partial channel coverage)",
                                plotsN, resolvedN)
                            return
                        end
                    else
                        firstFull = nil
                    end

                    if os.clock() - t0 > BARRIER_LIMIT then
                        finish("TIMED OUT", plotsN, resolvedN)
                        return
                    end

                    task.wait(0.03)
                end
            end)

            SharedState.AllAnimalsCache = allAnimalsCache
        end)
    end
    _G.VXGetPets = _buildPetList

    _G.VXScanBrainrots = function()
        local seen, out = {}, {}
        for _, p in ipairs(SharedState.AllAnimalsCache or {}) do
            local k = tostring(p.name or ""):lower()
            if k ~= "" and not seen[k] then
                seen[k] = true
                out[#out + 1] = { name = p.name, gen = p.genValue or 0 }
            end
        end
        return out
    end

    local function _tpTargetAllowed(t)
        if not t then return false end
        if t.isCarpet and Config.TpToCarpets ~= true then return false end
        return true
    end
    _G.VXTpTargetAllowed = _tpTargetAllowed

    local function doManualTP()
        local t = SharedState.SelectedPetData or (_buildPetList() or {})[1]
        if not t then
            _G.VXLog("Teleport", "Manual TP ignored - no brainrot selected and the ranked list is empty")
            return
        end

        if not _tpTargetAllowed(t) then
            _G.VXLog("Teleport", "Manual TP ignored - " .. tostring(t.petName or t.name or "target")
                .. " is a carpet and 'TP to carpets' is off")
            if _G.VXStealStatus then pcall(_G.VXStealStatus, "CARPET TP . OFF") end
            return
        end
        SharedState.SelectedPetData = t
        playAlert()
        if _G.VXRunTP then _G.VXRunTP() end
    end
    _G.VXManualTP = doManualTP

    if not SharedState.GetStealMode then
        SharedState.GetStealMode = function()
            if Config.StealNearest then return "Nearest"
            elseif Config.StealPriority then return "Priority"
            elseif Config.StealHighest then return "Highest"
            else return Config.LastBrainrotMode or "Highest" end
        end
    end
    if not SharedState.GetBrainrotEnabled then
        SharedState.GetBrainrotEnabled = function()
            return (Config.AutoStealBrainrots == true)
            or Config.StealNearest or Config.StealHighest or Config.StealPriority or false
        end
    end

    task.spawn(function()
        local _selBackupNext = 0
        local _liveNext = 0
        local _lastOrderArr = {}
        while true do
            task.wait(0.05)
            local enabled = SharedState.GetBrainrotEnabled and SharedState.GetBrainrotEnabled()
            if not enabled then continue end
            if tick() < (SharedState._brManualUntil or 0) then continue end
            if tick() < (SharedState.StealLockUntil or 0) then continue end
            local _now = tick()

            local _mode = SharedState.GetStealMode and SharedState.GetStealMode()
            local live = ((_mode == "Nearest") or (_mode == "Priority")) and _now >= _liveNext
            if not (SharedState.SelectionDirty or live or _now >= _selBackupNext) then continue end
            SharedState.SelectionDirty = false
            _liveNext = _now + 0.15
            _selBackupNext = _now + 0.5
            local pets = _buildPetList()
            if #pets > 0 then

                local best = pets[1]
                local pinUID = SharedState._brManualUID
                if pinUID ~= nil then
                    local found = nil
                    for _, p in ipairs(pets) do
                        if tostring(p.uid) == tostring(pinUID) then found = p; break end
                    end
                    if found then
                        best = found
                        SharedState._brPinMissingSince = nil
                    else

                        local since = SharedState._brPinMissingSince
                        if not since then
                            SharedState._brPinMissingSince = os.clock()
                        elseif os.clock() - since > 3 then
                            SharedState._brManualUID = nil
                            SharedState._brPinMissingSince = nil
                        end
                        if SharedState._brManualUID ~= nil then
                            best = SharedState.SelectedPetData or best
                        end
                    end
                end
                SharedState.SelectedPetData = best

                local orderChanged = (#pets ~= #_lastOrderArr)
                if not orderChanged then
                    for i = 1, #pets do
                        if _lastOrderArr[i] ~= pets[i].uid then orderChanged = true; break end
                    end
                end
                if orderChanged then
                    for i = 1, #pets do _lastOrderArr[i] = pets[i].uid end
                    for i = #_lastOrderArr, #pets + 1, -1 do _lastOrderArr[i] = nil end
                    if SharedState.UpdateBrainrotSelectionUI then pcall(SharedState.UpdateBrainrotSelectionUI) end
                end
            else

                if SharedState.SelectedPetData ~= nil then
                    _G.VXLog("Teleport", "Ranked list is empty - cleared the stale brainrot selection")
                    SharedState.SelectedPetData = nil
                end
                if #_lastOrderArr > 0 then
                    for i = #_lastOrderArr, 1, -1 do _lastOrderArr[i] = nil end
                    if SharedState.UpdateBrainrotSelectionUI then pcall(SharedState.UpdateBrainrotSelectionUI) end
                end
            end
        end
    end)

    _G.VXStealPhase = _G.VXStealPhase or "IDLE"
    SharedState.StealBarMirror = SharedState.StealBarMirror or { active = false, progress = 0, dur = 0 }
    task.spawn(function()

        local HOLD = 1.30
        while true do
            task.wait(0.1)
            pcall(function()
                local mir = SharedState.StealBarMirror
                if not mir then return end
                if LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("Stealing") == true then
                    _G.VXStealPhase = "CARRYING"
                    mir.active = false; mir.progress = 1; mir.dur = 0; mir._start = nil
                    return
                end
                if Config.Steal.AutoStealEnabled ~= true then
                    _G.VXStealPhase = "IDLE"
                    mir.active = false; mir.progress = 0; mir.dur = 0; mir._start = nil
                    return
                end
                local sel = SharedState.SelectedPetData
                if sel and sel.isCarpet then

                    local cdur = 0.10
                    local cst  = _G.VXCarpetState
                    local live = cst and cst.hasPrompt and cst.inRange
                    and (os.clock() - (cst.t or 0)) < 0.5
                    if live then
                        _G.VXStealPhase = "STEALING"
                        local now = os.clock()

                        if mir._dmode ~= "carpet" then mir._dmode = "carpet"; mir._start = nil end
                        mir._start = mir._start or now
                        local p = math.clamp((now - mir._start) / cdur, 0, 1)
                        mir.active = true; mir.progress = p; mir.dur = cdur
                        if p >= 1 then mir._start = now end
                    else
                        _G.VXStealPhase = "OUT_OF_RANGE"
                        mir.active = false; mir.progress = 0; mir.dur = 0; mir._start = nil
                    end
                    return
                end

                local preElapsed = _G.VXStealHoldElapsed and _G.VXStealHoldElapsed() or 0
                if preElapsed > 0 then
                    _G.VXStealPhase = "STEALING"
                    mir._dmode = "plot"
                    mir._start = os.clock() - preElapsed
                    mir.active = true
                    mir.progress = math.clamp(preElapsed / HOLD, 0, 1)
                    mir.dur = HOLD
                    return
                end

                if _G.VXStealSuppressed and _G.VXStealSuppressed() then
                    _G.VXStealPhase = "OUT_OF_RANGE"
                    mir.active = true; mir.progress = 0; mir.dur = HOLD; mir._start = nil
                    return
                end

                local char = LocalPlayer.Character
                local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local part = sel and (sel._part or (sel.animalData and findAdorneeGlobal(sel.animalData)))
                local dist = (root and part and part.Parent) and (root.Position - part.Position).Magnitude or math.huge
                local radius = 9999
                if dist <= radius then
                    _G.VXStealPhase = "STEALING"
                    local now = os.clock()
                    if mir._dmode ~= "plot" then mir._dmode = "plot"; mir._start = nil end
                    mir._start = mir._start or now
                    local p = math.clamp((now - mir._start) / HOLD, 0, 1)
                    mir.active = true; mir.progress = p; mir.dur = HOLD
                    if p >= 1 then mir._start = now end
                else
                    _G.VXStealPhase = "OUT_OF_RANGE"
                    mir.active = false; mir.progress = 0; mir.dur = 0; mir._start = nil
                end
            end)
        end
    end)

    _G.VXStealStatus = function(_txt) end

    local function closeFastScan() SharedState.FastScan = false end
    SharedState.FastScan = true
    task.delay(20, closeFastScan)

    local _autoTPRunning = false
    local _autoTPDone = false
    local function _firstAllowedCand(ranked)
        if type(ranked) ~= "table" then return nil end
        for _, c in ipairs(ranked) do
            if _tpTargetAllowed(c) then return c end
        end
        return nil
    end

    local function _runAutoTPOnLoad()
        if _autoTPDone or _autoTPRunning then return end
        -- ============================================================
        --  O PORTAO DO TP NO START.
        --
        --  Sao DOIS Config diferentes no arquivo: o da GUI (DefaultConfig)
        --  e o deste modulo. O syncConfig() copia GUI -> modulo a cada 0.5s
        --  e roda ANTES daqui, entao quem manda no valor lido aqui e sempre
        --  o da GUI -- o default do modulo nunca vale nada.
        --
        --  Era ai que o TP no start morria: o DefaultConfig da GUI nascia
        --  com TpOnLoad = false. Sem ligar "Auto TP on Load" na aba
        --  Teleport a mao, isto retornava e o resto nem comecava. Agora o
        --  DefaultConfig nasce com true e nil tambem conta como ligado, so
        --  um false explicito (toggle desligado) barra.
        --
        --  A flag ainda e lida uma vez so, porque _runAutoTPOnLoad e
        --  task.spawn'ado uma unica vez no load. Se estiver desligada,
        --  espera pelo toggle por ate 20s em vez de desistir na hora:
        --  ligado no load dispara na hora, ligado logo depois ainda pega,
        --  passou de 20s avisa e sai sem ficar em loop.
        -- ============================================================
        --  Nil agora conta como LIGADO. Config antigo salvo antes desta
        --  opcao existir vinha sem a chave, o syncConfig nao copiava nada
        --  e a leitura estrita transformava isso em "desligado".
        --  So um false explicito (toggle desligado na aba Teleport) barra.
        local function _tpOnLoadLigado()
            local t = Config.TpSettings
            if not t then return false end
            return t.TpOnLoad ~= false
        end
        if not _tpOnLoadLigado() then
            _G.VXLog("Auto-TP", "'Auto TP on Load' is OFF - waiting up to 20s for it")
            SharedState.VXAutoTPSettled = true
            task.spawn(function()
                local t0 = os.clock()
                while SharedState.VXScanBarrier ~= true and (os.clock() - t0) < 12 do task.wait() end
                closeFastScan()
            end)
            local _w0 = os.clock()
            while not _tpOnLoadLigado() and (os.clock() - _w0) < 20 do task.wait(0.25) end
            if not _tpOnLoadLigado() then
                _G.VXLog("Auto-TP", "skipped - 'Auto TP on Load' still OFF (Teleport tab)")
                return
            end
            _G.VXLog("Auto-TP", string.format("'Auto TP on Load' turned on after %.1fs - going", os.clock() - _w0))
            SharedState.FastScan = true
            SharedState.VXAutoTPSettled = false
        end
        _G.VXLog("Auto-TP", "enabled - starting target search")
        _autoTPRunning = true
        _autoTPDone = true

        local mode = (SharedState.GetStealMode and SharedState.GetStealMode()) or "Highest"
        _G.VXLog("Auto-TP", "Armed in " .. tostring(mode) .. " mode - plot and carpet scan running in sync")

        local _scanT0 = os.clock()
        local _hotDone = false
        local _hotDeadline = os.clock() + 12
        task.spawn(function()
            while not _hotDone and os.clock() < _hotDeadline do
                if _G.refreshAllPets  then pcall(_G.refreshAllPets)  end
                if _G.rescanCarpetNow then pcall(_G.rescanCarpetNow) end
                if _G.VXFlushCache then pcall(_G.VXFlushCache) end
                RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
            end
        end)

        if type(_G.VXFireGrapple) == "function" then task.spawn(_G.VXFireGrapple) end

        local char = LocalPlayer.Character or LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Wait()
        local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not hrp then
            local _hw = os.clock()
            repeat
                RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
                hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            until hrp or (os.clock() - _hw) > 10
        end
        if not hrp then
            _G.VXLog("Auto-TP", "Aborted - no character root after 10s")
            _hotDone = true
            SharedState.VXAutoTPSettled = true
            closeFastScan(); _autoTPRunning = false; return
        end
        local minGen = (tonumber(Config.MinGenForAutoTP) or 0) * 1e6

        -- ============================================================
        --  O RELOGIO DO SCAN SO COMECA AGORA.
        --
        --  O cap de 10s era medido a partir de _scanT0, que e tirado
        --  ANTES da espera pelo personagem. Em load lento (personagem
        --  demorando 6-10s pra nascer) o cap ja estava estourado quando
        --  o loop comecava: ele quebrava na primeira volta, com a lista
        --  ainda vazia, e o start terminava em "No target" sem nunca ter
        --  scaneado nada. _scanT0 continua so pros logs de tempo total.
        -- ============================================================
        local _waitT0 = os.clock()
        _hotDeadline = os.clock() + 12

        local PLOT_WAIT_CAP = 10
        local RETRY_WINDOW  = 6

        local function _plotCoverageReady()
            if _G.VXDisablePlotScan == true then return true end
            local st = SharedState.PlotScanStats or {}
            local plots = tonumber(st.plots) or 0
            local resolved = tonumber(st.resolved) or 0
            if plots > 0 and resolved >= plots then return true end
            return SharedState.VXScanBarrier == true
        end

        local function _pick()
            local ranked = _buildPetList()
            local cand = _firstAllowedCand(ranked)
            if cand and (tonumber(cand.mpsValue or cand.mps or cand.genValue) or 0) < minGen then
                cand = nil
            end
            return cand, ranked
        end

        local target, ranked, barrierOk = nil, {}, false
        local pushes = 0
        local settleAt = nil
        local SETTLE = 0.20
        while true do
            if _G.VXFlushCache then pcall(_G.VXFlushCache) end
            target, ranked = _pick()

            if SharedState.VXScanBarrierFast == true or SharedState.VXScanBarrier == true then
                barrierOk = true
            end
            pushes = pushes + 1

            local covered = _plotCoverageReady()
            if covered and #ranked > 0 then
                settleAt = settleAt or os.clock()
                if (os.clock() - settleAt) >= SETTLE then break end
            else
                settleAt = nil
            end

            if barrierOk and covered then break end
            if (os.clock() - _waitT0) > PLOT_WAIT_CAP then
                _G.VXLog("Auto-TP", string.format(
                    "Plot coverage incomplete after %.2fs - picking from what resolved", os.clock() - _waitT0))
                break
            end
            RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
        end

        if _G.VXFlushCache then pcall(_G.VXFlushCache) end
        target, ranked = _pick()

        --  Cap estourado com a lista ainda vazia significa que nada
        --  resolveu a tempo, nao que nao ha alvo. Antes o start desistia
        --  aqui e logava "No target". Agora insiste mais RETRY_WINDOW
        --  segundos, com o hot scan ainda rodando, antes de desistir.
        if not target then
            _hotDeadline = os.clock() + RETRY_WINDOW + 1
            local _r0 = os.clock()
            while not target and (os.clock() - _r0) < RETRY_WINDOW do
                RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
                if _G.VXFlushCache then pcall(_G.VXFlushCache) end
                target, ranked = _pick()
            end
            if target then
                _G.VXLog("Auto-TP", string.format(
                    "Target only resolved %.2fs past the scan cap - going anyway", os.clock() - _r0))
            end
        end
        _hotDone = true

        do
            local st = SharedState.PlotScanStats or {}
            _G.VXLog("Auto-TP", string.format("Picked from %d of %d plots resolved, %d ranked, %s",
                tonumber(st.resolved) or 0, tonumber(st.plots) or 0, #ranked,
                (target and target.isCarpet) and "carpet" or "plot"))
        end
        if SharedState.VXScanBarrierFast == true or SharedState.VXScanBarrier == true then
            barrierOk = true
        end
        local _pickT0 = os.clock()

        SharedState.VXAutoTPSettled = true

        if target then

            SharedState.SelectedPetData = target
            if _G.VXStartSideTP then
                task.spawn(_G.VXStartSideTP)
            elseif _G.VXRunTP then
                _G.VXRunTP()
            end
            closeFastScan()

            task.defer(function()
                if _G.VXShowAutoTPNotif then
                    pcall(_G.VXShowAutoTPNotif, target.petName or target.name,
                        target.mpsText or target.genText, target.index, target)
                end
                pcall(playAlert)
            end)
        end

        local _fireT = os.clock()
        task.spawn(function()
            local st = SharedState.PlotScanStats or {}
            _G.VXLog("Scanner", string.format("Target search %s in %.3fs (%d scan pushes) - barrier %s - %d of %d plots resolved - %d brainrots ranked",
                target and "hit" or "MISSED", _pickT0 - _scanT0, pushes,
                barrierOk and "reached" or "NOT reached",
                tonumber(st.resolved) or 0, tonumber(st.plots) or 0, #ranked))
            if target then
                _G.VXLog("Auto-TP", string.format("Target locked %.3fs after character - %s (%s) - owner %s, plot %s slot %s - reason: %s",
                    _fireT - _scanT0,
                    tostring(target.petName or target.name or "?"),
                    tostring(target.mpsText or target.genText or "$0/s"),
                    tostring(target.owner or "?"), tostring(target.plot or "?"),
                    tostring(target.slot or "?"), tostring(mode)))
                _G.VXLog("Auto-TP", string.format("Teleport fired - method %s, clone %s",
                    tostring(Config.TpSettings and Config.TpSettings.TeleportMethod or "?"),
                    (Config.TpSettings and Config.TpSettings.CloneAfterTP) and "on" or "off"))
            else
                _G.VXLog("Auto-TP", "No target - nothing met the minimum generation filter")
            end
            for i = 1, #ranked do _G.VXLogPet(i, ranked[i]) end
        end)

        closeFastScan()
        _autoTPRunning = false
    end
    task.spawn(_runAutoTPOnLoad)

end)()

_G.VXDelayFrom("ESPDelay", function()

    local function espMount(inst)

        if inst:IsA("LayerCollector") then
            pcall(function() if syn and syn.protect_gui then syn.protect_gui(inst) end end)
            pcall(function() if typeof(protectgui) == "function" then protectgui(inst) end end)
        end
        inst.Parent = VXGui
        return inst
    end

    local function espGoldPill(parent, topY, h, textSize)
        h = h or 17
        local holder = Instance.new("Frame", parent)
        holder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        holder.BorderSizePixel = 0
        holder.Position = UDim2.new(0, 7, 0, topY or 4)
        holder.Size = UDim2.new(1, -14, 0, h)
        local hl = Instance.new("UIListLayout", holder)
        hl.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
        hl.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Right
        hl.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center

        local pill = Instance.new("Frame", holder)
        pill.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X
        pill.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, h)
        pill.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.GoldHi
        pill.BackgroundTransparency = 0.05
        pill.BorderSizePixel = 0

        Instance.new("UICorner", pill).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
        local grad = Instance.new("UIGradient", pill)
        grad.Rotation = 0
        grad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Theme.GoldHi),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Theme.GoldLo),
        })

        local pad = Instance.new("UIPadding", pill)
        pad.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 9)
        pad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 9)

        local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel", pill)
        lbl.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X
        lbl.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
        lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        lbl.Text = ""
        lbl.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
        lbl.TextSize = textSize or 9
        lbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(24, 18, 6)
        lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
        return holder, lbl
    end

    local function espGoldGradient(inst, rotation)
        local g = Instance.new("UIGradient", inst)
        g.Rotation = rotation or 0
        g.Color = ColorSequence.new({
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Theme.GoldHi),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Theme.GoldLo),
        })
        return g
    end

    local function espGoldStroke(frame, thickness, transparency)
        local s = Instance.new("UIStroke", frame)
        s.Thickness = thickness or 1.2
        s.Transparency = transparency or 0.15
        s.Color = Theme.GoldHi
        s.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
        espGoldGradient(s, 0)
        return s
    end

    local function espGoldAccentBar(parent)
        local bar = Instance.new("Frame", parent)
        bar.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.14, 0)
        bar.Size = UDim2.new(0, 3, 0.72, 0)
        bar.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.GoldHi
        bar.BorderSizePixel = 0
        Instance.new("UICorner", bar).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 2)
        espGoldGradient(bar, 90)
        return bar
    end

    local function espHrp()
        local c = LocalPlayer.Character
        return c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    end

    local function espAbbrev(v)
        v = tonumber(v) or 0
        for _, u in ipairs({ {1e15,"Q"}, {1e12,"T"}, {1e9,"B"}, {1e6,"M"}, {1e3,"K"} }) do
            if math.abs(v) >= u[1] then
                local s = string.format("%.2f", v / u[1]):gsub("%.?0+$", "")
                return s .. u[2]
            end
        end
        return tostring(math.floor(v + 0.5))
    end

    local ESP_RARITY_FALLBACK = {
        ["OG"] = Color3.fromRGB(255, 214, 92), ["Secret"] = Color3.fromRGB(236, 237, 242),
        ["Mythic"] = Color3.fromRGB(231, 56, 61), ["Brainrot God"] = Color3.fromRGB(255, 104, 138),
        ["Legendary"] = Color3.fromRGB(255, 214, 72), ["Epic"] = Color3.fromRGB(190, 96, 246),
        ["Rare"] = Color3.fromRGB(72, 148, 255), ["Uncommon"] = Color3.fromRGB(108, 206, 128),
        ["Common"] = Color3.fromRGB(64, 214, 74),
    }
    local function espRarityInfo(data)
        if _G.VXRarityInfo then
            local ok, w, c = pcall(_G.VXRarityInfo, data)
            if ok and w and c then return w, c end
        end
        local word = data.rarity or "Common"
        return word, ESP_RARITY_FALLBACK[word] or Theme.TextMuted
    end

    local function espAdornee(data)
        if not data then return nil end
        if data.isCarpet then
            local p = data._part
            if p and p.Parent then return p end
            local m = data._model
            if m and m.Parent then
                return m:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or m.PrimaryPart
                or m:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
            end
            return nil
        end
        return findAdorneeGlobal(data)
    end

    local function espDistanceTo(data)
        local part = espAdornee(data)
        local hrp = espHrp()
        if not (part and part.Parent and hrp) then return "???" end
        return string.format("%.0f", (hrp.Position - part.Position).Magnitude)
    end

    local function espPathClear(origin, dest, char)
        local rp = RaycastParams.new()
        rp.FilterDescendantsInstances = { char }
        rp.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        local dir = dest - origin
        for _ = 1, 8 do
            local res = Workspace:Raycast(origin, dir, rp)
            if not (res and res.Instance) then return true end
            if res.Instance.CanCollide ~= false then return false end
            origin = res.Position + (dir.Unit * 0.1)
            dir = dest - origin
        end
        return false
    end

    local espLineGui
    local function espEnsureLineGui()
        if espLineGui and espLineGui.Parent then return true end
        espLineGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
        espLineGui.Name = _vxName("espLineGui")
        espLineGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
        espMount(espLineGui)
        return true
    end

    local function espStyleBeam(beam)
        if not beam then return end
        beam.FaceCamera = true
        beam.LightEmission = 1
        beam.LightInfluence = 0
        beam.Color = ColorSequence.new({
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Theme.GoldHi),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Theme.SilverHi),
        })
        beam.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0.35)
        beam.Width0 = 0.45
        beam.Width1 = 0.45
        beam.TextureMode = Enum.TextureMode.Wrap
        beam.TextureSpeed = 0
        beam.Enabled = true
    end

    local function espAttachOn(part, name, offset)
        local a = part:FindFirstChild(name)
        if not (a and a:IsA("Attachment")) then a = Instance.new("Attachment") end
        a.Name = name
        a.Position = offset or Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
        a.Parent = part
        return a
    end

    do
        local BEAM_NAME = _vxName("espBaseBeam")
        local ATT0_NAME = _vxName("espBaseA0")
        local ATT1_NAME = _vxName("espBaseA1")

        local _plotBeam, _plotAtt0, _plotAtt1, _plotPart
        local _cachedPlot

        local function ownsByYourBase(plot)
            local sign = plot:FindFirstChild("PlotSign")
            local yb = sign and sign:FindFirstChild("YourBase")
            return yb ~= nil and yb:IsA("BillboardGui") and yb.Enabled == true
        end

        local function ownsBySignText(plot)
            local sign = plot:FindFirstChild("PlotSign")
            local surfaceGui = sign and sign:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SurfaceGui", true)
            local label = surfaceGui and surfaceGui:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextLabel", true)
            if not label then return false end
            local text = label.Text:lower()
            return text:find(LocalPlayer.DisplayName:lower(), 1, true) ~= nil
            or text:find(LocalPlayer.Name:lower(), 1, true) ~= nil
        end

        local function ownsByChannel(plot)
            local syncOk, isOwner = false, false
            pcall(function()
                local get = _G.VXSyncGet
                if not get then return end
                local ch = get(plot.Name)
                if not ch then return end
                local own = _G.VXSProp(ch, "Owner")
                if own == nil then return end
                syncOk = true
                if (typeof(own) == "Instance" and own == LocalPlayer)
                or (type(own) == "table" and own.UserId == LocalPlayer.UserId)
                or (type(own) == "number" and own == LocalPlayer.UserId) then
                    isOwner = true
                elseif type(own) == "table" and type(own.Name) == "string" then
                    isOwner = (own.Name == LocalPlayer.Name)
                elseif type(own) == "string" then
                    isOwner = (own == LocalPlayer.Name or own == LocalPlayer.DisplayName)
                end
            end)
            return syncOk, isOwner
        end

        local function findMyPlot()
            local plots = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")
            if not plots then return nil end
            if _cachedPlot and _cachedPlot.Parent and _cachedPlot.Parent == plots then return _cachedPlot end
            local children = plots:GetChildren()

            local anySync = false
            for _, plot in ipairs(children) do
                local syncOk, owns = ownsByChannel(plot)
                if syncOk then
                    anySync = true
                    if owns then _cachedPlot = plot; return plot end
                end
            end

            for _, plot in ipairs(children) do
                if ownsByYourBase(plot) then _cachedPlot = plot; return plot end
            end

            if anySync then return nil end
            local hit, count = nil, 0
            for _, plot in ipairs(children) do
                if ownsBySignText(plot) then count = count + 1; hit = plot end
            end
            if count == 1 then _cachedPlot = hit; return hit end
            return nil
        end

        local function getPlotAnchorPart(plot)
            if not plot then return nil end
            local target = plot:FindFirstChild("AnimalTarget")
            if target and target:IsA("BasePart") then return target end
            local main = plot:FindFirstChild("MainRootPart")
            if main and main:IsA("BasePart") then return main end
            return plot:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
        end

        local function destroyPlotBeam()
            if _plotBeam then pcall(function() _plotBeam:Destroy() end) end
            if _plotAtt0 then pcall(function() _plotAtt0:Destroy() end) end
            if _plotAtt1 then pcall(function() _plotAtt1:Destroy() end) end
            _plotBeam, _plotAtt0, _plotAtt1, _plotPart = nil, nil, nil, nil
        end

        local function ensurePlotBeam(hrp, plotPart)
            if not (hrp and hrp.Parent and plotPart and plotPart.Parent) then return end

            if not _plotAtt0 or not _plotAtt0.Parent or _plotAtt0.Parent ~= hrp then
                if _plotAtt0 then pcall(function() _plotAtt0:Destroy() end) end
                _plotAtt0 = espAttachOn(hrp, ATT0_NAME, Vector3.new(0, 0, 0))
            end

            if _plotPart ~= plotPart or not _plotAtt1 or not _plotAtt1.Parent then
                if _plotAtt1 then pcall(function() _plotAtt1:Destroy() end) end
                _plotAtt1 = espAttachOn(plotPart, ATT1_NAME, Vector3.new(0, 0, 0))
                _plotPart = plotPart
                if _plotBeam then _plotBeam.Attachment1 = _plotAtt1 end
            end

            if not _plotBeam or not _plotBeam.Parent then
                if _plotBeam then pcall(function() _plotBeam:Destroy() end) end
                _plotBeam = Instance.new("Beam")
                _plotBeam.Name = BEAM_NAME
                _plotBeam.Attachment0 = _plotAtt0
                _plotBeam.Attachment1 = _plotAtt1
                espStyleBeam(_plotBeam)
                _plotBeam.Parent = hrp
            else
                _plotBeam.Attachment0 = _plotAtt0
                _plotBeam.Attachment1 = _plotAtt1
                espStyleBeam(_plotBeam)
            end
        end

        function createPlotBeam()
            if not Config.LineToBase then return end
            local hrp = espHrp()
            if not hrp then return end
            local myPlot = findMyPlot()
            if not myPlot then return end
            local plotPart = getPlotAnchorPart(myPlot)
            if not plotPart then return end
            pcall(ensurePlotBeam, hrp, plotPart)
        end

        _G.createPlotBeam = createPlotBeam
        _G.resetPlotBeam = function() _cachedPlot = nil; destroyPlotBeam() end

        local _check = 0
        RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            if not Config.LineToBase then
                if _plotBeam or _plotAtt0 or _plotAtt1 then destroyPlotBeam() end
                return
            end
            _check = _check + 1
            if _check < 10 then return end
            _check = 0

            local hrp = espHrp()
            if not hrp then
                if _plotBeam or _plotAtt0 or _plotAtt1 then destroyPlotBeam() end
                return
            end
            local myPlot = findMyPlot()
            if not myPlot then
                if _plotBeam or _plotAtt1 then
                    if _plotBeam then pcall(function() _plotBeam:Destroy() end); _plotBeam = nil end
                    if _plotAtt1 then pcall(function() _plotAtt1:Destroy() end); _plotAtt1 = nil end
                    _plotPart = nil
                end
                return
            end
            local plotPart = getPlotAnchorPart(myPlot)
            if not (plotPart and plotPart.Parent) then return end
            pcall(ensurePlotBeam, hrp, plotPart)
        end)

        LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
            task.wait(0.5)
            _cachedPlot = nil
            _plotPart = nil
            _plotAtt0 = nil
            if _plotBeam then pcall(function() _plotBeam:Destroy() end); _plotBeam = nil end
            if Config.LineToBase then pcall(createPlotBeam) end
        end)

        if Config.LineToBase and LocalPlayer.Character then
            task.defer(createPlotBeam)
        end
    end

    do
        local BEAM_NAME = _vxName("espLineBeam")
        local ATT0_NAME = _vxName("espLineA0")
        local ATT1_NAME = _vxName("espLineA1")

        local _beam, _att0, _att1, _targetPart
        local _marker

        local function destroyLineBeam()
            if _beam then pcall(function() _beam:Destroy() end) end
            if _att0 then pcall(function() _att0:Destroy() end) end
            if _att1 then pcall(function() _att1:Destroy() end) end
            _beam, _att0, _att1, _targetPart = nil, nil, nil, nil
            if _marker then _marker.Visible = false end
        end

        local function ensureMarker()
            if _marker and _marker.Parent then return end
            if not espEnsureLineGui() then return end
            local terrain = Workspace:FindFirstChildOfClass("Terrain")
            if not terrain then return end
            _marker = Instance.new("SphereHandleAdornment")
            _marker.Name = _vxName("espLineMarker")
            _marker.Radius = 0.6
            _marker.Transparency = 0.1
            _marker.Color3 = Theme.GoldHi
            _marker.Adornee = terrain
            _marker.Visible = false
            _marker.Parent = espLineGui
        end

        local function ensureLineBeam(hrp, targetPart)
            if not (hrp and hrp.Parent and targetPart and targetPart.Parent) then return end

            if not _att0 or not _att0.Parent or _att0.Parent ~= hrp then
                if _att0 then pcall(function() _att0:Destroy() end) end
                _att0 = espAttachOn(hrp, ATT0_NAME, Vector3.new(0, 0, 0))
            end

            if _targetPart ~= targetPart or not _att1 or not _att1.Parent then
                if _att1 then pcall(function() _att1:Destroy() end) end
                _att1 = espAttachOn(targetPart, ATT1_NAME, Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
                _targetPart = targetPart
                if _beam then _beam.Attachment1 = _att1 end
            end

            if not _beam or not _beam.Parent then
                if _beam then pcall(function() _beam:Destroy() end) end
                _beam = Instance.new("Beam")
                _beam.Name = BEAM_NAME
                _beam.Attachment0 = _att0
                _beam.Attachment1 = _att1
                espStyleBeam(_beam)
                _beam.Parent = hrp
            else
                _beam.Attachment0 = _att0
                _beam.Attachment1 = _att1
            end
        end

        local _clear = nil
        local function applyClear(isClear)
            if _clear == isClear or not _beam then return end
            _clear = isClear
            if isClear then
                _beam.Color = ColorSequence.new({
                    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Theme.GoldHi),
                    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Theme.SilverHi),
                })
                _beam.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0.35)
                _beam.LightEmission = 1
                if _marker then _marker.Color3 = Theme.GoldHi end
            else
                local dark = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 24)
                _beam.Color = ColorSequence.new(dark)
                _beam.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0.1)
                _beam.LightEmission = 0
                if _marker then _marker.Color3 = dark end
            end
        end

        local _check, _trSel, _trPart, _trPartNext, _trLastRay, _trClear = 0, nil, nil, 0, 0, true
        RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            local sel = Config.TracerEnabled and SharedState.SelectedPetData or nil
            if not sel then
                if _beam or _att0 or _att1 then destroyLineBeam() end
                return
            end
            _check = _check + 1
            if _check < 10 then return end
            _check = 0

            local char = LocalPlayer.Character
            local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not hrp then
                if _beam or _att0 or _att1 then destroyLineBeam() end
                return
            end
            if _trSel ~= sel then _trSel = sel; _trPart = nil; _trPartNext = 0; _trLastRay = 0 end

            local targetPart = _trPart
            if sel.isCarpet then
                targetPart = espAdornee(sel)
            elseif not (targetPart and targetPart.Parent) or os.clock() >= _trPartNext then
                _trPartNext = os.clock() + 0.25
                targetPart = espAdornee(sel)
                _trPart = targetPart
            end
            if not (targetPart and targetPart.Parent) then
                if _beam or _att0 or _att1 then destroyLineBeam() end
                return
            end

            ensureMarker()
            pcall(ensureLineBeam, hrp, targetPart)

            local exact = targetPart.Position
            if os.clock() - _trLastRay >= 0.15 then
                _trLastRay = os.clock()
                local clear = espPathClear(hrp.Position, exact, char)

                if not clear and not sel.isCarpet and exact.Y > 10 then
                    local bf = targetPart.Position + (targetPart.CFrame.LookVector * 3.5)
                    clear = espPathClear(hrp.Position, Vector3.new(bf.X, exact.Y - 6.75, bf.Z), char)
                end
                _trClear = clear
            end
            applyClear(_trClear)

            if _marker and _marker.Parent and _marker.Adornee then
                _marker.CFrame = _marker.Adornee.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(CFrame.new(exact))
                _marker.Visible = true
            end
        end)

        LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
            task.wait(0.5)
            _att0 = nil
            _targetPart = nil
            if _beam then pcall(function() _beam:Destroy() end); _beam = nil end
        end)
    end

    do
        local billboards = {}

        local priorityLower, espCustomized = {}, false
        local _plRef, _plStamp

        local function refreshPriorityLookup()
            local list = Config.PriorityList
            local stamp = _G.VXPriorityStamp or 0
            if list == _plRef and stamp == _plStamp then return end
            _plRef, _plStamp = list, stamp
            priorityLower, espCustomized = {}, false
            if type(list) ~= "table" or #list == 0 then return end
            espCustomized = true
            for _, name in ipairs(list) do priorityLower[tostring(name):lower()] = true end
            if type(Config.PriorityBlacklist) == "table" then
                for _, b in ipairs(Config.PriorityBlacklist) do priorityLower[tostring(b):lower()] = nil end
            end
        end
        refreshPriorityLookup()

        local function isPriorityBrainrot(name)
            if not name then return false end
            refreshPriorityLookup()
            return espCustomized and priorityLower[tostring(name):lower()] ~= nil
        end
        _G.VXIsPriorityBrainrot = isPriorityBrainrot

        local function espPrice(data)
            if data.price then return "$" .. espAbbrev(data.price) end
            return "$?"
        end

        local function espSig(data)
            return tostring(data.name) .. "|" .. tostring(data.genValue) .. "|"
            .. tostring(data.mutation) .. "|" .. tostring(data.traits) .. "|"
            .. tostring(data.rarity) .. "|" .. tostring(data.owner)
        end

        local CARD_W = 252
        local CARD_H_FULL = 74
        local CARD_H_SLIM = 60

        local function buildCard(data)
            local rWord, rCol = espRarityInfo(data)

            local ownerText = (data.owner and data.owner ~= "")
            and ("@" .. tostring(data.owner)) or nil
            local cardH = ownerText and CARD_H_FULL or CARD_H_SLIM

            local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
            bb.Name = _vxName("espBrainrot")
            bb.ResetOnSpawn = false
            bb.Size = UDim2.new(0, CARD_W, 0, cardH)

            mutLbl.TextSize = 12

            mutLbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left

            for i = 1, 4 do

                ic.LayoutOrder = 3 + i

        local function dropAll()
            for uid, entry in pairs(billboards) do
                if entry.bb then pcall(function() entry.bb:Destroy() end) end
                billboards[uid] = nil
            end
        end

        local function markBest(entry, isBest)
            local tag = entry.tagLbl
            if not tag then return end
            if isBest then
                if tag.Text ~= "BEST" then tag.Text = "BEST" end
            else
                local base = tag:GetAttribute("BaseText")
                if base and tag.Text ~= base then tag.Text = base end
            end
        end

        local BR_ESP_MAX  = 16
        local BR_ESP_FLOOR = 10000000

        local function refreshBrainrotESP()
            local cache = SharedState.AllAnimalsCache
            if not cache or #cache == 0 then return end
            local sel = SharedState.SelectedPetData
            local bestUid = sel and sel.uid
            refreshPriorityLookup()

            local topCarpetUid, topCarpetGen = nil, -1
            for _, data in ipairs(cache) do
                if data.isCarpet and data.uid then
                    local gv = tonumber(data.genValue) or 0
                    if gv > topCarpetGen then topCarpetGen = gv; topCarpetUid = data.uid end
                end
            end

            local seen, shown = {}, 0
            for _, data in ipairs(cache) do
                local isBest = data.uid ~= nil and data.uid == bestUid
                local isTopCarpet = data.uid ~= nil and data.uid == topCarpetUid
                local wanted
                if isBest or isTopCarpet then
                    wanted = true
                elseif shown >= BR_ESP_MAX then
                    wanted = false
                elseif espCustomized then
                    wanted = isPriorityBrainrot(data.name)
                else
                    wanted = (tonumber(data.genValue) or 0) >= BR_ESP_FLOOR
                end
                if data.uid and wanted then
                    if not (isBest or isTopCarpet) then shown = shown + 1 end
                    seen[data.uid] = true
                    local entry = billboards[data.uid]
                    local sig = espSig(data)
                    if entry and (not entry.bb or not entry.bb.Parent or entry.sig ~= sig) then
                        if entry.bb then pcall(function() entry.bb:Destroy() end) end
                        entry = nil
                        billboards[data.uid] = nil
                    end
                    if not entry then
                        local adornee = espAdornee(data)
                        if adornee then
                            local bb, distLabel, tagLbl = buildCard(data)
                            bb.Adornee = adornee
                            espMount(bb)
                            entry = { bb = bb, distLabel = distLabel, tagLbl = tagLbl,
                            sig = sig, isCarpet = data.isCarpet }
                            billboards[data.uid] = entry
                        end
                    end
                    if entry then markBest(entry, isBest) end
                end
            end

            for uid, entry in pairs(billboards) do
                if not seen[uid] then
                    if entry.bb then pcall(function() entry.bb:Destroy() end) end
                    billboards[uid] = nil
                end
            end
        end

        local _espWarned = false
        local function safeRefresh()
            if not Config.BrainrotESP then return end
            local ok, err = pcall(refreshBrainrotESP)
            if not ok and not _espWarned then
                _espWarned = true
                warn("[VX] Brainrot ESP error: " .. tostring(err))
            end
        end
        SharedState.OnBrainrotList(safeRefresh)

        task.spawn(function()
            local wasOn, lastBest = false, nil
            while true do
                task.wait(0.25)
                local on = (Config.BrainrotESP == true)
                if not on then
                    if wasOn or next(billboards) then dropAll() end
                    wasOn = false
                    lastBest = nil
                else
                    if not wasOn then
                        wasOn = true
                        safeRefresh()
                    end
                    local sel = SharedState.SelectedPetData
                    local bestUid = sel and sel.uid
                    if bestUid ~= lastBest then
                        lastBest = bestUid
                        safeRefresh()
                    end
                    if next(billboards) then
                        pcall(function()
                            local byUid = {}
                            local cache = SharedState.AllAnimalsCache
                            if cache then
                                for _, pet in ipairs(cache) do
                                    if pet.uid then byUid[pet.uid] = pet end
                                end
                            end
                            for uid, entry in pairs(billboards) do
                                local data = byUid[uid]
                                if data then
                                    if entry.isCarpet and entry.bb then
                                        local ad = espAdornee(data)
                                        if ad and entry.bb.Adornee ~= ad then entry.bb.Adornee = ad end
                                    end
                                    if entry.distLabel then
                                        entry.distLabel.Text = espDistanceTo(data) .. "m"
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end)
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
    end

    do
        local playerESPEnabled = Config.PlayerESP
        local playerESPData = {}

        local ESP_GROUP_COLORS = {
            Owner      = Color3.fromRGB(255, 70, 90),
            FMLY       = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 85),
        }

        local function espGroupTags(player)
            local tags = {}
            if Config.BaseOwnerESP == true and _G.VXBaseOwnerUserId == player.UserId then tags[#tags + 1] = "Owner" end
            if isFMLYPlayer(player) and Config.ESPShowFMLY == true then tags[#tags + 1] = "FMLY" end
            return tags
        end

        local function createPlayerESP(player)
            if player == LocalPlayer then return end
            local char = player.Character
            if not char then return end

            local anchorPart = char:FindFirstChild("Head") or char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not anchorPart then return end

            local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if hum then hum.DisplayDistanceType = Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None end

            local tags = espGroupTags(player)
            local isFmly = isFMLYPlayer(player) and Config.ESPShowFMLY == true

            local isOwner = (tags[1] == "Owner")
            local accent = isOwner and ESP_GROUP_COLORS.Owner
            or (tags[1] and ESP_GROUP_COLORS[tags[1]]) or Theme.GoldHi

            local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
            highlight.Name = _vxName("espPlayerHL")
            highlight.Adornee = char
            highlight.FillColor = accent
            highlight.FillTransparency = 0.72
            highlight.OutlineColor = accent
            highlight.OutlineTransparency = 0
            highlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
            espMount(highlight)

            local shownTags = 0
            for _, tag in ipairs(tags) do
                if tag ~= "Owner" then shownTags = shownTags + 1 end
            end

            local billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
            billboard.Name = _vxName("espPlayer")
            billboard.Size = UDim2.new(0, 260, 0, 30 + shownTags * 20)
            billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0)
            billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
            billboard.LightInfluence = 0
            billboard.MaxDistance = 2000
            billboard.ResetOnSpawn = false
            billboard.Adornee = anchorPart
            espMount(billboard)

            local stack = Instance.new("UIListLayout", billboard)
            stack.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Vertical
            stack.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
            stack.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Bottom
            stack.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
            stack.Padding = UDim.new(0, 1)

            for i, tag in ipairs(tags) do
                if tag ~= "Owner" then
                    local t = Instance.new("TextLabel", billboard)
                    t.Name = "Tag_" .. tag
                    t.LayoutOrder = i
                    t.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 19)
                    t.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                    t.BorderSizePixel = 0
                    t.Text = "[" .. tag .. "]"
                    t.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
                    t.TextSize = 16
                    t.TextColor3 = ESP_GROUP_COLORS[tag] or accent
                    t.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.15
                    t.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
                end
            end

            local nameLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel", billboard)
            nameLabel.Name = "NameLabel"
            nameLabel.LayoutOrder = shownTags + 1
            nameLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 26)
            nameLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            nameLabel.BorderSizePixel = 0
            nameLabel.Text = "@" .. player.DisplayName
            nameLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
            nameLabel.TextSize = 20
            nameLabel.TextColor3 = (isOwner and ESP_GROUP_COLORS.Owner)
            or (isFmly and ESP_GROUP_COLORS.FMLY or Theme.GoldHi)
            nameLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.15
            nameLabel.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)

            playerESPData[player.UserId] = {
                highlight = highlight,
                billboard = billboard,
                anchor = anchorPart,
                player = player,
                tagKey = table.concat(tags, ","),
            }
            return true
        end

        local function removePlayerESP(player)
            local data = playerESPData[player.UserId]
            if data then
                if data.highlight then pcall(function() data.highlight:Destroy() end) end
                if data.billboard then pcall(function() data.billboard:Destroy() end) end
                playerESPData[player.UserId] = nil
            end
        end

        local function clearAllPlayerESP()
            for _, data in pairs(playerESPData) do
                if data.highlight then pcall(function() data.highlight:Destroy() end) end
                if data.billboard then pcall(function() data.billboard:Destroy() end) end
            end
            playerESPData = {}
        end

        local function refreshPlayerESP()
            local ownerId = (Config.BaseOwnerESP == true) and _G.VXBaseOwnerUserId or nil
            if not playerESPEnabled and not ownerId then
                clearAllPlayerESP()
                return
            end
            local current = {}
            for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if player ~= LocalPlayer and (playerESPEnabled or player.UserId == ownerId) then
                    current[player.UserId] = true
                    local d = playerESPData[player.UserId]

                    local stale = d and (not d.anchor or not d.anchor.Parent
                        or not d.billboard or not d.billboard.Parent)
                    if stale then
                        removePlayerESP(player)
                        d = nil
                    end
                    if not d then createPlayerESP(player) end
                end
            end
            for userId, data in pairs(playerESPData) do
                if not current[userId] then
                    local player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(userId)
                    if player then
                        removePlayerESP(player)
                    else
                        if data.highlight then pcall(function() data.highlight:Destroy() end) end
                        if data.billboard then pcall(function() data.billboard:Destroy() end) end
                        playerESPData[userId] = nil
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        _G.VXRebuildPlayerESP = function()
            pcall(clearAllPlayerESP)
            pcall(refreshPlayerESP)
        end

        local function onCharacterAdded(player)
            return function()
                task.wait(0.5)
                if playerESPEnabled and player ~= LocalPlayer then
                    removePlayerESP(player)
                    createPlayerESP(player)
                end
            end
        end

        for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if player ~= LocalPlayer then
                player.CharacterAdded:Connect(onCharacterAdded(player))
            end
        end

        Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
            if player ~= LocalPlayer then
                player.CharacterAdded:Connect(onCharacterAdded(player))
                task.wait(0.5)
                if playerESPEnabled then createPlayerESP(player) end
            end
        end)

        Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
            removePlayerESP(player)
        end)

        task.spawn(function()
            local function plotBoxContains(plot, pos)
                local podiums = plot:FindFirstChild("AnimalPodiums")
                if not podiums then return false end
                local minX, maxX, minZ, maxZ = math.huge, -math.huge, math.huge, -math.huge
                local cnt = 0
                for _, p in ipairs(podiums:GetChildren()) do
                    local base = p:FindFirstChild("Base")
                    local spawnP = base and base:FindFirstChild("Spawn")
                    local checkPos = (spawnP and spawnP.Position) or (base and base.Position)
                    if checkPos then
                        cnt = cnt + 1
                        minX = math.min(minX, checkPos.X); maxX = math.max(maxX, checkPos.X)
                        minZ = math.min(minZ, checkPos.Z); maxZ = math.max(maxZ, checkPos.Z)
                    end
                end
                if cnt == 0 then return false end
                local sizeX = (maxX - minX) + 13
                local sizeZ = (maxZ - minZ) + 8
                local maxY = (cnt <= 10 and 10) or (cnt <= 18 and 25) or 40
                return pos.Y <= maxY and pos.Y >= -10
                and math.abs(pos.X - (minX + maxX) / 2) <= sizeX / 2
                and math.abs(pos.Z - (minZ + maxZ) / 2) <= sizeZ / 2
            end
            while true do
                task.wait(0.4)
                if Config.BaseOwnerESP == true then
                    local newOwnerId = nil
                    pcall(function()
                        local hrp = espHrp()
                        if not hrp then return end
                        local plots = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")
                        if not plots then return end

                        for _, plot in ipairs(plots:GetChildren()) do
                            if plotBoxContains(plot, hrp.Position) then
                                local op = _G.VXPlotOwnerPlayer
                                local ownerPlr = op and op(plot)
                                if ownerPlr and ownerPlr.UserId ~= LocalPlayer.UserId then
                                    newOwnerId = ownerPlr.UserId
                                end
                                break
                            end
                        end
                    end)
                    _G.VXBaseOwnerUserId = newOwnerId
                elseif _G.VXBaseOwnerUserId ~= nil then
                    _G.VXBaseOwnerUserId = nil
                end
            end
        end)

        local _pesAcc = 0
        RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
            playerESPEnabled = Config.PlayerESP
            local ownerActive = (Config.BaseOwnerESP == true) and (_G.VXBaseOwnerUserId ~= nil)
            if playerESPEnabled or ownerActive then
                _pesAcc = _pesAcc + dt
                if _pesAcc < 0.5 then return end
                _pesAcc = 0
                refreshPlayerESP()

                for _, data in pairs(playerESPData) do
                    local plr = data.player
                    if plr and plr.Parent then
                        local key = table.concat(espGroupTags(plr), ",")
                        if key ~= data.tagKey then
                            removePlayerESP(plr)
                            createPlayerESP(plr)
                        end
                    end
                end
            elseif next(playerESPData) then
                clearAllPlayerESP()
            end
        end)
    end

    do
        local mineData = {}
        local FolderName = "ToolsAdds"

        local function getMineOwner(mineName)
            local ownerName = mineName:match("SubspaceTripmine(.+)")
            if not ownerName then return "Unknown" end
            local found = Players:FindFirstChild(ownerName)

        end

        local function createMineESP(mine)

            local box = Instance.new("SelectionBox")
            box.Name = _vxName("espMineBox")

            box.Color3 = Theme.GoldHi
            box.LineThickness = 0.05
