        local function dropMine(data)
            if data.box and data.box.Parent then pcall(function() data.box:Destroy() end) end
            if data.bb and data.bb.Parent then pcall(function() data.bb:Destroy() end) end
        end

        local function refreshMineESP()
            if not Config.SubspaceMineESP then
                for k, data in pairs(mineData) do
                    dropMine(data)
                    mineData[k] = nil
                end
                return
            end
            local folder = Workspace:FindFirstChild(FolderName)
            if not folder then return end

            local current = {}
            for _, obj in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
                if obj:IsA("BasePart") and obj.Name:match("^SubspaceTripmine") then
                    current[obj] = true
                    if not mineData[obj] then mineData[obj] = createMineESP(obj) end
                end
            end
            for mineObj, data in pairs(mineData) do
                if not current[mineObj] or not mineObj.Parent then
                    dropMine(data)
                    mineData[mineObj] = nil
                end
            end
        end

        local _mineAcc = 0
        RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
            _mineAcc = _mineAcc + dt
            if _mineAcc < 1.5 then return end
            _mineAcc = 0
            pcall(refreshMineESP)
        end)
    end

    do
        local stealingESPData = {}
        _G.VXGetSteals = function() return stealingESPData end

        local function getOccupiedSlots(plot)
            local occupied = {}
            local cache = SharedState.AllAnimalsCache
            if type(cache) ~= "table" then return occupied end
            for _, pet in ipairs(cache) do
                if not pet.isCarpet and pet.plot == plot.Name then
                    local n = tonumber(pet.slot)
                    if n then occupied[n] = true end
                end
            end
            return occupied
        end

        local function _podiumHasStealPrompt(podium)
            local base = podium:FindFirstChild("Base")
            local spawnP = base and base:FindFirstChild("Spawn")
            local att = spawnP and spawnP:FindFirstChild("PromptAttachment")
            if not att then return false end
            for _, ch in ipairs(att:GetChildren()) do
                if ch:IsA("ProximityPrompt") and ch.Enabled then
                    local state = ch:GetAttribute("State")
                    if state == "Steal" or state == "Grab"
                    or ch.ActionText == "Steal" or ch.ActionText == "Grab" then
                        return true
                    end
                end
            end
            return false
        end

        local function _podiumHasAnimalRig(podium)
            for _, ch in ipairs(podium:GetChildren()) do
                if ch:IsA("Model")
                and (ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    or ch:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid")
                    or ch.PrimaryPart) then
                    return true
                end
            end
            return false
        end

        local function getFirstEmptySlot(plot)
            local podiumFolder = plot:FindFirstChild("AnimalPodiums")
            if not podiumFolder then return nil, nil end
            local occupied = getOccupiedSlots(plot)

            local maxSlot, slots = 0, {}
            for _, podium in ipairs(podiumFolder:GetChildren()) do
                local slotNum = tonumber(podium.Name)
                if slotNum then
                    slots[slotNum] = podium
                    if slotNum > maxSlot then maxSlot = slotNum end
                end
            end

            local livePodium, liveSlot = nil, nil
            for slot = 1, maxSlot do
                local podium = slots[slot]
                if podium then
                    local live = _podiumHasStealPrompt(podium) or _podiumHasAnimalRig(podium)
                    if not live then
                        if not occupied[slot] then return podium, slot end
                        if not livePodium then livePodium, liveSlot = podium, slot end
                    end
                end
            end

            if livePodium then return livePodium, liveSlot end
            return nil, nil
        end

        local _plotMemo = {}
        local PLOT_MEMO_TTL = 4

        local function _signNick(plot)
            local sign = plot:FindFirstChild("PlotSign")
            local surfaceGui = sign and sign:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SurfaceGui", true)
            local label = surfaceGui and surfaceGui:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextLabel", true)
            if not label then return nil end
            local txt = label.Text
            if not txt or txt == "" then return nil end
            local nick = txt:match("^(.-)'") or txt
            nick = nick:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
            if nick == "" then return nil end
            return nick:lower()
        end

        local function _remember(player, plot)
            _plotMemo[player.UserId] = { plot = plot, at = os.clock() }
            return plot
        end

        local function getPlayerPlot(player)
            local cached = _plotMemo[player.UserId]
            if cached and cached.plot and cached.plot.Parent
            and (os.clock() - cached.at) < PLOT_MEMO_TTL then
                return cached.plot
            end
            _plotMemo[player.UserId] = nil

            local plots = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")
            if not plots then return nil end
            local kids = plots:GetChildren()
            local dn, nm = player.DisplayName:lower(), player.Name:lower()

            local taken = {}
            for _, plot in ipairs(kids) do
                local oName, oUid
                if _G.VXPlotOwner then
                    local okO, a, b = pcall(_G.VXPlotOwner, plot)
                    if okO then oName, oUid = a, b end
                end
                if oUid ~= nil then
                    if oUid == player.UserId then return _remember(player, plot) end
                    taken[plot] = true
                elseif oName ~= nil then
                    local lo = tostring(oName):lower()
                    if lo == dn or lo == nm then return _remember(player, plot) end
                    taken[plot] = true
                end
            end

            local hit, matches = nil, 0
            for _, plot in ipairs(kids) do
                if not taken[plot] then
                    local nick = _signNick(plot)
                    if nick and (nick == dn or nick == nm) then matches = matches + 1; hit = plot end
                end
            end
            if matches == 1 then return _remember(player, hit) end

            hit, matches = nil, 0
            for _, plot in ipairs(kids) do
                if not taken[plot] then
                    local nick = _signNick(plot)
                    if nick and (nick:find(dn, 1, true) or nick:find(nm, 1, true)) then
                        matches = matches + 1; hit = plot
                    end
                end
            end
            if matches == 1 then return _remember(player, hit) end
            return nil
        end

        task.spawn(function()
            local plots = Workspace:WaitForChild("Plots", 20)
            if not plots then return end
            plots.ChildRemoved:Connect(function() _plotMemo = {} end)
            plots.ChildAdded:Connect(function() _plotMemo = {} end)
        end)

        local function isAnimalFromOwnPlot(animalName, playerPlot)
            if not playerPlot or animalName == nil then return false end
            local want = tostring(animalName):lower()
            if want == "" then return false end
            local cache = SharedState.AllAnimalsCache
            if not cache then return false end
            for _, pet in ipairs(cache) do
                if pet.plot == playerPlot.Name
                and ((pet.index and tostring(pet.index):lower() == want)
                    or (pet.name and tostring(pet.name):lower() == want)) then
                    return true
                end
            end
            return false
        end

        local _lastSeen = {}
        local function fileRow(key, row)
            if key == nil then return end
            local k = tostring(key):lower()
            if k ~= "" then _lastSeen[k] = row end
        end
        local function snapshotCache()
            local cache = SharedState.AllAnimalsCache
            if type(cache) ~= "table" then return end

            for pass = 1, 2 do
                local wantCarpet = (pass == 1)
                for _, pet in ipairs(cache) do
                    if ((pet.isCarpet and true or false) == wantCarpet)
                    and (pet.index or pet.name) then
                        local row = {
                            name     = pet.name,
                            index    = pet.index,
                            mutation = pet.mutation,
                            traits   = pet.traits,
                            genText  = pet.genText,
                            genValue = pet.genValue,
                            rarity   = pet.rarity,
                            price    = pet.price,
                            isCarpet = pet.isCarpet,
                            plot     = pet.plot,
                            slot     = pet.slot,
                        }
                        fileRow(pet.index, row)
                        fileRow(pet.name, row)
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        local _staticByKey = nil
        local function _staticRow(want)
            if _staticByKey == nil then
                local built = nil
                pcall(function()
                    local all = _G.VXAllAnimals and _G.VXAllAnimals() or nil
                    if type(all) ~= "table" or #all == 0 then return end
                    built = {}
                    for _, a in ipairs(all) do
                        local nm = tostring(a.name or "")
                        if nm ~= "" then
                            built[nm:lower()] = { name = nm, rarity = a.rarity, gen = tonumber(a.gen) or 0 }
                        end
                    end

                    local byDisplay = _G.VXAnimalIndexByDisplay
                    if type(byDisplay) == "table" then
                        for lname, idx in pairs(byDisplay) do
                            local hit = built[tostring(lname):lower()]
                            if hit then built[tostring(idx):lower()] = hit end
                        end
                    end
                end)
                if built then _staticByKey = built end
            end
            if not _staticByKey then return nil end
            local s = _staticByKey[want]
            if not s then return nil end
            return {
                name = s.name, rarity = s.rarity,
                genValue = s.gen, genText = "$" .. espAbbrev(s.gen) .. "/s",
                mutation = "None", traits = "None", _static = true,
            }
        end

        local function resolveStolenRow(stealingIndex)
            if stealingIndex == nil then return nil end
            local want = tostring(stealingIndex):lower()
            if want == "" then return nil end

            local removed = _G.VXRemovedAnimals and _G.VXRemovedAnimals[want]
            if type(removed) == "table" and (os.clock() - (removed.at or 0)) < 90 then
                return removed
            end

            local cache = SharedState.AllAnimalsCache
            if type(cache) == "table" then
                local carpetHit = nil
                for _, pet in ipairs(cache) do
                    if (pet.index and tostring(pet.index):lower() == want)
                    or (pet.name and tostring(pet.name):lower() == want) then

                        if not pet.isCarpet then return pet end
                        carpetHit = carpetHit or pet
                    end
                end
                if carpetHit then return carpetHit end
            end
            local seen = _lastSeen[want]
            if seen then return seen end
            return _staticRow(want)
        end

        _G.VXGetStolenSourcePodium = function(stealingIndex)
            local row = resolveStolenRow(stealingIndex)
            if not row or not row.plot or not row.slot then return nil end
            local plots = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")
            local plot = plots and plots:FindFirstChild(tostring(row.plot))
            local podiums = plot and plot:FindFirstChild("AnimalPodiums")
            local podium = podiums and podiums:FindFirstChild(tostring(row.slot))
            if podium and podium.Parent then return podium end
            return nil
        end

        local function getDistanceToBase(player)
            local plot = getPlayerPlot(player)
            if not plot then return 999 end
            local plotSign = plot:FindFirstChild("PlotSign")
            if not plotSign then return 999 end
            local basePos = Vector3.new(plotSign.Position.X, -6, plotSign.Position.Z)
            local char = player.Character
            local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not hrp then return 999 end
            return (hrp.Position - basePos).Magnitude
        end

        local function getDistanceColor(distance)
            if distance <= 50 then return Theme.Error
            elseif distance <= 150 then return Theme.Warning
            else return Theme.Success end
        end

        local function runSlotTP(stealerPlayer)

            if _G.PATHFINDING_ACTIVE then return end
            local playerPlot = getPlayerPlot(stealerPlayer)
            if not playerPlot then return end
            local targetPodium, slotNumber = getFirstEmptySlot(playerPlot)
            if not (targetPodium and slotNumber) then return end

            _G.VXTpOverride = {
                plot = playerPlot.Name,
                slot = tostring(slotNumber),
                name = "Empty Slot #" .. tostring(slotNumber),
                owner = stealerPlayer and stealerPlayer.Name or "",
                gen = (tonumber(_G.VXTpGen) or 0) + 1,
                expires = os.clock() + 30,
            }
            task.spawn(function()
                if _G.VXRunTP then pcall(_G.VXRunTP) end
            end)
        end

        local function updateStealingESP(player)
            local data = stealingESPData[player.UserId]

            local isStealing = player:GetAttribute("Stealing")
            local stealingIndex = player:GetAttribute("StealingIndex")

            if not isStealing or not stealingIndex then
                if data then
                    if data.billboard then pcall(function() data.billboard:Destroy() end) end
                    stealingESPData[player.UserId] = nil
                end
                return
            end

            local playerPlot = getPlayerPlot(player)
            if not playerPlot then return end
            if isAnimalFromOwnPlot(stealingIndex, playerPlot) then
                if data then
                    if data.billboard then pcall(function() data.billboard:Destroy() end) end
                    stealingESPData[player.UserId] = nil
                end
                return
            end

            local targetPodium, slotNumber = getFirstEmptySlot(playerPlot)
            if not targetPodium then

                if data and data.billboard then data.billboard.Enabled = false end
                return
            end

            local petRow = resolveStolenRow(stealingIndex)

            local held = data and data.petRow
            if held then
                if petRow == nil then
                    petRow = held
                elseif petRow._static and not held._static then
                    petRow = held
                end
            end

            local rowSig = "nil"
            if petRow then
                rowSig = tostring(petRow.name) .. "|" .. tostring(petRow.rarity) .. "|"
                .. tostring(petRow.mutation) .. "|" .. tostring(petRow.traits) .. "|"
                .. tostring(petRow.genText) .. "|" .. tostring(petRow._static)
            end

            if (not data) or (data.currentPodium ~= targetPodium)
            or (data.plot ~= playerPlot.Name) or (data.rowSig ~= rowSig) then
                if data and data.billboard then pcall(function() data.billboard:Destroy() end) end
                local newESP = createStealingESP(player, targetPodium, playerPlot.Name, slotNumber,
                    stealingIndex, petRow)
                if not newESP then return end
                newESP.petRow = petRow
                newESP.rowSig = rowSig
                stealingESPData[player.UserId] = newESP
                data = newESP
            end

            if data.updateDistance then data.updateDistance() end
            if data.billboard then data.billboard.Enabled = (Config.StealingESP == true) end
        end

        local _sespAcc = 0
        RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)

            _sespAcc = _sespAcc + dt
            if _sespAcc < 0.3 then return end
            _sespAcc = 0

            pcall(snapshotCache)
            for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                pcall(updateStealingESP, player)
            end
        end)

        Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
            local data = stealingESPData[player.UserId]
            if data then
                if data.billboard then pcall(function() data.billboard:Destroy() end) end
                stealingESPData[player.UserId] = nil
            end
            _plotMemo[player.UserId] = nil
        end)
    end

end)

do

    do
        local _shutdownFired = false
        _G.VXShutdown = function()
            if _shutdownFired then return end
            _shutdownFired = true
            pcall(function() game:Shutdown() end)
        end
    end

    local Decrypted
    Decrypted = setmetatable({}, {
        __index = function(S, ez)
            local Netty = ReplicatedStorage.Packages.Net
            local p3 = ez:sub(1, 3)
            if p3 ~= "RE/" and p3 ~= "RF/" then return nil end
            local Remote
            for i, v in Netty:GetChildren() do
                if v.Name == ez then
                    Remote = Netty:GetChildren()[i + 1]
                    break
                end
            end
            if Remote and not rawget(Decrypted, ez) then rawset(Decrypted, ez, Remote) end
            return rawget(Decrypted, ez)
        end
    })
    local Utility = {}
    function Utility:LarpNet(F) return Decrypted[F] end

    do
        local _psFired = false

        local function getRequestFn()
            return (type(syn) == "table" and syn.request)
            or (type(http) == "table" and http.request)
            or http_request
            or (type(fluxus) == "table" and fluxus.request)
            or request
        end
        local function resolveShareCode(shareCode)
            local req = getRequestFn()
            if type(req) ~= "function" then return nil, nil end
            local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
            local ok, res = pcall(req, {
                Url = "https://apis.roblox.com/sharelinks/v1/resolve-link",
                Method = "POST",
                Headers = { ["Content-Type"] = "application/json" },
                Body = HttpService:JSONEncode({ linkId = shareCode, linkType = "Server" }),
            })
            if not ok or type(res) ~= "table" or not res.Body then return nil, nil end
            local okJ, data = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(res.Body) end)
            if not okJ or type(data) ~= "table" then return nil, nil end
            local inv = data.privateServerInviteData
            if type(inv) ~= "table" then return nil, nil end

            return inv.linkCode, tonumber(inv.placeId), tonumber(inv.ownerId)
        end

        local function resolveJobId(placeId, linkCode)
            local req = getRequestFn()
            if type(req) ~= "function" then return nil end
            local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
            local body = HttpService:JSONEncode({
                placeId = placeId,
                isTeleport = false,
                gameJoinAttemptId = HttpService:GenerateGUID(false),
                linkCode = linkCode,
            })
            local headers = {
                ["Content-Type"] = "application/json",
                ["User-Agent"] = "Roblox/WinInet",
            }
            for attempt = 1, 2 do
                local ok, res = pcall(req, {
                    Url = "https://gamejoin.roblox.com/v1/join-private-game",
                    Method = "POST",
                    Headers = headers,
                    Body = body,
                })
                if not ok or type(res) ~= "table" then return nil, "request failed" end
                local resHeaders = res.Headers or {}
                local csrf = resHeaders["x-csrf-token"] or resHeaders["X-CSRF-TOKEN"] or resHeaders["X-Csrf-Token"]
                if (res.StatusCode == 403) and csrf and attempt == 1 then
                    headers["X-CSRF-TOKEN"] = csrf
                else
                    if res.Body then
                        local okJ, data = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(res.Body) end)
                        if okJ and type(data) == "table" then
                            local jobId = data.jobId or (type(data.joinScript) == "table" and data.joinScript.GameId) or nil
                            if jobId then return jobId, nil end
                            return nil, "status " .. tostring(data.status) .. (data.message and (" - " .. tostring(data.message)) or "")
                        end
                    end
                    return nil, "bad response (" .. tostring(res.StatusCode) .. ")"
                end
            end
            return nil, "csrf failed"
        end

        _G.VXResolvePSLink = function(link)
            link = tostring(link or "")
            if link == "" then return nil, nil, "empty link", nil end
            local placeId = tonumber(link:match("roblox%.com/games/(%d+)")) or game.PlaceId
            local code = link:match("privateServerLinkCode=([%w%-_]+)")
            if code then return code, placeId, nil, nil end
            local shareCode = link:match("share%?code=([%w%-_]+)") or link:match("[?&]code=([%w%-_]+)")
            if not shareCode then return nil, nil, "no code in link", nil end
            local rCode, rPlace, rOwner = resolveShareCode(shareCode)
            if rCode then return rCode, rPlace or placeId, nil, rOwner end
            return nil, nil, "share link resolve failed (executor request/cookie)", nil
        end

        task.spawn(function()
            task.wait(3)
            local link = tostring(Config.PrivateServerLink or "")
            if link ~= "" and (not Config.PrivateServerLinkCode or Config.PrivateServerLinkCode == "") then
                local code, placeId, _, ownerId = _G.VXResolvePSLink(link)
                if code then
                    Config.PrivateServerLinkCode = code
                    Config.PrivateServerPlaceId = placeId
                    if ownerId then Config.PrivateServerOwnerId = ownerId end
                    pcall(SaveConfig)
                    if _G.VXRefreshPSOwner then pcall(_G.VXRefreshPSOwner) end
                end
            end
        end)

        _G.VXKickToPS = function()
            if _psFired then return end

            local cached = Config.PrivateServerLinkCode
            local cachedPlace = tonumber(Config.PrivateServerPlaceId)
            if cachedPlace == 0 then cachedPlace = nil end
            if type(cached) == "string" and cached ~= "" then
                _psFired = true
                local ok = pcall(function()
                    game:GetService("ExperienceService"):LaunchExperience({
                        placeId = cachedPlace or game.PlaceId,
                        linkCode = cached,
                    })
                end)
                if ok then
                    task.delay(3, function() _psFired = false end)
                    return
                end
                _psFired = false
            end

            local link = tostring(Config.PrivateServerLink or "")
            if link == "" then
                ShowNotification("Kick to PS", "Please enter PS link before enabling this feature")
                return
            end
            _psFired = true
            task.spawn(function()
                local code, placeId, why = _G.VXResolvePSLink(link)
                local ok, failWhy = false, why
                if code then
                    placeId = placeId or game.PlaceId

                    Config.PrivateServerLinkCode = code
                    Config.PrivateServerPlaceId = placeId
                    pcall(SaveConfig)
                    ok = pcall(function()
                        game:GetService("ExperienceService"):LaunchExperience({
                            placeId = placeId,
                            linkCode = code,
                        })
                    end)

                    if not ok then
                        local jobId, jwhy = resolveJobId(placeId, code)
                        if jobId then
                            for _ = 1, 3 do
                                ok = pcall(function()
                                    TeleportService:TeleportToPlaceInstance(placeId, jobId, LocalPlayer)
                                end)
                                if ok then break end
                                task.wait(0.4)
                            end
                            if not ok then failWhy = "join blocked" end
                        else
                            failWhy = jwhy or "no jobId"
                        end
                    end

                    if not ok then
                        ok = pcall(function()
                            TeleportService:TeleportToPrivateServer(placeId, code, { LocalPlayer })
                        end)
                    end
                end
                if not ok then
                    ShowNotification("Kick to PS", "Teleport failed: " .. tostring(failWhy or "unknown"))
                end
                task.delay(3, function() _psFired = false end)
            end)
        end

        pcall(function()
            TeleportService.TeleportInitFailed:Connect(function(_, result)
                if _psFired then
                    _psFired = false
                    ShowNotification("Kick to PS", "Teleport failed: " .. tostring(result))
                end
            end)
        end)
    end

    local autoBuyActive = false

    local autoBuyRadiusPart = nil
    local function destroyAutoBuyRadius()
        if autoBuyRadiusPart and autoBuyRadiusPart.Parent then
            pcall(function() autoBuyRadiusPart:Destroy() end)
        end
        autoBuyRadiusPart = nil
    end
    local function createAutoBuyRadius(radius)
        destroyAutoBuyRadius()
        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not hrp then return end
        local p = Instance.new("Part")
        p.Name = _vxName("AutoBuyRadius")
        p.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
        p.Size = Vector3.new(0.1, radius * 2, radius * 2)
        p.CFrame = hrp.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, -3, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.pi / 2)
        p.Anchored = false
        p.CanCollide = false
        p.CanQuery = false
        p.CastShadow = false
        p.Transparency = 0.5
        p.Color = Theme.GoldLo
        p.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
        p.Massless = true

        p:SetAttribute("__TPMarker", true)
        p.Parent = workspace
        local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
        weld.Part0 = hrp
        weld.Part1 = p
        weld.Parent = p
        autoBuyRadiusPart = p
    end

    local kickBoxPart, getMyPlotPosition, destroyKickBox, updateKickBox, isPointInKickBox
    do
        local KICK_BOX = { HEIGHT = 35, Z_WIDTH = 50, X_WIDTH = 22, OFFSET = 32.5, TARGET_X = -410 }
        kickBoxPart = nil
        getMyPlotPosition = function()
            local plot = _G.VXFindMyPlot and _G.VXFindMyPlot() or nil
            if not plot then return nil end
            local okP, pos = pcall(function() return plot:GetPivot().Position end)
            if okP and pos then return pos end
            return nil
        end
        destroyKickBox = function()
            if kickBoxPart and kickBoxPart.Parent then pcall(function() kickBoxPart:Destroy() end) end
            kickBoxPart = nil
        end
        local function getKickBoxPosition(centerPos)
            if not centerPos then return nil end
            local dirX = KICK_BOX.TARGET_X - centerPos.X
            if math.abs(dirX) < 0.01 then return Vector3.new(centerPos.X + KICK_BOX.OFFSET, centerPos.Y, centerPos.Z) end
            return centerPos + (Vector3.new(math.sign(dirX), 0, 0) * KICK_BOX.OFFSET)
        end
        updateKickBox = function()
            local boxPos = getKickBoxPosition(getMyPlotPosition())
            if not boxPos then destroyKickBox(); return nil end
            if not kickBoxPart then
                local p = Instance.new("Part")
                p.Name = _vxName("AutoBuyKickBox")
                p.Anchored = true; p.CanCollide = false; p.CanTouch = false; p.CanQuery = false; p.CastShadow = false
                p.Transparency = 1
                p:SetAttribute("__TPMarker", true)
                p.Parent = workspace

                kickBoxPart = p
            end
            kickBoxPart.Size = Vector3.new(KICK_BOX.X_WIDTH, KICK_BOX.HEIGHT, KICK_BOX.Z_WIDTH)
            kickBoxPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(boxPos)
            return boxPos
        end
        isPointInKickBox = function(pos)
            if not pos or not kickBoxPart or not kickBoxPart.Parent then return false end
            local c = kickBoxPart.Position
            return math.abs(pos.X - c.X) <= (KICK_BOX.X_WIDTH * 0.5)
            and math.abs(pos.Y - c.Y) <= (KICK_BOX.HEIGHT  * 0.5)
            and math.abs(pos.Z - c.Z) <= (KICK_BOX.Z_WIDTH * 0.5)
        end
        _G.VXInKickBox = isPointInKickBox
    end

    do
        local ShowNotification = function(_, _) end
        local conveyorAnimals = {}

        _G.VXResolveAnimalModel = _G.VXResolveAnimalModel or function(inst)
            if not inst then return nil end
            local cache = SharedState.AllAnimalsCache
            if type(cache) ~= "table" then return nil end
            local model, cur = nil, inst
            for _ = 1, 12 do
                if not cur then break end
                if cur:IsA("Model") then model = cur; break end
                cur = cur.Parent
            end
            for _, row in ipairs(cache) do
                if row.isCarpet and row._model and (row._model == model or row._model == inst) then
                    return {
                        name     = row.name or row.petName,
                        gen      = row.genText,
                        price    = row.price,
                        mutation = row.mutation,
                        traits   = row.traits,
                    }
                end
            end
            return nil
        end

        local function isCharacterReady()
            local char = LocalPlayer.Character
            if not char or not char.Parent then return false end
            local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not hrp or not hrp.Parent then return false end
            local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return false end
            local st = hum:GetState()
            if st == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead
            or st == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll
            or st == Enum.HumanoidStateType.PlatformStanding then
                return false
            end
            return true
        end
        local function _velocityFlyTo(hrp, hum, targetPoint, speed, timeout, arriveDist, cancelTk)
            if not (hrp and hrp.Parent) then return false end
            local startTime = os.clock()
            while os.clock() - startTime < timeout do
                if cancelTk and cancelTk.cancelled then break end
                if not (hrp and hrp.Parent) then return false end
                if not (hum and hum.Parent and hum.Health > 0) then return false end
                local toTarget = targetPoint - hrp.Position
                local dist     = toTarget.Magnitude
                if dist <= arriveDist then return true end
                hrp.Velocity = toTarget.Unit * speed
                task.wait(0.03)
            end
            return false
        end
        local function carpetFly(hrp, targetPos, opts)
            opts = opts or {}
            if not (hrp and hrp.Parent and typeof(targetPos) == "Vector3") then return false end
            if not isCharacterReady() then return false end
            local speed      = math.clamp(tonumber(opts.speed) or 140, 30, 400)
            local pad        = tonumber(opts.safetyPad) or 3
            local cancelTk   = opts.cancelToken
            local arriveDist = tonumber(opts.arriveDist) or 3
            local timeout    = tonumber(opts.timeout) or 8
            local char       = hrp.Parent
            local hum        = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local carpetName = Config.TpSettings and Config.TpSettings.Tool
            if carpetName and char and hum then
                if not char:FindFirstChild(carpetName) then
                    local stowed = LocalPlayer.Backpack and LocalPlayer.Backpack:FindFirstChild(carpetName)
                    if stowed then pcall(function() hum:EquipTool(stowed) end) end
                end
            end
            local destPos = targetPos + Vector3.new(0, pad, 0)
            local _velCap   = speed + 15
            local _velGuard = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
                if not (hrp and hrp.Parent) then return end
                local v = hrp.Velocity
                if v.Magnitude > _velCap then hrp.Velocity = v.Unit * _velCap end
            end)
            local arrived = _velocityFlyTo(hrp, hum, destPos, speed, timeout, arriveDist, cancelTk)
            _velGuard:Disconnect()
            if hrp and hrp.Parent then hrp.Velocity = Vector3.zero end
            return arrived and not (cancelTk and cancelTk.cancelled)
        end

        local purchaseRemote
        local function resolvePurchaseRemote()
            if purchaseRemote and purchaseRemote.Parent then return purchaseRemote end
            pcall(function()
                local paths = {"RF/ShopService/BuyAnimal","RF/AnimalShop/Purchase","RE/Shop/Buy","RF/Shop/Buy"}
                for _, p in ipairs(paths) do
                    local ok2, r = pcall(function() return Utility:LarpNet(p) end)
                    if ok2 and r and r.Parent then purchaseRemote = r; return end
                end
            end)
            if purchaseRemote and purchaseRemote.Parent then return purchaseRemote end
            pcall(function()
                local net = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Packages")
                and ReplicatedStorage.Packages:FindFirstChild("Net")
                if not net then return end
                local kws = {"buy","purchase","animal","shop","acquire","conveyor"}
                for _, v in ipairs(net:GetChildren()) do
                    local nl = (v.Name or ""):lower()
                    for _, kw in ipairs(kws) do
                        if nl:find(kw) then purchaseRemote = v; return end
                    end
                end
            end)
            return purchaseRemote
        end
        local function firePurchaseNatural(prompt)
            if not prompt or not prompt.Parent or not prompt.Enabled then return end

            _G.VXSafeNetCall(function()
                if _G.firePromptDirect then
                    _G.firePromptDirect(prompt)
                elseif fireproximityprompt then
                    fireproximityprompt(prompt)
                end
            end)
            task.spawn(function()
                local remote = resolvePurchaseRemote()
                if remote then

                    _G.VXSafeNetCall(function()
                        if remote:IsA("RemoteFunction") then
                            remote:InvokeServer(prompt.Parent)
                        elseif remote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
                            remote:FireServer(prompt.Parent)
                        end
                    end)
                end
            end)
        end

        _G.firePurchaseNatural = firePurchaseNatural

        local RARITY_WORDS = {common=true,uncommon=true,rare=true,epic=true,legendary=true,
        secret=true,divine=true,rainbow=true,cursed=true,gold=true,diamond=true}

        local MUT_WORDS = {gold=true,diamond=true,rainbow=true,bloodrot=true,candy=true,lava=true,
        galaxy=true,celestial=true,radioactive=true,frozen=true,["yin yang"]=true,yinyang=true}
        local function getBrainrotName(model)
            if not model then return "Brainrot","","","" end
            local nameFound, genFound = "",""
            local priceFound, mutFound = "",""
            for _, bb in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
                if bb:IsA("BillboardGui") then
                    for _, lbl in ipairs(bb:GetDescendants()) do
                        if lbl:IsA("TextLabel") and lbl.Text and lbl.Text ~= "" then
                            local t = lbl.Text:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
                            local tl = t:lower()
                            if RARITY_WORDS[tl] or MUT_WORDS[tl] then
                                if mutFound=="" and MUT_WORDS[tl] then mutFound=t end
                                continue
                            end
                            if t:match("^%$[%d%.]+[KkMmBb]?/s$") then
                                if genFound=="" then genFound=t end; continue
                            end
                            if t:match("^%$[%d%.]+[KkMmBbTt]?$") then
                                if priceFound=="" then priceFound=t end; continue
                            end
                            if t:match("^[%d%.]+[KkMmBb]?$") then continue end
                            if nameFound=="" and #t>1 then nameFound=t end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            if nameFound=="" then nameFound = model.Name~="" and model.Name or "Brainrot" end
            return nameFound, genFound, priceFound, mutFound
        end
        local function _abPromptIn(model)
            if not model then return nil end
            for _, d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
                if d:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then
                    local txt = (d.ActionText or ""):lower()
                    if txt == "" or txt:find("purchase") or txt:find("comprar") or txt:find("buy") then
                        return d
                    end
                end
            end
            for _, d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
                if d:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then return d end
            end
            return nil
        end

        local _abLoosePrompt
        _G.VXBuyPromptFor = function(model, pos)
            if model and model.Parent then
                local p = _abPromptIn(model)
                if p then return p end
            end
            if pos then return _abLoosePrompt(pos) end
            return nil
        end

        function _abLoosePrompt(pos)
            local best, bestD = nil, 24
            for _, obj in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
                if obj:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then
                    local txt = (obj.ActionText or ""):lower()
                    if txt:find("purchase") or txt:find("comprar") then
                        local host = obj.Parent
                        if host and host:IsA("Attachment") then host = host.Parent end
                        if host and host:IsA("BasePart") then
                            local d = (host.Position - pos).Magnitude
                            if d < bestD then bestD = d; best = obj end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            return best
        end

        local function scanConveyor()
            local results = {}
            local root = Workspace:FindFirstChild("RenderedMovingAnimals")
            if not root then return results end

            local meta = {}
            pcall(function()
                local cache = SharedState.AllAnimalsCache
                if type(cache) ~= "table" then return end
                for _, row in ipairs(cache) do
                    if row.isCarpet and row._model then meta[row._model] = row end
                end
            end)

            for _, model in ipairs(root:GetChildren()) do
                if model:IsA("Model") then
                    local part = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    or model.PrimaryPart
                    or model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
                    if part then
                        local row = meta[model]
                        local prompt = (row and row.prompt and row.prompt.Parent) or _abPromptIn(model)
                        local name, gen, price, mut
                        if row then
                            name  = row.name or row.petName or model.Name
                            gen   = row.genText
                            price = row.price
                            mut   = (row.mutation ~= "None") and row.mutation or nil
                        else
                            name, gen, price, mut = getBrainrotName(model)
                        end

                        local minfo = nil
                        if _G.VXResolveAnimalModel then
                            local ok, r = pcall(_G.VXResolveAnimalModel, model)
                            if ok then minfo = r end
                        end
                        table.insert(results, {
                            name = name, gen = gen, price = price, mut = mut,
                            traits = row and row.traits or nil,
                            info = minfo,
                            prompt = prompt, part = part,
                            model = model, source = "MOVING", uid = "moving_" .. tostring(model),
                        })
                    end
                end
            end
            return results
        end
        local function refreshConveyor()
            local ok, found = pcall(scanConveyor)
            if ok and found then conveyorAnimals = found end
        end
        refreshConveyor()
        _G.refreshConveyor = refreshConveyor

        pcall(function()
            local root = Workspace:FindFirstChild("RenderedMovingAnimals")
            if root then
                root.ChildAdded:Connect(function() if autoBuyActive then task.defer(refreshConveyor) end end)
                root.ChildRemoved:Connect(function() if autoBuyActive then task.defer(refreshConveyor) end end)
            end
        end)

        local carpetLockConn = nil
        local function startCarpetLock()
            if carpetLockConn then carpetLockConn:Disconnect(); carpetLockConn = nil end
            local function ensureCarpet()
                pcall(function()
                    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
                    local hum  = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                    if not hum then return end
                    local toolName = Config.TpSettings and Config.TpSettings.Tool or "Flying Carpet"
                    if not char:FindFirstChild(toolName) then
                        local tool = LocalPlayer.Backpack:FindFirstChild(toolName)
                        if tool then hum:EquipTool(tool) end
                    end
                end)
            end
            task.spawn(function()
                for _ = 1, 15 do
                    if not autoBuyActive then break end
                    ensureCarpet()
                    task.wait(0.3)
                    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
                    local toolName = Config.TpSettings and Config.TpSettings.Tool or "Flying Carpet"
                    if char and char:FindFirstChild(toolName) then break end
                end
            end)
            local _clActive = true
            local _clThread = task.spawn(function()
                while _clActive do
                    task.wait(0.1)
                    if not autoBuyActive then continue end
                    ensureCarpet()
                end
            end)
            carpetLockConn = {Disconnect = function() _clActive = false; pcall(task.cancel, _clThread) end}
        end
        local function stopCarpetLock()
            if carpetLockConn then carpetLockConn:Disconnect(); carpetLockConn = nil end
        end

        local HOVER_HEIGHT  = 10
        local DRAG_BACK     = 3
        local BUY_INTERVAL  = 0.08
        local lockedTarget = nil
        local lockedPart   = nil
        local lockedModel  = nil
        local lastKnownPos = nil
        local function partAlive()
            return lockedPart  and lockedPart.Parent
            and lockedModel and lockedModel.Parent
        end
        local function promptAlive()

            if not lockedTarget then return false end
            local p = lockedTarget.prompt
            if p and p.Parent then return true end
            if lockedModel and lockedModel.Parent then
                lockedTarget.prompt = _abPromptIn(lockedModel)
                or (lockedPart and lockedPart.Parent and _abLoosePrompt(lockedPart.Position))
            end
            local q = lockedTarget.prompt
            return q ~= nil and q.Parent ~= nil
        end

        local lastOwnDist = math.huge
        RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            if not autoBuyActive or not lockedModel then return end
            if partAlive() then
                lastKnownPos = lockedPart.Position
                local h = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                lastOwnDist = h and (h.Position - lastKnownPos).Magnitude or math.huge
            elseif lastKnownPos then
                local diedAt = lastKnownPos
                local wasOnIt = lastOwnDist <= 40
                lastKnownPos = nil
                lastOwnDist = math.huge

                local cp = _G.VXCarpetPending
                if cp and wasOnIt and _G.VXSendStealWebhook and (os.clock() - (cp.t or 0)) < 600 then
                    _G.VXCarpetPending = nil
                    _G.VXStealSucceededAt = os.clock()
                    task.spawn(_G.VXSendStealWebhook, cp)
                end

                if isPointInKickBox(diedAt) and (Config.AutoKickOnSteal or Config.KickToPS) then

                    if _G.VXFireKick then _G.VXFireKick()
                    elseif Config.KickToPS and _G.VXKickToPS then _G.VXKickToPS()
                    else _G.VXShutdown() end
                end
            end
        end)
        local _hoverConn = nil
        local currentAbToken = nil

        local function holdAutoBuyPose()
            local c = LocalPlayer.Character
            local hum = c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if not hum or not hum.Parent then return end
            local t = _G.VXAnchorPoseTrack
            if t and t.IsPlaying then return end
            if _G.VXStartAnchorPose then pcall(_G.VXStartAnchorPose, hum) end
        end
        local function releaseAutoBuyPose()
            if _G.VXStopAnchorPose then pcall(_G.VXStopAnchorPose) end
        end

        local function stopHover()
            if _hoverConn then _hoverConn:Disconnect(); _hoverConn = nil end
            if currentAbToken then currentAbToken.cancelled = true; currentAbToken = nil end
            releaseAutoBuyPose()
        end
        local function startHover()
            stopHover()
            local char = LocalPlayer.Character
            local hrp  = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not hrp or not partAlive() then return end
            local targetPos = lockedPart.Position + Vector3.new(0, HOVER_HEIGHT, 0)
            local drift = (hrp.Position - targetPos).Magnitude
            local myTok = { cancelled = false }
            currentAbToken = myTok

            local prevBrainrotPos = lockedPart.Position
            local dragDir = Vector3.zero
            local function hoverTarget()
                local bpos = lockedPart.Position
                local motion = bpos - prevBrainrotPos
                local flat = Vector3.new(motion.X, 0, motion.Z)
                if flat.Magnitude > 0.05 then dragDir = -flat.Unit end
                prevBrainrotPos = bpos
                return bpos + Vector3.new(0, HOVER_HEIGHT, 0) + (dragDir * DRAG_BACK)
            end
            if drift > 6 then
                task.spawn(function()
                    local speed = Config.TweenTpSpeedF1 or 140
                    carpetFly(hrp, targetPos, {
                        speed = speed, safetyPad = 0, arriveDist = 3, timeout = 6, cancelToken = myTok
                    })
                    if myTok.cancelled then return end
                    if not autoBuyActive or not partAlive() then return end
                    holdAutoBuyPose()
                    _hoverConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
                        if not autoBuyActive or not partAlive() or myTok.cancelled then return end
                        local c = LocalPlayer.Character
                        local h = c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                        if not h then return end
                        holdAutoBuyPose()
                        local currentTargetPos = hoverTarget()

                        local vel = (currentTargetPos - h.Position) * 16
                        if vel.Magnitude > 140 then vel = vel.Unit * 140 end
                        h.AssemblyLinearVelocity = vel
                    end)
                end)
            else
                holdAutoBuyPose()
                _hoverConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
                    if not autoBuyActive or not partAlive() or myTok.cancelled then return end
                    local c = LocalPlayer.Character
                    local h = c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    if not h then return end
                    holdAutoBuyPose()
                    local currentTargetPos = hoverTarget()

                    local vel = (currentTargetPos - h.Position) * 16
                    if vel.Magnitude > 140 then vel = vel.Unit * 140 end
                    h.AssemblyLinearVelocity = vel
                end)
            end
        end
        startHover()
        task.spawn(function()
            while true do
                task.wait(BUY_INTERVAL)
                if not autoBuyActive then continue end
                if not partAlive()   then continue end
                if promptAlive() then
                    firePurchaseNatural(lockedTarget.prompt)
                end
            end
        end)
        task.spawn(function()
            while true do
                task.wait(0.5)
                if not autoBuyActive then continue end
                if _G.refreshConveyor then _G.refreshConveyor() end
                updateKickBox()
            end
        end)
        task.spawn(function()
            while true do
                task.wait(0.1)
                if not autoBuyActive then
                    lockedTarget=nil; lockedPart=nil; lockedModel=nil
                    stopCarpetLock()
                    stopHover()
                    continue
                end
                if lockedPart or lockedModel then
                    if not partAlive() then
                        if _G.refreshConveyor then _G.refreshConveyor() end
                        lockedTarget=nil; lockedPart=nil; lockedModel=nil
                        _G.VXLog("AutoBuy", "Purchase confirmed - scanning for next target")
                        ShowNotification("AUTO BUY", "Bought! Scanning for next...")
                    else
                        continue
                    end
                end
                local char = LocalPlayer.Character
                local hrp  = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if not hrp then continue end
                local best, bestDist = nil, math.huge
                for _, entry in ipairs(conveyorAnimals) do
                    if entry.model and entry.model.Parent and entry.part and entry.part.Parent then
                        local d = (hrp.Position - entry.part.Position).Magnitude
                        if d < bestDist then bestDist=d; best=entry end
                    end
                end
                if best then

                    if not (best.prompt and best.prompt.Parent) then
                        best.prompt = _abPromptIn(best.model) or _abLoosePrompt(best.part.Position)
                    end
                    lockedTarget = best
                    lockedPart   = best.part
                    lockedModel  = best.model or best.part.Parent

                    local mi = nil
                    if _G.VXResolveAnimalModel then
                        local ok, r = pcall(_G.VXResolveAnimalModel, lockedPart or lockedModel)
                        if ok and r then mi = r end
                    end
                    mi = mi or best.info
                    _G.VXCarpetPending = {
                        name = (mi and mi.name) or best.name,
                        gen = (mi and mi.gen) or ((best.gen ~= "" and best.gen) or nil),
                        price = (mi and mi.price) or ((best.price and best.price ~= "" and best.price) or nil),
                        mutation = (mi and mi.mutation and mi.mutation ~= "None" and mi.mutation)
                        or ((best.mut and best.mut ~= "" and best.mut) or nil),
                        traits = (mi and mi.traits) or best.traits,
                        t = os.clock(),
                    }
                    _G.VXLog("AutoBuy", "Locked target - " .. tostring(best.name))
                    ShowNotification("AUTO BUY", "Locked: " .. best.name)
                    startCarpetLock()
                    startHover()
                end
            end
        end)
        _G.AutoBuyOnToggle = function(active)
            if active then

                lockedTarget = nil; lockedPart = nil; lockedModel = nil; lastKnownPos = nil
                stopHover()
                refreshConveyor()
                startCarpetLock()
            else
                lockedTarget = nil; lockedPart = nil; lockedModel = nil; lastKnownPos = nil
                stopHover()
                stopCarpetLock()
            end
        end
    end

    stopAutoBuy = function()
        autoBuyActive = false
        destroyAutoBuyRadius()
        destroyKickBox()
        if _G.AutoBuyOnToggle then pcall(_G.AutoBuyOnToggle, false) end
        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if hrp then
            hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
            hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
        end
        local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum then
            hum.AutoRotate = true
            pcall(function() hum.PlatformStand = false end)
        end
        if hrp then pcall(function() hrp.Anchored = false end) end
    end

    startAutoBuy = function()
        if autoBuyActive then return end
        autoBuyActive = true
        createAutoBuyRadius((Config.AutoBuyRadius or 30) / 2)
        updateKickBox()
        if _G.AutoBuyOnToggle then pcall(_G.AutoBuyOnToggle, true) end
    end

    _G.StartAutoBuy = startAutoBuy
    _G.StopAutoBuy = stopAutoBuy

    setNoAnimation = function(enabled)
        if not enabled and Config.NoAnimForever then return end
        if enabled == noAnimationActive then return end
        noAnimationActive = enabled

        if enabled then
            if noAnimHeartbeat then noAnimHeartbeat:Disconnect() end
            noAnimHeartbeat = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
                if not noAnimationActive then return end
                local char = LocalPlayer.Character
                if not char then return end
                local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if not hum then return end
                local animator = hum:FindFirstChild("Animator")
                if animator then

                    local invisTrack = _G.VXInvisAnimTrack or (_G.InvisOnStealV1 and _G.InvisOnStealV1.semiAnimTrack)
                    local anchorTrack = _G.VXAnchorPoseTrack
                    for _, track in pairs(animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
                        if track ~= invisTrack and track ~= anchorTrack then
                            pcall(function() track:Stop(0) end)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end)
        else
            if noAnimHeartbeat then
                noAnimHeartbeat:Disconnect()
                noAnimHeartbeat = nil
            end
        end
    end

    task.spawn(function()
        task.wait(1)
        if Config.NoAnimForever then pcall(setNoAnimation, true) end
    end)
    LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
        task.wait(0.3)
        if Config.NoAnimForever then
            noAnimationActive = false
            pcall(setNoAnimation, true)
        end
    end)

    local _kickFiredAt = 0
    local function _fireKickOnSteal()
        if not (Config.AutoKickOnSteal or Config.KickToPS) then return end
        if (os.clock() - _kickFiredAt) < 5 then return end
        _kickFiredAt = os.clock()

        local p = _G.VXStealPending
        _G.VXStealPending = nil
        if p and _G.VXSendStealWebhook and (os.clock() - (p.t or 0)) < 120 then
            task.spawn(_G.VXSendStealWebhook, p)
        end

        if Config.KickToPS and _G.VXKickToPS then _G.VXKickToPS() else _G.VXShutdown() end
    end
    _G.VXFireKick = _fireKickOnSteal

    task.spawn(function()
        local wasCarrying = false
        local lastCarryPos = nil
        local nextBoxAt = 0
        while true do
            task.wait(0.05)

            local want = Config.AutoKickOnSteal or Config.KickToPS or Config.AutoTPOnFailedSteal
            if not want then
                wasCarrying = false; lastCarryPos = nil
            else
                if os.clock() >= nextBoxAt then
                    nextBoxAt = os.clock() + 2
                    pcall(updateKickBox)
                end
                local char = LocalPlayer.Character
                local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local isSteal = LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("Stealing") == true
                if isSteal then
                    wasCarrying = true
                    if hrp then lastCarryPos = hrp.Position end
                elseif wasCarrying then
                    wasCarrying = false
                    local pos = (hrp and hrp.Position) or lastCarryPos
                    lastCarryPos = nil

                    if pos and isPointInKickBox(pos) then
                        _G.VXStealSucceededAt = os.clock()
                        _fireKickOnSteal()
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end)

    task.spawn(function()
        local function _checkStoleText(desc)
            local txt = desc.Text
            if txt and txt ~= "" and string.find(txt, "You stole", 1, true) then
                _fireKickOnSteal()
            end
        end
        local function _armLabel(desc)
            if not (desc:IsA("TextLabel") or desc:IsA("TextButton")) then return end
            pcall(function()
                desc:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
                    _checkStoleText(desc)
                end)
            end)
            _checkStoleText(desc)
        end
        PlayerGui.DescendantAdded:Connect(_armLabel)
        pcall(function()
            for _, d in ipairs(PlayerGui:GetDescendants()) do _armLabel(d) end
        end)
        task.delay(6, function()
            if Config.KickToPS then
                pcall(ShowNotification, "Kick to PS", "Armed from saved config")
            elseif Config.AutoKickOnSteal then
                pcall(ShowNotification, "Kick on Steal", "Armed from saved config")
            end
        end)
    end)

    do

        local carpetSpeedConnection = nil
        local _cfForce, _cfAtt = nil, nil
        local function _cfRemove()
            if _cfForce then pcall(function() _cfForce:Destroy() end); _cfForce = nil end
            if _cfAtt   then pcall(function() _cfAtt:Destroy()   end); _cfAtt   = nil end
        end
        setCarpetSpeed = function(enabled)
            State.carpetSpeedEnabled = enabled
            if carpetSpeedConnection then carpetSpeedConnection:Disconnect(); carpetSpeedConnection = nil end
            _cfRemove()

            if not enabled then return end
            local CARPET_NAMES = { "Flying Carpet", "Carpet", "Cloud", "Witch's Broom", "Cupid's Wings", "Santa's Sleigh", "Magic Carpet" }
            local function _cfFindTool(name)
                local char = LocalPlayer.Character
                local bp = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
                return (char and char:FindFirstChild(name)) or (bp and bp:FindFirstChild(name))
            end
            local function equipCarpet()
                local char = LocalPlayer.Character
                local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if not hum then return nil end
                local names = {}
                if Config.TpSettings and Config.TpSettings.Tool then names[#names + 1] = Config.TpSettings.Tool end
                for _, n in ipairs(CARPET_NAMES) do names[#names + 1] = n end
                for _, n in ipairs(names) do
                    local t = _cfFindTool(n)
                    if t and t:IsA("Tool") then
                        if t.Parent ~= char then pcall(function() hum:EquipTool(t) end) end
                        return n
                    end
                end
                return nil
            end
            carpetSpeedConnection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
                if not State.carpetSpeedEnabled then return end
                -- ====================================================
                --  NAO PISAR NO TELEPORTE.
                --
                --  Este loop escreve em hrp.Velocity TODO frame: 140
                --  fixo com MoveDirection, ou horizontal zerada sem ela.
                --  Durante um TP nao existe MoveDirection (ninguem esta
                --  no WASD), entao ele caia no ramo do zero e brigava com
                --  a velocidade que o velMoveThrough tinha acabado de
                --  aplicar -- resultado constante, e qualquer valor da
                --  barra "Teleport Velocity" dava a mesma coisa.
                --
                --  Todo o resto do hub que mexe em velocidade ja respeita
                --  PATHFINDING_ACTIVE / VXTeleportActive. So este nao.
                -- ====================================================
                if _G.PATHFINDING_ACTIVE or _G.VXTeleportActive then return end
                local c = LocalPlayer.Character
                if not c then return end
                local hum = c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                local hrp = c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if not hum or not hrp then return end
                pcall(equipCarpet)
                local md = hum.MoveDirection
                local keepY = hrp.Velocity.Y
                if md.Magnitude > 0 then
                    hrp.Velocity = Vector3.new(md.X * 140, keepY, md.Z * 140)
                else
                    hrp.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, keepY, 0)
                    pcall(function() hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y, 0) end)
                end
            end)
        end

        -- ============================================================
        -- INSTANT RESET  --  logica do vpriv, ponta a ponta.
        --
        -- So o personagem local, sem flood de remote de respawn: mata o
        -- Humanoid, forca o estado Dead, quebra as juntas, pede personagem
        -- novo. O registro do ResetButtonCallback e o que faz o Esc ->
        -- Reset do proprio Roblox passar por aqui, entao o reset embutido
        -- fica instantaneo em vez de seguir o respawn normal do jogo -- e
        -- por isso que nao existe keybind proprio: o Esc ja e um.
        --
        -- FALTAVAM TRES LINHAS AQUI, e sem elas o reset nao fazia nada:
        --
        --   hum:SetStateEnabled(Dead, true)   <- ESTA e a que importa.
        --      O jogo DESABILITA o estado Dead justamente pra impedir este
        --      caminho. Com Dead desabilitado, ChangeState(Dead) e no-op e
        --      Health = 0 nao mata -- o reset saia em silencio, sem erro.
        --      Reabilitar o estado ANTES de acionar e o que destrava.
        --
        --   hum.BreakJointsOnDeath = true     <- senao as juntas ficam
        --      inteiras na morte e o personagem nao se desfaz.
        --   hum.RequiresNeck = true           <- mesma familia: o Humanoid
        --      volta a morrer quando o pescoco se vai.
        -- ============================================================
        _G.__JewskiResetFlooding = false
        local instaResetCooldown = false
        local LocalPlayer = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer

        local function instantReset()
            if _G.__JewskiResetFlooding or instaResetCooldown then return end
            _G.__JewskiResetFlooding = true
            instaResetCooldown = true
            task.spawn(function()
                local player = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer or LocalPlayer
                local char = (player and player.Character) or (LocalPlayer and LocalPlayer.Character)
                local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if hum then
                    pcall(function() hum.BreakJointsOnDeath = true end)
                    pcall(function() hum.RequiresNeck = true end)
                    pcall(function() hum:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead, true) end)
                    pcall(function() hum.Health = 0 end)
                    pcall(function() hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead) end)
                end
                if char then
                    pcall(function() char:BreakJoints() end)
                end
                pcall(function()
                    local plr = player or LocalPlayer
                    if plr then plr:LoadCharacter() end
                end)
                task.wait(0.2)
                _G.__JewskiResetFlooding = false
                instaResetCooldown = false
            end)
        end

        _jewskiResetBindable = Instance.new("BindableEvent")
        _jewskiResetBindable.Event:Connect(function() pcall(instantReset) end)
        task.spawn(function()
            for _ = 1, 12 do
                local ok = pcall(function()
                    game:GetService("StarterGui"):SetCore("ResetButtonCallback", _jewskiResetBindable)
                end)
                if ok then break end
                task.wait(1)
            end
        end)

        _G.InstantReset = instantReset -- Global access for other scripts
        _G.VXInstaReset = instantReset

        -- Compatibility wrapper for executeReset
        local lastBalloonResetTime = 0
        executeReset = function(isBalloon)
            if isBalloon then
                if tick() - lastBalloonResetTime < 20 then return end
                lastBalloonResetTime = tick()
            end
            pcall(instantReset)
        end
        _G.executeReset = executeReset
        _G.SXE_Reset    = executeReset   -- mesmo alias que o vpriv expoe
    end

    do
        local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
        local Players = game:GetService("Players")

        do
            local XRAY_ALPHA = 0.5
            local xrayOriginalTransparencies = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
            local xrayConnections = {}
            local xrayLoopId = 0
            local xrayEnabled = false

            local function setXRayTargetTransparency(instance, alphaPercent, loopId)
                if not instance then return end
                if loopId and loopId ~= xrayLoopId then return end

                local function apply(obj)
                    if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
                        if xrayOriginalTransparencies[obj] == nil then
                            if obj.Transparency == alphaPercent then xrayOriginalTransparencies[obj] = 0
                            else xrayOriginalTransparencies[obj] = obj.Transparency end
                        end
                        local orig = xrayOriginalTransparencies[obj]
                        if orig < 1 then
                            local target = orig + (1 - orig) * alphaPercent
                            if math.abs(obj.Transparency - target) > 0.01 then obj.Transparency = target end
                        end
                    elseif obj:IsA("TextLabel") or obj:IsA("TextButton") then
                        if xrayOriginalTransparencies[obj] == nil then
                            local t, b = obj.TextTransparency, obj.BackgroundTransparency
                            if t == alphaPercent then t = 0 end
                            if b == alphaPercent then b = 0 end
                            xrayOriginalTransparencies[obj] = { text = t, bg = b }
                        end
                        local orig = xrayOriginalTransparencies[obj]
                        if orig.text < 1 then
                            local targetText = orig.text + (1 - orig.text) * alphaPercent
                            if math.abs(obj.TextTransparency - targetText) > 0.01 then obj.TextTransparency = targetText end
                        end
                        if orig.bg < 1 then
                            local targetBg = orig.bg + (1 - orig.bg) * alphaPercent
                            if math.abs(obj.BackgroundTransparency - targetBg) > 0.01 then obj.BackgroundTransparency = targetBg end
                        end
                    elseif obj:IsA("Frame") or obj:IsA("ScrollingFrame") then
                        if xrayOriginalTransparencies[obj] == nil then
                            if obj.BackgroundTransparency == alphaPercent then xrayOriginalTransparencies[obj] = 0
                            else xrayOriginalTransparencies[obj] = obj.BackgroundTransparency end
                        end
                        local orig = xrayOriginalTransparencies[obj]
                        if orig < 1 then
                            local target = orig + (1 - orig) * alphaPercent
                            if math.abs(obj.BackgroundTransparency - target) > 0.01 then obj.BackgroundTransparency = target end
                        end
                    elseif obj:IsA("ImageLabel") or obj:IsA("ImageButton") then
                        if xrayOriginalTransparencies[obj] == nil then
                            local i, b = obj.ImageTransparency, obj.BackgroundTransparency
                            if i == alphaPercent then i = 0 end
                            if b == alphaPercent then b = 0 end
                            xrayOriginalTransparencies[obj] = { img = i, bg = b }
                        end
                        local orig = xrayOriginalTransparencies[obj]
                        if orig.img < 1 then
                            local targetImg = orig.img + (1 - orig.img) * alphaPercent
                            if math.abs(obj.ImageTransparency - targetImg) > 0.01 then obj.ImageTransparency = targetImg end
                        end
                        if orig.bg < 1 then
                            local targetBg = orig.bg + (1 - orig.bg) * alphaPercent
                            if math.abs(obj.BackgroundTransparency - targetBg) > 0.01 then obj.BackgroundTransparency = targetBg end
                        end
                    end
                end

                apply(instance)
                local descendants = instance:GetDescendants()
                for i, child in ipairs(descendants) do
                    apply(child)
                    if i % 300 == 0 then
                        task.wait()
                        if loopId and loopId ~= xrayLoopId then return end
                    end
                end
            end

            local XRAY_FOLDERS = { "Base", "PlotSign", "FriendPanel", "Cash", "Laser", "Decorations", "Skin", "Unlock", "Purchases" }

            local function trackXRaySubtree(root, alphaPercent, loopId)
                if not root then return end
                if loopId ~= xrayLoopId then return end
                setXRayTargetTransparency(root, alphaPercent, loopId)
                if loopId ~= xrayLoopId then return end
                xrayConnections[#xrayConnections + 1] = root.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(obj)
                    if loopId ~= xrayLoopId then return end
                    setXRayTargetTransparency(obj, alphaPercent, loopId)
                end)
            end

            local function processPlotXRay(plot, alphaPercent, loopId)
                if not plot then return end
                if loopId ~= xrayLoopId then return end
                for _, fname in ipairs(XRAY_FOLDERS) do
                    if loopId ~= xrayLoopId then return end
                    trackXRaySubtree(plot:FindFirstChild(fname), alphaPercent, loopId)
                end
                if loopId ~= xrayLoopId then return end
                xrayConnections[#xrayConnections + 1] = plot.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
                    if loopId ~= xrayLoopId then return end
                    for _, fname in ipairs(XRAY_FOLDERS) do
                        if child.Name == fname then trackXRaySubtree(child, alphaPercent, loopId); break end
                    end
                end)

                local animalPodiums = plot:FindFirstChild("AnimalPodiums")
                if animalPodiums then
                    local function processPodium(podium)
                        for _, child in ipairs(podium:GetChildren()) do
                            if child.Name == "Claim" then
                                trackXRaySubtree(child, alphaPercent, loopId)
                            elseif child.Name == "Base" then
                                trackXRaySubtree(child:FindFirstChild("Decorations"), alphaPercent, loopId)
                            elseif child:IsA("Model") and child.Name ~= "Decorations" then
                                trackXRaySubtree(child, alphaPercent, loopId)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    for _, podium in ipairs(animalPodiums:GetChildren()) do processPodium(podium) end
                    xrayConnections[#xrayConnections + 1] = animalPodiums.ChildAdded:Connect(function(podium)
                        if loopId ~= xrayLoopId then return end
                        task.wait(0.1)
                        if loopId ~= xrayLoopId then return end
                        processPodium(podium)
                    end)
                end
            end

            local function applyTransparencyToAllPlotsXRay(alphaPercent, loopId)
                local plotsFolder = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")
                if not plotsFolder then return end
                for _, plot in ipairs(plotsFolder:GetChildren()) do
                    if loopId ~= xrayLoopId then return end
                    processPlotXRay(plot, alphaPercent, loopId)
                    task.wait()
                end
                xrayConnections[#xrayConnections + 1] = plotsFolder.ChildAdded:Connect(function(plot)
                    if loopId ~= xrayLoopId then return end
                    task.wait(0.2)
                    processPlotXRay(plot, alphaPercent, loopId)
                end)
            end

            local function _enableXray()
                xrayEnabled = true
                for _, conn in ipairs(xrayConnections) do
                    if typeof(conn) == "RBXScriptConnection" then pcall(function() conn:Disconnect() end) end
                end
                xrayConnections = {}
                xrayLoopId = xrayLoopId + 1
                local currentLoopId = xrayLoopId
                task.spawn(function()
                    while currentLoopId == xrayLoopId and not Workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots") do
                        task.wait(0.5)
                    end
                    if currentLoopId ~= xrayLoopId then return end
                    pcall(applyTransparencyToAllPlotsXRay, XRAY_ALPHA, currentLoopId)
                end)
                pcall(function()
                    LocalPlayer.DevEnableMouseLock = true
                    LocalPlayer.DevCameraOcclusionMode = Enum.DevCameraOcclusionMode.Invisicam
                end)
            end

            local function _disableXray()
                xrayEnabled = false
                for _, conn in ipairs(xrayConnections) do
