                    if typeof(conn) == "RBXScriptConnection" then pcall(function() conn:Disconnect() end) end
                end
                xrayConnections = {}
                xrayLoopId = xrayLoopId + 1
                local snapshot = xrayOriginalTransparencies
                xrayOriginalTransparencies = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
                for obj, orig in pairs(snapshot) do
                    pcall(function()
                        if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
                            obj.Transparency = orig
                        elseif obj:IsA("TextLabel") or obj:IsA("TextButton") then
                            obj.TextTransparency = orig.text
                            obj.BackgroundTransparency = orig.bg
                        elseif obj:IsA("Frame") or obj:IsA("ScrollingFrame") then
                            obj.BackgroundTransparency = orig
                        elseif obj:IsA("ImageLabel") or obj:IsA("ImageButton") then
                            obj.ImageTransparency = orig.img
                            obj.BackgroundTransparency = orig.bg
                        end
                    end)
                end
            end

            _G.VXSetXRay = function(on)
                Config.XRay = on and true or false
                if SaveConfig then pcall(SaveConfig) end
                if Config.XRay then _enableXray() else _disableXray() end
            end

            LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
                task.wait(0.5)
                if xrayEnabled then _enableXray() end
            end)

            if Config.XRay then
                _G.VXDelayFrom("XRayDelay", function()
                    if Config.XRay then _enableXray() end
                end)
            end
        end

        do
            local function isPlayerCharacter(model)
                return Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model) ~= nil
            end

            local function _vxStripPreserve(obj)
                local node = obj
                while node and node ~= Workspace do
                    if node:GetAttribute("__TPMarker") then return true end
                    if node:GetAttribute("__VXESP") then return true end
                    local nm = node.Name
                    if type(nm) == "string" then
                        if nm:find("Sentry") then return true end
                        if nm:sub(1, 2) == "VX" or nm:find("VX") or nm:find("Vergent") then return true end
                        if nm:find("PlotBeam") or nm:find("Brainrot") or nm:find("ESP") or nm:find("BaseBeam") then return true end
                    end
                    node = node.Parent
                end
                return false
            end
            local function handleAnimator(animator)
                local model = animator:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
                if model and isPlayerCharacter(model) then return end
                for _, track in pairs(animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do track:Stop(0) end
                animator.AnimationPlayed:Connect(function(track) track:Stop(0) end)
            end
            local function stripVisuals(obj)
                if _vxStripPreserve(obj) then return end
                if obj:IsA("Highlight") then return end

                if obj:IsA("BillboardGui") or obj:IsA("Beam") or obj:IsA("Handles")
                or obj:IsA("SelectionBox") or obj:IsA("BoxHandleAdornment")
                or obj:IsA("CylinderHandleAdornment") or obj:IsA("SphereHandleAdornment")
                or obj:IsA("LineHandleAdornment") or obj:IsA("Attachment") then
                    return
                end
                local model = obj:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
                local isPlayer = model and isPlayerCharacter(model)
                if obj:IsA("Animator") then handleAnimator(obj) end

                if (obj:IsA("Accessory") or obj:IsA("Clothing")) and not isPlayer then
                    if obj:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model") then obj:Destroy() end
                end
                if not isPlayer then
                    if obj:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or obj:IsA("Trail") or obj:IsA("Beam") or
                    obj:IsA("Smoke") or obj:IsA("Fire") or obj:IsA("Sparkles") then
                        obj.Enabled = false
                    end
                    if obj:IsA("PointLight") or obj:IsA("SpotLight") or obj:IsA("SurfaceLight") then
                        obj.Enabled = false; obj.Brightness = 0; obj.Range = 0
                        task.defer(function() pcall(function() obj:Destroy() end) end)
                    end
                    if obj:IsA("Explosion") then obj:Destroy() end
                    if obj:IsA("MeshPart") then obj.TextureID = "" end
                end
                if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
                    obj.Material = Enum.Material.Plastic; obj.Reflectance = 0; obj.CastShadow = false
                end
                if obj:IsA("SurfaceAppearance") or obj:IsA("Texture") or obj:IsA("Decal") then
                    obj:Destroy()
                end
            end
            local _stripConn = nil

            applyGraphicsStrip = function()
                local enabled = (Config.GraphicsStripping == true)
                if _stripConn then _stripConn:Disconnect(); _stripConn = nil end
                if not enabled then return end
                pcall(function()
                    Lighting.GlobalShadows = false
                    Lighting.FogEnd = 9e9; Lighting.FogStart = 0
                    Lighting.EnvironmentDiffuseScale = 0; Lighting.EnvironmentSpecularScale = 0
                    for _, v in pairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do
                        if v:IsA("BlurEffect") or v:IsA("SunRaysEffect") or v:IsA("BloomEffect")
                        or v:IsA("DepthOfFieldEffect") then

                            v.Enabled = false
                        end
                    end
                    local Terrain = Workspace:FindFirstChildOfClass("Terrain")
                    if Terrain then
                        Terrain.WaterWaveSize = 0; Terrain.WaterWaveSpeed = 0
                        Terrain.WaterReflectance = 0; Terrain.WaterTransparency = 1
                    end
                end)
                task.spawn(function()
                    local objs = Workspace:GetDescendants()
                    for i = 1, #objs do
                        pcall(stripVisuals, objs[i])
                        if i % 30 == 0 then task.wait() end
                    end
                end)
                _stripConn = Workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(obj)
                    if Config.GraphicsStripping == false then return end
                    task.defer(function() pcall(stripVisuals, obj) end)
                end)
            end
            if Config.GraphicsStripping == true then
                _G.VXDelayFrom("StripDelay", function()
                    if Config.GraphicsStripping == true then pcall(applyGraphicsStrip) end
                end)
            end
        end

        do
            local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

            local antiRagdollConns = {}
            local charConn = nil
            local cleanRagdollV2Scheduled = false

            local function cleanRagdollV2(char)
                if not char then return end
                local carpetEquipped = false
                pcall(function()
                    local toolName = (Config.TpSettings and Config.TpSettings.Tool) or "Flying Carpet"
                    local tool = char:FindFirstChild(toolName)
                    if tool then
                        local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                        if hrp then
                            for _, obj in ipairs(hrp:GetChildren()) do
                                if obj:IsA("BodyVelocity") or obj:IsA("BodyPosition") or obj:IsA("BodyGyro") then carpetEquipped = true break end
                            end
                        end
                        if not carpetEquipped then
                            for _, obj in ipairs(tool:GetChildren()) do
                                if obj:IsA("BodyVelocity") or obj:IsA("BodyPosition") or obj:IsA("BodyGyro") then carpetEquipped = true break end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end)
                local descendants = char:GetDescendants()
                for _, d in ipairs(descendants) do
                    if d:IsA("BallSocketConstraint") or d:IsA("NoCollisionConstraint")
                    or d:IsA("HingeConstraint")
                    or (d:IsA("Attachment") and (d.Name == "A" or d.Name == "B")) then
                        d:Destroy()
                    elseif (d:IsA("BodyVelocity") or d:IsA("BodyPosition") or d:IsA("BodyGyro")) and not carpetEquipped then
                        d:Destroy()
                    end
                end
                for _, d in ipairs(descendants) do
                    if d:IsA("Motor6D") then d.Enabled = true end
                end
                local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if hum then
                    local animator = hum:FindFirstChild("Animator")
                    if animator then
                        for _, track in ipairs(animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
                            local n = track.Animation and track.Animation.Name:lower() or ""
                            if n:find("rag") or n:find("fall") or n:find("hurt") or n:find("down") then
                                track:Stop(0)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                task.defer(function()
                    pcall(function()
                        local pm = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerScripts")
                        if pm then pm = pm:FindFirstChild("PlayerModule") end
                        if pm then require(pm):GetControls():Enable() end
                    end)
                end)
            end

            local function cleanRagdollV2Debounced(char)
                if cleanRagdollV2Scheduled then return end
                cleanRagdollV2Scheduled = true
                task.defer(function()
                    cleanRagdollV2Scheduled = false
                    if char and char.Parent then cleanRagdollV2(char) end
                end)
            end

            local function isRagdollRelatedDescendant(obj)
                if obj:IsA("BallSocketConstraint") or obj:IsA("NoCollisionConstraint") or obj:IsA("HingeConstraint") then return true end
                if obj:IsA("Attachment") and (obj.Name == "A" or obj.Name == "B") then return true end
                if obj:IsA("BodyVelocity") or obj:IsA("BodyPosition") or obj:IsA("BodyGyro") then return true end
                return false
            end

            local function stopV2()
                cleanRagdollV2Scheduled = false
                for _, c in ipairs(antiRagdollConns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
                antiRagdollConns = {}
                if charConn then pcall(function() charConn:Disconnect() end); charConn = nil end
            end

            local function hookAntiRagV2(char)
                for _, c in ipairs(antiRagdollConns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
                antiRagdollConns = {}
                local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)
                local hrp = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 10)
                if not hum or not hrp then return end
                local lastVel = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
                local c1 = hum.StateChanged:Connect(function()
                    local st = hum:GetState()
                    if st == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics or st == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll
                    or st == Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown or st == Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp then
                        local carpetActive = false
                        pcall(function()
                            local toolName = (Config.TpSettings and Config.TpSettings.Tool) or "Flying Carpet"
                            local tool = char:FindFirstChild(toolName)
                            if tool and hrp then
                                for _, obj in ipairs(hrp:GetChildren()) do
                                    if obj:IsA("BodyVelocity") or obj:IsA("BodyPosition") or obj:IsA("BodyGyro") then carpetActive = true end
                                end
                            end
                        end)
                        if not carpetActive then hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running) end
                        cleanRagdollV2(char)
                        pcall(function() Workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraSubject = hum end)
                        pcall(function()
                            local pm = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerScripts")
                            if pm then pm = pm:FindFirstChild("PlayerModule") end
                            if pm then require(pm):GetControls():Enable() end
                        end)
                    end
                end)
                table.insert(antiRagdollConns, c1)
                local c2 = char.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(desc)
                    if isRagdollRelatedDescendant(desc) then cleanRagdollV2Debounced(char) end
                end)
                table.insert(antiRagdollConns, c2)
                pcall(function()
                    local pkg = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Packages")
                    if pkg then
                        local net = pkg:FindFirstChild("Net")
                        if net then
                            local applyImp = net:FindFirstChild("RE/CombatService/ApplyImpulse")
                            if applyImp and applyImp:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
                                local c3 = applyImp.OnClientEvent:Connect(function()
                                    local st = hum:GetState()
                                    if st == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics or st == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll
                                    or st == Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown or st == Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp then
                                        pcall(function() hrp.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0) end)
                                    end
                                end)
                                table.insert(antiRagdollConns, c3)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end)
                local _c4Active = true
                local c4Thread = task.spawn(function()
                    while _c4Active do
                        task.wait(0.05)
                        local st = hum:GetState()

                        local ragEnd = LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("RagdollEndTime")
                        local attrRagdolled = (ragEnd ~= nil) and ((ragEnd - Workspace:GetServerTimeNow()) > 0)
                        local stateRagdolled = (st == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics or st == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll
                            or st == Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown or st == Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp)
                        if stateRagdolled or attrRagdolled then
                            if attrRagdolled then
                                pcall(function() LocalPlayer:SetAttribute("RagdollEndTime", Workspace:GetServerTimeNow()) end)
                            end
                            if stateRagdolled then
                                local carpetActive = false
                                pcall(function()
                                    local tool = char:FindFirstChild((Config.TpSettings and Config.TpSettings.Tool) or "Flying Carpet")
                                    if tool and hrp then
                                        for _, obj in ipairs(hrp:GetChildren()) do
                                            if obj:IsA("BodyVelocity") or obj:IsA("BodyPosition") or obj:IsA("BodyGyro") then carpetActive = true end
                                        end
                                    end
                                end)
                                if not carpetActive then pcall(function() hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running) end) end
                            end
                            cleanRagdollV2(char)
                            local vel = hrp.Velocity
                            if (vel - lastVel).Magnitude > 40 and vel.Magnitude > 25 then
                                hrp.Velocity = vel.Unit * math.min(vel.Magnitude, 15)
                            end
                        end
                        lastVel = hrp.Velocity
                    end
                end)
                local c4 = {Disconnect = function() _c4Active = false; task.cancel(c4Thread) end}
                table.insert(antiRagdollConns, c4)

                local c5 = LocalPlayer:GetAttributeChangedSignal("RagdollEndTime"):Connect(function()
                    local ragEnd = LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("RagdollEndTime")
                    if ragEnd ~= nil and (ragEnd - Workspace:GetServerTimeNow()) > 0 then
                        pcall(function() LocalPlayer:SetAttribute("RagdollEndTime", Workspace:GetServerTimeNow()) end)
                        if char and char.Parent then cleanRagdollV2(char) end
                    end
                end)
                table.insert(antiRagdollConns, c5)
                cleanRagdollV2(char)
            end

            local function startV2(enabled)
                stopV2()
                if not enabled then return end
                local char = LocalPlayer.Character
                if char then task.spawn(function() hookAntiRagV2(char) end) end
                charConn = LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(c)
                    task.spawn(function() hookAntiRagV2(c) end)
                end)
            end

            _G.VXSetAntiRagdoll = function(on)
                on = on and true or false
                Config.AntiRagdoll = on
                Config.AntiRagdollV2 = false
                pcall(SaveConfig)
                startV2(on)
            end

            if Config.AntiRagdoll == true or Config.AntiRagdoll == 1 then
                startV2(true)
            end
        end

        do
            local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
            local antiRagdollConnections = {}
            local antiRagdollCharacter, antiRagdollHumanoid, antiRagdollRootPart, antiRagdollAnimator
            local lastVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
            local velocityChangeThreshold = 40
            local velocityMagnitudeThreshold = 25
            local maxVelocity = 15

            local function isFlyingCarpetActive()
                if not antiRagdollCharacter then return false end
                local tool = antiRagdollCharacter:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Tool")
                if not tool then return false end
                local hrp = antiRagdollCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if hrp then
                    for _, obj in ipairs(hrp:GetChildren()) do
                        if obj:IsA("BodyVelocity") or obj:IsA("BodyPosition") or obj:IsA("BodyGyro") then
                            return true
                        end
                    end
                end
                return false
            end

            local function isRagdolled()
                if not antiRagdollHumanoid then return false end
                local state = antiRagdollHumanoid:GetState()
                return state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics
                or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll
                or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown
                or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp
            end

            local function attrRagdolled()
                local ragEnd = LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("RagdollEndTime")
                return (ragEnd ~= nil) and ((ragEnd - Workspace:GetServerTimeNow()) > 0)
            end

            local function enableAntiRagdollControls()
                pcall(function()
                    local PlayerModule = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerScripts"):WaitForChild("PlayerModule", 10)
                    require(PlayerModule):GetControls():Enable()
                end)
            end

            local function cleanupRagdoll()
                if not antiRagdollCharacter then return end
                local carpetEquipped = isFlyingCarpetActive()

                local function processChildren(parent)
                    for _, obj in ipairs(parent:GetChildren()) do
                        if obj:IsA("BallSocketConstraint") or obj:IsA("NoCollisionConstraint") or obj:IsA("HingeConstraint")
                        or (obj:IsA("Attachment") and (obj.Name == "A" or obj.Name == "B")) then
                            obj:Destroy()
                        elseif obj:IsA("BodyVelocity") or obj:IsA("BodyPosition") or obj:IsA("BodyGyro") then
                            if not carpetEquipped then obj:Destroy() end
                        elseif obj:IsA("Motor6D") then
                            obj.Enabled = true
                        elseif obj:IsA("BasePart") then
                            for _, child in ipairs(obj:GetChildren()) do
                                if child:IsA("BallSocketConstraint") or child:IsA("NoCollisionConstraint") or child:IsA("HingeConstraint") or child:IsA("Motor6D") then
                                    if child:IsA("Motor6D") then
                                        child.Enabled = true
                                    else
                                        child:Destroy()
                                    end
                                elseif child:IsA("Attachment") and (child.Name == "A" or child.Name == "B") then
                                    child:Destroy()
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end

                pcall(function() processChildren(antiRagdollCharacter) end)

                if antiRagdollAnimator then
                    for _, track in pairs(antiRagdollAnimator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
                        local animName = track.Animation and track.Animation.Name:lower() or ""
                        if animName:find("rag") or animName:find("fall") or animName:find("hurt") or animName:find("down") then
                            track:Stop(0)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end

            local function setupAntiRagdollCharacter(char)
                antiRagdollCharacter = char
                antiRagdollHumanoid = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)
                antiRagdollRootPart = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 10)
                antiRagdollAnimator = antiRagdollHumanoid and antiRagdollHumanoid:WaitForChild("Animator", 10)
                lastVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
            end

            local function clearAntiRagdollConnections()
                for _, c in pairs(antiRagdollConnections) do
                    pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end)
                end
                antiRagdollConnections = {}
            end

            local setupAntiRagdollConnections

            setupAntiRagdollConnections = function()
                clearAntiRagdollConnections()
                if not antiRagdollHumanoid or not antiRagdollRootPart then return end

                table.insert(antiRagdollConnections, antiRagdollHumanoid.StateChanged:Connect(function()
                    if _G.invisibleStealEnabled or _G.RecoveryInProgress then return end
                    if (_G.AntiRagdollEnabled or _G.antiKnockbackEnabled) and (isRagdolled() or attrRagdolled()) then
                        antiRagdollHumanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running)
                        cleanupRagdoll()
                        Workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraSubject = antiRagdollHumanoid
                        enableAntiRagdollControls()
                    end
                end))

                pcall(function()
                    local impulsePath = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Packages")
                    if impulsePath then
                        impulsePath = impulsePath:FindFirstChild("Net")
                        if impulsePath then
                            impulsePath = impulsePath:FindFirstChild("RE/CombatService/ApplyImpulse")
                            if impulsePath then
                                table.insert(antiRagdollConnections, impulsePath.OnClientEvent:Connect(function()
                                    if (_G.AntiRagdollEnabled or _G.antiKnockbackEnabled) and isRagdolled() then
                                        antiRagdollRootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
                                    end
                                end))
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end)

                table.insert(antiRagdollConnections, antiRagdollCharacter.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(desc)
                    if not (_G.AntiRagdollEnabled or _G.antiKnockbackEnabled) then return end
                    if _G.invisibleStealEnabled or _G.RecoveryInProgress then return end
                    if isRagdolled() or attrRagdolled()
                    or desc:IsA("BallSocketConstraint") or desc:IsA("NoCollisionConstraint")
                    or desc:IsA("HingeConstraint") then
                        cleanupRagdoll()
                        if antiRagdollHumanoid and not isFlyingCarpetActive() then
                            antiRagdollHumanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running)
                        end
                    end
                end))

                table.insert(antiRagdollConnections, LocalPlayer:GetAttributeChangedSignal("RagdollEndTime"):Connect(function()
                    if not (_G.AntiRagdollEnabled or _G.antiKnockbackEnabled) then return end
                    if _G.invisibleStealEnabled or _G.RecoveryInProgress then return end
                    local ragEnd = LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("RagdollEndTime")
                    if ragEnd ~= nil and (ragEnd - Workspace:GetServerTimeNow()) > 0 then
                        pcall(function() LocalPlayer:SetAttribute("RagdollEndTime", Workspace:GetServerTimeNow()) end)
                        cleanupRagdoll()
                    end
                end))

                table.insert(antiRagdollConnections, RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
                    if not (_G.AntiRagdollEnabled or _G.antiKnockbackEnabled) then return end
                    if _G.invisibleStealEnabled or _G.RecoveryInProgress then return end

                    local liveChar = LocalPlayer.Character
                    if liveChar and (liveChar ~= antiRagdollCharacter
                        or not antiRagdollRootPart or antiRagdollRootPart.Parent == nil
                        or not antiRagdollHumanoid or antiRagdollHumanoid.Parent == nil) then
                        task.spawn(function()
                            setupAntiRagdollCharacter(liveChar)
                            setupAntiRagdollConnections()
                        end)
                        return
                    end

                    local ragEnd = LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("RagdollEndTime")
                    local attrRagdolled = (ragEnd ~= nil) and ((ragEnd - Workspace:GetServerTimeNow()) > 0)
                    if attrRagdolled then
                        pcall(function() LocalPlayer:SetAttribute("RagdollEndTime", Workspace:GetServerTimeNow()) end)
                    end
                    if isRagdolled() or attrRagdolled then
                        cleanupRagdoll()
                        local velocity = antiRagdollRootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity
                        if (velocity - lastVelocity).Magnitude > velocityChangeThreshold
                        and velocity.Magnitude > velocityMagnitudeThreshold then
                            antiRagdollRootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = velocity.Unit * math.min(velocity.Magnitude, maxVelocity)
                        end
                        lastVelocity = velocity
                    end
                end))

                enableAntiRagdollControls()
                cleanupRagdoll()
            end

            local function sxeStartAntiRagdoll()
                _G.AntiRagdollEnabled = true
                _G.antiKnockbackEnabled = true
                local char = LocalPlayer.Character
                if char then

                    task.spawn(function()
                        setupAntiRagdollCharacter(char)
                        setupAntiRagdollConnections()
                    end)
                end
            end

            local function sxeStopAntiRagdoll()
                _G.AntiRagdollEnabled = false
                _G.antiKnockbackEnabled = false
                clearAntiRagdollConnections()
            end

            _G.toggleAntiRagdoll = function(enabled)
                if enabled then sxeStartAntiRagdoll() else sxeStopAntiRagdoll() end
            end
            _G.enableAntiKnockback = function() sxeStartAntiRagdoll() end
            _G.disableAntiKnockback = function() sxeStopAntiRagdoll() end

            LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
                clearAntiRagdollConnections()
                antiRagdollCharacter = nil; antiRagdollHumanoid = nil; antiRagdollRootPart = nil; antiRagdollAnimator = nil
                local humanoid = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)
                local rootPart = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 10)
                if not humanoid or not rootPart then return end
                task.wait(0.2)
                setupAntiRagdollCharacter(char)
                if _G.AntiRagdollEnabled or _G.antiKnockbackEnabled then
                    setupAntiRagdollConnections()
                end
            end)

            if LocalPlayer.Character then

                task.spawn(function()
                    setupAntiRagdollCharacter(LocalPlayer.Character)
                    if _G.AntiRagdollEnabled or _G.antiKnockbackEnabled then
                        setupAntiRagdollConnections()
                    end
                end)
            end

            local _wasOn = (Config.AntiRagdoll == true or Config.AntiRagdoll == 1)
            if _G.VXSetAntiRagdoll then pcall(_G.VXSetAntiRagdoll, false) end
            Config.AntiRagdoll = _wasOn
            if _wasOn then pcall(SaveConfig) end

            _G.VXSetAntiRagdoll = function(on)
                on = on and true or false
                Config.AntiRagdoll = on
                Config.AntiRagdollV2 = false
                pcall(SaveConfig)
                if on then sxeStartAntiRagdoll() else sxeStopAntiRagdoll() end
            end

            if _wasOn then
                sxeStartAntiRagdoll()
            end
        end

        do
            local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
            local FORCE_FOV = 70
            local ab = {
                running = false, connections = {}, originalMoveFunction = nil, controlsProtected = false,
                badLightingNames = { Blue = true, DiscoEffect = true, BeeBlur = true, ColorCorrection = true },
            }
            local function nuke(obj)
                if obj and obj.Parent and ab.badLightingNames[obj.Name] then pcall(function() obj:Destroy() end) end
            end
            local function disconnectAll()
                for _, c in ipairs(ab.connections) do if typeof(c) == "RBXScriptConnection" then c:Disconnect() end end
                ab.connections = {}
            end
            local function protectControls()
                if ab.controlsProtected then return end
                pcall(function()
                    local PlayerModule = LocalPlayer.PlayerScripts:FindFirstChild("PlayerModule")
                    if not PlayerModule then return end
                    local Controls = require(PlayerModule):GetControls()
                    if not Controls then return end
                    if not ab.originalMoveFunction then ab.originalMoveFunction = Controls.moveFunction end
                    local function protectedMoveFunction(self, moveVector, relativeToCamera)
                        if ab.originalMoveFunction then ab.originalMoveFunction(self, moveVector, relativeToCamera) end
                    end
                    local _abFrame = 0
                    table.insert(ab.connections, RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
                        if not ab.running or not Config.AntiBeeDisco then return end
                        _abFrame = _abFrame + 1
                        if _abFrame < 6 then return end
                        _abFrame = 0
                        if Controls.moveFunction ~= protectedMoveFunction then Controls.moveFunction = protectedMoveFunction end
                    end))
                    Controls.moveFunction = protectedMoveFunction
                    ab.controlsProtected = true
                end)
            end
            local function restoreControls()
                if not ab.controlsProtected then return end
                pcall(function()
                    local PlayerModule = LocalPlayer.PlayerScripts:FindFirstChild("PlayerModule")
                    if not PlayerModule then return end
                    local Controls = require(PlayerModule):GetControls()
                    if Controls and ab.originalMoveFunction then
                        Controls.moveFunction = ab.originalMoveFunction
                        ab.controlsProtected = false
                    end
                end)
            end
            local function blockBuzzingSound()
                pcall(function()
                    local beeScript = LocalPlayer.PlayerScripts:FindFirstChild("Bee", true)
                    if beeScript then
                        local buzzing = beeScript:FindFirstChild("Buzzing")
                        if buzzing and buzzing:IsA("Sound") then buzzing:Stop(); buzzing.Volume = 0 end
                    end
                end)
            end
            local function Enable()
                if ab.running then return end
                ab.running = true
                for _, inst in ipairs(Lighting:GetDescendants()) do nuke(inst) end
                table.insert(ab.connections, Lighting.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(obj)
                    if ab.running and Config.AntiBeeDisco then nuke(obj) end
                end))
                protectControls()
                local _abFovFrame = 0
                table.insert(ab.connections, RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
                    if not ab.running or not Config.AntiBeeDisco then return end
                    _abFovFrame = _abFovFrame + 1
                    if _abFovFrame < 12 then return end
                    _abFovFrame = 0
                    blockBuzzingSound()
                    local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera

                    local _targetFov = tonumber(Config.FOV) or FORCE_FOV
                    if _G.VXFovReady and cam and cam.FieldOfView ~= _targetFov then cam.FieldOfView = _targetFov end
                end))
            end
            local function Disable()
                if not ab.running then return end
                ab.running = false
                restoreControls()
                disconnectAll()
            end
            SharedState.ANTI_BEE_DISCO = { Enable = Enable, Disable = Disable }
            if Config.AntiBeeDisco then task.delay(1, Enable) end
        end

        if not Config.AntiBodySwapOnByDefault then
            Config.AntiBodySwapOnByDefault = true
            Config.AntiBodySwap = false
            pcall(SaveConfig)
        end
        _G.AntiBodySwapEnabled = Config.AntiBodySwap == true
        task.spawn(function()
            local POTION_NAME   = "Body Swap Potion"
            local THREAT_TTL    = 45
            local SWAP_RADIUS   = 12
            local TELEPORT_MIN  = 10
            local HIST_WINDOW   = 1.2
            local LOOKBACK      = 0.25
            local PER_PLAYER_CD = 4
            local FIRE_WINDOW   = 1.5
            local CHASE_TIMEOUT = 3
            local CHASE_OFFSET  = 3
            local ACTIVATE_WAIT = 0.05
            --  "Teleported" has to mean teleported. At 3 studs a sprinting
            --  player clears this inside one LOOKBACK window (16 studs/s over
            --  0.25s = 4), which made ordinary running read as a swap.
            local HOLDER_JUMP   = 10

            local threats        = {}
            local hitCooldowns   = {}
            local selfHist       = {}
            local localJustFired = false
            local lastStealingAt = 0
            local charSpawnedAt  = 0
            local prevSelfPos    = nil
            local hookedChars    = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

            local function getLocalHRP()
                local char = LocalPlayer.Character
                if not char then return nil end
                return char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or char.PrimaryPart
            end

            local function pushHist(h, pos, now)
                h[#h + 1] = { p = pos, t = now }
                while h[1] and (now - h[1].t) > HIST_WINDOW do table.remove(h, 1) end
            end

            local function histAt(h, ago, now)
                local want = now - ago
                local best = nil
                for i = #h, 1, -1 do
                    best = h[i].p
                    if h[i].t <= want then return h[i].p end
                end
                return best
            end

            local function threatOf(plr)
                local th = threats[plr]
                if not th then th = { hist = {}, lastPotionAt = 0, firedAt = nil }; threats[plr] = th end
                return th
            end

            local function markPotion(plr)
                if plr == LocalPlayer then return end
                threatOf(plr).lastPotionAt = tick()
            end

            local function seenPotion(th, now)
                return th.lastPotionAt > 0 and (now - th.lastPotionAt) <= THREAT_TTL
            end

            local function hookCharacter(plr, char)
                if not char or hookedChars[char] then return end
                hookedChars[char] = true
                if char:FindFirstChild(POTION_NAME) then markPotion(plr) end
                char.ChildAdded:Connect(function(c)
                    if c.Name == POTION_NAME then markPotion(plr) end
                end)

                char.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(c)
                    if c.Name == POTION_NAME then
                        local th = threatOf(plr)
                        th.lastPotionAt = tick()
                        th.firedAt = tick()
                    end
                end)
            end

            local function hookBackpack(plr)
                if plr == LocalPlayer then return end
                local bp = plr:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
                if not bp or hookedChars[bp] then return end
                hookedChars[bp] = true
                if bp:FindFirstChild(POTION_NAME) then markPotion(plr) end
                bp.ChildAdded:Connect(function(c)
                    if c.Name == POTION_NAME then markPotion(plr) end
                end)
            end

            local function hookPlayer(plr)
                if plr == LocalPlayer then return end
                if plr.Character then hookCharacter(plr, plr.Character) end
                pcall(hookBackpack, plr)
                plr.ChildAdded:Connect(function(c)
                    if c:IsA("Backpack") then task.defer(function() pcall(hookBackpack, plr) end) end
                end)
                plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(c) task.wait(0.1); hookCharacter(plr, c) end)
            end
            for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do hookPlayer(plr) end
            Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(hookPlayer)
            Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(plr) threats[plr] = nil; hitCooldowns[plr] = nil end)

            task.spawn(function()
                while true do
                    task.wait(0.25)
                    if _G.AntiBodySwapEnabled then
                        for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                            if plr ~= LocalPlayer then
                                local c = plr.Character
                                if c then
                                    hookCharacter(plr, c)
                                    if c:FindFirstChild(POTION_NAME) then markPotion(plr) end
                                end
                                pcall(hookBackpack, plr)
                                local bp = plr:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
                                if bp and bp:FindFirstChild(POTION_NAME) then markPotion(plr) end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end)

            local function hookLocalPotion()
                local char = LocalPlayer.Character
                if not char then return end
                local function hook(potion)
                    potion.Activated:Connect(function()
                        localJustFired = true
                        task.delay(1.5, function() localJustFired = false end)
                    end)
                end
                local existing = char:FindFirstChild(POTION_NAME)
                if existing then hook(existing) end
                char.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
                    if child.Name == POTION_NAME then hook(child) end
                end)
            end
            LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
                charSpawnedAt = tick()
                prevSelfPos = nil
                selfHist = {}
                task.wait(0.1)
                hookLocalPotion()
            end)
            charSpawnedAt = tick()
            hookLocalPotion()

            local function selfCaused()
                return _G.PATHFINDING_ACTIVE
                or _G.VXTeleportActive
                or _G.RecoveryInProgress
                or _G.VXBodySwapRecovery
                or localJustFired
                or (tick() - charSpawnedAt) < 2
            end

            local function swapBackTo(threatPlayer, stealWasBroken, strong)
                _G.VXLog("BodySwap", "Swap detected from " .. tostring(threatPlayer and threatPlayer.Name or "?") ..
                    " - equipping potion" .. (stealWasBroken and " (steal was broken)" or ""))
                if _G.VXBodySwapRecovery then return end
                if (_G.VXTeleportActive or _G.PATHFINDING_ACTIVE) and not strong then return end
                _G.VXBodySwapRecovery = true

                local chaseConn = nil
                local function stopChase()
                    if chaseConn then chaseConn:Disconnect(); chaseConn = nil end
                end

                local ok = pcall(function()

                    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
                    local hum  = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                    if not hum then return end
                    local potion = char:FindFirstChild(POTION_NAME)
                    or (LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("Backpack") and LocalPlayer.Backpack:FindFirstChild(POTION_NAME))
                    if not potion then return end

                    if potion.Parent ~= char then pcall(function() hum:EquipTool(potion) end) end
                    local eq0 = os.clock()
                    while (os.clock() - eq0) < 0.5 do
                        char = LocalPlayer.Character
                        if char and char:FindFirstChild(POTION_NAME) then break end
                        RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
                    end

                    local t0 = os.clock()
                    chaseConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
                        if os.clock() - t0 > CHASE_TIMEOUT then stopChase(); return end
                        local tChar = threatPlayer.Character
                        local tHRP  = tChar and tChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                        local lHRP  = getLocalHRP()
                        if tHRP and tHRP.Parent and lHRP and lHRP.Parent then
                            local tp = tHRP.Position

                            local dest = Vector3.new(tp.X + CHASE_OFFSET, tp.Y, tp.Z + CHASE_OFFSET)
                            lHRP.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(dest, tp)
                            lHRP.AssemblyLinearVelocity  = Vector3.zero
                            lHRP.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
                        end
                    end)

                    task.delay(CHASE_TIMEOUT, stopChase)

                    local s0 = os.clock()
                    while (os.clock() - s0) < ACTIVATE_WAIT do RunService.Heartbeat:Wait() end

                    local c2 = LocalPlayer.Character
                    local p2 = c2 and c2:FindFirstChild(POTION_NAME)
                    if p2 then pcall(function() p2:Activate() end) end
                end)

                stopChase()
                _G.VXBodySwapRecovery = nil
                if not ok then return end

                if stealWasBroken and Config.AutoTPOnFailedSteal then
                    task.wait(0.1)
                    if _G.VXBackToBrainrot then pcall(_G.VXBackToBrainrot) end
                end
            end

            local function fire(plr, strong)

                if (_G.VXTeleportActive or _G.PATHFINDING_ACTIVE) and not strong then return end
                local now = tick()
                local cd = hitCooldowns[plr]
                if cd and (now - cd) < PER_PLAYER_CD then return end
                hitCooldowns[plr] = now
                local broken = (now - lastStealingAt) < 2 and not LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("Stealing")

                if strong and (_G.VXTeleportActive or _G.PATHFINDING_ACTIVE) and _G.VXCancelTP then
                    pcall(_G.VXCancelTP)
                end
                task.spawn(function() swapBackTo(plr, broken, strong) end)
            end

            RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
                if not _G.AntiBodySwapEnabled then
                    prevSelfPos = nil
                    if #selfHist > 0 then selfHist = {} end
                    return
                end

                local now = tick()
                if LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("Stealing") then lastStealingAt = now end

                local char = LocalPlayer.Character
                local lHRP = getLocalHRP()
                if not lHRP then prevSelfPos = nil; return end
                local myNow = lHRP.Position
                pushHist(selfHist, myNow, now)

                for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                    if plr ~= LocalPlayer then
                        local c = plr.Character
                        local h = c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                        if h then pushHist(threatOf(plr).hist, h.Position, now) end
                    end
                end
                for plr in pairs(threats) do
                    if not plr.Parent then threats[plr] = nil end
                end

                local prev = prevSelfPos
                prevSelfPos = myNow
                if not prev then return end

                if localJustFired or _G.VXBodySwapRecovery or (tick() - charSpawnedAt) < 2 then return end

                local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                local walk = (hum and hum.WalkSpeed) or 16

                local maxHuman = (walk + 90) * math.max(dt, 1 / 240) + 4
                local jumped = (myNow - prev).Magnitude
                local iTeleported = jumped > math.max(TELEPORT_MIN, maxHuman)

                local myOld = histAt(selfHist, LOOKBACK, now) or prev
                local weMovedOurselves = selfCaused()

                for plr, th in pairs(threats) do
                    local c = plr.Character
                    local h = c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    if h then
                        local theirNow = h.Position
                        local theirOld = histAt(th.hist, LOOKBACK, now)
                        local recentFire = th.firedAt and (now - th.firedAt) <= FIRE_WINDOW
                        local hadPotion = seenPotion(th, now)

                        local theyLandedWhereIWas = (theirNow - myOld).Magnitude <= SWAP_RADIUS
                        local iLandedWhereTheyWere = theirOld and (myNow - theirOld).Magnitude <= SWAP_RADIUS
                        local theyTeleported = theirOld and (theirNow - theirOld).Magnitude > HOLDER_JUMP

                        local exchanged = iTeleported and theyTeleported
                        and theyLandedWhereIWas and iLandedWhereTheyWere
                        and theirOld ~= nil
                        and (myOld - theirOld).Magnitude > (SWAP_RADIUS * 2)

                        --  Only a real two-way exchange counts as being
                        --  swapped: we teleported, they teleported, they landed
                        --  where we were, we landed where they were, and the two
                        --  spots were far apart to begin with.
                        --
                        --  The old one-sided branches are what made this grab
                        --  random people. Each of them fired on half the
                        --  signature: "we teleported and somebody is standing
                        --  near where we were" matched every hub teleport that
                        --  landed near another player, and "they teleported and
                        --  jumped > 1" matched anyone walking past our old spot.
                        --  Neither is evidence that we were swapped, so a
                        --  bystander got swapped at instead.
                        local hit, strong = false, false
                        if exchanged then
                            --  Mid-teleport the hub is throwing us around, so
                            --  require corroboration that this player actually
                            --  used a potion before acting. Otherwise the
                            --  exchange signature stands on its own -- it is not
                            --  something ordinary movement can fake.
                            if weMovedOurselves then
                                hit = (recentFire and hadPotion) and true or false
                            else
                                hit = true
                            end
                            strong = hit
                        end

                        if hit then
                            th.firedAt = nil
                            fire(plr, strong)
                            break
                        end
                    end
                end
            end)
        end)
        SharedState.ANTI_BODY_SWAP = {
            Enable = function() Config.AntiBodySwap = true; _G.AntiBodySwapEnabled = true end,
            Disable = function() Config.AntiBodySwap = false; _G.AntiBodySwapEnabled = false end,
        }

        local balloonResetTriggered = false
        task.spawn(function()
            local balloonPhrase = 'ran "balloon" on you'

            PlayerGui.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(desc)
                if not Config.AutoResetOnBalloon then return end
                if balloonResetTriggered then return end
                if not (desc:IsA("TextLabel") or desc:IsA("TextButton")) then return end

                local txt = desc.Text
                if txt and string.find(txt, balloonPhrase, 1, true) then
                    balloonResetTriggered = true
                    if _G.executeReset then _G.executeReset() elseif executeReset then executeReset() end
                    task.delay(2, function()
                        balloonResetTriggered = false
                    end)
                end
            end)

            task.wait(1)
            if Config.AutoResetOnBalloon then
                for _, desc in ipairs(PlayerGui:GetDescendants()) do
                    if desc:IsA("TextLabel") or desc:IsA("TextButton") then
                        local txt = desc.Text
                        if txt and string.find(txt, balloonPhrase, 1, true) then
                            balloonResetTriggered = true
                            if _G.executeReset then _G.executeReset() elseif executeReset then executeReset() end
                            break
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end)

        do
            local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
            local _activeSentryConns = {}
            local _antiTurretReadyAt = os.clock() + 10
            local function handleSentry(child, immediate)
                if not child.Name or not child.Name:find("Sentry") then return end
                if _activeSentryConns[child] then return end
                local sentry_owner_id = child.Name:match("Sentry_(%d+)")
                if not sentry_owner_id or tonumber(sentry_owner_id) == LocalPlayer.UserId then return end
                if not immediate then
                    local setupReady = child:FindFirstChild("SetupReady")
                    if not setupReady then
                        local waitTime = 0
                        while not setupReady and child.Parent and waitTime < 5 do
                            task.wait(0.1)
                            setupReady = child:FindFirstChild("SetupReady")
                            waitTime = waitTime + 0.1
                        end
                        if not child.Parent then return end
                    end
                    task.wait(0.1)
                end
                if _activeSentryConns[child] then return end
                local sentryPart = child:IsA("BasePart") and child or child:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
                if not sentryPart and child:IsA("Model") then
                    for _, desc in ipairs(child:GetDescendants()) do
                        if desc:IsA("BasePart") then sentryPart = desc; break end
                    end
                end

                local last_attack, equipAttempts, frameSkip, _prepped = 0, 0, 0, false
                local heartbeat_conn
                heartbeat_conn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
                    if not child.Parent then
                        if heartbeat_conn and typeof(heartbeat_conn) == "RBXScriptConnection" then heartbeat_conn:Disconnect() end
                        _activeSentryConns[child] = nil
                        return
                    end
                    if not Config.AutoDestroyTurrets then return end
                    if os.clock() < _antiTurretReadyAt then return end
                    if not _prepped then
                        _prepped = true
                        if sentryPart then
                            pcall(function()
                                sentryPart.CanCollide = false
                                sentryPart.Transparency = 1
                                sentryPart.Size = Vector3.new(10, 10, 10)
                            end)
                        end
                    end
                    frameSkip = frameSkip + 1
                    if frameSkip < 3 then return end
                    frameSkip = 0
                    local now = tick()
                    if now - last_attack < 0.05 then return end
                    last_attack = now
                    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
                    if char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
                        local hrp = char.HumanoidRootPart
                        local targetCFrame = hrp.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -2)
                        if child:IsA("Model") and child.PrimaryPart then
                            pcall(function() child:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(targetCFrame) end)
                        elseif sentryPart then
                            pcall(function() sentryPart.CFrame = targetCFrame end)
                        end
                        local bat = (LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("Backpack") and LocalPlayer.Backpack:FindFirstChild("Bat")) or char:FindFirstChild("Bat")
                        if bat then
                            if bat.Parent == LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("Backpack") then
                                equipAttempts = equipAttempts + 1
                                if equipAttempts <= 3 then
                                    pcall(function() char.Humanoid:UnequipTools(); char.Humanoid:EquipTool(bat) end)
                                end
                            end
                            if bat.Parent == char then
                                equipAttempts = 0
                                pcall(function() bat:Activate() end)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end)
                _activeSentryConns[child] = heartbeat_conn
            end
            local function scanExistingSentries()
                task.spawn(function()
                    pcall(function()
                        for _, child in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
                            if child and child.Name and child.Name:find("Sentry") and not _activeSentryConns[child] then
                                task.spawn(function() pcall(function() handleSentry(child, true) end) end)
                            end
                        end
                    end)
                end)
            end
            scanExistingSentries()
            task.delay(2, scanExistingSentries)
            task.delay(5, scanExistingSentries)
            Workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(child) handleSentry(child, false) end)

            _G.ToggleAutoDestroyTurrets = function()
                Config.AutoDestroyTurrets = not Config.AutoDestroyTurrets
                pcall(SaveConfig)
                if _G.setAutoDestroyTurretsToggle then pcall(_G.setAutoDestroyTurretsToggle, Config.AutoDestroyTurrets) end

                pcall(ShowNotification, "Auto Destroy Turrets", Config.AutoDestroyTurrets and "Enabled" or "Disabled")
            end
        end

        do
            local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
            local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
            local ijConn, lastJump = nil, 0
            setInfiniteJump = function(enabled)
                infiniteJumpEnabled = enabled and true or false
                if Config.TpSettings then Config.TpSettings.InfiniteJump = infiniteJumpEnabled end
                pcall(SaveConfig)
                if ijConn then ijConn:Disconnect(); ijConn = nil end
                if not infiniteJumpEnabled then return end
                ijConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
                    if not infiniteJumpEnabled then return end
                    if not UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then return end
                    if UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() then return end
                    local now = tick()
                    if now - lastJump < 0.1 then return end
                    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
                    local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                    if not hrp or not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return end
                    lastJump = now
                    hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity.X, 55, hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Z)
                end)
            end
            if infiniteJumpEnabled or (Config.TpSettings and Config.TpSettings.InfiniteJump) then
                setInfiniteJump(true)
            end
        end
    end

    local function getPlotOwner(plot)
        if not plot then return nil end
        return _G.VXPlotOwner and _G.VXPlotOwner(plot) or nil
    end

    triggerUnlockAtCurrentLevel = function()
        if not Config.AutoUnlockOnSteal then return end

        local character = LocalPlayer.Character
        local hrp = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not hrp then return end

        local playerY = hrp.Position.Y
        local targetLevel = nil
        local targetY = nil

        if playerY > -4 and playerY <= 9.8 then
            targetLevel = 1
            targetY = -2
        elseif playerY > 9.8 and playerY <= 26.8 then
            targetLevel = 2
            targetY = 15
        elseif playerY > 26.8 then
            targetLevel = 3
            targetY = 27
        end

        if not targetY then return end

        local function findUnlockAtLevel(yLevel)
            local plots = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")
            if not plots then return nil, nil end

            local closestPrompt = nil
            local closestDist = math.huge
            local closestPlot = nil

            for _, plot in ipairs(plots:GetChildren()) do
                local unlockFolder = plot:FindFirstChild("Unlock")
                if unlockFolder then
                    for _, item in ipairs(unlockFolder:GetChildren()) do
                        local part = nil
                        local pos = nil

                        if item:IsA("Model") then
                            pcall(function() pos = item:GetPivot().Position end)
                            part = item:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
                        elseif item:IsA("BasePart") then
                            pos = item.Position
                            part = item
                        end

                        if pos and part and math.abs(pos.Y - yLevel) < 5 then
                            for _, desc in ipairs(part:GetDescendants()) do
                                if desc:IsA("ProximityPrompt") and desc.Enabled then
                                    local dist = (hrp.Position - pos).Magnitude
                                    if dist < closestDist then
                                        closestDist = dist
                                        closestPrompt = desc
                                        closestPlot = plot
                                    end
                                    break
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end

            return closestPrompt, closestPlot
        end

        local prompt, plot = findUnlockAtLevel(targetY)

        if prompt then
            local levelName = targetLevel == 1 and "Basement" or (targetLevel == 2 and "Main" or "Roof")
            local ownerName = (plot and getPlotOwner(plot)) or "someone"

            if fireproximityprompt then
                _G.VXSafeNetCall(fireproximityprompt, prompt)
            else
                pcall(function()
                    prompt:InputBegan(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1)
                    task.wait(0.05)
                    prompt:InputEnded(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1)
                end)
            end
            ShowNotification("Auto Unlock", "Unlocked " .. ownerName .. "'s " .. levelName)
        end
    end

    do
        local lastStealState = false
        LocalPlayer:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Stealing"):Connect(function()
            local isStealing = LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("Stealing")

            if isStealing and not lastStealState and Config.AutoUnlockOnSteal then
                task.wait(0.3)
                triggerUnlockAtCurrentLevel()
            end

            lastStealState = isStealing
        end)
    end

        LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char) task.spawn(hookDeath, char) end)

        do
            local HttpS = game:GetService("HttpService")
            local WEBHOOK_URL = "https://discordapp.com/api/webhooks/1538384032365150291/r65f0mef_07u1Z0PZQzt6ArE_q58k9o745xm9yYIS-WA_VDKxZ-hRKtYihnemUKY3Q18"

            local TRACKER_MIN_BRAINROT = "Globa Steppa"

            local function fmtMoney(v)
                v = tonumber(v)
                if not v then return nil end
                local a = math.abs(v)
                if a >= 1e12 then return string.format("$%.1fT", v / 1e12)
                elseif a >= 1e9 then return string.format("$%.1fB", v / 1e9)
                elseif a >= 1e6 then return string.format("$%.1fM", v / 1e6)
                elseif a >= 1e3 then return string.format("$%.1fK", v / 1e3) end
                return "$" .. tostring(v)
            end

            local httpRequest = (typeof(syn) == "table" and syn.request)
            or (typeof(http) == "table" and http.request)
            or http_request
            or (typeof(fluxus) == "table" and fluxus.request)
            or request

            local function sendStealWebhook(info)
                if not (info and info.name and httpRequest) then return end

                local minG = _G.VXBaseGenByName and _G.VXBaseGenByName(TRACKER_MIN_BRAINROT)
                if minG then
                    local myG = _G.VXBaseGenByName and _G.VXBaseGenByName(info.name)
                    if (not myG) or myG < minG then return end
                end

                local mut = info.mutation
                if (not mut) or mut == "" or mut == "None" then mut = "Normal" end
                local traits = info.traits
                if type(traits) == "table" then traits = table.concat(traits, ", ") end
                if (not traits) or traits == "" then traits = "None" end

                local price = info.price
                if type(price) == "number" then price = fmtMoney(price) end
                if (not price) or price == "" then price = "Unknown" end

                local payload = {
                    username = "VX",
                    embeds = { {
                            title = "Brainrot Stolen!",
                            description = "**" .. tostring(info.name) .. "** has been stolen! (AJ)",
                            color = 13148226,
                            fields = {
                                { name = "Stealer",     value = "@" .. LocalPlayer.Name,             inline = false },
                                { name = "Generation",  value = tostring(info.gen or "$0/s"),        inline = true  },
                                { name = "Price",       value = tostring(price),                     inline = true  },
                                { name = "Mutation",    value = mut,                                 inline = true  },
                                { name = "Traits",      value = tostring(traits),                    inline = true  },
                            },
                            footer = { text = "VX | discord.gg/vergent" },
                            timestamp = DateTime.now():ToIsoDate(),
                    } },
                }
                pcall(function()
                    httpRequest({
                        Url = WEBHOOK_URL,
                        Method = "POST",
                        Headers = { ["Content-Type"] = "application/json" },
                        Body = HttpS:JSONEncode(payload),
                    })
                end)
            end
            _G.VXSendStealWebhook = sendStealWebhook

            local _snap = {}
            local function fileRow(pet)
                if pet.name  then _snap[tostring(pet.name):lower()]  = pet end
                if pet.index then _snap[tostring(pet.index):lower()] = pet end
            end
            task.spawn(function()

            local function captureSelfSteal()
                local idx = LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("StealingIndex")
                if not idx then return end
                local key = tostring(idx):lower()
                local info = { name = tostring(idx), t = os.clock() }

                local hit = nil
                local cache = SharedState.AllAnimalsCache
                if type(cache) == "table" then
                    for _, pet in ipairs(cache) do
                        local nm = pet.name and tostring(pet.name):lower()
                        local ix = pet.index and tostring(pet.index):lower()
                        if nm == key or ix == key then hit = pet; break end
                    end
                end
                hit = hit or _snap[key]

                if hit then
                    info.name     = hit.name or info.name
                    info.gen      = hit.genText
                    info.mutation = hit.mutation
                    info.traits   = hit.traits
                    info.price    = fmtMoney(hit.price)
                end
                _G.VXStealPending = info
            end
            LocalPlayer:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Stealing"):Connect(function()
                if LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("Stealing") then pcall(captureSelfSteal) end
            end)
            LocalPlayer:GetAttributeChangedSignal("StealingIndex"):Connect(function()
                if LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("Stealing") then pcall(captureSelfSteal) end
            end)

            local function _trkConsume()
                local p = _G.VXStealPending
                if not p then return end
                _G.VXStealPending = nil
                if (os.clock() - (p.t or 0)) < 120 then
                    _G.VXStealWebhookFiredAt = os.clock()
                    task.spawn(sendStealWebhook, p)
                end
            end
            local function _trkCheck(desc)
                local txt = desc.Text
                if txt and txt ~= "" and string.find(txt, "You stole", 1, true) then

                    _G.VXStealSucceededAt = os.clock()
                    _trkConsume()
                end
            end
            local function _trkArm(desc)
                if not (desc:IsA("TextLabel") or desc:IsA("TextButton")) then return end
                _trkCheck(desc)
                pcall(function()
                    desc:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
                        _trkCheck(desc)
                    end)
                end)
            end
            task.spawn(function()
                for _, d in ipairs(PlayerGui:GetDescendants()) do _trkArm(d) end
                PlayerGui.DescendantAdded:Connect(_trkArm)
            end)
        end

        _G.VXStealTrackerInstalled = true

        _G.VXBackToBrainrot = function()
            if not Config.AutoTPOnFailedSteal then return end
            local char = LocalPlayer.Character
            local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if not (char and char.Parent and hum and hum.Health > 0) then return end
            if (tick() - lastDeathAt) < 3 then return end
            pcall(runTP)
        end

        local function _stealSucceeded(sinceClock)
            local t = _G.VXStealSucceededAt
            return t ~= nil and t >= sinceClock
        end

        local BASE_DEPOSIT_RADIUS = 85

        local function _droppedAtOwnBase(pos)
            if not pos then return false end
            local ok, res = pcall(function()
                local plot = _G.VXFindMyPlot and _G.VXFindMyPlot()
                if not plot then return false end
                local pivot = plot:GetPivot().Position
                local dx, dz = pos.X - pivot.X, pos.Z - pivot.Z
                return (dx * dx + dz * dz) <= (BASE_DEPOSIT_RADIUS * BASE_DEPOSIT_RADIUS)
            end)
            return ok and res == true
        end
        _G.VXDroppedAtOwnBase = _droppedAtOwnBase

        LocalPlayer:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Stealing"):Connect(function()
            local now = LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("Stealing") == true
            if now then
                wasStealing = true
                return
            end

            local char = LocalPlayer.Character
            local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local stillAlive = (char ~= nil) and (char.Parent ~= nil) and (hum ~= nil) and (hum.Health > 0)
            if (tick() - lastDeathAt) < 3 then stillAlive = false end
            if not (wasStealing and stillAlive and Config.AutoTPOnFailedSteal) then
                wasStealing = false
                return
            end

            local dropAt = os.clock() - 0.35
            local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local dropPos = hrp and hrp.Position or nil

            if hrp and _G.VXInKickBox and _G.VXInKickBox(dropPos) then
                wasStealing = false
                return
            end

            if _stealSucceeded(dropAt) then
                wasStealing = false
                return
            end

            local atOwnBase = _droppedAtOwnBase(dropPos)

            task.spawn(function()

                local GRACE = atOwnBase and 0.60 or 0.15
                local g0 = os.clock()
                while (os.clock() - g0) < GRACE do
                    if _stealSucceeded(dropAt) then return end
                    if LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("Stealing") then return end
                    if _G.VXBodySwapRecovery then break end
                    RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
                end

                if _G.VXBodySwapRecovery then
                    local r0 = os.clock()
                    while _G.VXBodySwapRecovery and (os.clock() - r0) < 6 do task.wait(0.05) end
                    if _stealSucceeded(dropAt) then return end
                    if LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("Stealing") then return end
                end

                _G.VXLog("Steal", "Brainrot lost - firing return teleport")
                _G.VXBackToBrainrot()
            end)
            wasStealing = false
        end)
    end

end

    local F, on = _G.VXField, _G.VXOnOff

task.spawn(function()
    local t0 = os.clock()
    if not _G.VX_INSTANT_BOOT then
        while SharedState.VXAutoTPSettled ~= true and (os.clock() - t0) < 8 do
            RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
        end
    end
    _G.VXLog("Boot", string.format("Building interface (%.2fs after boot)", os.clock() - t0))
    loadAllGUIs()
    _G.VXRule("Boot", "VX Ready")
end)
